jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer (Databricks) - Spain
jobs.description:
At DATAPAO, data ignites passion, community fuels collaboration, and growth knows no bounds. We are a leading Data Engineering and AI consulting company backed by Databricks and recognized for our unmatched delivery standards and rapid growth. We have been named Databricks EMEA Emerging Business Partner of the Year (2024), achieved the Golden Tier status in the Databricks Partner Program, and made three consecutive appearances on the Financial Times FT1000 list.

We are currently looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join us remotely in Spain. You will work with our EMEA and US customers to help them solve their data engineering, ML, ML Ops, and cloud migration puzzles.

"As a Data Engineer at DATAPAO, you will have the unique opportunity to push the boundaries of technology and lead the way in how data transforms the world. We work with customers who want to innovate and change their industries. So it never gets boring! Sorting out a complex technical puzzle, setting up a new data architecture from scratch, or guiding our customers through adopting the latest technologies is our routine here. Hence, we'd expect you to be more than just a (data) engineer. We'd expect you to breathe and live data, to thrive for knowledge and excellence, and to be keen to build something enduring and impactful for our customers. We'd expect you to be a (data) Paoneer!" (Máté Gulyás, CEO)

What will you do?

As a Senior Data Engineer, you are expected to deliver (across industries) on some of our most complex projects - individually or by leading small delivery teams. Although we work for the biggest multinational companies where years-long behemoth projects are the norm, our projects are fast-paced, typically 2 to 4 months long. Most are delivered using Apache Spark/Databricks on AWS/Azure and require you to directly manage the customer relationship alone or in collaboration with a Project Manager. Additionally, at this seniority level, we expect you to compound your impact across the team and the organization - by supporting our pre-sales process, mentoring more junior engineers, and contributing to hiring best-in-class data talent.

What does it take to fit the bill?

Technical Expertise

  • You (ideally) have 5+ years of experience in Data Engineering, with a focus on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP);
  • You have a proven track record working with Databricks (PySpark, SQL, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog);
  • You have extensive experience in ETL/ELT development and data pipeline orchestration (e.g., Databricks Workflows, DLT, Airflow, ADF, Glue, and Step Functions.);
  • You’re proficient in SQL and Python, using them to transform and optimize data like a pro;
  • You know your way around CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or Bicep);
  • You’ve hands-on experience integrating Databricks with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker).

Consulting & Client-Facing Skills

  • Ideally, you bring a proven history in consulting, from scoping to gathering requirements, designing solutions, and communicating effectively with stakeholders. If you bring a product company background with you, that's also fine as long as you can show a good consulting mindset and desire to be customer-facing;
  • You’ve successfully delivered projects like Data Lakehouse buildouts and cloud data migrations;
  • You excel in explaining technical concepts to non-technical audiences and drive decision-making.

Operational Readiness & Soft Skills

  • You’re (almost) ready to hit the ground running, immediately contributing to live client projects;
  • In a fast-paced consulting environment, where no two days are the same, flexibility and problem-solving comes naturally to you. Furthermore, resilience and thriving on challenges are essential traits in our industry;
  • Your communication skills are on point—whether you’re writing, speaking, or collaborating with stakeholders, you know how to keep everyone in the loop.

What do we offer?

You'll have the rare opportunity to join DATAPAO at a time when you can still meaningfully impact our growth trajectory and organizational success. Furthermore, as our first-ever Spain hire, you could meaningfully contribute to expanding our local presence and, eventually, establishing a physical hub in this geography.

Surely, we know everyone needs a little something to do their best work. Here is a list of some other extras we offer:

  • The chance to work remotely - as we don't have a physical office in Spain yet, we offer a fully remote setup for the time being. However, given our strong community emphasis, we'd expect you to spend one month in our Budapest hub during onboarding and visit the office for one week every quarter;

  • World-class educational benefits - there’s no shortage of learning opportunities at DATAPAO, meaning that you'll get access to Databricks' public and internal courses to learn all the tricks of Distributed Data Processing, MLOps, Apache Spark, Databricks, and Cloud Migration from the best. Additionally, we'll pay for various data & cloud certifications, you'll get dedicated time for learning during work hours, and access to our internal library;

  • Flexible PTO days - we’re flexible with how many days you take off if that does not conflict with customer success and the work getting done;

  • Fully paid Medical Leave for up to 15 days per year - because when you’re unwell, we want you to focus on recovery and not worry about your paycheck;

  • Comprehensive private health insurance plan via Allianz - offered via our EOR (Employer of Record) provider, Remote.com. Remote will be your official employer in Spain for the foreseeable future until we establish our own legal entity in Spain;

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) via Allianz & Remote - life always happens! And we'd like to be there for you when it counts the most. Through EAP, we offer our employees access to psychology, financial, and legal consulting services via phone or in person;

  • Top-notch working equipment - working comfortably means working well. You will get a MacBook Pro and a sign-up bonus of 500 EUR gross (to be paid with your first payroll) to set up your home office or whatever else is needed to give your best;

  • The chance to make an impact in a high-transparency culture - open feedback and no politics are things we value a lot at DATAPAO. Additionally, you'll get the chance to work in the field of data & AI and shape the future of a rapidly growing tech company.

IMPORTANT NOTE: Given that we are still sorting our way in Spain, this list will likely get an update in the following months, and we're also committed to growing it with us over time.

The gross salary for this position ranges from 70.000 to 80.000 EUR/year, depending on your assessed seniority level during the selection process.

Please note that currently we are unable to support transfer or offer full sponsorship for Skilled Worker visas as we’re just setting foot into Spain.

Want to know more about us?

DATAPAO is a Databricks Gold Partner covering the full data and AI journey — architecture, delivery, and enablement — for global brands that refuse to settle for "good enough." We don't hand over a slide deck and walk away: our engineers embed directly with client teams, and our training arm has turned 20,000+ professionals into Databricks experts worldwide.
We're backed by Databricks itself — the creators of Apache Spark — and act as their delivery and training partner across Europe. That partnership has earned us Databricks EMEA Emerging Partner of the Year, and a spot on the Financial Times FT1000 list of Europe's fastest-growing companies for the third year running (2026).
We've delivered 200+ projects for clients like Norsk-Hydro, Richter, Egis, Schufa, GetYourGuide, TechnoAlpin, and Logically, to name a few. As trainers, we've taught teams at NASDAQ, Imperial Brands, Accenture, Shell, UBS, Danske Bank, Pfizer, ASDA, Heineken, Hays, and Citigroup how to put data to work — not just talk about it.
Curious to see us in action? Check these out:
  • Databricks Data + AI Summit 2026: The Biggest Announcements Explained (EN) by Máté Gulyás
  • How Databricks Builds Production AI (EN) by Brooke Wenig, Head of AI FDE at Databricks — Data+AI Summit 2026
  • TechnoAlpin × Datapao: How TechnoAlpin Modernized Its Data Platform on Databricks — a client's take on working with us
You can also follow us on LinkedIn for all the good stuff, or just hit our recruitment team at
We're firm believers in scaling up a team without judgment or prejudice. What we really care about is working with the best people out there, no matter their background. And you should also not worry if you don't tick every box in the requirements. If you're passionate about data and learning new things, you'll fit right in, and we'd love to hear back from you.
When we hear back from you, we'd like you to know that we are committed to your privacy and keeping your data safe. jobs.title: Software Systems Architect - Clearance Required
jobs.description:
Overview

LMI is seeking an experienced Software Systems Architect to support the U.S. Army Training Information System (ATIS) program and the ALCMC delivery team. ATIS is a major Army initiative to modernize and consolidate Army training systems into a secure, cloud-native, enterprise-level capability. As part of an Agile Release Train (ART) operating under the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe), this role will lead team-level technical architecture and solution design, establish architectural runway, guide interface and integration decisions, and enable the team to deliver secure, scalable, and maintainable capabilities within broader solution architecture guardrails.

This is a highly technical, collaborative, and hands-on individual contributor role. The Software Systems Architect will work directly with developers, Product Management, DevSecOps, testing, cybersecurity, and Solution Architecture to translate mission and product needs into implementable designs, reduce technical ambiguity and rework, manage architectural and technical-debt risks, and ensure architecture actively enables delivery rather than becoming an approval gate.

The ideal candidate combines strong architectural judgment with hands-on software engineering experience and is comfortable working directly with engineering teams through design, implementation, integration, troubleshooting, and technical problem solving.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

  • Lead team-level solution design and translate mission, product, functional, and non-functional requirements into implementable technical designs.
  • Develop and maintain the team’s architectural runway, identifying technical enablers, dependencies, constraints, and architectural work needed to support upcoming capabilities.
  • Lead interface and integration design across applications, services, APIs, data sources, external systems, and shared platform capabilities.
  • Define and guide implementation of non-functional requirements (NFRs), including security, performance, reliability, scalability, maintainability, observability, and testability.
  • Establish and guide team technology standards, reusable architectural patterns, reference implementations, and engineering guardrails in alignment with broader Solution Architecture direction.
  • Partner with the Product Owner and Solution Architect to identify, assess, and prioritize technical debt based on mission impact, delivery risk, maintainability, and architectural health.
  • Create and maintain architecture diagrams, system and component models, interface definitions, architectural decision records, and other technical documentation that directly supports development and delivery.
  • Work directly with developers through design sessions, whiteboarding, implementation, code and design reviews, troubleshooting, and technical mentoring to ensure architectural decisions are practical and implemented effectively.
  • Collaborate with DevSecOps, testing, UX, cybersecurity, Product Management, and other stakeholders to ensure architecture supports secure CI/CD, automated testing, deployment, integration, and operational requirements.
  • Identify cross-team, environment, infrastructure, integration, and external dependencies early and drive the technical coordination necessary to reduce delivery risk.
  • Remain actively engaged in implementation and technical problem solving, including root-cause analysis of complex or recurring defects, integration issues, environment constraints, and architectural problems.
  • Promote reusable solutions, knowledge sharing, and team self-sufficiency while reducing unnecessary complexity and reliance on tribal knowledge.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • 7+ years of professional software engineering, application development, systems engineering, or technical architecture experience, including hands-on responsibility for designing and delivering production software.
  • Demonstrated experience with software/application architecture and system design, including translating functional and non-functional requirements into implementable technical solutions and making architecture tradeoffs.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud environments (AWS preferred) and understanding of cloud architecture, secure networking, identity and access management, service integration, and deployment considerations.
  • Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs and integrating applications, services, data sources, and external systems.
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, Git-based workflows, automation, and DevSecOps practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to work directly with software developers through technical design, implementation guidance, code/design reviews, troubleshooting, and complex problem solving.
  • Demonstrated ability to address non-functional requirements including security, performance, reliability, scalability, maintainability, observability, and testability.
  • Strong technical communication and collaborative leadership skills, with the ability to explain architecture decisions and tradeoffs to engineering, Product Management, testing, DevSecOps, cybersecurity, leadership, and other stakeholders.
  • Experience working in Agile software delivery environments and leading team-level technical decisions while operating within broader solution or enterprise architecture guardrails.
  • Active DoD Secret security clearance or ability to obtain and maintain one.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with modern UI/frontend technologies and frameworks such as Angular, including frontend-to-backend integration patterns.
  • Broad technical knowledge spanning applications, cloud, infrastructure/platforms, cybersecurity, integrations, data, and delivery pipelines.
  • Experience with microservices, containers, Kubernetes, Docker, or comparable modern application/platform architectures.
  • Familiarity with architectural decision records, reference architectures, technology standards, reusable architectural patterns, and lightweight architecture governance.
  • AWS certification (e.g., Solutions Architect or DevOps Engineer) and/or demonstrated depth in AWS architecture.
  • Experience working within a SAFe Agile Release Train (ART) and supporting architectural runway, technical enablers, PI Planning, and cross-team dependency management.
  • Experience supporting Army, DoD, federal, or other secure/regulated mission systems, including familiarity with ATO/RMF processes.
  • Experience with ATIS, Army training systems, learning management systems (LMS), or similar enterprise mission systems is a plus.
  • Additional useful experience includes UI/UX, accessibility testing, organizational change management, and demonstrated ability to rapidly learn unfamiliar technologies.

Travel Requirements

  • Occasional travel required, including for PI Planning, program increment events, user engagement sessions, architecture/design workshops, and key program milestones.

jobs.description:
Overview

LMI is seeking an experienced Data Engineer – Army Vantage / Palantir Foundry to support the U.S. Army Training Information System (ATIS) program. This hands-on role will develop, maintain, and improve ATIS data products and integrations, with a primary focus on capabilities delivered through Army Vantage and Palantir Foundry.

The Data Engineer will transform authoritative ATIS data into reliable, reusable enterprise data products and ensure Vantage/Foundry capabilities integrate effectively with the broader ATIS data ecosystem. The ideal candidate has hands-on Foundry experience, strong data-engineering skills, and the ability to independently identify and resolve end-to-end data quality and integration issues across ATIS and Vantage/Foundry.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, troubleshoot, and enhance ATIS data products, datasets, pipelines, applications, dashboards, and related capabilities within Army Vantage/Palantir Foundry.
  • Design, build, and sustain production-quality data pipelines and transformations using Python, SQL, PySpark, and native Foundry capabilities.
  • Develop and maintain Foundry ontology objects, relationships, and data models that make authoritative ATIS data understandable, reusable, and accessible to approved users.
  • Integrate authoritative ATIS data with Vantage/Foundry and other Army enterprise data sources while maintaining data quality, lineage, and appropriate access controls.
  • Trace, diagnose, and drive resolution of end-to-end data quality and integration issues across ATIS source data, interfaces, transformations, pipelines, and Vantage/Foundry products.
  • Develop Foundry-native dashboards, applications, reports, and other data products to support Army analytics, visualization, reporting, and mission needs.
  • Implement data-quality validation, monitoring, scheduling, error handling, and other practices necessary to operate reliable production data products.
  • Apply sound software and data-engineering practices, including version control, peer review, testing, documentation, and CI/CD where supported.
  • Work directly with product owners, engineers, architects, analysts, and users to translate mission needs into practical technical solutions and support appropriate use of authoritative ATIS data.
  • Document solutions, share knowledge, and build team capability so ATIS can sustain and extend its data and Foundry capabilities without creating single-person dependencies.
  • Operate as a self-directed member of the Agile team, taking ownership of technical outcomes and independently driving problems toward resolution.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • 4+ years of professional experience in data engineering, data integration, software development, or development of production data products.
  • Hands-on experience developing or maintaining solutions in Palantir Foundry and/or Army Vantage, with sufficient familiarity to contribute with limited platform-specific ramp-up.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and Python for data transformation, analysis, automation, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience designing, building, and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines involving complex or disparate datasets.
  • Experience with data modeling, including schemas, keys, relationships, reference data, and transformation of source data into reusable data products.
  • Experience with Foundry ontology, semantic data models, or comparable enterprise data structures.
  • Experience with PySpark, Spark, Pandas, or comparable technologies for transforming complex datasets.
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot data pipelines, integrations, data-quality issues, and production data products, including tracing problems across source systems and downstream consumers.
  • Ability to work independently from mission intent or a desired end state while collaborating effectively with multidisciplinary technical and product teams.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and documentation skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to nontechnical stakeholders.

jobs.description:
Mission - Why we exist, what we do, and why we need you

SpotMe is a leading B2B event platform that helps enterprises increase the impact of their events by delivering CRM-connected, high-quality experiences across in-person, virtual, hybrid events, and webinars. With a strong focus on life sciences, SpotMe powers Onomi: the Live HCP Engagement Platform that enables medical and commercial teams to run impactful congresses, symposia, advisory boards, and webinars. Together, SpotMe and Onomi turn live events into a company’s most effective engagement channel.

Pharma companies use event platforms as registration forms while request, approval, budget, HCP registration, transfer of value (ToV), and reporting run in Excel and at agencies. We are building Onomi 360, the life-sciences strategic meetings management (SMM) product, to replace the incumbent event platform in that space. First accounts already run their meeting requests and approvals in Onomi 360; the demand is validated and the trajectory is exciting.

Your focus will be MeetingsEQ, the SMM layer of Onomi 360: one front door for every request, approval and budget as configuration, unified HCP identity, per-attendee ToV allocation, and engagement and spend flowing back into the CRM without re-keying. The customer's CRM and master data stay where they are; the event platform behind the meetings program is where we play. AI-assisted development is how we work, and you will have real freedom to use it.

This position is the ideal role for a hands-on product leader from the life-sciences meetings, compliance, or HCP-data world who would rather ship and test than talk about the problem, and who wants to own one product end to end and see the process they once operated replaced with a modern, AI-first workflow.

As a Senior Product Manager, Onomi 360, you will be reporting to the VP Product. Your time will be spent on:

  • [35%] Defining the detailed product. Turn customer workbooks, operating procedures, RFP requirements, and our capability map into roadmap priorities and build-ready specifications.
  • [30%] Shipping. Work daily with design and engineering in the Onomi 360 codebase: thin production slices, prototypes, scope calls, validation in the running product. Daily AI-based prototyping and customer validation.
  • [25%] Customers and partners. Work with meetings operations, compliance, medical affairs, finance, agencies, and the customer’s data team. Define how Onomi 360 works with Veeva, Salesforce, Snowflake, and consent, and own the venue-sourcing and fair-market-value partner integrations.
  • [10%] Product truth. Keep what we claim, what we demo, and what we ship documented, clear and moving in the right direction.

Objectives - The problems you will solve

In your first month, you will:

  • Take over the first customer’s move from their meeting request form to Onomi 360: spec, build, history migration, customer session.
  • Get set up with AI-based toolkit and the Onomi 360 codebase, and use both in your daily work.
  • Meet the early access customers (design partners) for Onomi 360.

After 3 months, you will have:

  • The first customer live on meeting request and approvals in Onomi 360, measured against their baseline.
  • The roadmap priorities for the next two quarters defined, and the first priorities specified to build depth with engineering.
  • A clean separation everyone uses: aspirational (slides), forward-looking (prototype-based demo), and committed (roadmap and backlog).

After 6 months, you will have:

  • The full end-to-end MeetingsEQ product specified and engineering-reviewed, request through approval, budget, HCP registration, ToV, and reporting.
  • One customer replacing Excel with the Onomi 360 ToV module, and the first live account expanded from request and approval into budget, ToV, or venue sourcing.

After 12 months, you will have:

  • One customer closing a full ToV reporting cycle in Onomi 360 instead of Excel.
  • Three accounts running request to closure in production, and the org-wide calendar or HCP engagement view used outside compliance.
  • Onomi 360 winning the meetings-management scope in RFPs.

What you need to be great at

  • Life-sciences meetings, compliance, or transparency operations. You have built or operated workflows spanning approval, budgeting, ToV, and closure, and you know what EFPIA and Sunshine disclosure mean in practice.
  • HCP data and integration fluency. Identity across Veeva, Salesforce, OneKey, and NPI; match rates; what a data team expects from a write-back.
  • Domain-to-product translation. A messy operating process becomes states, rules, configuration, permissions, and audit events, with regulation separated from customer policy.
  • Sequencing. The smallest production slice that proves the model without hiding the hard architectural or compliance question.
  • Bias to execute. You ship, prototype, and put things in front of users in days, not spend weeks describing the problem. You drive decisions to a close and pull others along.
  • Precise writing and direct communication. Specs detailed enough to build and review, plain words, disagreement in the open.
  • Technical and AI fluency. You work in Claude Code or OpenAI Codex, you understand code, data flows, and architecture well enough to challenge an engineering design. You know the software development lifecycle deeply, from RFC and specification through review, release, and support. AI takes you from evidence to a testable artifact in hours.

What we want to hear about

  1. Life-sciences meetings and transfer of value. Tell us about a meetings or transfer-of-value process you built or ran end to end, from request through approval, budget, HCP registration, and disclosure. Where did it break, and what did you change? This is the process Onomi 360 replaces, and we want someone who has lived it.
  2. From operating process to product. Tell us about a messy process you turned into a product: which rules you made fixed, which you made configurable, what you integrated, and what you left manual. That translation is the heart of this role.
  3. Shipping fast. Tell us about the last thing you shipped or prototyped within two weeks of first hearing the problem. What did you skip, and what did users do with it? Here you put working software in front of pharma design partners every few weeks, not slides.
  4. Building with AI. Tell us about something you built yourself with Claude Code or another AI tool that changed a product decision, and what it taught you about the code or the architecture underneath. AI-assisted development is how we build, and you will have real freedom to use it.

Fluent English (written and spoken). Remote, based in Europe or in the US Eastern or Central time zones, with about 10-20 % travel to design partners and industry events.

You'll build algorithms spanning mixed-integer programming, constraint optimization, and ML-driven forecasting that turn hard supply constraints into defensible, auditable allocation decisions.   • Design and implement optimization models (e.g., mixed-integer linear programming, constraint programming) for allocating scarce parts and resources across competing programs.

  • Translate ambiguous, competing program priorities into formal objective functions and constraints.
  • Validate model outputs against historical allocation decisions and stakeholder expectations; iterate on formulations as new constraints emerge.
  • Build and maintain the data pipelines needed to keep optimization models current with live inventory, demand, and program data.
  • Present modeling tradeoffs and recommendations to non-technical program and supply-chain stakeholders.

  • Strong Python skills, with experience in ML frameworks (e.g., scikit-learn, PyTorch) and data manipulation libraries (pandas, NumPy).
  • Experience working with messy, real-world supply chain, inventory, or program data.
  • Excellent communication skills; comfortable presenting complex tradeoffs to program and business stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with allocation problems in aerospace, defense, or manufacturing supply chains.
  • Familiarity with ERP systems (e.g., SAP) and how allocation decisions flow into procurement and production planning.
  • Experience deploying optimization models as production services (APIs, batch pipelines).
  • Exposure to reinforcement learning or Bayesian methods for decision-making under uncertainty.

jobs.title: Digital Designer
jobs.description:
Digital Designer

PH location / Remote first

Want to challenge yourself at a purpose-led scale up AND make a difference in the world? Come join the revolootion!

Funny name, serious business We make eco-friendly products and donate 50% of our profits to provide clean water and help build toilets for the billions of people who lack proper access. So far, we’ve contributed over $18 million AUD (roughly $12.5 million USD) to fund sanitation projects around the globe. Basically, we’re really good at doing good. With hubs in Australia, the Philippines, China, the US, UK and Europe, our amazing team of 200+ work to make the biggest possible impact for people and the planet. Over the next couple of years, we’re hoping to increase our annual donation tenfold to get us closer to our dream of everyone in the world having access to clean water and sanitation services.

A bit about the role We are looking for a creative and collaborative Digital Designer to join our Digital Product team! In this role, your goal is simple: help us design the digital experiences that turn curious consumers into loyal subscribers.

Working closely with our eCommerce Specialist, Growth Marketing, and Creative partners, you will take our brand campaigns and translate them into engaging on-site experiences. You’ll work closely with our Product Designer on the storefront, with a focus on visual craft, brand expression, and keeping the storefront looking fresh and commercially effective.

We are also excited for this person to embrace AI. You'll use AI tools to speed up your day-to-day workflow—handling routine formatting and generating assets so you have more time to spend on the actual creative craft that AI can't replicate.

If you worked here this past month, here are some things you might have been involved in:

  • Helping design a site takeover for a new product launch (like adding a cameo from “Clammy” as a temporary avatar during our Splash Limited Edition).
  • Using AI tools to generate draft assets and format standard banners, saving yourself hours of manual resizing.
  • Collaborating with Growth Marketing to iterate on landing pages, making sure the design connects the ad content smoothly to the shop experience.
  • Partnering with the Product Designer to ensure your campaign placements fit nicely within the everyday storefront.
  • Updating standard campaign placements (banners, hero treatments, product callouts) to keep the site looking unmistakably Who Gives A Crap.
  • Sprinkling digital easter eggs across the site that reward curiosity (like hiding toilets across the site for a "Where's the Loo" Limited Edition campaign).

Let’s talk about you
You are a solid visual designer who understands that great digital design isn't just about looking good—it's about helping the customer find what they need. You have a great eye for typography and composition, and you're eager to learn how your designs impact metrics like conversion.

Here’s what we're hoping you'll bring to the table:

  • Visual Craft: You have a strong portfolio of digital work. You know how to take a campaign brief and apply it to digital surfaces while keeping the brand feeling consistent and high-quality.
  • Curiosity around AI: You are comfortable experimenting with AI tools to speed up your production work, but you know that the final brand finish and quality control always stay with you.
  • Commercial Interest: You want to know why a design works. You're curious about how campaigns perform on site and are open to using customer insights to tweak your designs.
  • A Collaborative Mindset: You are a great team player. You listen well, adapt your communication style depending on who you are working with (marketing, engineering, etc.), and take constructive feedback in stride.
  • Time Management: You know how to juggle multiple tasks. Campaign work moves fast, so you are good at prioritizing your time, keeping the team updated on your progress, and flagging when you need help.

You give a crap
Do you want your work to make the world a better place? Do you want to work with other people who feel the same way? What a coincidence — us too!

Why should you work with us?
First off, as a certified B Corp™, we work to make a difference every day while maintaining the highest standards of social and environmental impact. With our most recent score of 125.5 we’re in very good company with other exceptional B Corps around the world. We also believe that helping to make the world a better place should be rewarded accordingly – that’s why we offer competitive, market informed salaries, meaningful support towards healthcare for our team around the world, generous paid leave, tailored learning and development opportunities, and free toilet paper (yes, you read that right). Our engagement surveys (thanks Culture Amp!) tell us that our team is really proud (95%) to work for Who Gives A Crap and, well, we couldn’t be more proud of that.

Have you made it this far?
If you’re still reading, we think there’s a strong chance you might be our kind of person. Here’s the thing, though — research suggests that 60% of women and underrepresented folks might have already talked themselves out of applying. Even if you don’t check every box above, we want to encourage you to introduce yourself. We believe a diversity of perspectives and experiences makes a team stronger — and the stronger our team, the closer we are to delivering toilets and clean water for all.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Growth
jobs.description:
Who is Credible?

Credible is a leading U.S. consumer finance marketplace, transforming the way consumers access and compare financial products. We operate at a consumer and enterprise level. On the consumer side, we help millions of people make smarter financial decisions by comparing personalized, pre-qualified offers across student loans, personal loans, mortgages, credit cards, and insurance — all without impacting their credit score. On the enterprise side, we power financial product comparison and distribution through deep integrations and partnerships with lenders, insurance carriers, and financial institutions, as well as providing marketplace technology and capabilities to third-party partners and distribution channels.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the CRO (conversion rate optimization) of Credible's performance marketing landing pages and on-site funnel. This is a high-impact, cross-functional role sitting at the intersection of performance marketing, product, and data - responsible for the experiments roadmap, landing page creation and optimization, and the testing infrastructure that helps Credible convert more of its paid traffic into qualified leads.

You will work directly with the Head of Performance Marketing and partner closely with Engineering, Design, and BI to run a continuous stream of CRO experiments. The ideal candidate combines strong product instincts with a quantitative mindset and a bias for shipping tests quickly over building perfect solutions.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own the experiments roadmap: maintain and prioritize a rolling backlog of CRO and landing page experiments across all verticals (Personal Loans, Student Loan Refi, Private Student Loans, Insurance, etc.); sequence tests by impact and dependency
  • Landing page creation & optimization using Credible’s CMS: collaborate with Design, Engineering, and Marketing to build and refine landing pages that boost Quality Score, load speed, conversion rates, and overall CMS capabilities
  • A/B test design and analysis: define hypotheses, success metrics, and minimum detectable effects for each experiment; own statistical analysis and present clear readouts with recommended next steps
  • Funnel performance ownership: track and own KPIs across the paid funnel — click-to-prequal rate, prequal-to-submit rate, submit-to-approval rate — and identify the highest-leverage drop-off points
  • Cross-functional execution: coordinate with Engineering on implementation timelines, with BI on instrumentation and event tracking, and with the SEM team on campaign alignment and Quality Score requirements
  • Performance reporting: build and maintain dashboards that give the marketing team real-time visibility into experiment status, landing page performance, and conversion trends
  • Conversion signal infrastructure: partner with the BI Engineer to improve offline conversion data quality and ensure experiment results feed back accurately into Google Ads bidding signals
  • User insight synthesis: use session recordings, heatmaps, funnel analytics, and qualitative feedback to generate testable hypotheses and maintain a prioritized insight backlog

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE

  • Experience: 5+ years in a Product Management role with a strong focus on conversion rate optimization, growth, or performance marketing products
  • CRO depth: hands-on experience designing, running, and analyzing A/B tests on landing pages or on-site funnels; familiarity with statistical significance, sample sizing, and experiment pitfalls
  • Marketing fluency: strong understanding of paid acquisition mechanics - Quality Score, landing page relevance, campaign-to-page alignment, and how conversion rate impacts paid channel economics
  • Technical collaboration: able to write clear specs, work closely with engineers on implementation, and understand front-end constraints without needing to code
  • Data skills: experienced with Google Analytics, Looker, or similar analytics tools
  • Speed and pragmatism: bias for launching imperfect tests quickly over waiting for perfect conditions; comfortable operating in a high-iteration environment
  • Communication: strong written English; able to present experiment results and strategic recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Education: Bachelor's degree; quantitative, engineering, or business background preferred

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience at a FinTech, financial marketplace, or lead-generation company
  • Familiarity with Google Ads Quality Score and how landing page experience affects paid channel performance
  • Experience with Strapi
  • Experience with tools like Optimizely, VWO, Google Optimize, or similar experimentation platforms
  • Background working with session replay tools (Hotjar, FullStory) and funnel analytics (Mixpanel, Amplitude)
  • Prior experience in a performance marketing or growth role before moving into PM
  • Experience managing experiments across mobile and desktop simultaneously

This role is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, various benefits, including medical/dental/vision, insurance, a 401(k) plan, paid time off, and other benefits in accordance with applicable plan documents.

View more details about Credible Benefits

For high cost of labor markets such as but not limited to New York City and San Francisco:
$140,000—$165,000 USD
For all other US locations:
$120,000—$150,000 USD

Why work at Credible?

We combine the intelligence, expertise, and confidence of a financial advisor with the approachability and honesty of a friend. In other words, we’re the friend you always wish you had in finance.

We are optimistic, challengers, trustworthy, clever, and smart. We are open and transparent. We strive to act as advisors by being friendly, objective, and open in our communication. We use language that is intelligent yet approachable. When appropriate, we’ll drop in a bit of wit to position ourselves as a fresh, reliable voice in the financial world.

Our Deep Learning technology captures user behavior and utilizes machine learning to connect people with the products, content, and information they need. Brands including American Airlines, Lenovo, Red Hat, and Cisco Systems rely on Lucidworks' suite of products to power commerce, customer service, and workplace applications that delight customers and empower employees. jobs.title: Agile Coach (FTC)
jobs.description:
TrustedHousesitters is a fast growing, direct-to-consumer marketplace that is redefining pet care and travel.

Here at TrustedHousesitters, we’re on a mission to make travel work better for pets, for their people, and for the global community of animal lovers who look after them. We’ve got big plans on becoming the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people. We’ve built something pretty special: a trusted place where pet owners and sitters connect to keep pets happy at home while their humans explore the world.

We’ve already grown into a global community with members in over 140 countries, a product people genuinely love, and a team of more than 100 brilliant humans powering it all.

But we’re only just getting started. Our goal? To grow to 1 million members and make TrustedHousesitters the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people.

At the moment, a sit starts every two minutes somewhere on the planet. We want that to be every single minute and we know the only way we’ll get there is with the right people in the right roles.

The right people in the right roles will shape our future. So, here’s the big question: Could that be you?

About The Role

We're looking for an Agile Coach to enable our Product Engineering squads to work more effectively together across the full product development lifecycle - from problem definition and discovery, through to delivery, release and outcome measurement. You’ll bring consistency and rigour to how individual squads work at every stage, and own the consistency of how those squads plan, visualise progress, and share their work.

We're looking for someone with solid, hands-on coaching experience who's not afraid to roll up their sleeves and get stuck into squad ways of working and drive impact.

You'll work closely with Product Managers, Engineering Managers, Product Designers, Software Engineers, Data Analysts, and leadership across Product Engineering. Rather than spreading thin across every team at once, you'll typically go deep - spending an extended period (for example, a quarter) embedded with one or two squads at a time, building the relationships and trust needed to drive real, measurable change before moving focus elsewhere.

What you'll do

  • Coach squads to embed effective agile and product-centric practices helping teams adopt dual-track ways of working so research and discovery run effectively alongside delivery.

  • Guide teams as they mature their delivery practices and adopt product-centred planning and prioritisation approaches.

  • Coach teams on outcomes over output, helping them understand whether what they shipped actually had the desired customer and business impact.

  • Facilitate team-level meetings (refinement, retrospectives, planning) as required as part of team coaching.

  • Help drive our shift left quality approach.

  • Eliminate blockers through creative conversation and become a trusted advisor to the teams you work with.

  • Offer insight on which metrics best measure team effectiveness and how to improve them over time.

  • Act as a catalyst for change and experimentation, embedding an agile mindset without imposing a one-size-fits-all solution.

  • Coach teams to build and sustain the habit of keeping their roadmaps, delivery plans, and progress clearly visualised spotting where consistency is slipping across squads and working with the relevant people to close the gap.

  • Own the cadence of cross-squad sessions (e.g. show & tells, team learnings) - organising, running, and iterating on them so good practice and information travel beyond a single team.

  • Spot where AI can genuinely speed teams up, and build that into their everyday ways of working.

Requirements

  • Experience working as an Agile Coach with cross-functional, self-organising Agile teams.
  • Experience working in fast-paced, customer-centric scale-ups.
  • Experience working in a remote-first, high-performance company.
  • Deep understanding of Agile and Lean thinking, values and principles.
  • Hands-on experience applying a variety of frameworks and methodologies such as Scrum, Kanban, DevOps and XP, and a track record of combining these approaches effectively.
  • Experience teaching a wide range of Agile practices such as user story mapping, event storming, example mapping, and slicing.
  • Experience coaching teams on “outcomes over output” and the adoption of continuous product discovery and delivery with a track record of helping teams improve discovery and quality practices, not just delivery speed.
  • Comfortable holding people accountable to agreed team practices - working with relevant team members to close gaps against those standards..
  • A progressive understanding of emerging Agile practices and concepts, including how AI is changing how teams work.
  • A servant-leader who gets a kick out of helping others to succeed and grow.

You'll feel like a fish out of water if:

We know this isn't what you'd see in most job ads - but TrustedHousesitters isn't most companies.

Trust, transparency, and honest feedback aren't just things we say; they're genuinely how we operate, every day. So rather than leaving you guessing if things don't work out, we'd rather give you what you need to make a great decision upfront about whether this opportunity is right for you.

With that in mind, here are a few things worth considering before you hit apply:

  • You're more comfortable as a delivery or project manager than a coach - if your instinct is to manage dependencies and chase updates rather than challenge teams and remove the dependency altogether, this isn't that role

  • You need everything mapped out before you start - this is a brand new role here, still being shaped, and you'll have a hand in defining it as you go

  • You've only coached in large, rigid or enterprise environments - we're a scrappy, five-or-six-team setup, not a heavily-processed org with the infrastructure that comes with it

  • You lean on frameworks, certifications, or "doing Scrum by the book" over understanding the why - we care far more about mindset than ticking off methodology or chasing a SAFE certification

In addition to a competitive salary and bonus, we offer a range of benefits, including:

🐾 For the love of pets

  • Each year, you’ll get a Premium TrustedHousesitters Combined membership which includes benefits like free airport lounge passes, Sit Cancellation Plan and Home and Contents Plan, plus five Premium memberships to gift to friends and family

  • Our team can work remotely from as many house sits as they like, and we contribute up to £500 per
    year towards travel costs to and from sits

  • Find a rescue pet to join your family and we’ll cover the adoption fees, as well as “pawternity” to help your pet settle into their new home

💜 Health & wellbeing

  • SimplyHealth healthcare cash plan

  • Bupa Health Insurance and Dental Insurance plan

  • Specsavers eyecare scheme

  • Weekly virtual yoga sessions

  • Optional enrollment onto our Trusted Giving scheme, which includes employee giving via Charities Trust and 2 days paid annual volunteering allowance

💻 Working environment

  • Work fully remotely from anywhere in the world - as long as you follow compliance as a UK tax resident

  • Get £200 to spend on home office equipment each year + Macbook and Apple accessories when you start

  • Access to Spaces co-working locations across the globe

  • We host an all-expenses-paid meetup each quarter and fund team events (remote or in-person) throughout the year

  • We cover the costs of personal development resources and have regular time set aside for learning and growth

  • Depending on your role within the business, you’ll have the option to customise your work hours to better align with your personal schedule

💰 Compensation & time off

  • 25 days off per year, plus bank holidays and festive closure between Christmas and New Year (36 days + Christmas Day for some roles)

  • Competitive salary which is reviewed annually

  • Discretionary 10% quarterly bonus scheme, distributed quarterly

  • Pension scheme: 5% from you as an employee and 3% from TrustedHousesitters

  • £500 recruitment referral bonus

jobs.title: Head of Data Platform & AI
jobs.description:
About the Company:

Octave is a modern behavioral health practice creating a new standard for care delivery that’s both high-quality and accessible. With in-person and virtual clinics in multiple states, the company offers evidence-based individual, couples, and family therapy, while pioneering relationships with payers to make care more affordable through insurance. By raising the bar on how care is delivered and how providers are supported, we are building a sustainable system that values equity, affordability, and effectiveness.

Job Summary:

Octave is looking for a Head of Data Platform & AI to lead the technical vision and execution across our data platform and emerging AI, machine learning, and Data Science capabilities. This role will own and evolve Octave’s data and AI/ML technical foundation, set the technical/strategic direction for AI/ML in close partnership with Product and cross-functional business leaders, and build the team required to execute that vision as Octave grows.

This is a leadership role for a builder. While you will set strategy, lead the team, and operate as a senior cross-functional partner, you will remain close to the technology and be expected to contribute directly to architecture, prototypes, technical evaluation, and difficult engineering problems. You will initially lead a Data Platform team and work closely with Product, Engineering, Analytics, and business leaders across Octave.

Management Responsibilities:

  • Develops, coordinates, and implements systems, policies, procedures, and productivity standards.
  • Provide leadership and guidance to the team, ensuring the achievement of goals and objectives.
  • Foster a positive and collaborative work environment.
  • Oversee the planning, execution, and completion of projects and initiatives within the team.
  • Establish and monitor operational processes and workflows to enhance efficiency and productivity.
  • Streamline operational processes, enhance efficiency, and improve overall organizational performance.
  • Implement best practices, monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), and develop strategies to achieve operational excellence.
  • Ensures a safe, secure, and compliant work environment.
  • Accomplishes staff results by communicating job expectations; planning, monitoring, and appraising job results.
  • Build and manage a high-performing team, including hiring, training, and development.
  • Provide leadership to the team, including setting goals, providing guidance, and ensuring the team's overall success.
  • Set performance expectations and goals for team members. Conduct regular performance evaluations, provide feedback, and address performance issues.
  • Identify skill gaps within the team and develop strategies for filling those gaps. Support employee development through training, mentoring, and coaching. Identify high-potential employees and create succession plans.

Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Define Octave’s Data & AI Technical Vision
    • Develop and own the technical strategy and roadmap for Octave’s data platform and AI/ML capabilities, while shaping company-level direction and investment priorities by bringing a data and AI perspective to decisions about where Octave competes and how it grows.
    • Own company-level KPIs spanning Octave's AI/ML and Data Platform areas — defining the measures that matter, holding accountability for outcomes against them, and reporting on progress to the executive team.
    • Partner closely with Product and cross-functional leaders to identify where AI, machine learning, and Data Science can create meaningful customer and business value, and own the technical strategy and capabilities required to bring those opportunities to life.
    • Serve as Octave’s senior technical leader and thought partner on data, AI, ML, and Data Science.
    • Help Product, Engineering, and business leaders evaluate opportunities, understand technical feasibility and tradeoffs, and shape Octave’s approach to emerging capabilities.
    • Develop a clear point of view on where traditional machine learning, predictive modeling, generative AI, LLM-based systems, and other approaches are appropriate.
    • Establish principles for when Octave should build capabilities internally, leverage third-party platforms or models, or partner externally.
    • Balance near-term delivery with the foundational investments required to support Octave’s longer-term strategy.
  • Lead AI/ML and Data Science Technical Strategy
    • Establish the technical capabilities required to develop, evaluate, deploy, monitor, and continuously improve production AI and machine-learning systems.
    • Work with Product and business leaders to translate promising AI/ML opportunities into well-defined technical initiatives.
    • Ensure AI/ML initiatives are grounded in clear customer or business outcomes rather than pursued as standalone technology projects.
    • Guide technical experimentation and prototyping to validate opportunities before making significant investments.
    • Establish rigorous approaches to model and system evaluation, experimentation, observability, feedback loops, governance, privacy, security, and responsible AI.
    • Determine the Data Science, ML Engineering, and Applied AI capabilities Octave needs over time and develop an appropriate organizational model to support them.
  • Own and Evolve the Data Platform
    • Own the architecture and evolution of Octave’s centralized data platform and the systems that collect, transform, store, govern, and serve data across the company.
    • Ensure the platform is reliable, scalable, observable, secure, and straightforward for downstream consumers to use.
    • Establish strong engineering practices around data quality, testing, lineage, documentation, monitoring, and reliability.
    • Build scalable interfaces and data products that enable analysts, Product, Engineering, and other teams to work effectively with trusted data.
    • Make pragmatic architectural and technology decisions that balance scalability and technical quality with the speed required in a fast-growing company.
    • Avoid unnecessary complexity and ensure platform investments are justified by real customer, product, or business needs.
  • Enable a Decentralized Analytics Organization
    • Treat analysts embedded within Octave’s product and business organizations as key customers and partners of the Data Platform.
    • Partner with analysts and their leaders to understand common needs, remove technical bottlenecks, and improve access to reliable and well-modeled data.
    • Establish shared technical standards, platform capabilities, and ownership models that allow decentralized analytics teams to move quickly without creating unnecessary fragmentation.
    • Create clear ownership boundaries between the centralized Data Platform organization and embedded analytics teams.
    • Build foundational data capabilities that allow analysts to spend more time generating insights and less time solving recurring infrastructure or data-quality problems.
  • Build the Capabilities and Team Octave Needs
    • Lead, mentor, and develop the existing Data Platform team while remaining close to the technical work.
    • Continuously assess the technical capabilities required to execute Octave’s evolving data and AI strategy.
    • Develop existing team members where appropriate and recruit exceptional external talent when specialized skills or experience are missing internally.
    • Proactively identify capability gaps rather than scaling the organization through headcount alone.
    • Build additional specialized capabilities—including Data Science, ML Engineering, Applied AI, or other disciplines—as product and business needs warrant.
    • Determine when capabilities should live centrally, be embedded within Product or Engineering teams, or operate through another organizational model.
    • Develop strong technical leaders and individual contributors and create an environment characterized by high standards, ownership, curiosity, collaboration, and pragmatic execution.
    • Build an organization that can scale without introducing unnecessary layers or process.
  • Remain a Hands-On Technical Leader
    • Stay sufficiently close to the technology to provide credible technical leadership and make high-quality architecture and engineering decisions.
    • Dive into system design, architecture, data modeling, prototypes, code, technical evaluations, or production issues when your involvement can materially accelerate the team.
    • Personally engage with emerging AI/ML technologies enough to develop an informed point of view on their capabilities, limitations, and relevance to Octave.
    • Serve as a technical thought partner to Data Platform engineers, Product engineers, analysts, and senior company leadership.
    • Set a high technical bar while empowering the team to own execution.
    • Use technical depth to simplify problems and help the company avoid both underinvestment and unnecessary overengineering.

Required Skills:

  • Strong technical foundation and prior experience as a highly capable individual contributor before moving into leadership.
  • Strong understanding of traditional machine-learning and Data Science approaches and newer AI capabilities, including LLM-based systems and generative AI.
  • Strong judgment around build-versus-buy decisions and the ability to assess rapidly evolving technologies pragmatically.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to move fluidly between detailed technical discussions and conversations with senior business and product leaders.
  • Comfortable operating in a small, fast-moving organization where senior leaders remain close to execution.

Education & Experience:

  • 8+ years of experience building and leading data platform, data engineering, Data Science, ML, or AI capabilities in high-growth technology environments.
  • Demonstrated experience architecting and building modern data platforms and production data systems.
  • Meaningful experience applying machine learning and/or AI to real-world product or business problems and taking solutions from experimentation into production.
  • Experience partnering closely with Product teams to identify and deliver technically sophisticated product capabilities.
  • Demonstrated ability to diagnose organizational capability gaps, build new technical capabilities, and recruit senior, specialized technical talent to fill them.

Octave's Company Values:

The below values drive our day-to-day operations.

  • We’re human beings first. We operate with empathy and kindness – with our clients, with our collaborators, and with ourselves.
  • People deserve better than status quo. We’re willing to tackle the intractable problems, no matter how big, because someone should. We ask big questions, we craft big solutions, and we challenge ourselves and others to make it happen.
  • No bystanders. No stars. No tourists. Each person has been selected to be here, and with that comes a responsibility to bring your expertise, share your ideas, and help make this company better.
  • Partnership paves the path ahead. We don’t operate in a silo, internally or externally. To transform the system, we believe in working with others to create something bigger, better, and stronger.
  • Quality is crucial at scale. Quality is core to our business, and we refuse to sacrifice it as we grow.
  • Progress is a process. In the pursuit of progress, we iterate, reflect, learn, adjust – and always leave things better than we found them.
  • There are people behind every data point. We recognize that numbers tell only one part of the story, and we also do the work to understand impacts at the individual level.

Physical Requirements:

  • Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Must be able to frequently communicate with others through virtual meeting applications such as Zoom and Google Meet.
  • Must be able to observe and communicate information on company provided laptop.
  • Move up to 10 pounds on occasion.
  • Must be eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship now or in the future.

Compensation, Equity & Incentives:

Base Salary Range Octave is committed to pay equity and transparency. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location/ zone. Final pay within the posted range will be decided based on a combination of job-related factors, including education, training, experience, and market demands.

  • Geo 1 (All other states & D.C.): $239,300 – $272,100
  • Geo 2 (CO, HI, MD, RI): $263,200 – $280,000
  • Geo 3 (AK, CA, CT, MA, NJ, NY, WA): $275,200 – $280,000

Variable Compensation & Equity

  • Performance Bonus: This role is not currently eligible for bonus incentives.
  • Equity Awards: This role is eligible to participate in Octave’s equity program via Stock Options, subject to the terms of the applicable Equity Incentive Plan.
  • Remote Work Stipend: New full-time employees receive a $300 equipment reimbursement to support a home office setup.
  • Internet & Phone Reimbursement: Full-time employees are eligible for a monthly reimbursement of up to $75 for internet and cell phone related expenses.

Octave is committed to pay equity and transparency. Octave will not discharge or in any other manner coerce, intimidate, threaten, discriminate or retaliate against employees or applicants because they have: (i) inquired about, discussed, compared, or disclosed their own wages, benefits, or other compensation, or the wages, benefits, or other compensation of another employee or applicant; (ii) asked Octave to provide a reason for the employee's wages or lack of opportunity for advancement; or (iii) aided or encouraged others in exercising their rights to discuss wages, compensation, or benefits, or to seek pay equity.

However, except as otherwise provided by law, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) in compliance with the company's legal duty to furnish information under applicable law .

Comprehensive Benefits:

At Octave, we believe in supporting the "human being first". Here’s a snapshot of the benefits available to eligible employees:

  • Health & Wellness: Choose what works best for you with one High Deductible Health Plan (HDHP) and two PPO medical plan options, plus comprehensive Dental and Vision coverage.
  • Medical Support: Enjoy access to a company-sponsored membership with One Medical for convenient, modern care.
  • Retirement: Plan for your future with a 401(k) that offers both traditional and Roth options.
  • Paid Time Off: Time to recharge matters. Take advantage of a generous time off policy, up to 15 paid company holidays, and accrued sick time.
  • Financial Protection: We’ve got you covered with company-paid Life, AD&D, and Disability insurance, plus optional extras like Pet, Legal, and Worksite plans (Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity, and Accident).
  • Parental Leave (Bonding Time): Growing your family? Full-time employees can take paid bonding leave after 6 months, whether it’s a new baby, adoption, or foster placement. Time off increases with tenure.
  • Growth: Keep learning and leveling up with professional development reimbursement for role-related growth opportunities.

How We Use Technology in Hiring:

As part of our hiring process, we may use technology tools, including AI-supported systems, to assist with reviewing applications or documenting interviews. These tools are designed to support our team, not replace human judgment, and final hiring decisions are always made by our team.

Qualifications

  • Experienced Professionals: You have a background in customer service. Call center experience is a plus.

Internet Service Requirements

All agents are required to have wired internet service installed directly into their home.

Examples of acceptable wired services include:

  • Cable internet
  • Fiber‑optic internet
  • DSL broadband

Wireless-only internet services are not allowed.This includes:

  • Cellular/mobile hotspots (4G, 5G, LTE)
  • Fixed wireless internet
  • Satellite internet providers (e.g., Starlink, HughesNet, Viasat)

Direct Ethernet Connection Requirement

The Qualfon computer must be plugged directly into your home router or modem using an Ethernet cable.

Wi‑Fi cannot be used at any point between the Qualfon computer and your internet service provider.This means:

  • No wireless connection from the computer to the router
  • No Wi‑Fi extenders, mesh systems, or boosters
  • No cellular hotspots or any other wireless links

Both of the above requirements must be met.

Proof of internet service provider and service required upon hire.

We fully support you through the transition from trainee to Licensed Professional.

  • Comprehensive Benefits: Access to medical, dental, and vision insurance to keep you and your family healthy.

Our Mission Drives Us:

At Qualfon, our mission is to help as many people as possible pursue their total vocation. We strive to be the "partner of choice" for our clients by delivering engaging interactions that leave a lasting impression. When you work here, you have the power to make each person’s life better including your own.

jobs.description:
Cottingham & Butler is seeking an experienced Salesforce Administrator to lead the administration, optimization, and strategic growth of our Salesforce ecosystem. This role will serve as the primary owner of the Salesforce platform, driving user adoption, system enhancements, automation, reporting, and data integrity while partnering closely with business stakeholders to improve sales, service, and operational processes.

What You'll Do

  • Serve as the primary administrator for Salesforce, including user management, security, profiles, permission sets, roles, and sharing rules.
  • Configure and maintain Salesforce objects, fields, page layouts, validation rules, record types, flows, and other declarative solutions.
  • Design, build, and optimize business process automation using Salesforce Flow and other low-code tools.
  • Partner with business leaders and end users to gather requirements and translate business needs into scalable Salesforce solutions.
  • Create and maintain reports, dashboards, and analytics that provide actionable business insights.
  • Manage data quality through governance, deduplication, data imports, cleansing initiatives, and ongoing monitoring.
  • Support and maintain integrations between Salesforce and third-party applications using APIs, middleware, and native integration tools.
  • Coordinate testing, deployment, and release management activities for Salesforce enhancements and updates.
  • Evaluate and implement new Salesforce features, products, and capabilities, including Salesforce Einstein and AI-driven functionality.
  • Develop user documentation, training materials, and best practices to drive adoption and maximize platform effectiveness.
  • Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and provide advanced support to users across the organization.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Business, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of Salesforce Administration experience in a complex, enterprise environment.
  • Deep knowledge of Salesforce configuration, security model, automation tools, reporting, and data management.
  • Experience gathering business requirements and delivering Salesforce solutions that improve efficiency and user experience.
  • Hands-on experience supporting Salesforce integrations and data synchronization processes.
  • Strong understanding of CRM best practices, governance, and data stewardship.
  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Salesforce Administrator Certification required or strongly preferred; Advanced Administrator, Business Analyst, or Platform App Builder certifications are a plus.
  • Experience with Salesforce Flow, Approval Processes, Dynamic Forms, and Lightning Experience customization.
  • Working knowledge of Apex, SOQL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), or Salesforce development concepts.
  • Experience with Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, or Financial Services Cloud.
  • Experience in insurance, employee benefits, financial services, or a highly regulated industry.
  • Experience leveraging Salesforce Einstein, Agentforce, Copilot, or other AI-enabled Salesforce capabilities.

Skills & Competencies

Strong Salesforce platform expertise, business process analysis, solution design, data management, stakeholder collaboration, communication, continuous improvement mindset, and the ability to translate business challenges into scalable CRM solutions.

About Cottingham & Butler:

At Cottingham & Butler, we sell a promise to help our clients through life’s toughest moments. To deliver on that promise, we aim to hire, train, and grow the best professionals in the industry. We look for people with an insatiable desire to succeed, are committed to growing, and thrive on challenges. Our culture is guided by the theme of “better every day” constantly pushing ourselves to be better than yesterday – that’s who we are and what we believe in.

As an organization, we are tremendously optimistic about the future and have incredibly high expectations for our people and our performance. Our ability to grow as a company, fuels investments in new resources to better serve our clients and provide the amazing career opportunities our employees want and deserve. This is why we are a growth company and why we are committed to being better every day.

jobs.description:
Description

About the role

At Solidus Labs, we are shaping the financial markets of tomorrow by providing cutting-edge, real-time trade surveillance and transaction monitoring technology for regulated and crypto-native financial institutions. We protect investors, enhance transparency, and ensure regulatory compliance across traditional assets, prediction markets, and crypto.

We're hiring a Tech Lead to join our Algorithms team and own the Transaction Monitoring (TM) detection algorithms, product engineering effort end to end.

What you'll own :

  • Lead, mentor, and grow the existing TM global engineering team - sprint delivery, code quality, on-call health.
  • Own implementation of our offchain TM detection suite.
  • Drive the build-out of on-chain TM - wallet-level and protocol-level monitoring, and the data pipelines behind it.
  • Produce and defend both high-level and low-level design: system architecture, data models, detection logic, and threshold/tuning frameworks.
  • Partner with Global Product on the on-chain roadmap, translating regulatory and customer requirements into deliverable engineering plans.
  • Merging various patterns to re-use: You'll help shape that architecture and, over time, how engineering resources are shared across TM and TS.
  • Work with compliance, customer success, and solutions teams on alert quality, false-positive reduction, and client tuning requests.

Requirements

What we're looking for

  • 8+ years backend engineering experience, including 2+ years leading or tech-leading a team.
  • Strong domain knowledge of the financial ecosystem - fintech, payments, banking or crypto - and a solid understanding of financial crime or compliance concepts.
  • Genuinely hands-on: Strong data structures and algorithms fundamentals, a track record of high-performance concurrent code, and still reviewing PRs and debugging production.
  • Proven design ownership at both levels - architecture decisions and detailed implementation design.
  • Experience with high-throughput, low latency data systems: streaming (Kafka or similar), analytical stores (ClickHouse, Snowflake, or similar),and distributed batch processing.
  • Clear written and verbal communication with non-engineering stakeholders.
  • Experience with AI coding and using coding harnesses

Nice to have

  • On-chain/blockchain data experience - chain indexing, wallet clustering, DeFi protocol mechanics.
  • Exposure to trade surveillance or market abuse detection.
  • Experience at a RegTech vendor or in a bank/exchange compliance technology function.

Benefits

Why join us?

You'll own a product line, not a component - with a team already in place, a clear regulatory driver, and a roadmap that expands into on-chain and market surveillance convergence.
