jobs.title: Redwood Automation Solution Designer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance Close, I
jobs.description:
Redwood Automation Solution Designer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance Close, Iceland

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Iceland. Day rate: EUR 400 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its SAP finance close on the Redwood platform, the same engine that runs RunMyJobs and that SAP sold for years as SAP Central Process Scheduling (CPS) and SAP Business Process Automation (BPA). The work covers the record-to-report cycle: accruals, balance sheet reconciliation, journal posting and the period-end close, all driven into SAP S/4HANA and ECC.

You will own the solution design. You will work with the finance process owners to understand how the close runs today, decide what to automate and in what order, and set out a design the engineers can build on the Redwood platform. You will then stay with that design through build, testing and go-live, and make the calls when what was designed meets what is real.

What you will work on

Current-state analysis of the SAP period-end close with controllers and finance operations leads. The target automation design: close task lists, dependencies, calendars, approvals and exception paths, written up as the solution design. Accruals, balance sheet reconciliation and certification, and journal posting with its posting controls. The integration design with SAP S/4HANA or ECC and the other source systems, through APIs, files and middleware. Security and controls designed in: role-based access, segregation of duties, audit trails and SOX-aligned evidence. Monitoring, recovery and the non-functional design that keeps the close running. Leading the engineers through build, and reviewing what they deliver against the design at design-authority and go-live checkpoints. Test strategy and acceptance criteria with the finance users.

What you bring

Solution design on the Redwood platform under any of its names: RunMyJobs, SAP BPA by Redwood, SAP CPS or Cronacle. Design of an automated SAP FI/CO period-end close, where you ran the design workshops and wrote the design yourself. Controls built into your designs: role-based security, segregation of duties, audit trails and SOX-aligned evidence. Leading engineers from an approved design through build, testing and go-live. 8 or more years in SAP finance systems, finance automation or record-to-report process design.

Useful but not essential:

Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance). A BPA-to-RunMyJobs migration. CPS or Redwood tasks run from the SAP Financial Closing cockpit, or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. Financial services or another regulated industry.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood or SAP close automation project: which Redwood product it ran on, the finance processes in scope, and which design decisions were yours.

About Yadimen

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood and SAP finance close automation people in front of the client.

The role focuses on developing valuation frameworks, links-based financial models, establishing internal controls, coordinating PCAOB-registered independent audits, and overseeing financial readiness for potential Nasdaq direct listings.

Operating on a flexible, part-time 10-15 hours per week remote basis with working hours aligned with regular United States business hours (5pm - 12pm SAST), you will oversee external service providers across accounting, taxation, and audit disciplines. A primary focus of the role involves executing outreach and negotiating commercial terms with intellectual property owners across universities, research institutions, and enterprises to secure technology licences, assignments, options, and joint ventures.

Key Responsibilities

  • Construct valuation and financial models (DCF, comparable transactions, risk-adjusted NPV) incorporating development risks, dilution, and sensitivity scenarios to support licensing and acquisition decisions.

  • Lead outreach and commercial negotiations with universities, research institutions, and corporate IP owners to structure and execute IP licenses, assignments, acquisitions, options, and joint ventures.

  • Build linked financial forecasts (income statement, balance sheet, cash flow) incorporating R&D, clinical, and engineering milestones, while maintaining 13-week cash flow tracking.

  • Source PCAOB-registered audit firms, maintain auditor independence, prepare audit schedules, and resolve queries relating to IP, R&D, and share-based compensation accounting.

  • Oversee financial preparations for US public listings in partnership with SEC counsel and listing advisers, maintaining cap tables, transaction accounting, and SEC filing calendars.

jobs.title: Clinical Informaticists III
jobs.description:
Job Summary

Aptive is seeking an experienced Clinical Informaticist III to support the Veterans Health Administration (VHA) Office of Health Informatics (OHI), Clinical Informatics and Data Management Office (OCI), in advancing the enterprise standard of care through improved data, tools, and informatics processes across 170+ VA Medical Centers.

This is a senior clinical informatics role. You will assess the information and knowledge-based needs of clinicians and Veterans, characterize and refine clinical processes, and lead the analysis, design, and continuous improvement of clinical decision support, clinical content, and standardized national workflows in the modernized electronic health record. You will translate complex clinical and operational problems into documented, defensible recommendations that VHA governance bodies and Tier 1 Subject Matter Experts can act on quickly.

Work on this program is organized under the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe). Analyses, decision support, and recommendations are delivered as Features within quarterly Planning Intervals, demonstrated to the government on a two-week cadence, and tracked in Jira and Jira Align.

The ideal candidate brings a clinical background, deep informatics expertise, strong facilitation skills, and the judgment to lead others and operate independently in a fast-moving, decision-driven environment.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Clinical Needs Assessment. Assess the information and knowledge-based needs of healthcare professionals and Veterans; characterize, evaluate, and refine clinical processes to improve safety, quality, and efficiency at the point of care.
  • Clinical Workflow Analysis and Standardization. Analyze current- and future-state clinical workflows across surgical, primary care, dental, specialty care, pharmacy, and ancillary service areas; document processes using BPM+ notation and value stream mapping to drive enterprise workflow standardization.
  • Clinical Decision Support. Develop, implement, evaluate, and continuously refine clinical decision support, order sets, PowerPlans, templates, alerts, and standardized clinical content in the federal EHR.
  • Clinical Systems Lifecycle. Lead or participate in the customization, development, implementation, management, evaluation, and continuous improvement of clinical information systems and order-entry systems.
  • Feature Delivery. Analyze government-provided problem statements and develop the lean business cases, epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and non-functional requirements needed to execute work prioritized in Planning Interval planning.
  • Agile Team Participation. Serve as a clinical subject matter expert on interdisciplinary agile teams; participate in daily stand-ups, iteration planning, PI planning, retrospectives, roadmap updates, and biweekly demonstration ceremonies, presenting both completed work and work in progress.
  • Decision Management Support. Intake, capture, and triage incoming clinical decisions through a standardized process; determine the appropriate decision-making authority based on established criteria; and create, maintain, and disseminate decision logs communicating Tier 1 SME decisions to stakeholders.
  • Governance and Consensus Building. Facilitate continuous exploration and iteration of standard configuration National Workflows, obtaining renewed consensus with Tier 1 SMEs, governing bodies, and VHA stakeholders; analyze emergent Courses of Action for adoption as standard workflow configurations or contingency plans.
  • Clinical Content Migration. Support migration of Design Decision Matrices (DDMs), Data Collection Workbooks (DCWs), and problem resolution artifacts, and integrate workflows into a VA National Standards of Practice Model in partnership with Oracle Health.
  • Value and Outcome Measurement. Perform value-based analysis of available healthcare data to assess and recommend how VA measures value delivered at the point of care; contribute to OKRs, KPIs, and leading indicators tied to safety, alignment to standard, timely access, cost reduction, automation, and provider and Veteran experience.
  • Risk and Quality Management. Identify, document, and track clinical and functional risks and issues; maintain risk registers; convey impacts to relevant VHA offices; and support quality assurance activities.
  • Stakeholder Engagement and Change Management. Engage clinical and operational stakeholders across VHACO, VISNs, and VAMCs; facilitate working sessions; and support communications and change management for informatics decisions and workflow changes.
  • Mentorship and Leadership. Provide direction, technical review, and mentorship to junior informaticists and analysts; may manage or lead the work of others.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Advanced clinical degree (MSN, PharmD, MD, DO, DNP) or master's degree in health informatics or a related discipline.
  • 10 years of progressive clinical informatics, health systems analysis, or EHR implementation and optimization experience.
  • Clinical background such as registered nurse, nurse informaticist, pharmacist, physician, therapist, Health Informatics Specialist (HIS), or Clinical Application Coordinator (CAC).
  • Demonstrated experience assessing clinical information needs, refining clinical processes, and developing or optimizing clinical decision support.
  • Experience analyzing and documenting clinical workflows, including process mapping using BPM+ or comparable notation.
  • Experience working in an Agile or Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) environment, including backlog management and delivery tracking in Jira and/or Jira Align.
  • Expert-level proficiency with Microsoft Office 365, Power BI, Power Apps, and Power Automate, and advanced Excel skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to brief clinical and executive stakeholders and produce decision-quality documentation.
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple concurrent priorities, and deliver on a fixed iteration and Planning Interval cadence.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a public trust clearance.
  • Completion of VA Privacy and Information Security Awareness and Rules of Behavior training (TMS #10176) upon onboarding and annually thereafter.
  • Position is located within the United States; legal authorization to work in the U.S. is required.

Desired Qualifications

  • Informatics certification such as NI-BC (Nursing Informatics Board Certified), CPHIMS, or AMIA Health Informatics Certification.
  • Direct VA or VHA experience, including work with OHI, OCI, CPMO, EHRM, or VA Medical Center informatics operations.
  • Hands-on experience with Oracle Health (Cerner Millennium), including PowerChart, PowerPlans, PharmNet, or comparable module-level configuration.
  • Experience with VistA/CPRS and legacy-to-modernized EHR transition, mapping, or dual-system workflow support.
  • Experience supporting EHR governance bodies, decision boards, or Tier 1 SME structures in a large health system.
  • Familiarity with ServiceNow, Remedy, Jazz, or robotic process automation applied to clinical workflow and ticketing integration.
  • Experience with value stream mapping, Lean process improvement, or high reliability organization methods in healthcare.
  • Experience mentoring or leading clinical informatics staff.

About Aptive. Aptive partners with federal agencies to achieve their missions through improved performance, streamlined operations and enhanced service delivery. Based in Alexandria, Virginia, we support more than a dozen agencies including Veterans Affairs, Transportation, Defense, Homeland Security and the National Science Foundation. We specialize in applying technology, creativity and human-centered services to optimize mission delivery and improve experiences for millions of people who count on government services every day. jobs.description:
Lead, Provider Ops Insights & Analytics

Remote | Full-Time, Salary, Exempt | Includes Benefits, PTO, Flexible Schedule, Equity

About the Role

Provider Operations keeps Steno's nationwide network of court reporters running — coverage, quality, retention, and growth. Today, many of those calls get made on intuition, because the team is lacking direct access to reliable and comprehensive data. This role exists to close that gap: independently define, build, and own the analytics function for Provider Operations — starting with funnel and coverage visibility and expanding into quality and tiering, retention, coverage forecasting, and more. You'll set the roadmap for what gets built and in what order.

This is a senior individual contributor role reporting to the Sr. Director of Provider Operations. You'll operate with a high degree of autonomy and you'll be trusted to exercise business judgment on trade-offs that affect coverage, cost, and provider experience, not just technical judgment on how to build the analysis.

Who We're Looking For

Someone equal parts analytically strong and operationally curious. You're comfortable with the technical side of the work, but you don't stop at the number — you dig into why it moved, what's driving it operationally, and what it means for the team's next decision. Analysis that's technically correct but that no one can act on isn't a win here; usable, contextualized insight is the bar.

On a Regular Basis, You Will

  • Build and own the reporting and analysis backbone for Provider Operations — spanning the provider funnel (sourcing, onboarding, activation), coverage and fill rate, quality and tiering, retention, and rate strategy
  • Partner day-to-day with our Provider Operations pillars and leadership to understand how the business actually runs, and translate that context into analysis the team can use
  • Own dashboards and recurring reporting that make the health of the provider network visible — where it's working, where it's leaking, and why
  • Build and refine a reporter quality and tiering framework that connects performance data to sourcing, retention, and incentive decisions
  • Develop coverage and fill rate forecasting that flags risk by market before it becomes a miss
  • Analyze retention and rate strategy — what keeps reporters engaged versus what drives attrition
  • Field ad hoc data and analysis requests across Provider Operations, prioritizing based on business impact
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and Data to build proper tools and instrumentation, rather than patching solutions together manually long-term
  • Present findings and recommendations to Provider Operations leadership and own follow-through on adoption

You'll Thrive in This Role If

  • You're analytically strong — comfortable with SQL, dashboarding tools, and turning ambiguous business questions into structured analysis
  • You're operationally curious by nature — you understand the operational reality well enough that your analysis is contextualized and immediately usable, not just technically sound
  • You can translate complex analysis into something a non-analyst can read, understand, and act on
  • You have experience in operations, marketplace, or high-volume service environments, and understand how ground-level work actually happens
  • You prioritize well — you know which questions matter most right now and focus there first, rather than chasing every interesting thread
  • You're comfortable shipping a useful first version and iterating, rather than waiting for a perfect model
  • You communicate clearly, both in writing and when presenting findings to technical and non-technical audiences alike

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in analytics, business operations, or a related field, ideally within a marketplace, staffing, or operations-heavy environment
  • Demonstrated ability to build reporting and analysis that directly influenced operational decisions
  • Proficiency in SQL and modern dashboarding/BI tools
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary: $125,000-$155,000
  • Health, Vision, & Dental Benefits — generous company-sponsored health plans for both employees and dependents, including comprehensive vision & dental
  • Wellness/Mental Health — shared benefits to be used among employees and families
  • Flexible Paid Time Off — allowing employees to find balance in their lives
  • Options of Equity — we know our success is nothing without our team
  • Access to a company-provided 401(k) account
  • A home office setup and a monthly stipend to offset internet and phone costs

Application Information

  • Information provided to Steno, such as professional credentials and skills, educational and work history, the results of technical skills assessments or working exercises, and other information included in an application, is collected, analyzed, and stored in our system.

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
About You:

  • You are highly organized and thrive in fast-paced environments where you can manage multiple priorities.
  • You are an analytical problem solver who enjoys improving systems, processes, and efficiency.
  • You are proactive, driven, and take initiative to get things done.
  • You have a strong commitment to accuracy, quality, and achieving results.
  • You communicate clearly, directly, and confidently while holding yourself and others accountable.
  • You are self-disciplined, detail-oriented, and passionate about creating structure and driving operational excellence.

About Kickstart Accounting, Inc.

Kickstart Accounting, Inc. is a growing bookkeeping and accounting firm helping business owners get clarity and confidence in their finances. Our team spans finance, HR, marketing, sales, and admin, all working together to support our clients and each other.

About the Role

We're creating a new Operations Manager position to strengthen the administrative, financial, and back-end systems that keep Kickstart Accounting Group running. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys building organized processes, keeping projects on track, and making sure the behind-the-scenes side of the business runs smoothly.

You'll work closely with the VP of Operations to manage internal administrative functions, support financial operations, oversee key projects from start to finish, and strengthen the back-end systems and workflows the business depends on. This is a great fit for someone who is detail-oriented, comfortable with financial and administrative processes, and energized by building order out of complexity.

What You'll Do

  • Manage administrative operations, including internal recordkeeping, scheduling, vendor coordination, and office/systems management
  • Support financial operations tasks such as invoicing, expense tracking, budget monitoring, and reporting
  • Own project management for operational initiatives, including timelines, task tracking, and cross-team coordination
  • Build and maintain back-end systems and tools that support day-to-day business functions
  • Develop and document standard operating procedures for administrative and back-end processes
  • Identify inefficiencies in current administrative or financial workflows and implement improvements
  • Manage software, platforms, and internal tools used to run daily operations
  • Track progress on operational projects and keep initiatives moving forward
  • Flag risks, bottlenecks, or compliance gaps before they become larger problems

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience in an operations, administrative, or project management role, ideally with financial operations exposure
  • Strong organizational skills and comfort managing multiple priorities and deadlines at once
  • Experience with basic financial processes (invoicing, expense tracking, budgeting, or reporting)
  • A process-oriented mindset, with experience building or improving administrative workflows
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment
  • Comfort with project management tools, spreadsheets, and back-end business systems
  • Bonus: experience in accounting, bookkeeping, or professional services

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 90 days, you'll have a clear picture of our administrative, financial, and back-end operations, including where the friction points are, and a prioritized plan for addressing them. jobs.title: Tax Accountant (Corporate & VAT) - UK
jobs.description:
GoGlobal is establishing an in-house UK corporate tax and VAT capability to support a growing portfolio of clients. The role combines hands-on tax compliance delivery with technical support to the business-development process.

The postholder prepares and reviews UK Corporation Tax and VAT returns and files them with HMRC to deadline, while maintaining the supporting accounting records. In addition, the postholder provides technical tax input to the sales process, including scoping client requirements, estimating effort and supporting proposals and pricing, and advises clients across corporate tax and VAT.

The role sits within the Accounting, Tax & Payments function and reports to the Regional Product Owner (EMEA). Two positions are available, at Senior and Junior level, to provide cover, resilience and a route for progression. The working language is English and no additional language is required, giving access to a broad candidate pool from UK practice and industry.

GoGlobal acts as its clients’ UK tax agent, and is registered with HMRC and supervised for anti-money-laundering purposes in accordance with HMRC’s Standard for Agents. The postholder operates within this framework.

Roles & Responsibilities

Corporate Tax Compliance

• Prepare and review UK Corporation Tax returns (CT600) and computations, including iXBRL tagging, and file them with HMRC to deadline.

• Address capital allowances, tax adjustments to the accounts, loss and group relief, and Research & Development claims where relevant.

• Manage Corporation Tax payment deadlines, including Quarterly Instalment Payments for larger companies.

VAT Compliance

• Prepare and review VAT returns under Making Tax Digital (MTD) and file them with HMRC to deadline.

• Manage VAT registrations and de-registrations, and advise on schemes and treatments, including flat-rate, partial exemption, and place-of-supply and cross-border matters.

• Manage VAT deadlines, payments and reconciliations across the client portfolio.

Accounting and Statutory

• Prepare and review statutory accounts under UK GAAP (FRS 102 / FRS 105) and management accounts in support of the tax work.

• Support Companies House filings, including annual accounts and the confirmation statement, and maintain statutory records.

Business Development Support

• Provide technical tax input to the sales process, including scoping client requirements, estimating effort and supporting proposals and pricing.

• Represent the tax function in client and prospective-client meetings, presenting GoGlobal’s UK capability accurately and credibly.

• Identify opportunities to extend GoGlobal services (entity management, payroll, accounting and Employer of Record) within the client portfolio.

• Contribute to service documentation, scoping templates and technical guidance for UK tax.

Client Relationship and Advisory

• Manage the relationships within an assigned client portfolio and provide proactive, practical UK tax and accounting advice.

• Resolve client queries and issues promptly, and communicate technical matters clearly and commercially.

HMRC, Controls and Quality

• Manage HMRC correspondence, agent authorisations (form 64-8), enquiries and filing calendars.

• Apply four-eyes review, GoGlobal internal controls and data-protection standards, and operate within anti-money-laundering requirements and HMRC’s Standard for Agents.

Key Performance Indicators

• Corporation Tax, VAT and statutory-accounts filings completed accurately and on time, with no missed HMRC or Companies House deadlines.

• Contribution to business development, measured through proposals supported and new or extended work won.

• Client satisfaction and retention across the portfolio.

• Turnaround times and quality of work, including levels of rework.

Requirements

Minimum Qualifications

• Qualified in UK corporate tax and VAT: ATT (Association of Taxation Technicians), or qualified by experience in corporate tax and VAT compliance.

• No statutory licence is required in the United Kingdom to prepare or file Corporation Tax or VAT returns. A chartered-accountant qualification (ACA or ACCA) or CPA is not required, as this is a tax role rather than an audit role.

• CTA (Chartered Tax Adviser) is desirable, particularly for the Senior position. Candidates for the Junior position may be ATT-qualified or part-qualified and studying.

• GoGlobal provides the anti-money-laundering supervision and HMRC agent registration; the postholder is expected to meet fit-and-proper standards and to work within HMRC’s Standard for Agents.

Core Requirements

• Practical working knowledge of UK Corporation Tax (CT600, computations and iXBRL) and VAT (MTD), together with UK GAAP (FRS 102 / FRS 105).

• Familiarity with HMRC online services, Making Tax Digital and Companies House filings, and competence with tax and accounting software (for example Alphatax, Digita, CCH, TaxCalc, Xero or Sage).

• Commercial awareness and a client-facing manner, with the confidence to support business development through scoping, pricing and client meetings.

• Strong written and spoken English, and a well-organised, accurate and deadline-driven approach.

• The right to work in the United Kingdom.

Preferred

• Experience in practice (an accountancy or tax firm) managing a portfolio of clients, ideally including international or foreign-owned entities.

• Exposure to payroll and PAYE, Research & Development relief, or cross-border and international tax.

• Experience contributing to proposals, pricing or business development, and with cloud accounting software such as Xero.

Who Thrives in This Role

• Technically strong tax professionals who are also commercially minded and comfortable supporting business development.

• Client-facing advisers who enjoy variety across corporate tax, VAT and accounting, and managing a growing portfolio.

• Clear communicators who can make technical matters simple and useful for clients.

A company small enough for your voice to be heard meaningfully, yet large enough to make a global impact

Collaborating with a diverse, global and supportive team

WHY WE ARE DIFFERENT

    • We operate with the benefits of a partnership without the complexities of a partnership. Our hybrid partnership-corporate model offers all employees the opportunity to become a partner, while maintaining a streamlined corporate structure so that decisions are made quickly.

Ability to identify the unmet medical, educational, and research needs at a local & regional level in the medical community.

Job Title: Senior Manager, Logistics Performance & Analytics (Remote Eligible)

Job Location: Boston, MA

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Description

POSITION SUMMARY:

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Logistics Performance & Analytics Senior Manager to join our Global Logistics team.

This person owns Logistics performance reporting, KPIs, TMS master data creation & maintenance, annual budget planning (inclusive of long rage planning), and freight accruals. This role is a critical end-user voice in the design of Logistics Data Products, and partners closely with the Global Logistics Business Process Owner (BPO) to ensure continuous improvement is grounded in real performance data. The role is also the reporting and performance lens through which Logistics contributes to the organization's broader Digital Transformation.

The Senior Manager operates in a lean organization — resourcefulness, analytical rigor, and the ability to communicate complex performance data clearly to senior stakeholders are as important as technical execution.

KEY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

This role owns run-time execution - building and maintaining reporting against those definitions, operating master data governance, owning budget and freight accruals, and monitoring performance.

Performance reporting & KPIs

  • Own the design, development, and ongoing maintenance of Logistics performance reports and KPI dashboards across all Logistics processes.
  • Define KPI frameworks in partnership with the Global Logistics BPO and the Global Logistics leadership; ensure metrics reflect business priorities and process standards.
  • Monitor KPI trends; identify performance gaps, root causes, and corrective action opportunities; escalate and report findings to Logistics leadership.
  • Prepare and deliver executive-level performance reporting — including PowerPoint-based briefings — with clear narrative, options, and recommendations.
  • Serve as the primary Logistics interface for the Data & Performance team on reporting design, data requirements, and dashboard development.

TMS Master Data Maintenance

  • Own master data governance and maintenance within Oracle OTM in close collaboration with the broader BSMO / CM&TO data governance teams.
  • Operate master data governance against the data model, valid-value rules, and validation logic defined by the Global Logistics BPO ; maintain master data values and enforce standards operationally.
  • Drive continuous improvement of master data quality; identify gaps, implement controls, and track data health metrics.
  • Partner with DTE and Role 1 on master data requirements for system releases, UAT, and release validation.

Annual Budget Planning & Freight accruals

  • Build the annual Logistics operations budget from the bottom up, structured by LSP, Disease Area, and Cost Center following the process and design as part of the end to end process.
  • Own freight accruals calculation methodology and monthly reporting to Finance; ensure accuracy and timeliness.
  • Track actuals vs. budget; identify variances, provide analysis, and support Logistics leadership in financial decision-making.
  • Partner with Procurement, Finance, and Logistics Operations to align budget assumptions with network realities and contractual commitments.

Logistics Data Products: End-User representation

  • Serve as the primary end-user voice for reporting, KPI, and performance-data requirements within Logistics Data Products;.
  • Partner with the Global Logistics BPO, DTE, and the Supply Chain SCORE team to ensure data products deliver the analytical capabilities Logistics needs to operate and improve.
  • Validate data product outputs against business requirements; provide structured feedback on gaps, quality issues, and enhancement priorities.

Digital Transformation — Reporting & Performance Automation

  • Ensures digital initiatives are designed with reporting and performance measurement needs in mind from the outset, inclusive development and implementation of performance-automation opportunities
  • Champion data-driven decision-making across Logistics; build the analytical culture and capability within the function.

Communication & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Navigate ambiguous data and performance situations by structuring the analysis, presenting clear options, and driving alignment to a decision.
  • Communicate complex performance and financial topics clearly to Logistics leadership and senior stakeholders, including preparation of executive-level presentations.
  • Build cross-functional consensus on data definitions, KPI methodology, and reporting standards across teams with competing priorities.

REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS:

  • Analytical rigor: builds accurate, reliable reporting from complex, multi-source data; identifies trends and root causes with precision. Proficiency in analyzing data to support decision-making in a matrix organization.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: working with Operating Units, commercial business units, and various internal functions.
  • Analytical rigor: builds accurate, reliable reporting from complex, multi-source data; identifies trends and root causes with precision.
  • Data governance: defines and enforces master data standards; tracks data health and drives continuous improvement.
  • Financial acumen: builds bottoms-up budgets, manages accrual methodologies, and communicates financial performance to Finance stakeholders.
  • Executive communication: translates complex performance and financial data into clear narratives and recommendations for senior leadership — including PowerPoint-based briefings.
  • KPI instrumentation: proposes metric calculation methodology and owns metric sourcing and visualization, so dashboards reflect true business performance - not just what is easy to measure.
  • Cross-functional influence: builds alignment on data definitions and reporting standards across teams without direct authority. Strong stakeholder management and influence skills across different organizational levels.
  • Ambiguity navigation: structures unclear analytical situations into defined options and drives the organization to a decision. Agile mindset to constantly adapt to a changing environment
  • Resourcefulness: delivers rigorous analysis within lean resource constraints; finds ways forward without waiting for perfect data or systems.
  • Systems fluency: works effectively with TMS and data platforms; can articulate data requirements to DTE and data engineering teams.
  • Data governance: defines and enforces master data standards; tracks data health and drives continuous improvement.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

  • Bachelor's degree in business administration, engineering, and/or Supply Chain management.
  • Minimum of 6 years of relevant experience in Distribution and Logistics management.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (advanced: pivot tables, arrays, conditional formatting) and PowerPoint for analysis and executive reporting.
  • Familiarity with BI and analytics tools (Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent) preferred.
  • Professional certification in Supply Chain or Logistics (APICS CLTD or CSCP) preferred.
  • Requires 2 years of experience as a lead for performance metric reporting, management & governance in a global matrix organization.
  • Master’s degree in business or Supply Chain or Industrial Engineering or finance preferred
  • Good knowledge of Supply Chain systems, particularly Oracle TMS.
  • Excellent communication skills in English, additional languages are a plus.

jobs.title: Senior Organic Analytics Manager
jobs.description:
Risepoint is an education technology company that helps regional universities launch and grow online programs for modern learners. Risepoint supports more than 100 universities and colleges across five countries, with programs concentrated in high-demand fields including nursing, healthcare, teaching, business, technology, and public service. Our suite of products and services supports the full student journey and each university’s long-term goals. Together, we increase access to affordable education that delivers a strong return on investment for learners and meets employer and community needs. Learn more at risepoint.com.


The Impact You Will Make

This role helps Risepoint understand how organic discovery, AI search, and the digital experience contribute to student demand and enrollment. The Senior Manager, Organic Analytics will lead day-to-day analytical work across SEO, answer engine optimization (AEO), website/DXP performance, and the organic funnel. By connecting visibility and website behavior to leads, applications, and enrollments, this person will help the organization understand what happened, why it happened, where it is concentrated, and what actions should follow.

How You Will Bring Our Mission to Life
The Senior Manager, Organic Analytics is the primary day-to-day analytics partner for SEO, AEO, organic content, and DXP/CRO measurement within Channel Analytics. Working under the direction of the Sr. Director, Channel Analytics, this person leads analytical execution, develops measurement approaches, defines business and reporting requirements, conducts deep-dive analyses, and translates findings into clear recommendations. They partner closely with Analytics Solutions, which develops production dashboards, as well as SEO/AEO, Digital Experience, CRO, CRM, Data Engineering, and other analytics stakeholders. The role measures and evaluates organic strategy; it does not own SEO/content execution.

What You Will Do

  • Lead monthly Organic MBR analysis and recurring performance diagnosis across SEO, AEO, website/DXP, and the organic funnel, including traffic, leads, applications/enrollments where available, conversion, YoY/MoM drivers, where performance is concentrated, opportunities, and risks.
  • Analyze SEO performance using GA4, Google Search Console, and SEO platforms, including impressions, clicks, CTR, rankings/visibility, branded vs. non-branded demand where useful, landing-page/content performance, and where performance gains or declines are concentrated.
  • Lead AEO measurement across AI visibility, citations, Citation Share/Share of Voice, prompts/topics, engine-level performance, AI referral traffic, competitive/source analysis, and downstream outcomes; partner with Profound or similar platform data as available.
  • Design measurement for AEO, SEO, DXP, and CRO initiatives by establishing baselines, intervention dates, comparison groups or matched controls where appropriate, and post-launch reads; evaluate uncertainty, confounding, and whether observed changes are reasonably attributable to the intervention.
  • Measure website and funnel performance from organic/AI discovery through landing-page behavior, forms, leads, applications, and enrollments; distinguish traffic-driven changes from conversion-driven changes and evaluate DXP migrations, site releases, and CRO changes.
  • Reconcile GA4/GSC/SEO/AEO/CRM data, investigate material Organic performance changes, identify tracking or taxonomy issues before results reach leadership, and translate findings into 2–4 decision-ready insights rather than metric dumps.
  • Define KPI logic, reporting requirements, analytical views, intervention/change logs, and data-quality needs; partner with Antonio/Analytics Solutions and Data Engineering to bring GA4, GSC, AEO platform, Salesforce, and intervention data into scalable reporting and Databricks-based workflows rather than relying on manual Excel processes.

What Success Looks Like

  • Organic MBR analysis is delivered with clear drivers, concentrations, business implications, and recommended actions, allowing the Sr. Director to review and sharpen the story rather than perform the first-pass analysis.
  • SEO, AEO, and DXP performance can be connected from visibility and search demand through website behavior, leads, applications, and enrollments, with known data limitations clearly documented.
  • AEO reporting moves from manual snapshots toward a scalable history and measurement process with clear hero metrics, engine-level views, prompt/topic and URL-level analysis, intervention tracking, and credible post-launch reads.
  • Material Organic, content, and website changes can be diagnosed quickly, including whether movement reflects demand, visibility, traffic quality, conversion, tracking, taxonomy, or maturation effects.
  • The Senior Manager becomes the primary day-to-day analytics partner for Organic, AEO, and Digital Experience stakeholders, increasing Channel Analytics capacity while the Sr. Director retains overall strategy, prioritization, and cross-channel accountability.

How Impact Will be Measured

  • Reliability, adoption, and usefulness of Organic MBR analysis and recurring SEO, AEO, DXP/CRO, and funnel reporting.
  • Quality of business requirements, KPI definitions, analytical specifications, and data QA provided to Analytics Solutions and Data Engineering.
  • Improved visibility into organic traffic quality, search/content effectiveness, AI-search performance, website conversion, and progression through application and enrollment.
  • Quality and credibility of pilot, test, migration, and rollout measurement, including appropriate treatment of baselines, comparison groups, intervention timing, uncertainty, and confounding.
  • Clarity and actionability of recommendations and evidence that insights influence SEO/AEO, content, DXP/CRO, partner, and prioritization decisions.
  • Reduction in repetitive manual analysis and stakeholder confidence in the Organic analytics story presented to leadership.

What You’ll Bring to the Team

Experience & Skills That Matter Most (Required)

  • 6+ years of hands-on experience in digital/web analytics, organic/SEO analytics, marketing analytics, or a closely related data-driven environment, with demonstrated strength diagnosing performance rather than only producing reports.
  • Advanced SQL skills and the ability to independently pull, join, QA, and investigate complex web, marketing, and CRM datasets in cloud data environments.
  • Strong analytical proficiency with GA4 and Google Search Console plus working knowledge of SEO data/tools such as Ahrefs, Semrush, or equivalent; understand traffic sources, landing pages, events, funnels, rankings/visibility, queries, content performance, and technical SEO concepts.
  • Strong funnel analytics skills, including the ability to connect sessions and website behavior to leads, applications, enrollments, conversion rates, cohort/maturation considerations, and known attribution or identity-resolution limitations.
  • Strong analytical diagnosis, data QA, and executive storytelling skills: identify whether unusual results are real or caused by tracking/taxonomy issues and translate findings into what happened, why, where it is concentrated, and what should happen next.
  • Experience defining KPI logic, business requirements, and reporting specifications for BI/Analytics Solutions teams; strong Excel skills and enough data-visualization fluency to design useful reporting without being the production dashboard developer.
  • Working knowledge of experimentation and causal measurement concepts, including pre/post design, control or matched-comparison groups, confounding, uncertainty/statistical significance, and the limits of correlation; deep experimental-design expertise is not required.

Experience That’s Great to Have (Preferred)

  • AEO/generative-search literacy, including citations vs. mentions, prompts and prompt themes, AI visibility/Share of Voice, source attribution, branded vs. non-branded prompts, engine differences, AI referrals, zero-click/offsite discovery, and experience with Profound, Ahrefs Brand Radar, Semrush AI visibility tools, or similar platforms.
  • Deeper experimentation/causal-inference experience, including matched controls, difference-in-differences, natural experiments, incrementality, or rollout measurement; Python or R experience for large-scale prompt/citation analysis, URL classification, topic clustering, or competitor analysis is also valuable.
  • Experience with Databricks, BigQuery, Snowflake, Salesforce data, Power BI, GSC/API data, web scraping/log-file analysis, DXP/CRO teams, or higher-education/high-consideration lead-generation environments.

jobs.title: Senior Performance Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Summary


The Senior Performance Engineer is responsible for expected-versus-actual energy performance across SunStrong’s serviced fleet, spanning residential systems, commercial and industrial sites, community solar, and utility-scale projects. This role models production, quantifies and defends contractual performance obligations, and drives underperformance to root cause with operations and field services. As the senior technical authority on fleet performance, the position sets the data requirements behind performance reporting, advises on dashboard and analytics development rather than building it, and partners with asset management and O&M on billing and settlement accuracy. The role sits on the Fleet Management Technology team and requires equal comfort with a residential inverter fleet, a metered utility-scale PPA settlement, and the data platform that carries both.

Responsibilities

  • Model and monitor energy performance across residential, C&I, community solar, and utility-scale assets in PlantPredict and the fleet monitoring platforms (AlsoEnergy, Power Factors, 3E), comparing metered production against simulation using weather and irradiance data from Solcast, SolarAnywhere, and Open-Meteo.
  • Calculate and defend contractual performance metrics including availability, performance ratio, production guarantees, and liquidated damages exposure, and produce the recurring analysis that supports billing, PPA and lease invoicing, and investor and securitization reporting.
  • Evaluate billing and settlement accuracy with the asset management and O&M teams, reconciling metered, monitored, and invoiced quantities and resolving discrepancies at the source.
  • Investigate underperformance to root cause across inverters, meters, communications, energy storage, and site conditions, and drive corrective work to closure with O&M and field services.
  • Direct the data requirements for fleet performance — tags, granularity, units, timestamps, and quality rules — and support data collection, ingestion, and reconciliation with the data platform team.
  • Advise on the development of Power BI dashboards and performance reporting, defining metric definitions, calculation logic, and acceptance criteria, and validating output rather than building the reports directly.
  • Define monitoring, revenue-grade metering, and telemetry requirements for new and retrofitted sites, and validate commissioning data before a site is accepted into the fleet.
  • Establish performance baselines and data mappings for newly acquired or transitioned portfolios, including migration from legacy monitoring platforms.
  • Validate storage system performance against contracted operating modes, including dispatch behavior, state of health, cycling, and demand-charge and tariff-driven response.
  • Apply AI tooling and agentic workflows to accelerate fleet diagnostics, anomaly triage, and recurring analysis, and define where model output requires engineering verification before it is relied on.
  • Serve as technical reviewer for warranty, insurance, and equipment claims requiring quantified production loss, and mentor junior engineers and analysts on performance methods.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in engineering, physics, or a related technical field.
  • 8+ years in solar or storage performance engineering, asset performance management, or renewable O&M engineering, including 3+ years supporting commercial or utility-scale assets.
  • Hands-on experience with PV performance modeling in PlantPredict (PVsyst or SAM acceptable as a secondary), and with satellite irradiance and weather datasets including Solcast, SolarAnywhere, and Open-Meteo.
  • Working experience with fleet monitoring and asset performance platforms including AlsoEnergy, Power Factors, and 3E, including data extraction, tag mapping, and alarm configuration.
  • Proficiency in SQL and in Python for engineering analysis (pandas, numpy, pvlib or equivalent).
  • Practical fluency with AI tooling — coding assistants, LLM-based analysis, and agentic workflows — applied to engineering work, with sound judgment on where output must be verified.
  • Demonstrated ability to specify data requirements, validation rules, and reconciliation logic for engineering and BI teams, and to review dashboards and reporting for correctness.
  • Working knowledge of monitoring, metering, and SCADA data acquisition, including common protocols and vendor APIs (Modbus, SunSpec, DNP3, REST).

jobs.title: Redwood Automation Solution Designer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance Close, B
jobs.description:
Redwood Automation Solution Designer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance Close, Belgium

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Belgium. Day rate: EUR 400 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its SAP finance close on the Redwood platform, the same engine that runs RunMyJobs and that SAP sold for years as SAP Central Process Scheduling (CPS) and SAP Business Process Automation (BPA). The work covers the record-to-report cycle: accruals, balance sheet reconciliation, journal posting and the period-end close, all driven into SAP S/4HANA and ECC.

You will own the solution design. You will work with the finance process owners to understand how the close runs today, decide what to automate and in what order, and set out a design the engineers can build on the Redwood platform. You will then stay with that design through build, testing and go-live, and make the calls when what was designed meets what is real.

What you will work on

Current-state analysis of the SAP period-end close with controllers and finance operations leads. The target automation design: close task lists, dependencies, calendars, approvals and exception paths, written up as the solution design. Accruals, balance sheet reconciliation and certification, and journal posting with its posting controls. The integration design with SAP S/4HANA or ECC and the other source systems, through APIs, files and middleware. Security and controls designed in: role-based access, segregation of duties, audit trails and SOX-aligned evidence. Monitoring, recovery and the non-functional design that keeps the close running. Leading the engineers through build, and reviewing what they deliver against the design at design-authority and go-live checkpoints. Test strategy and acceptance criteria with the finance users.

What you bring

Solution design on the Redwood platform under any of its names: RunMyJobs, SAP BPA by Redwood, SAP CPS or Cronacle. Design of an automated SAP FI/CO period-end close, where you ran the design workshops and wrote the design yourself. Controls built into your designs: role-based security, segregation of duties, audit trails and SOX-aligned evidence. Leading engineers from an approved design through build, testing and go-live. 8 or more years in SAP finance systems, finance automation or record-to-report process design.

Useful but not essential:

Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance). A BPA-to-RunMyJobs migration. CPS or Redwood tasks run from the SAP Financial Closing cockpit, or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. Financial services or another regulated industry.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood or SAP close automation project: which Redwood product it ran on, the finance processes in scope, and which design decisions were yours.

About Yadimen

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood and SAP finance close automation people in front of the client.

The ideal candidate combines technical SEO knowledge with commercial thinking. You understand how backlinks contribute to organic growth, can identify valuable opportunities quickly, and are able to prioritize activities that generate measurable results.

You are detail-oriented, data-driven, and comfortable taking ownership of your work while collaborating effectively with colleagues across different functions.

Our customers are among the most demanding in the world: Fortune 500 enterprises in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, government, life sciences) who require SOX compliance, zero-trust architecture, and audit-grade governance. Product Vision & Strategy

  • Define and drive the multi-year product roadmap across Flosum's five product lines: DevOps, Backup & Archive, Trust Center, Data Seeding, and DevOps for Veeva.
  • Identify whitespace opportunities in the Salesforce ecosystem where Flosum can create new categories or capture market share from competitors.

jobs.description:
Join EVA Pharma, a leading pharmaceutical company dedicated to empowering the fight for Health and well-being as a fundamental human right. Recognized and certified as a best place to work, we are committed to fostering a supportive and innovative environment for our team members.

Job Summary

The Quality Compliance Manager (Part-Time) is responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the German Quality Management System (QMS), ensuring compliance with German and EU pharmaceutical regulations. The role oversees quality processes, inspections, audits, training, supplier qualification, CAPA management, and quality oversight of external partners to ensure the organization remains inspection-ready and fully compliant with GxP requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Maintain and continuously improve the local Quality Management System (QMS).
  • Manage quality documentation, including SOPs, forms, records, and periodic reviews.
  • Coordinate employee training, qualification programs, and compliance records.
  • Lead supplier, customer, and service provider qualification activities.
  • Plan, conduct, and follow up on internal audits and quality assessments.
  • Manage deviations, quality events, CAPAs, and process improvement initiatives.
  • Oversee quality-related interfaces with manufacturers, external service providers, and batch release partners.
  • Prepare for, coordinate, and support regulatory authority inspections while ensuring ongoing inspection readiness.

Employment Type

Part-Time | Remote (Germany-based)

Requirements

  • Degree in Pharmacy, Life Sciences, or a related scientific discipline.
  • Minimum 5-7 years of experience in pharmaceutical or healthcare quality management systems.
  • Experience as a Responsible Person for Wholesale Distribution under German Medicines Act (AMG §52a).
  • Strong knowledge of GxP requirements, German pharmaceutical regulations, and EU compliance standards.
  • Manage multiple quality activities, and effectively interact with internal and external stakeholders.

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
The role is about:
As a DevOps Engineer at payabl., you will play a key role in building and scaling our infrastructure while collaborating across multiple product teams. Your primary focus will be supporting the Data engineering team, ensuring robust, automated, and secure delivery of data-driven solutions. At the same time, you’ll work closely with Banking, Payments, and payabl.one teams to enable faster, more reliable releases and provide the foundations for innovation across our global payments platform. This role is highly cross-functional, giving you the opportunity to influence how teams build, deploy, and operate products at scale.

Location: Portugal, Poland fully remote. Cyprus Hybrid in Limassol Office.
What you will do:

  • Building and maintaining our Kubernetes clusters, (not just creating tools and also deploying apps with Helm), but the emphasis is on being able to do this in a code-first way: infrastructure as code .
  • Work closely with other teams to identify pain points and problems around the platform.
  • Develop new tools and frameworks to improve data platforms.
  • Manage CI/CD. Design, develop, and implement CI/CD pipelines using tools like Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab.
  • Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration management using tools like Ansible, Terraform, or AWS CloudFormation.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot infrastructure issues using tools like Prometheus, Grafana.
  • Implement security best practices and ensure compliance with internal and external regulations.
  • Participate in code reviews and help teammates with constructive feedback.

What we need:

  • At least 5 years of experience with containerization technology (Kubernetes, Docker) and cloud platforms.
  • Proficiency in provisioning infrastructure and managing configurations with tools such as Ansible, Terraform, or AWS CloudFormation.
  • Strong knowledge of Data lake services on AWS (Glue, Athena).
  • Linux experience: troubleshooting, Bash/Python/Perl scripting, familiarity with multiple distributions (Debian, Ubuntu, RHEL).
  • Experience developing automation for CI/CD pipelines, especially Jenkins.
  • Good to have Kafka knowledge.
  • Desire to learn and participate in coaching junior members of the team.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Outstanding attention to details.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • A customer-centric, empathetic mindset with excellent listening skills.
  • An ability to focus on what counts, creating simple solutions to deliver fast results.

The perks of being a payabl.er:

  • Future-Proof Your Finances: Once you’ve passed probation, we’ll kickstart your Provident Fund to secure your future.
  • Grow with Us: Annual Learning Budget for professional development (eligible after probation)—because your growth is our growth.
  • Wolt Your Way Through Lunch: €150 monthly Wolt allowance to keep you fueled and happy.
  • Stay Active Your Way: Enjoy a SportsBenefits membership giving you access to a wide variety of gyms and sports facilities to support your active lifestyle.
  • Drive in Style: After one year with us, you may be eligible for a company car—performance and availability permitting.
  • Park with Ease: Complimentary parking space just steps from the office, so your commute is as smooth as your workday.
  • Max Out Your Downtime: 25 days of vacation + public holidays + 10 days of sick leave.
  • Shop & Save: Exclusive local discount card + tickets for exciting events like Beonix, basketball games, and more.
  • Speak Like a Local: Join free Greek language classes, twice a week, open to all team members.
  • Celebrate Together: We bring colleagues from all offices together for unforgettable company celebrations.
  • Global Collaboration & Events: Opportunities to participate in international company events and initiatives, connecting with colleagues from all regions and contributing to a truly global community

The benefits listed above are for our Cyprus office location only, a list of benefits and contract type will be assessed subject to your location and discussed in the first interview with your Talent Acquisition Partner.

Hiring Process:

  • Step 1 – Thinking in Action (40 minutes) Your first conversation will be with our Talent Acquisition team. We'll explore your background, career journey, motivations, and overall fit for the role. As part of this discussion, you'll also complete a short technical screening that will be reviewed by our engineering team. This stage helps us understand both your experience and how you approach technical challenges.
  • Step 2 – Build in Production (60–90 minutes) Meet with the Team Lead and technical experts for a practical assessment. Depending on the role, this may involve a live coding exercise or a real-world scenario designed to evaluate your technical skills, problem-solving approach, and ability to work through challenges similar to those faced by our teams.
  • Step 3 – Final Interview (45 minutes) The final stage is a group interview with senior members of our Technology squad, which may include the CTO, CPO, and Team Lead. This is also an opportunity for you to learn more about our culture and ways of working.

jobs.title: Director
jobs.description:
About Elevate

Elevate is a small business providing comprehensive grant writing support to nearly 100 nonprofit organizations working on a wide variety of issues. Our fully-remote staff work on teams and build long-term partnerships with clients to support every stage of the grant cycle: fundraising strategy & goal development, prospect research and cultivation, drafting and submission, and funder stewardship. All staff work remotely, with the option to visit our co-working space in downtown DC or meet with clients and teams in-person provided that these activities align with our COVID-19 policies. All candidates must be legally authorized to work for Elevate, and must work for Elevate, in the United States.

Staff benefit from flexible scheduling, built-in mentorship and support from colleagues on their client teams, a dedicated supervisor responsible for training and professional growth, established career development pathways that outline clear expectations for current and future positions within the company, and the opportunity to work with a portfolio of clients that align with their interests or provide exposure to new social change issues.

For more information about our organizational culture and the clients we serve, visit our websitehere.

Overview of the Position

For this role, Elevate seeks skilled institutional fundraising professionals with the confidence, flexibility, and persistence to coach clients on best-practices in fundraising strategy, grant writing, financials, and program evaluation while overseeing junior staff who produce compelling proposals and manage detailed grants calendars. Directors work independently to oversee 5-6 client teams at a time. They meet regularly with a dedicated Supervisor to report progress toward client goals, request support managing their teams, and to identify potential obstacles to a successful long-term client partnership for Elevate’s Client Services department.

Strong candidates have at least four years of experience or comparable experience with the key tasks and responsibilities listed below and demonstrated ability to meet the key competencies for the role.

Key Tasks & Responsibilities

  • Lead 4-5 client teams while overseeing the work of junior staff;
  • Develop and implement comprehensive institutional fundraising strategies in close partnership with clients that establish short- and long-term goals, prospecting priorities, and systems for cultivation and stewardship;
  • Lean on impeccable project management skills to ensure prospect research, cultivation, solicitation, and grand calendar management deliverables are completed on time and at a consistently high quality for each client;
  • Manage early career development professionals who are eager to learn from you about institutional fundraising;
  • Draft select proposals, reports, LOIs, and concept papers to ensure highly strategic writing on the most complex deliverables.
  • Contribute positively to Elevate’s culture, commitment to equity and inclusion, and company values.

Key Competencies

Fundraising & Nonprofit Expertise. You develop and clearly articulate strong institutional fundraising strategies for clients that work in at least two issue areas or funder landscapes. You demonstrate exemplary, strengths-based writing skills and work to understand the root causes of the challenges facing your client organizations' beneficiaries; demonstrate a command of program design sufficient to guide clients in the development of competitive funding proposals, even for programs and interventions that are new to you. You demonstrate a comfort with budgets, basic program evaluation, and other common grant attachments. You efficiently research well-aligned funding opportunities for different organizational needs and support the cultivation of funders with concise cultivation emails and talking points that demonstrate a nuanced understanding of the funding landscape and individual funder's interests. You work effectively with your teams and clients to maintain accurate, comprehensive, and regularly updated Salesforce records that support high quality grant calendars and data analysis.

Team Management. You demonstrate standard management skills which includes all standard Elevate processes (1:1s, task delegation, and oversight), consistent and timely feedback, and proactive approach to solving problems within the team. You identify potential performance challenges on your teams and discuss them with your supervisor. You facilitate an inclusive environment that’s welcoming to all.

Problem Solving. You support team members who identify incomplete, inaccurate, or inconsistent program information that impacts the quality of our grants, helping to identify problems and develop solutions collaboratively. You check-in regularly with team members to ensure work products are on track for a timely submission and plan for contingencies in which needed information, data, or reviews are unavailable. You are comfortable addressing or adapting your strategy to common barriers to fundraising success, including, for example, minimal impact data or evaluation practices, weaknesses in organizational program/project budgeting, and limited staff capacity.

Consulting & Professional Communication. You independently present complex problems, goals, and ideas in a way that is accessible even to those unfamiliar with Elevate's work, such as program, finance, and evaluation staff. You introduce client points of contact to best-practices in fundraising strategy, budget development, measurement and evaluation, and organizational planning/sustainability. You proactively identify potential obstacles in the Elevate/Client relationship and work with a supervisor to address them.

Timeliness & Prioritization. You support your team while consistently delivering on projects, and communicate promptly to set expectations appropriately. You are accountable for the quality and timeliness of all work products you deliver to the client.

Information Processing. You independently implement an efficient and effective system for tracking and updating information relevant to your work. You independently identify information and data needs and fill them by finding what you need in Elevate's information systems (Dropbox, Salesforce, Google Groups, etc.), asking targeted questions in internal check-ins, and reaching out directly to the client. You recommend new tools and systems to better track information and data on your client teams.

Attention to Detail. You are accountable for all details in your team's work products. You catch details that other team members have overlooked or included in error. Clients rarely identify missing or inaccurate information that you did not already flag for their review.

Tools and Systems. You adhere to and consistently use Elevate's standard tools and systems; You know what information is logged in Salesforce by default and what information can be logged by request.

Continuous Learning. You proactively request feedback from others and are open to continuous constructive feedback. You consistently deliver useful feedback on both overall performance and specific deliverables to your peers and manager in a way that strengthens relationships and enables projects to advance more efficiently or effectively.

Compensation and Benefits

The annual salary for this full-time position is $72,500 and is based on a market analysis of comparable job duties and positions within the nonprofit sector and across a variety of United States geographies. Due to our commitment to internal parity within each position and across the company, we do not negotiate salaries.

In addition to this base compensation and flexible work schedule, we offer a generous benefits package to all staff, including:

  • Health insurance: On average, Elevate pays over 94% of the medical premium, 80% of the dental premium, and 80% of the vision premium for employees only. Dependent coverage is the full responsibility of individual employees.
  • Paid time off: 15 days’ vacation, 8 sick days, 12 company holidays, 24 hours of voting leave and civic engagement leave.
  • Winter Break: The office typically closes in the last week of the calendar year (between December 24 and January 2nd). Employees can choose to take the full break or apply some of this time for religious observance days (up to three) at other times of the year.
  • Summer Break : The office typically closes the first week of July.
  • Sabbatical Leave: Staff with six years of FT service or more are eligible for a 4-week (21 day) paid sabbatical.
  • 401(k) retirement plan- We offer a 2% employer match after the first year of employment.
  • Reimbursements for your personal cell phone and home internet
  • A $200 initial office set up stipend with an additional $100 stipend annually
  • A $500 annual professional development stipend, in addition to a robust and growing internal training program provided free to staff.

Hiring Process

All applicants should apply via our Rippling hiring platform. You are asked to provide an updated resume, as well as a cover letter that should detail the following:

  • Relevant skills and experience;
  • Your interest in the position, including your interest in advancing in your career at Elevate, specifically;
  • Your professional strengths;
  • Evidence of your alignment with our company values.

Based on these materials, a hiring manager will contact you with next steps on a rolling basis. Applicants whose experiences and qualifications are strongly aligned with the position will be asked to complete a hiring exercise designed to assess your fundraising strategy and grant writing skills, as well as an interview process that will include at least two interviews prior to final decisions.

We accept applications and hire on a rolling basis that is aligned with our staffing needs for new clients and projects. This process can take anywhere from one to three months from application to start date. Additionally, we use Rippling to communicate with our applicants throughout the hiring process. Please take a moment to add emails from @ats.rippling.com as a safe sender before submitting your application. If you do not, emails may be directed to your spam folder, or may not reach you at all.

Elevate provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment, without regard to race, creed, ancestry, citizenship, religion, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, family responsibilities, age, national origin, political affiliation, sexual orientation, genetic information, status as a victim of domestic violence, marital status, disability, personal appearance or any other protected characteristic or status under applicable federal, state and local laws. If you require reasonable accommodations under the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) for any part of the application process, please contact .

Southern New Hampshire University is a team of innovators. World changers. Individuals who believe in progress with purpose. Since 1932, our people-centered strategy has defined us — and helped us grow a team that now serves over 180,000 learners worldwide.

Our mission to transform lives is made possible by talented people who bring diverse industry experience, backgrounds and skills to the university. And today, we're ready to expand our reach. All we need is you.

The opportunity

At SNHU, you'll have the option to work remotely in the following states: Alabama, Arizona, Arkansas, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Mississippi, Missouri, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New Mexico, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, West Virginia, Wisconsin and Wyoming.

Southern New Hampshire University is seeking a student employee to fill the role of English Teacher for Adults for our partner organization Intercambio Uniting Communities. Intercambio Uniting Communities is seeking dedicated and passionate individuals to serve as English teachers for individual online instruction with adult English learners. As an Online teacher, you will play a vital role in helping learner improve their English language skills, enhancing their confidence, and building life-changing connections.

Job Responsibilities

  • Teaching English: Using Intercambio’s relationship-based adult online ESL curriculum, Confidence and Connections, Online teachers plan and deliver English lessons to one learner. Online Teachers use the Intercambio Learning System to lead interactive, fun, and engaging lessons, while promoting a cooperative learning environment.
  • Fostering Cultural Connections: Online teachers embrace the “Intercambio Way” which promotes opportunities for learners and teachers to learn from each other about their cultures, perspectives, experiences, and traditions while learning and teaching English.

Minimum Qualification

  • Current enrollment in classes as part of a SNHU degree program
  • Work study part of financial aid package
  • Students with work study may be prioritized
  • Passion for building community, teaching English, and helping learners succeed.
  • Patience, empathy, a positive attitude, and a spirit of life-long learning.
  • Basic computer knowledge to use a video-conferencing platform, similar to Zoom, to conduct online classes (working camera and microphone).
  • Do not need to speak a language other than English.
  • No prior teaching or tutoring experience in English required. Our materials are designed to be used by people of all different backgrounds and to make it as easy as possible for anyone with patience, enthusiasm, and a desire to learn and connect with others to teach English.
  • Designated time in your schedule to hold two 90-minute classes per week, plus about 30 minutes for lesson preparation. Intercambio will find a learner who you can meet at the time you are available. If you have more than 4 hours a week, you can teach more than one learner!

Time Commitment

  • Online teachers meet with their students for 90 minutes, 2 times a week to complete at least two Confidence and Curriculum books (about a 6-month commitment). After completing two books, Online teachers are encouraged to continue with their students for subsequent books.
  • The class schedule is based on the availability provided by teachers and learners.

Training and Ongoing Support:

  • All Online Teachers must complete Intercambio’s training for new teachers, which includes approximately 8 hours of online training video modules that can be completed independently and one 2-hour live Zoom online training session. Upon successful completion of this training, trained teachers will receive a certificate of completion from Intercambio for to become an English teacher for adults.
  • In addition to the required training for Online teachers, Intercambio also provides ongoing workshops, Teacher Connection Hours, and a summer conference to help support teachers to continue to improve their skills. These sessions are recommended but not required.

Learning Outcomes

This is a perfect position for anyone considering teaching, living abroad, working in global business, or just curious about other people and their cultures. Skills learned such as time management, organization of work, and communication will help give an excellent foundation for any future career.


We believe real innovation comes from inclusion - where different experiences, perspectives and talents are celebrated. So if you're wondering whether SNHU is right for you, take the leap and apply. You might be just the person we're looking for.


If you have a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to fully engage in any part of the application or hiring process, please complete the Accommodation Request form or contact us at 603-626-9447. A member from the Employee Accommodation Support Center will be in contact with you within two business days to discuss your request.


Compensation


The hourly pay range for this position is $13.00 - $15.00. Actual offer will be based on skills, qualifications, experience and internal equity, in addition to relevant business considerations.

Forecasting:

    • Build scenario and sensitivity analyses to test potential outcomes.

Variance Analysis:

    • Compare actual results to budgets/forecasts.
    • Prepare written commentary to explain variances and recommend corrective actions.

Financial Modeling:

    • Build dynamic Excel or Google Sheets models (DCF, ROI, IRR, break-even).
    • Use advanced formulas, macros, or BI tool integrations to improve accuracy.

Reporting:

    • Prepare management reporting packages with dashboards and visualizations.

Collaboration:

    • Partner with department heads to align forecasts with operational plans.
    • Work with FP&A teams to refine planning assumptions.

Process Improvement:

    • Identify inefficiencies in forecasting workflows.
    • Implement new FP&A software or improve data integrations (Adaptive Insights, Anaplan, Workday, or equivalent).

What Makes You a Perfect Fit:

  • Highly analytical with an eye for detail.
  • Comfortable building models from scratch and explaining them simply.
  • Proactive in identifying trends, risks, and opportunities.

What Does a Typical Day Look Like?

A Budgeting/Forecasting Specialist’s day revolves around building clarity about the future of the business. You will:

  • Maintain financial models — updating them with actuals and revising assumptions based on market or internal trends.
  • Analyze variances — reviewing how actual results differ from plan and preparing written explanations with supporting data.
  • Support decision-making — running scenario analyses (“what happens if revenue grows 15%?” “what if headcount increases by 20?”) and presenting implications to leadership.

Working Hours: U.S. client business hours (aligned with prospect time zones and sales team schedules)
