jobs.title: Application Security Engineer - Agents platform
jobs.description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenAgents is our platform for building and running conversational AI agents at scale. As our first Application Security Engineer embedded in the Agents team, you’ll make the secure way the easy way. You’ll build the security tooling and reusable primitives that let engineers ship securely by default.

This is a builder role. Expect to spend about 70% of your time building tools and internal systems, and the rest working with engineers, staying in sync with Core Security, and doing security research. More than half of the work is greenfield and most of it starts with you, you’ll spot the problems worth solving and own each solution from idea to production.

You will:

  • Build security primitives that are easy for engineers to adopt, starting from what you find when you audit the Agents codebase

  • Review new product work for security and feed what you learn back into shared tooling

  • Lead the major security improvements to the Agents platform, working closely with Core Security

  • Make sure Agents platform uses authn and authz controls correctly and building the guardrails that keep the platform from compromising on security best practices

  • Set the security bar for the Agents platform and make meeting it the easy path for product engineers

  • Work with engineers daily to help them ship fast and safely

Requirements

  • 5+ years in application security engineering at scale, covering secure design, vulnerability management and security tooling

  • Strong software engineering skills: you have built and shipped products end to end, in production-quality code

  • Fluency in Python, our main language. Golang or another language is fine if you can pick up Python quickly

  • Hands-on experience with authentication and authorization. Experience securing cross-service communication is a bonus

  • Experience with large-scale, customer-facing backend systems and enterprise-grade security

  • Clear communication and a real enjoyment of working with developers

  • A track record of owning delivery end to end

Bonus:

  • Security for AI and LLM applications

  • Cloud-native experience (AWS or GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, IAM, networking, Linux internals)

  • Experience in regulated environments (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI, HIPAA)

  • Not required: Compliance certifications, incident response experience, a traditional security background, or prior domain knowledge. We care about what you have built and shipped, and open source work or conference talks are welcome evidence of that.

Location

This role is remote and can be executed globally. However, to facilitate working with the Security Team, we prefer candidates based in GMT to GMT+3 or UK. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in Dublin, London or Warsaw

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.title: Developer Relations Engineer
jobs.description:
Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

About Tailscale

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

Tailscale is looking for a Developer Relations Engineer to own and improve the developer experience across Tailscale’s expanding product portfolio. You’ll help developers understand, adopt, extend, and build with our core VPN/connectivity product, while also shaping how that experience evolves as Tailscale expands into new product areas like secure AI access (Aperture), privileged access management (PAM), and whatever comes next.

You’re a builder, investigator, and storyteller. You write code, chase technical curiosities all the way down, and turn what you learn into things other developers can use like demos, docs, talks, blog posts, sample apps, workshops, videos, tools, and open source contributions. You build things, break things, explain things, and keep going until the thing you’re working on has a name.

You’re comfortable speaking at conferences and just as comfortable digging through an API, a GitHub issue, or a weird networking edge case until it makes sense. You’re probably the kind of person who runs a local AI model in your homelab and can explain exactly why. You ask “why does it work that way?” often, and your instinct is to make the answer clearer, simpler, and better for the next developer.

Requirements

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, with demonstrated experience building, debugging, and shipping real projects through professional work, open source, self-directed learning, or ambitious personal projects.
  • Ability to create clear, useful developer-facing materials, including code samples, demos, tutorials, docs, blog posts, videos, talks, and workshops.
  • Deep curiosity about how systems work, especially across networking, infrastructure, security, identity, cloud, open source, AI, or developer tooling.
  • A track record of building and explaining technical systems, such as production software, developer tools, infrastructure projects, homelabs, local AI setups, networking experiments, or open source contributions.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and visual communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical ideas clearly, creatively, and practically.
  • Experience presenting to technical audiences, whether through conferences, meetups, livestreams, workshops, podcasts, videos, or internal engineering forums.
  • Comfortable working in public through GitHub issues, pull requests, community forums, social channels, open source projects, and developer feedback loops.
  • Strong developer empathy, emotional intelligence, and product sense; you notice friction, understand why it matters, and help translate it into better docs, APIs, examples, workflows, and product experiences.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with engineering, product, marketing, support, community, and other technical stakeholders while operating independently and driving high-impact projects from idea to execution.
  • Comfortable managing multiple workstreams, meeting regular publishing, event, or launch deadlines, discussing technical tradeoffs in detail, and traveling for events, conferences, and community moments.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Go, networking, VPNs, WireGuard, identity, access controls, infrastructure automation, or security products.
  • Experience building developer education programs, sample apps, workshops, technical video content, or conference talks.
  • A visible history of technical writing, talks, demos, open source contributions, or community work.
  • Experience with homelabs, self-hosting, local AI models, infrastructure experiments, or other “I wanted to understand how this works, so I built it” projects.
  • Familiarity with secure AI access, privileged access management, zero trust, or modern infrastructure security patterns.
  • Familiarity with open source contribution workflows and technical collaboration in public.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, whether gained through formal education, professional experience, open source work, self-directed learning, or building ambitious projects on your own.
  • A track record of building and explaining technical systems. This could include production software, developer tools, infrastructure projects, open source contributions, homelab experiments, local AI setups, networking projects, or anything else that shows how you think.
  • If your background is less conventional, we still want to hear from you. Bring us your GitHub repos, blog posts, diagrams, configs, talks, demos, lab notes, or the deeply specific story of why your homelab is built the way it is.
  • Comfort discussing technical tradeoffs in detail such as explaining what you built, why you built it, what broke, what you learned, and what you would do differently next time.

As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.

UK Pay Range

£100,330—£111,390 GBP

What We Offer

  • An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self. We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life.
  • A competitive total compensation package. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).
  • Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family!
  • Remote first company—most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description.
  • Employer-funded retirement contributions. Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation.
  • Connect with other Tailscalars IRL. Attend our annual company retreat, participate in team off-sites, and collaborate in person with teammates across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Singapore. We support intentional in-person connection through team travel and distributed collaboration.
  • Support for your personal and professional development. Grow your career thoughtfully with $1500 USD annually for professional development, or take advantage of mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities.
  • Paid time off and a healthy work-life integration. Our flexible, paid time off program supports you for any situation life throws your way, whether moving homes or travelling the world!
  • A build-your-own home office setup. You choose your own company-owned laptop (Mac or PC), receive a monthly home internet reimbursement, and $500 USD to customize your workstation to make it your own.
  • Paid parental leave program. We care about your life outside of work and encourage new parents to take advantage of parental leave top-ups (20 weeks for birthing parents, 16 weeks for non-birthing parents).

Tailscale is committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring process. If you require an accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process or related to any aspect of this role, please contact your recruiter.

Our hiring process uses AI-assisted tools to help screen and assess candidates. All hiring decisions are made by people.

Please be aware that legitimate emails from Tailscale's talent team will only originate from @tailscale.com, @greenhouse.io, and @interviews.modernloop.io email addresses. For more information about protecting yourself from impersonators and scams, please visit https://tailscale.com/scam-awareness.

jobs.title: Sales & Operations Specialist, RC Capital
jobs.description:
RevenueCat gives app businesses the infrastructure and tools to build, run, and improve their monetization. Since graduating from YC's S18 batch, we've grown into the default monetization platform for mobile.

We're in 50%+ of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $16B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo developer to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue.

We're a remote-first team of 150+ people across 25+ countries, guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance.

This isn't the right fit for everyone. The systems you’ll build here manage billions of dollars and touch hundreds of millions of end users, and we don’t take that lightly. You'll be expected to work hard and hold a high bar for what you ship, alongside some of the sharpest, most driven people you've worked with. If that sounds energizing rather than exhausting, keep reading.

The Role

RC Capital is RevenueCat's first move into financial services. Our first product, Early Payouts, gives developers access to App Store proceeds without waiting the usual 30 to 60 days for Apple and Google to pay them.

As Sales & Operations Specialist, RC Capital, you will own the customer lifecycle end-to-end - from identifying and qualifying suitable prospects through screening, onboarding, activation, ongoing support, account operations, and portfolio health. You will combine commercial judgment, customer care, operational discipline, and risk awareness to help RC Capital acquire and serve more healthy customers.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role on a small founding team. You might move from a discovery call to an onboarding issue, a portfolio review, and a workflow improvement in the same day. You will work closely with Sales, Support, Product, Data, Finance, Legal, Marketing, and GTM Operations, and report to the VP of Strategy & Operations. You will also help build the playbook and systems future teammates inherit.

What You'll Own:

  • Sales and qualification. Manage a portfolio of inbound and targeted outbound opportunities. Run discovery, assess product and customer fit, coordinate screening, handle objections, maintain momentum, and guide suitable prospects to a clear decision.

  • Onboarding and activation. Lead approved customers from decision to activated. Ensure customers understand how to use Early Payouts successfully.

  • Customer support and portfolio operations. Serve as a reliable point of contact for customers, including questions, disputes, and operational issues. Coordinate with RevenueCat Support and specialist teams, and own follow-through through resolution.

  • Risk-aware execution. Apply documented customer, fraud, and risk policies consistently; investigate issues; document decisions; monitor emerging patterns; and make sound recommendations. Escalate exceptions and regulated or high-impact decisions to the appropriate risk, legal, finance, or leadership owner.

  • Lifecycle performance and insight. Maintain a reliable view of pipeline, onboarding, support demand, usage, and portfolio health. Turn data into recommendations on funnel quality, conversion, time to activation, drop-off, retention, customer experience, and risk indicators. Bring structured customer insight to Product to inform roadmaps.

  • Systems, automation, and playbooks. Improve CRM, support workflows, internal handoffs, reporting, documentation, and automation. Use AI thoughtfully to reduce manual work and response times without weakening controls or customer trust. Partner with Marketing, Operations, Data, and Product on durable implementations.

  • Customer and growth. Partner with Marketing on focused acquisition and lifecycle experiments. Support marketing efforts like campaign execution, competitive analysis, and content that drives demand.

What We're Looking For

  • 4+ years in a high-ownership, customer-facing commercial or operations role spanning sales, account management, customer success, customer support, or customer operations.

  • A track record of moving opportunities through a commercial process and managing a meaningful volume of customer relationships with strong follow-through.

  • Experience in fintech, payments, lending, factoring, embedded finance, or another environment where customer growth and operational risk are closely connected.

  • 1-2 years of marketing or growth experience running campaigns or managing CRM-driven outreach.

  • Strong operational judgment: you clarify ownership, define next steps, document decisions, apply policy consistently, and recognize when an issue needs specialist review.

  • Analytical fluency across CRM, support, and analytics tools, with the ability to diagnose funnel or portfolio performance and recommend action.

  • Practical experience improving workflows with automation and AI, including judgment about where automation introduces unacceptable risk or a poor customer experience.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication: persuasive with prospects, clear during onboarding, calm in disputes, and concise with executives and cross-functional partners.

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity on a small, autonomous team and working hours that meaningfully overlap with US time zones.

Nice to Have

  • Direct experience with payment operations, underwriting, fraud and risk workflows, disputes, or compliance-adjacent processes.

  • Experience launching a new product, business line, or operating motion before the playbook was written.

  • Knowledge of mobile apps, developer products, subscriptions, or App Store economics.

  • Experience contributing to CRM or lifecycle campaigns, customer-facing content, or growth experiments.

  • Familiarity with tools such as Salesforce, Notion, Linear, Intercom or Zendesk, Slack, Zoom, and product analytics platforms.

What success looks like

In your first 30 days

  • Understand RC Capital's product, customers, unit economics, risk model, and role within RevenueCat.

  • Map the lifecycle from first signal through activation and live-account support.

  • Establish baseline reporting for pipeline quality, conversion, time to decision, time to activation, support demand, repeat usage, and portfolio health.

  • Shadow sales, onboarding, support, risk, and account reviews; then handle initial customer interactions with support.

  • Ship one concrete improvement to a workflow, report, playbook, or automation.

By 90 days

  • Independently own a portfolio from qualification and screening through onboarding and ongoing operations, escalating genuine exceptions appropriately.

  • Give the team a reliable view of pipeline, onboarding, support, usage, and portfolio performance, with recommendations rather than reporting alone.

  • Run a consistent cadence for opportunity follow-up, onboarding, live-account reviews, and issue resolution.

  • Ship workflow or automation improvements that reduce manual work or customer wait time without weakening controls.

  • Support marketing efforts to deliver on targets.

  • Translate recurring customer and operational friction into structured recommendations for Product, Data, Finance, Legal, Support, or Marketing.

By 6 to 12 months

  • Improve key lifecycle measures such as conversion, activation speed, utilization and retention.

  • Help grow a portfolio of healthy customers while keeping fraud, disputes, losses, and other agreed risk indicators within guardrails.

  • Maintain a commercial and customer-operations playbook another teammate can follow without relying on context held only in people's heads.

  • Help turn the early motion into a repeatable engine and identify which responsibilities should move to partner teams or future hires as volume grows.

What we offer:

  • Competitive equity in a fast-growing, Series C startup backed by top-tier investors, including Y Combinator

  • 10-year window to exercise vested equity options

  • A fully remote environment designed around autonomy and flexibility

  • 4-5 weeks of flexible time off annually

  • Paid desk at a co-working space

  • Workspace budget and continuous learning stipend

Interviewing at RevenueCat

Our interview process is rigorous on purpose. We want to be sure that everyone we bring on is genuinely excited about this work, aligned with how we operate, and ready to meet our high bar for performance. Curious what that actually looks like? Read more in our blog post on how we hire at RevenueCat, including tips to help you succeed.

More on how we work:

  • How we think about hiring and team design: Building a Winning Team

  • The values that guide how we work: Our Values

  • How we work as a remote team: How We Work Remotely at RevenueCat

  • What to expect from our interview process: Interview Expectations

  • What to expect from comp and employment: Employment FAQ

jobs.title: Director of Platform Engineering [gn] – Data Intelligence Platform
jobs.description:
About Actian

Actian is the company behind the Data Intelligence Platform — an enterprise solution that helps organisations discover, govern, and trust their data at scale.

Our platform connects metadata, data lineage, data quality, and business context into a single knowledge graph, enabling enterprises to turn raw data into reliable decisions and providing the trusted data foundation required for enterprise AI.

We operate globally, move fast, and build for the long term.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced Director of Platform Engineering or Director of DevOps to establish and lead our newly formed Platform Engineering organisation.

This is a hands-on technical leadership position for an engineering leader who has successfully built and scaled platform or infrastructure teams within a technology product company.

You will not simply inherit and manage an existing organisation. You will build the team, define its technical direction, establish its operating model, and remain closely involved in architecture and implementation.

You should be someone who can move confidently between strategic decisions and hands-on engineering: designing infrastructure, reviewing code, implementing automation, solving complex production challenges, and setting engineering standards.

We are an AI-first engineering organisation. We expect you to actively use AI technologies to accelerate engineering, automate infrastructure operations, and fundamentally rethink how platform teams work.

This is a builder's role, not a traditional executive management position.

What You Will Own:

1. Platform Engineering & Architecture

  • Establish and lead the Platform Engineering organisation from the ground up.
  • Design and implement scalable, reliable platform services supporting our data catalog, knowledge graph, and integration APIs.
  • Define the architecture and engineering standards used across the organisation.
  • Establish clear ownership boundaries and effective collaboration with product engineering teams.

2. Cloud Infrastructure & Deployment

  • Design and deliver a cloud-agnostic deployment architecture across AWS, Azure or Google Cloud, and customer-managed on-premises and private-cloud environments.
  • Build and maintain Kubernetes-based infrastructure in production.
  • Own infrastructure as code using Terraform/Terragrunt and GitOps-based deployment using Argo CD or equivalent technologies.
  • Ensure reliable installation, upgrades, maintenance, and supportability across different customer environments.
  • Support restricted-network and air-gapped deployment scenarios where required.

3. AI-First Engineering & Infrastructure Operations

  • Integrate AI agents into infrastructure operations, including incident triage, remediation, change validation, and reporting.
  • Use AI coding assistants and development agents extensively in your own daily engineering work.
  • Establish practical standards for AI-assisted engineering across the platform team.
  • Identify opportunities to replace traditional tools and operational processes with AI-driven automation.
  • Build the infrastructure required to support AI and ML workloads, including model-serving environments and associated data services.
  • Ensure appropriate human oversight, security guardrails, and auditability for AI-driven operations.

4. Security, Compliance & Reliability

  • Establish security and compliance practices supporting SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and GDPR.
  • Ensure compliance with EU data residency and customer-specific security requirements.
  • Implement automated compliance evidence collection and audit readiness.
  • Establish observability, monitoring, incident management, and on-call practices.

5. Team Building & Leadership

  • Recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing Platform Engineering team.
  • Define the team's structure, responsibilities, processes, and engineering culture.
  • Remain technically involved while developing the team's capabilities and autonomy.
  • Work closely with the SVP of Engineering and other technical leaders to align platform strategy with business and product priorities.

What You Will Deliver in Your First 12 Months:

  • Build and establish a high-performing Platform Engineering team with clear ownership and responsibilities.
  • Deliver a portable deployment architecture supporting AWS, at least one additional public cloud, and customer-managed infrastructure.
  • Establish infrastructure as code and GitOps delivery as standard engineering practices.
  • Introduce AI agents into operational workflows, with measurable reductions in manual effort and operational overhead.
  • Deliver scalable infrastructure foundations for our data catalog, knowledge graph, and integration APIs.
  • Automate compliance evidence collection and improve audit readiness.
  • Establish a reliable operating model covering observability, incident response, security, and cloud cost management.

What You Bring:

Leadership & Experience

  • 10+ years of professional experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, Infrastructure Engineering, or SRE.
  • At least 3 years of direct engineering management experience.
  • Currently operating at Director of Platform Engineering, Director of DevOps, or an equivalent hands-on Director-level position.
  • Demonstrated experience building and scaling engineering teams, rather than exclusively managing established organisations.
  • A strong track record of delivering and operating production platforms within a technology product company.
  • The ability to combine technical leadership with hands-on engineering execution.

Technical Expertise

  • Deep, hands-on production experience with Kubernetes.
  • Strong infrastructure-as-code experience, particularly Terraform or Terragrunt.
  • Proven experience implementing GitOps and CI/CD pipelines using Argo CD or comparable technologies.
  • Strong AWS expertise and practical experience designing cloud-portable architectures.
  • Experience with Azure or Google Cloud is highly desirable.
  • Demonstrated experience with self-hosted or on-premises enterprise software deployments.
  • Practical experience with SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, and data residency requirements.
  • Experience with cloud cost optimisation, FinOps, and infrastructure efficiency.

AI-First Mindset

  • Extensive practical use of AI coding assistants, development agents, and AI-driven automation.
  • Experience applying AI to engineering productivity and infrastructure operations.
  • Ability to identify, implement, and govern AI-driven operational workflows.
  • A forward-looking mindset about how AI will change platform engineering and infrastructure management.

Leadership Approach

  • Strong ownership and execution skills.
  • Comfortable making technical decisions and taking responsibility for their outcomes.
  • Able to build teams and systems from scratch.
  • Clear communication and the ability to work across distributed international engineering teams.
  • Comfortable working across US Eastern and Central European time zones.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with enterprise data platforms, data catalogues, metadata management, or graph databases.
  • Production experience across multiple cloud providers.
  • Experience with air-gapped and restricted-network deployments.
  • Infrastructure for AI/ML workloads, model serving, vector databases, or graph data stores.
  • OpenTelemetry or comparable observability technologies.
  • Privileged access management solutions such as StrongDM.

How You Will Work:

You will report directly to the SVP of Engineering and work closely with Product Engineering, Security, Customer Success, and Support.

This is a fully remote position based in the US East Coast, UK, Germany, France, or Spain, subject to local employment eligibility.

You should be able to maintain at least four hours of daily overlap with both US Eastern Time and Central European Time.

Occasional travel for team offsites and company-wide meetings may be required.

We value builders over theorists, ownership over hierarchy, and measurable outcomes over activity.

If you have built and scaled a platform engineering organisation, remain technically hands-on, and believe AI should fundamentally change how infrastructure teams operate, we would like to hear from you.

What We Offer:

  • The chance to be part of an innovative, fast-growing company making a significant impact in the data management space.
  • Collaboration with a passionate and diverse team.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Flexible work arrangements (remote or hybrid).
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.

Compensation

Additional Information

Why Join Us? At Actian, we are passionate about innovation and teamwork. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment, loves creating an efficient and welcoming workspace, and enjoys working closely with a talented team.

Interested? We’d love to hear from you! Let’s discuss how you can contribute to our success while growing your career with us.

We value diversity at our company. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.

jobs.description:
About Us

Our Interview Process

jobs.title: Product Manager, Network & Accounts
jobs.description:
Product Manager; Network & Accounts

Location: Remote - United Kingdom United States, and Europe (France, Germany, Portugal)

About Worldly

Worldly is the world’s most comprehensive impact intelligence platform — delivering real data to businesses on impacts within their supply chain. Worldly is trusted by 40,000 global brands, retailers, and manufacturers to provide the single source of ESG intelligence they need to accelerate business and industry transformation.

Through strategic and meaningful customer relationships, Worldly provides key insights around supplier performance, product impact, trends analysis, and compliance. When a company wants to change how business is done, we enable that systemic shift.

Backed by a dedicated global team of individuals aligned by values, Worldly proudly operates as a public benefit corporation with backing from mission-aligned investors. Want to learn more? Read our story.

About the Role

Worldly's Network connects the brands and retailers who source goods, the suppliers who make them, and the verifiers who confirm the accuracy of supplier assessments. Brands use it to find and connect with their suppliers, and suppliers join to share assessments with the brands they work with. Every Worldly product, including the Higg Index, depends on the Network being accurate, because an assessment is only useful when it's attached to the right facility and visible to the right brand. The Network is also the foundation of Worldly's transparency and traceability work: a brand can only trace what it sources if every supplier and facility in the chain appears in the Network once, correctly.

This is a technical product role with a customer problem at the center of it. You will own the experiences that bring customers into the Network and keep them there:

  • Getting in: finding a company or facility, joining or claiming it for their Worldly account, and resolving duplicates and conflicting claims so each real-world entity has one trusted record.

  • Buying in: purchase, checkout and subscriptions.

  • Managing: accounts, users and access once a customer is in.

You will spend real time with brands, sourcing teams, suppliers, and our internal Customer Success teams to understand where these experiences help them achieve their goals and where they fall short, and you will set the measures that show whether they're improving.

You'll collaborate with product managers across Platform and Traceability, turning what customers need into clear requirements for the shared services behind the Network.

What You'll Do

  • Align teams and cross-functional partners so everyone understands what is being built (and why)

  • Translate product vision into initiatives, epics and stories

  • Run discovery with brands, suppliers, and Customer Success on how the Network is used; set and track KPIs

  • Cultivate backlog prioritization for your areas of focus

  • Write clear specs and plain-language definitions that engineers, CS, and customers can all use; support release planning and change management.

We'd Like to See

  • 5+ years of product management experience on technical or platform products

  • You can reason about data as a graph: entities, identifiers, and relationships. You have shipped onboarding, identity or account experiences where users must find, claim or de-duplicate records, and you know what it takes for a customer to trust a record

  • Comfortable reading data models and API contracts well enough to write precise requirements for platform teams and judge the trade-offs they propose

  • Deep customer focus: you spend time with the people who build and use supplier networks, you can explain a technical concept to a sourcing manager in plain language, and you decide from what customers do, not only what they say

  • Strong analytical skills; you define conversion, adoption and data quality metrics for the experiences you own and use them to prioritize

It Helps If You Have

  • Experience with entity resolution, de-duplication or master data products

  • Experience in apparel, footwear, or consumer goods supply chains: how brands source, who sits at each tier, and what brands and suppliers each need from a shared platform

  • Exposure to sustainability data such as the Higg Index, or to supplier registries and third-party entity data.

What We Can Offer You

  • Comprehensive benefits offerings. 90% employee premium and 75% spouse/dependent premium covered by Worldly.

  • Company-sponsored 401k with up to 4% match.

  • Incentive Stock Options

  • 100% Parental Paid Leave

  • Unlimited PTO

  • 13 company holidays

Life at Worldly

Our team is motivated to transform the way products are made. By helping our customers succeed in a new era of sustainable production, we are able to build technology that makes a difference on a planetary level.

Our team represents over 15 countries, and brings unique experiences from technology to farming to the table. Surround yourself with kind, enthusiastic, and dedicated people who put collaboration and growth at the center of our shared goals.

Benefits and Perks

  • Earn a competitive salary and performance-based bonuses. Get healthcare, retirement matching, and equity for US employees.

  • Use the office stipend to get the supplies you need. Combat zoom fatigue with no-meeting Fridays.

  • Flexible time off. Take the time you need to recharge. Our culture encourages team members to explore and rest to be their best selves.

  • We're remote, not lonely. Join the culture committee, coffee chats, or a variety of other interest groups.

Travel Notice

Roles at Worldly may require occasional travel to support business needs, including but not limited to team collaboration, customer engagement, or company events.

Equity Statement

We believe it’s essential to reflect the diversity of those we strive to serve. True innovation happens when everyone has room at the table, including the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. We’re dedicated to building a culturally and experientially diverse team that leads and works with empathy and respect.

Compensation Information

Annual Base Salary:

  • €86,000 - €105,000 Annually (EU/UK Range)

  • $120,000 -$135,000 USD Annually (US Range)

10% Annual Bonus Potential

Incentive Stock Option Package (for approved countries)

Work-From-Home Stipends

*Final compensation figures will be determined based on a wide variety of factors, including experience and location. These factors will be evaluated and considered by Worldly throughout the entirety of this process.

**For candidates located outside the U.S., the salary range listed in USD will be paid in the local currency equivalent at the time of offer using the then-current exchange rate.

Ready to innovate? Then join us today.

jobs.title: Senior Customer Engineer Middle East, Oil & Gas
jobs.description:
About the Company

Armada is the hyperscaler for the edge, delivering modular AI infrastructure from first deployment to AI factory with speed, scale and sovereignty. Named one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and to the CNBC Disruptor 50, Armada’s solutions are deployed in over 60 countries globally for organizations ranging from energy to defense.

With nearly $500 million in funding to date, Armada is backed by leading investors including Founders Fund, Lux, BlackRock and Microsoft (M12), alongside strategic partnerships with Microsoft, Dell, Palantir, NVIDIA, SpaceX, and Skydio. We are building the infrastructure layer for sovereign and edge AI - rugged, deployable compute for customers that cannot rely on centralized cloud.

Working at Armada means taking ownership, driving autonomy, and delivering impact. You’ll tackle challenges that haven’t been solved before and help build something transformative from the ground up. What you do here will not only define your career but help further Armada’s mission to bridge the digital divide for customers around the world.

About the Role

We are hiring a Senior Customer Engineer Middle East, Oil & Gas to lead technical pre-sales across our National Oil Company (NOC) engagements in the region. Working alongside our Value Advisor for energy, you will own the technical relationship with NOC customers, translating their operational challenges into Armada solutions across edge compute, sovereign AI, and disconnected/denied-environment use cases. This role covers the regional NOC portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own technical pre-sales for regional NOC accounts: discovery, solution design, demos, proofs of concept, and technical proposals.
  • Maintain accountability for the pre-sale design of integrated edge solutions, including an enclosure appropriate for physical site constraints, hardware requirements sized for workloads, network strategy for local data transfer and remote backhaul, and the application (first- or third-party) deployment approach.
  • Translate upstream, midstream, and downstream operational use cases (e.g. real-time field analytics, edge AI at remote sites, data sovereignty) into Armada architectures.
  • Lead and document proofs of concept, partnering with product, delivery, and partner engineering teams.
  • Remain the customer’s technical point of contact through implementation, partnering with delivery on execution.
  • Act as the trusted technical advisor to customer engineering and IT/OT stakeholders, building credibility at both working and decision-maker levels.
  • Position Armada’s Galleon, Atlas, and Bridge platforms and the Microsoft Azure Local / NVIDIA / Qualcomm stack against alternatives, articulating differentiation on sovereignty, speed, and scale.
  • Develop and maintain deep working knowledge of Armada’s partner ecosystem, their products, software, technology stacks, and how they integrate with Armada, and design joint solutions that combine Armada and partner technologies.
  • Act as the technical interface to partners and system integrators on shared NOC engagements, aligning architectures and dividing technical scope.
  • Support bid and RFP responses with technical content, architecture diagrams, solution selection (hardware and software) and effort estimates.
  • Partner closely with Account Executives and the energy Value Advisor to advance pipeline and shorten technical sales cycles.
  • Feed customer and field insights back to product management to shape the roadmap for energy use cases.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of pre-sales, solution architecture, or customer/sales engineering experience, including direct experience in the oil & gas sector. Oil & gas domain experience is a hard requirement for this role.
  • Strong grasp of edge computing, data center infrastructure, cloud, and/or AI/ML solution architecture.
  • Ability to lead technical conversations with both engineering teams and senior decision-makers.
  • Experience scoping and running proofs of concept and writing technical proposals.
  • Familiarity with the GCC / MEA energy landscape and NOC procurement and operating environments.
  • Comfort working within a multi-partner ecosystem; quickly learning partner and integrator products and stitching them into coherent end-to-end architectures.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills in English; willingness to travel across the region.

Preferred

  • Hands-on exposure to OT/IIoT, remote and disconnected operations, or data sovereignty requirements.
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure (incl. Azure Local) and/or NVIDIA AI and/or Qualcomm infrastructure.
  • Arabic language skills.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first six months, you will have built credible technical relationships across the regional NOC portfolio, delivered at least one reference-grade proof of concept, and become the go-to technical authority for energy engagements alongside the Value Advisor. Performance will be measured against concrete targets, including [technical-win rate / pipeline supported / average technical-phase cycle time], agreed with your manager in your first 30 days.

You're a Great Fit if You're

  • A go-getter with a growth mindset. You're intellectually curious, have strong business acumen, and actively seek opportunities to build relevant skills and knowledge
  • A detail-oriented problem-solver. You can independently gather information, solve problems efficiently, and deliver results with a "get-it-done" attitude
  • Thrive in a fast-paced environment. You're energized by an entrepreneurial spirit, capable of working quickly, and excited to contribute to a growing company
  • A collaborative team player. You focus on business success and are motivated by team accomplishment vs personal agenda
  • Highly organized and results-driven. Strong prioritization skills and a dedicated work ethic are essential for you

Equal Opportunity Statement

At Armada, we are committed to fostering a work environment where everyone is given equal opportunities to thrive. As an equal opportunity employer, we strictly prohibit discrimination or harassment based on race, color, gender, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law. This policy applies to all employment decisions, including hiring, promotions, and compensation. Our hiring is guided by qualifications, merit, and the business needs at the time.

Unsolicited Resumes and Candidates

Armada does not accept unsolicited resumes or candidate submissions from external agencies or recruiters. All candidates must apply directly through our careers page. Any resumes submitted by agencies without a prior signed agreement will be considered unsolicited and Armada will not be obligated to pay any fees.

ABOUT ALIMENTIV

Alimentiv is a global CRO with a singular focus: advancing therapies for patients with gastrointestinal diseases. GI is our WHY and for more than 30 years that purpose has driven our scientific rigour, operational excellence, and deep therapeutic expertise, including supporting more than 70% of IBD compounds in development.

+ bonus

jobs.title: Coordinator, Clinical Operations

At Cogstate, we’re advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.

Our digital cognitive assessments are trusted by researchers, clinicians, and pharmaceutical partners around the world, helping to drive breakthroughs in neuroscience and improve outcomes for people living with neurological conditions. Founded on decades of cognitive science and backed by rigorous validation, Cogstate’s assessments are used in more than 150 countries and over 2,000 clinical trials.

Our global team of experts - spanning psychology, data science, operations, and technology - works together to solve complex challenges in brain health assessment, always with a patient-first mindset. Whether we’re supporting a multinational Alzheimer’s trial or developing tools to bring cognitive testing into routine care, our work is meaningful, collaborative, and constantly evolving.

At Cogstate, we’re not just imagining the future of brain health - we’re building it.

That’s why we’re seeking a Clinical Operations Coordinator, accountable for supporting the operational delivery of a variety of contracted services in a Clinical Trial. These services include Rater Training and Monitoring activities (training deployment, management, and in-study reporting/calibration), Clinician Network Management (ensuring quality and consistency across global clinical interviews), Data Management (opening and resolving data queries), and Scale Management (binder creation, translations, logistics & shipping).

The daily workload for the above functional areas will fluctuate throughout the life cycle of a Clinical Trial. The Clinical Operations Coordinator will be cross trained to support multiple functional areas, flexibly jumping in to assist study teams according to their changing bandwidth needs.

Base Salary range - £35,000 - £42,000

  • Work with study teams across a variety of functional areas to ease bandwidth strain on Coordinator responsibilities detailed below.

  • Schedule 1:1 training video conferences between site raters and Cogstate Rater Services staff
  • Hardware shipment scheduling and documentation management.
  • Documenting real time updates to applicable status trackers, coordinating high volume email correspondence, communicating status updates to clinicians/raters, electronic records filing.
  • Point of contact for clinician/rater support questions.
  • Direct communication with site coordinators at clinical settings, activity and communication tracking and general support throughout study.
  • Interact with CRAs for site monitoring activities.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or 1+ years of related experience.
  • Previous project management or administrative support experience preferable
  • Microsoft Office proficiency.

What’s In It For You

  • Remote Work Practices: Cogstate is a virtual first company. Cogstate employees can work from anywhere where Cogstate is registered to business within the United States, Australia, or the United Kingdom!
  • Competitive Salary: We offer competitive base salaries plus additional earning opportunities based on the
    position.
  • Learning & Development Opportunities: Cogstate offers a variety of learning and development opportunities from internal and external sources focused on leadership, and professional & personal development.

Our Culture
We bring our whole selves to work every day. We’re courageous and we deliver together. We’re passionate individuals who enjoy working together. We’re brave enough and care enough to have the right conversations to get the best outcome and are famous for our can-do attitude. We see challenges as opportunities and move with pace to achieve our goals.

If you’re ready to help us in our journey to optimize the measurement of brain health around the world, please apply now!

At Cribl, we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world’s biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality. As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what’s next.

We’re one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd.

Why You’ll Love This Role

Cribl is hiring a Facility Security Officer to build and manage our industrial security program as our federal business grows. You will serve as Cribl’s appointed FSO of record with the Defense Counterintelligence and Security Agency (DCSA), own the Facility Clearance (FCL) program, and support compliance with the National Industrial Security Program and 32 CFR Part 117.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - XTM One
jobs.candidate_required_location: France,  Germany,  Italy,  Portugal,  Spain,  UK
jobs.description:
🌀 The Company

Founded in 2022, Filigran is a global cybersecurity company on a mission to empower defense teams to be proactive through open-source solutions that uncover threats and drive action.

Filigran stands out in the cybersecurity ecosystem through its open-source, AI-powered and threat-informed approach to Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). Our eXtended Threat Management (XTM) platform brings together threat intelligence, exposure validation and cyber risk reduction, enabling organizations to better understand their threat landscape and take action.

At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative.

As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. How we scale matters just as much as how fast we scale: our CORE values: Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity shape how we work together, make decisions and build for the future.

🎯 The Role

We're looking for a Principal Software Engineer to define and drive the technical direction of XTM One, Filigran's AI platform for threat informed defense and the agentic core of the XTM Suite.

XTM One creates and runs cybersecurity expert AI agents and dispatches their intelligence across OpenCTI, OpenAEV and OpenGRC. It also hosts the suite's shared commons (unified authentication, consolidated datasets, configuration) and ships both as SaaS and on premises. Every XTM product connects to it, which makes its architecture one of the most structuring technical decisions at Filigran.

This is not a management role: no headcount, no sprints. You own the technical craft, standards and vision of XTM One, and you carry them into the XTM Foundation, where the engineering principles shared by all products are set for the 60+ engineers at Filigran.

💼 Your Responsibilities

Vision & architecture

  • Define and carry the technical vision of XTM One over the long term, with technical and product leadership.

  • Own the platform architecture: agent runtime and orchestration, tool and MCP integrations, data and context layers, APIs, permission model, shared commons.

  • Design for SaaS and on premises from day one: multitenancy, isolation, upgrade paths, configuration, operability in customer environments.

  • Arbitrate key decisions on scalability, resilience, security, maintainability and cost, including LLM latency and inference cost.

Standards & quality

  • Define the team's technical principles (architecture patterns, code quality, tooling, CI/CD, testing, development with AI assistants) and get them applied through docs, reviews, pairing and example.

  • Set the bar for observability and reliability of nondeterministic AI workloads: metrics, logs, traces, evaluations, and guardrails that make agent behavior measurable and debuggable in production.

  • Keep the right balance between features, technical debt and innovation.

Integration across products & XTM Foundation

  • Define how OpenCTI, OpenAEV, OpenGRC and future products integrate with XTM One: contracts, authentication, data exchange, versioning.

  • Be a full member of the XTM Foundation: bring the XTM One perspective in, carry its decisions back, and keep coherence with the other Principal and Staff Engineers.

In the code

  • Write production code, prototype new approaches before the team adopts them, review critical PRs so that feedback teaches, and unblock engineers.

🤝 Who You'll Work With

  • Reports to: VP of Technology

  • Key collaborators: XTM One engineering team and its verticals; XTM Foundation (Principal and Staff Engineers across OpenCTI, OpenAEV, OpenGRC); Product leadership; open source contributors.

  • Working model: embedded in the XTM One team, with regular XTM Foundation work.

🧬 Profile We're Looking For

  • 10+ years in software engineering, with technical leadership on complex production platforms.

  • Strong fullstack background, with a backend and architecture focus. You master TypeScript and Python, the core languages of XTM One, and you can take a feature from the data model all the way to the UI.

  • Strong system design: distributed systems, scalability, performance, security, observability.

  • A 360° view of software engineering: product need, design, code and tests, CI/CD, packaging and release, infrastructure and deployment, production operations, monitoring, incident response. A container image or an upgrade path is as familiar to you as an API contract.

  • Built and operated platforms delivered both as SaaS and on premises, including multitenancy and enterprise constraints.

  • Strong AI affinity. You've been building with LLMs by choice for a year or two, with LLM systems in production: agent frameworks, tool calling, MCP, RAG and vector search, evaluation, and the discipline to make them reliable.

  • Technical watch is part of the job. You keep up with your craft deliberately (reading, experimenting, prototyping) and turn what you learn into concrete proposals.

  • You define and carry technical standards: you raise the bar on a team, you don't just follow it.

  • Excellent written communication in English: design docs, ADRs and review comments that others learn from.

  • Autonomous and at ease in a remote, asynchronous culture; you drive problems to resolution and enable others instead of becoming a bottleneck.

  • Bonus: cybersecurity domain knowledge (CTI, CTEM, MITRE ATT&CK, STIX/TAXII); extensible plugin or tool ecosystems; open source contributions or maintainership.

🛡️ About XTM One

XTM One is Filigran's AI platform for threat informed defense. It is dedicated to creating and running cybersecurity expert AI agents and dispatching their intelligence across the products of the XTM Suite.

Every product of the XTM Suite is connected to XTM One to leverage AI agents for a more proactive platform that is easier to use. Within XTM One, agents can use and correlate data across products to make the most meaningful assessments and take the most relevant actions. XTM One also hosts shared commons such as unified authentication and consolidated datasets and configuration.

🌱 Why Join Filigran? More than just a job.

We are a fast-growing, global and remote-first company, and we believe the best work combines purpose, impact and innovation. You’ll work alongside talented people across the world who care about what they build, how they build it, and the impact they make on the broader cybersecurity ecosystem.

⭐ Be part of something bigger

We believe we do work that matters. Our open-source approach means that work extends beyond Filigran. You’re contributing to technology and ideas that strengthen a global community of defenders and help make cybersecurity more open and collaborative.

💻 Work at the edge of what’s next

We bring together cybersecurity, open source and AI — giving you the opportunity to work with emerging technologies, experiment with new ways of working, and contribute to how they are applied in practice.

🌍 Global opportunity without borders

Be part of a fast-growing, truly international team — collaborating across Europe, North America, APJ and beyond, with the flexibility of a remote-first environment. As we grow, you’ll have opportunities to expand your scope, take ownership, learn quickly and grow with us.

🧭 A culture grounded in CORE

Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity define how we work together — with openness, ownership, collaboration and respect. These are the principles that guide how we make decisions, treat people and grow together, especially when no one’s watching.

💰 What you can expect

  • Competitive compensation + equity — everyone shares in our success

  • Remote-first flexibility — work from wherever you’re based, with flexibility built into how we operate

  • 25 days PTO baseline — real time to disconnect, recharge and enjoy life outside work

  • Volunteer days — paid time to contribute to causes that matter to you

  • Set up for success — choose the equipment that works for you, with additional support for your remote work and development needs as our programs evolve

  • Two annual in-person get-togethers — one global company get-together and one team get-together, creating dedicated time to connect, collaborate and strengthen our culture beyond the screen

🌍 Equal Employment Opportunity

We enable cybersecurity through inclusion — from code to culture.

At Filigran, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe the diversity of our people makes our products and our team stronger. We welcome talent of every background, identity and lived experience, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability or veteran status.

What matters here is what you bring, not what you look like, where you’re from or how you identify.

🚀 Ready to Join Us?

Apply now and help us build the future of the cybersecurity ecosystem, together.

jobs.title: Customer Support Manager
jobs.description:

With growth comes the need to ensure our customer experience is top of mind even in the most challenging scenarios.

We’re working to build something like magic for a really wide range of startup businesses. A key piece of the magic we’ve built thus far has been smart, product-driven support, and we’re looking to bring on an operational-focused, thoughtful Support Manager to help us continuously improve our Customer Support experience as we scale quickly.

You’ll join as a manager on our Customer Support team, partnering closely with our existing Customer Support Leadership team to execute the operational function of the team and support the wider strategic vision. You’ll manage your own cohort of specialists who are dedicated to managing customer interactions and operational tasks across key customer workstreams. You’ll work closely with our Voice of the Customer, Customer Trust, Operations, WFM and CX Eng teams to improve our product and general customer-facing processes to provide clear, thoughtful, and accurate support systems to help customers.

You’ll need to understand how our products and internal teams work in detail. Banking* has a lot of moving pieces, so this is harder than it might seem. Finding efficient, elegant solutions for problems stemming from the oft-convoluted U.S. financial system isn’t always easy, but if you’re good at your job, our users will never know it.

Your Role:

  • Lead & Develop: Hire, mentor, and manage a customer support team that excels in product knowledge, user support, and the US banking* system
  • Performance Management & Development: Own team performance management by setting clear goals, tracking key metrics, and driving continuous improvement across your team. Foster a culture of continuous learning and professional growth within your team, providing regular feedback and coaching
  • Process Improvements, AI & Automation: Refine and evolve our support processes, building workflows that drive efficiency and effectiveness across the organization including AI tools and automation to make Support faster and more effective. Take ideas from pilot to production while keeping every workflow within our compliance, privacy, and regulatory standards
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with compliance, engineering, product, and banking partners to resolve complex issues, improve our product based on Customer Support interactions, and implement changes that make for a better customer experience
  • Customer Advocacy: Champion our customers by advocating for their needs with data-driven insights and compelling narratives
  • Hands-On Leadership: Be ready to dive into tickets alongside your team during peak times or critical issues, be a sounding board for escalations, and help wherever the team needs as a leader on the front lines

What we’re looking for:

  • 3+ years of experience leading customer support or other user-facing teams, preferably in high-growth technology companies
  • A collaborative leadership style and comfort sharing ownership of a function with a peer manager
  • Expertise in adding structure for support teams growing quickly

The ideal candidate may also have:

jobs.title: Federal Climate Policy Director
jobs.description:
Pacific Environment is a nonprofit organization dedicated to confronting our most urgent environmental issues by connecting local and global movements, catalyzing policy change, and inspiring action for the benefit of people and our planet. Together, we promote a healthy climate, reduce pollution, and conserve biodiversity for an equitable and thriving future. Learn more at www.pacificenvironment.org.

Building on more than thirty years of policy wins for the Pacific Rim's peoples, ecosystems, and climate, Pacific Environment has been campaigning to end fossil fuel use, including to get ships off fossil fuels. Our federal strategies include securing strong regulatory frameworks and legislation to achieve zero-emission shipping on a timeline commensurate with the climate emergency; mobilizing congressional and public pressure on federal agencies and policymakers to adopt binding emissions standards and public investments; and engaging industry and maritime workers as partners in the transition to zero-emission shipping — working with bodies such as the U.S. Coast Guard, MARAD, and the Federal Maritime Commission to align national maritime policy with a zero-emission shipping future.

Position

Pacific Environment seeks an experienced Federal Policy Director to lead the organization's federal government affairs strategy on maritime shipping issues. This role is the organization's principal advocate before Congress and federal agencies — including the U.S. Coast Guard, Maritime Administration (MARAD), Federal Maritime Commission (FMC), EPA, and Department of Transportation — on policy priorities such as vessel emissions and fuel standards, port and vessel infrastructure investment, supply chain resilience, and maritime workforce and safety standards.

The Federal Policy Director will build and maintain relationships with congressional offices and committee staff, track and analyze relevant legislation and rulemakings, represent the organization in coalitions and public forums, and translate technical maritime policy into actionable advocacy strategy. This is a senior externally facing role requiring deep familiarity with the federal legislative and regulatory process and credibility with maritime policy stakeholders.

Key responsibilities

Legislative & regulatory advocacy

  • Serve as the organization's lead representative to Congress, federal agencies, and the Administration on maritime shipping policy.
  • Develop and execute a federal advocacy strategy and annual policy agenda in coordination with organizational leadership.
  • Track, analyze, and respond to relevant legislation, appropriations, and agency rulemakings (e.g., Coast Guard authorization, MARAD programs, FMC actions, EPA vessel emissions standards, IMO-related federal implementation).
  • Draft and deliver testimony, comment letters, position papers, one-pagers, and talking points for policymakers and internal leadership.
  • Build and sustain relationships with congressional members and staff, relevant committees (e.g., House T&I, Senate Commerce), and agency officials.
  • Work with congressional offices to shape, draft, and advance legislative proposals.
  • Secure new bipartisan cosponsors for priority legislation and lead efforts to frame bill messaging for cross-party audiences.
  • Carry out various advocacy tactics such as grassroots organizing, traditional and digital outreach, engaging policymakers, in-person mobilization tactics, etc.

Coalition & stakeholder engagement

  • Represent the organization in coalitions, working groups, and industry/NGO partnerships focused on maritime and shipping policy.
  • Cultivate and help lead a Washington, D.C.-based clean shipping/maritime policy coalition, including environmental justice groups, labor organizations, port and maritime associations, and academic partners.
  • Engage with carriers, cargo owners, ports, and maritime industry associations to understand industry positions, identify potential allies for federal policy goals, and inform advocacy strategy.
  • Build and maintain strategic partnerships with industry, labor and allied advocacy organizations.
  • Develop and maintain target lists, relationship maps, and coordinated work plans with congressional offices, agency contacts, and coalition partners to guide advocacy priorities and divisions of labor.
  • Represent the organization at hearings, briefings, conferences, and public forums, and with the press as needed.
  • Support grassroots and grasstops mobilization tactics (e.g., sign-on letters, fly-ins, constituent engagement) to build pressure for federal action, in coordination with campaigns/organizing staff.
  • Support ports, companies, and labor partners in identifying and pursuing federal funding opportunities that advance clean vessel deployment, port electrification, battery production, and domestic maritime supply chains.

Strategy, communications & internal coordination

  • Advise senior leadership and the board on the federal policy landscape, emerging risks, and opportunities.
  • Partner with communications/media teams on public messaging tied to federal policy developments.
  • Coordinate with development/fundraising staff to support grant proposals and donor engagement related to federal policy work, as needed.
  • Supervise consultants, contract lobbyists, or junior policy staff as applicable.
  • Ensure all advocacy activity complies with applicable lobbying disclosure and 501(c)(3) rules.
  • Other tasks as determined by the Climate Policy Director

Qualifications

Required

  • 5–10+ years of federal government affairs, legislative, or regulatory experience, ideally including maritime, transportation, energy, or environmental policy.
  • Demonstrated relationships with congressional offices, committee staff, and/or relevant federal agencies (Coast Guard, MARAD, FMC, EPA, DOT).
  • Strong understanding of the federal legislative process, appropriations cycle, and administrative rulemaking.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience drafting testimony, letters, public comments, and policy materials for non-expert audiences.
  • Track record of representing an organization credibly in coalitions and with external stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote/hybrid environment while regularly meeting with congressional and agency offices in Washington, D.C.
  • Bachelor's degree required.
  • Commitment for climate action, with a demonstrated ability to think creatively and identify innovative opportunities to advance campaign goals.

Preferred

  • Prior experience on Capitol Hill, in a federal agency, or in maritime/shipping industry government affairs.
  • Familiarity with transportation, clean energy, maritime decarbonization, clean fuels, or vessel emissions policy.
  • Existing network within maritime trade associations, port authorities, or environmental/labor coalitions.
  • Experience with defensive advocacy (protecting existing law, funding, or regulatory authority from rollback), not solely proactive policy advocacy.

Compensation

Pacific Environment offers compensation commensurate with experience and equitable with others on our team, along with a full benefits package for staff positions. The benefits include medical, dental, vision, 403b retirement planning with employer match, WFH stipend, generous PTO, sabbatical for tenured staff, and professional development reimbursements.  The salary range is carefully considered to account for equity, and the final offer will be based on the candidate’s qualifications. The employee will enjoy a flexible working environment with a dedicated, diverse group of colleagues. This position has a salary range of $105,000–$115,000. Individual work experience and internal pay equity are considered when extending an offer.

Additional Information

Work environment & travel

This position is remote but requires the employee to be based in Washington, D.C. for regular meetings on the Hill, at agencies, and with coalition partners. Some additional domestic and international travel for conferences and events may be required.

Physical requirements

This role primarily involves sitting and working at a computer for extended periods, frequent virtual and phone communication, and regular in-person meetings, hearings, and events on Capitol Hill and at federal agencies. The ideal candidate must be able to complete the physical requirements of the job with or without reasonable accommodation.

Pacific Environment is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage people from communities harmed by environmental degradation and from backgrounds underrepresented in the environmental movement to apply. We welcome diversity to do our best work and believe that creating teams in which everyone can be their authentic self is key to the change we seek.

Applicants with disabilities may be entitled to reasonable accommodation under the terms of the Americans with Disabilities Act and certain state or local laws. A reasonable accommodation is a change in the way things are normally done which will ensure an equal employment opportunity without imposing undue hardship on Pacific Environment. Please inform our HR team by emailing recruiting@pacificenvironment.org if you need any assistance completing any forms or to otherwise participate in the application or interview process.

Pacific Environment participates in the E-Verify Program: https://www.e-verify.gov/employees

To ensure fair consideration of all candidates, we ask that applicants do not contact Human Resources, Hiring Manager, or Program Staff directly. No phone calls, please.

jobs.title: Account Executive - NA
jobs.description:
🌀 The Company

Founded in 2022, Filigran is a global cybersecurity company on a mission to empower defense teams to be proactive through open-source solutions that uncover threats and drive action.

Filigran stands out in the cybersecurity ecosystem through its open-source, AI-powered and threat-informed approach to Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). Our eXtended Threat Management (XTM) platform brings together threat intelligence, exposure validation and cyber risk reduction, enabling organizations to better understand their threat landscape and take action.

At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative.

As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. How we scale matters just as much as how fast we scale: our CORE values: Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity shape how we work together, make decisions and build for the future.

🎯 The Role

We're looking for an Account Executive, North America to join our Go-to-Market team and drive strategic enterprise growth across the region. You'll own the full sales cycle, from identifying new opportunities to closing complex enterprise deals, while helping organizations adopt Filigran's open-source cybersecurity platforms.

This role is ideal for an entrepreneurial seller who creates opportunities rather than waits for them. You'll work closely with Solutions Engineers, Customer Success, Marketing, Product, and Partners to deliver exceptional customer outcomes and contribute to Filigran's long-term growth.

💼 Your Responsibilities

  • Collaborate closely with Solutions Engineers, Customer Success, Marketing, Product, and Partners to maximize customer success and revenue growth.

  • Maintain accurate forecasting, CRM hygiene, and apply MEDDIC principles to identify risks early and drive action plans.

  • Continuously contribute to improving sales processes, best practices, and team performance.

🤝 Who You’ll Work With

  • Partners closely with Solutions Engineers throughout the sales cycle.

  • Works alongside Customer Success to ensure smooth customer onboarding and long-term adoption.

  • Collaborates with Marketing on pipeline generation and strategic campaigns.

  • Engages regularly with Product and Engineering to relay customer feedback and market insights.

  • Works with Partners to expand market reach and drive joint opportunities.

🧬 Profile We’re Looking For

  • Strong interest in AI and its applications in cybersecurity.

  • Comfortable leveraging AI-powered tools (LLMs, copilots, automation) to improve productivity, research, account planning, and customer engagement.

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in complex B2B enterprise software sales.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a strong sense of ownership, accountability, curiosity, resilience, and coachability.

  • Passionate about delivering long-term customer value beyond the initial sale.

We are looking for someone who:

  • Is highly coachable while bringing ideas and challenging the status quo respectfully.

  • Brings energy, curiosity, and a strong desire to continuously learn.

🌱 Why Join Filigran? More than just a job.

We are a fast-growing, global and remote-first company, and we believe the best work combines purpose, impact and innovation. You’ll work alongside talented people across the world who care about what they build, how they build it, and the impact they make on the broader cybersecurity ecosystem.

🚀 Ready to Join Us?

Apply now and help us build the future of the cybersecurity ecosystem, together.
