jobs.title: IT Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT BASETEN

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.

THE ROLE

We’re looking for an IT Engineer to design the systems behind how people at Baseten get access, stay secure, and move through their time here. This role builds the controls and automation that our IT Operations team runs every day across identity, client platforms, SaaS, and cloud access.

The goal is a corporate environment that’s secure by default and easy to use: access that’s right from day one, removed when it should be, and provable at any time.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Strengthen our identity platform with strong authentication, clean access models, and least privilege as the default.

  • Automate the workforce lifecycle so that joining, changing roles, and leaving Baseten are fast, consistent, and need little manual work.

  • Build reliable pipelines for OS updates, patching, and software deployment that keep the fleet current without disrupting people’s work.

  • Connect device health to access decisions, so a compliant device is what earns access to sensitive systems.

  • Recommend identity and security standards for our SaaS and AI tools, and make the secure configuration the easy path for teams adopting new ones.

  • Bring governance to non-human identities (service accounts, API keys, AI agents) and replace long-lived credentials with better options wherever possible.

  • Manage configuration as code across identity and endpoints to reduce drift, so audit readiness comes from the systems themselves instead of a separate workstream.

  • Give IT Operations well-designed tools and guardrails, so they can handle more requests on their own, safely.

REQUIREMENTS

  • 5+ years in IT engineering or corporate security engineering, ideally at a cloud-native company.

  • Strong grounding in identity: SSO, MFA, provisioning, and the protocols behind them.

  • Hands-on experience engineering macOS fleets at scale: MDM, configuration profiles, app packaging and deployment, and endpoint visibility and EDR tooling.

  • Experience automating real workflows in code (Python, Bash, or similar), and comfort with infrastructure-as-code.

  • A working understanding of SaaS and cloud access risks, and how to reduce them without blocking the business.

  • Good judgment about when to build, when to buy, and when to leave something alone.

  • Clear writing, and a track record of working across IT, People, Engineering, Legal, GRC and Security.

BENEFITS

  • Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity

  • (U.S. only) 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents

  • Flexible PTO policy including company wide Winter Break (our offices are closed from Christmas Eve to New Year's Day!)

  • Paid parental leave

  • Fertility and family-building stipend through Carrot

  • (U.S. only) Company-facilitated 401(k)

  • Exposure to a variety of ML startups, offering unparalleled learning and networking opportunities.

Apply now to embark on a rewarding journey in shaping the future of AI! If you are a motivated individual with a passion for machine learning and a desire to be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team, we would love to hear from you.

At Baseten, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law (by example, the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, where applicable).

jobs.title: Platform Engineer - FedD180/FedD181
jobs.description:
EMPLOYER IS A CONTRACTOR FOR THE U.S. GOVERNMENT. THIS POSITION WILL REQUIRE AN ACTIVE SECRET CLEARANCE TO APPLY.

Defense Unicorns is seeking a Platform Engineer to join our platform team — a combined DevOps and Site Reliability Engineering team responsible for the development, maintenance, and reliability of a cloud-based platform environment. The ideal candidate is a strong problem-solver with hands-on experience in Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, and CI/CD, and is motivated by building and improving the systems that other teams depend on.

In this role, you will work across infrastructure as code, automated deployments, identity and access management, monitoring, and CI/CD pipelines. You will serve as a bridge between application teams and the platform, advocating best practices and helping ensure that the platform is reliable, secure, and scalable. You should be comfortable operating in ambiguity, contributing to documentation and standards where they exist, and building them where they don’t.

Responsibilities

  • Build, maintain, and improve Kubernetes clusters and containerized application deployments across cloud environments (AWS, EKS, RKE2)
  • Develop and manage infrastructure as code (IaC) to provision and configure platform resources consistently and repeatably
  • Own and improve CI/CD pipelines, including GitLab CI configuration, runner deployments, and automated build and deployment workflows
  • Support identity and access management through tools such as Keycloak, including user onboarding, role configuration, and troubleshooting
  • Implement and maintain monitoring, alerting, and logging to ensure platform health and support incident investigation
  • Manage certificate lifecycle operations, including renewal of public certificates and related automation
  • Contribute to platform security posture through container security practices, Iron Bank image compliance, and support for ATO processes
  • Collaborate with application teams to troubleshoot deployment issues, broken pipelines, and platform integration problems
  • Write and maintain technical documentation, runbooks, architecture decision records (ADRs), and operational standards
  • Influence the strategic vision by contributing to the strategic planning that aligns technological advancements with the mission objectives.
  • Participate in on-call rotations and support platform incidents in a tier 2 role
  • Mentor and support junior engineers through pairing, code reviews, and knowledge sharing

The listed responsibilities are not exhaustive and additional responsibilities may be assigned based on the evolving needs of the organization. We are seeking a dynamic individual who is able to adapt and take on new responsibilities as they arise.

Travel Expectations/Requirements: 5-10%

Minimum Experience and Qualifications

  • Active Secret clearance to start
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes (deploying, managing, and troubleshooting clusters and workloads)
  • Experience with infrastructure as code tools (e.g., Terraform, Pulumi, or similar)
  • Proficiency with CI/CD tooling, particularly GitLab CI or equivalent pipeline platforms
  • Working knowledge of Linux/Unix operating systems and command-line administration
  • Experience with cloud platforms, preferably AWS (EC2, EKS, IAM, S3, VPC)
  • Familiarity with containerization (Docker, container image builds, registry management)
  • Ability to read and write YAML fluently for Kubernetes manifests, CRDs, Helm charts, and pipeline configurations
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently in a remote, asynchronous environment
  • Possess or ability to obtain a DoD 8570 IAT II certification (e.g., Security+ CE)

Preferred Experience and Qualifications

  • Experience with UDS Core, Iron Bank, and/or Continuous Authority to Operate (C-ATO) processes
  • Familiarity with identity and access management platforms such as Keycloak or similar
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, or similar)
  • Proficiency in one or more programming languages (Go, Python, or Bash scripting)
  • Experience working in a DevSecOps model with secure coding practices and vulnerability remediation
  • Familiarity with GitOps workflows and tools (e.g., Flux, ArgoCD)
  • Department of Defense experience, specifically working on a production ATO’d system
  • Experience with distributed architectures and everything-as-code approaches
  • AWS certifications related to platform or solutions architecture
  • Experience writing architecture decision records (ADRs), operational runbooks, or engineering standards

Mid Platform Engineer: $123,250 - $166,750

Who We Are

Defense Unicorns delivers mission value by streamlining software delivery so our customers can focus on the most important challenges. We share a vision of freedom and security for the advancement of progress and innovation. Our commitment to this vision, and to our mission-driven customers, means a commitment to speed, user experience and optionality, without compromising security. Our team is composed of innovators, software engineers, and veterans with decades of experience delivering technology programs across the federal market.

What We Do

We create and deliver secure solutions for continuous software integration and delivery. Defense Unicorns consolidates the best practices for security pipelines, testing, and deployment automation in order to meet the high security requirements valued by mission owners. Our solutions are agnostic by design and we believe that growing a robust ecosystem of secure, cloud-native software solutions can help enterprise customers inside and outside the federal market buy and integrate software more easily.

Who We Serve

Defense Unicorns’ customers are mission-focused leaders across public and private enterprises. We proudly support defense and civil agencies across the U.S. government and we work closely with the creators of leading-edge software solutions to deliver value to the mission-owner by improving the security and consumability of commercial software products.

What We Work On

  • Kubernetes
  • Cloud Environments (AWS/GCP and Azure)
  • Infrastructure-as-code (like Terraform/Pulumi)
  • Continuous Delivery and automation tooling
  • GitOps
  • Containers
  • CNCF projects and open source products and packages
  • Helm/Kustomize-Value Stream Mapping
  • Building and improving security delivery
  • Building Kubernetes and cloud native applications

Benefits Our Unicorns Enjoy

Health:

  • Medical/Dental/Vision
  • Premiums are 100% Company Paid
  • Health Savings Account
  • Life Insurance
  • Disability Insurance

Financial:

  • 401k Retirement Plan
  • Company Stock Options
  • Home Office Budget

Leave:

  • We offer all full-time Unicorns Flexible Time Off (FTO) plus all Federal Holidays, one week for Thanksgiving, and two weeks for Christmas and New Year’s
  • Paid Parental Leave

Learning:

  • Reimbursement for approved trainings/subscriptions
  • Conferences (travel, lodging, and fees)

jobs.title: Head of Solutions, Power Markets (West)
jobs.description:
About Energy Exemplar

In an era where the world is rapidly advancing towards a cleaner future through decarbonization, Energy Exemplar’s mission lies in ‘Empowering Transformative Energy Decisions’. Founded in 1999 in Adelaide, Australia, our award-winning software portfolio encompassing the modeling and simulation platform PLEXOS®, Aurora, and Adapt2, is trusted by innovative organizations across the globe. Through our technology and people, we strive to enable stakeholders from across the entire energy value chain to revolutionize the energy ecosystem and to collaboratively plan and execute for a sustainable energy future with unprecedented clarity, speed, and innovation.

Our impact is global and is being recognized across the industry. Some of our recent accolades include:

  • SaaS Company of the Year (2025) – Global Business Tech Awards.
  • Environmental Impact Award (2025) – E+E Leaders Awards.
  • IPPAI (Independent Power Producers Association of India) Power Awards (2025) - Winners
  • Finalist: Platts Global Energy Awards (2024) – Grid Edge category
  • Finalist: Reuters Global Energy Transition Awards (2024) – Technologies of Change
  • Top 50 Marketing Team (2024) – Voted by the public at the ICON Awards.

How We Work

Energy Exemplar is growing fast and that growth is driven by how we work. We trust our team to deliver great results from wherever they work best, whether that’s at home, in the office, or on the move.

We’re a global team that values ownership, integrity, and innovation. You’ll be supported to balance work and life in a way that works for you, and empowered to take initiative, solve problems, and make an impact, regardless of your background, location, or role.

Our four core values, Customer Success, One Global Team, Integrity & Ownership, and Innovation Excellence aren’t just words. They show up in how we collaborate, how we solve, and how we grow together.

About the Position

The Head of Solutions, Power Markets (West Region) leads Energy Exemplar's presales Solutions team across the Western United States and Canada. The role owns the technical win for every opportunity in ERCOT, CAISO, SPP, WECC, AESO, and IESO. Accountability runs from first discovery through technical close and a signed handoff to Services. Scope covers new-logo pursuits and expansion within existing accounts across utilities, ISOs/RTOs, regulators, developers, traders, and consultancies.

This is the region's senior pre-sales leader and its engine of retention and growth. The role turns deployed software into measurable customer outcomes: calibrated models, trusted results, and repeatable decision workflows across resource adequacy, capacity expansion, transmission planning, and market operations. Working with the Regional VP of Sales under a shared handoff protocol, the Head of Solutions ensures every West Region account has a success plan, an executive sponsor, and a clear path to expansion.

Key Responsibilities

The role is accountable for five things: team leadership, technical presales execution, pipeline partnership with Sales, market expertise across six Western markets, and a clean handoff to Services.

  • Lead, coach, and develop the West Region presales Solutions team of energy economists, power systems engineers, and modeling specialists; set goals and build succession depth.
  • Own technical presales across the sales cycle - discovery, solution design, demonstrations, proofs of concept, and proposals - for PLEXOS, Aurora, and Adapt2 opportunities.
  • Partner with the Regional VP of Sales on territory plans, account strategies, and pipeline reviews; align Solutions capacity to the highest-value pursuits.
  • Lead discovery with prospects to map business problems - resource adequacy, capacity expansion, transmission planning, trading - to differentiated Energy Exemplar solutions.
  • Design and deliver compelling, market-specific demonstrations and workshops that prove value quickly and advance opportunities toward technical close.
  • Scope, govern, and execute proofs of concept and pilots with clear success criteria, timelines, and exit decisions tied to commercial outcomes.
  • Lead technical responses to RFPs, RFIs, and security questionnaires; own solution architecture, pricing inputs, and statements of work for Services handoff.
  • Operate the signed Presales-to-Services handoff protocol so every closed deal transfers with agreed scope, assumptions, model artifacts, and success criteria.
  • Bring deep market expertise across ERCOT, CAISO, SPP, WECC, AESO, and IESO to position PLEXOS and Aurora against competitors credibly.
  • Translate regulatory and market change (FERC Order 1920, WRAP, EDAM, SPP Markets+, ERCOT reliability standards) into use cases, campaigns, and pipeline.
  • Drive expansion within existing accounts by identifying new use cases, additional modules, and AI-enabled upsell opportunities with Sales and Services.

Candidate Requirements

The ideal candidate combines Western power-market depth, technical presales leadership, and hands-on modeling credibility.

  • 10-15+ years of experience in power markets, energy consulting, or utility planning, including 5+ years leading technical presales or advisory teams.
  • Proven record owning technical wins - discovery, demonstrations, proofs of concept, proposals - for enterprise software or analytics sales.

  • Executive presence and credibility with utility, ISO, and regulatory leaders; comfortable presenting model results and recommendations to C-suite.
  • Strong people leadership: hiring, coaching, performance management, and developing technical talent in a distributed team.
  • Data fluency with Python, SQL, or similar tools, and familiarity with applying AI/ML to energy modeling workflows.
  • Commercial acumen: able to qualify opportunities, shape deal strategy with Sales, and scope services for proposals.

Qualifications

  • Master's or PhD in power systems engineering, energy economics, energy policy, or a related discipline.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) license or an equivalent professional engineering credential.
  • Formal training in a solution-selling or value-selling methodology (for example, MEDDICC, Challenger, or Command of the Message).
  • Active membership in IEEE PES, IAEE, USAEE, ISO stakeholder committees or similar professional bodies..
  • Prior presales or solutions engineering experience at an energy modeling, analytics, or enterprise software vendor serving utilities and grid operators.
  • Published or presented work on electricity market design, resource adequacy, or transmission planning.

jobs.title: Sales Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
About Clipboard

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.

Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

About the Role

Clipboard is looking for a Sales Operations Analyst to help build and run the systems behind our sales organization.

You'll work across Salesforce, data, automation, and internal tools to help our sales team operate more effectively. That might mean building an automation that eliminates a recurring workflow, investigating a messy data problem, redesigning part of our Salesforce setup, or building a new system from the ground up.

We are a small team with an unusual operating model. Much of our execution runs through AI agents that we direct and quality-check, allowing each analyst to operate with the leverage of a much larger team.

This is equal parts builder and operator. You'll own systems end to end, work through ambiguous requests from reps and leadership, and be accountable for making sure the things you build actually work.

What You'll Do

  • Own live systems. Take ownership of production systems such as account distribution, deal intelligence, competitor tracking, and data sync pipelines. You'll be accountable for their accuracy and reliability.

  • Solve ambiguous problems. Work through requests from sales reps, managers, and leadership, figure out what is actually needed, and execute quickly.

  • Direct AI agents. Write specs and prompts, supervise AI agents, and rigorously QA their output before it touches production data.

  • Build automations and tools. Create scripts, scheduled jobs, Slack bots, and lightweight web apps that turn recurring manual work into scalable systems.

  • Analyze and report. Use SQL and other tools to answer important revenue questions and build reporting the organization can trust.

  • Guard data quality. Handle merges, deduplication, account mapping, enrichment, and other work required to keep our systems accurate at scale.

What We're Looking For

  • Evidence of building. You've built scripts, automations, tools, systems, or other solutions to real problems.

  • AI-native working style. You already use AI to multiply your output and understand where it can fail and how to verify its work.

  • High judgment under ambiguity. You can take a loosely defined problem, figure out what matters, and know when to act versus when to ask.

  • Strong attention to detail. You're comfortable being the last line of defense before changes affect production systems and large datasets.

  • Bias to ownership. When something you own breaks, you don't just fix the immediate issue. You look for the underlying problem and improve the system.

SQL and Python experience are strong pluses, but we're more interested in your curiosity, judgment, and ability to ship than checking every technical box.

Nice to Have

  • Salesforce administration or development experience, including flows, SOQL, or data model design.

  • Experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Business Operations, analytics, or a similar environment.

  • Experience building automations with tools, scripts, APIs, or AI agents.

Interview Process

  1. Application Review – We'll review your experience and evidence of things you've built, automated, or owned.

  2. Take-Home Assessment – A practical, ~2-hour assessment using a fictional company, mock website, and CRM. You'll have 48 hours to complete it, and AI tools are encouraged.

  3. Technical Walkthrough – A 30-minute session where you'll demo what you built, explain your decisions, and make a small live change to your system.

  4. Manager Interview – A 30-minute conversation focused on communication, ownership, judgment, and how you operate under ambiguity.

  5. Final Steps / Offer! – Some candidates may have an executive conversation, followed by references and an offer.

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary

  • Insurance benefits + 401k options

  • Unlimited PTO and flexible holidays

  • Remote-first working environment

To get a better understanding of the general type of people we want to hire, you can check out our blog here.

Quick Note on Scammers:

Clipboard would never ask you for money or your bank details to participate in our hiring process. Report any scammers impersonating the Clipboard hiring team members here.

jobs.title: Lead Counsel, Commercial and Marketing, APAC and Americas
jobs.description:
Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

Reporting to the Principal Counsel, Director of Commercial and Healthcare this role will serve as Lead Counsel, Commercial & Marketing for APAC and the Americas and be a key member of Oura’s Legal Team. The role will partner closely with the APAC and US Commercial, Sales, Partnerships, Retail and Marketing teams, along with other cross-functional leaders, to support Oura as the company grows and scales internationally.The ideal candidate is a seasoned commercial lawyer with substantial in-house and law firm experience advising on and negotiating complex B2B sales, strategic partnerships, data and technology licensing, and retail and distribution arrangements across APAC. Beyond commercial transactions, the right candidate will have hands-on experience advising marketing teams on advertising, promotions and consumer-facing campaigns in Asia and ANZ, including markets with distinct regulatory regimes such as Singapore, Australia, Japan, South Korea and China. The successful candidate will bring strong judgment, credibility with senior stakeholders, and the ability to translate complex legal issues into clear, actionable guidance in a fast-paced, evolving environment

What You Will Do:

  • Review, draft and negotiate complex commercial agreements as the lead lawyer supporting the APAC Commercial and Marketing functions, including enterprise and corporate sales agreements, B2B and channel partnerships, strategic alliances, co-marketing arrangements, and data sharing and licensing agreements.
  • Structure and negotiate retail, distribution, reseller, marketplace and e-commerce agreements across APAC markets.
  • Counsel and advise stakeholders on legal issues affecting APAC business, supporting alignment, efficiency and excellence in execution of commercial and marketing initiatives.

  • Coordinate with US Legal, Privacy, Product and outside counsel in key APAC jurisdictions to deliver consistent global positions adapted to local law, and manage outside counsel where local qualification is required.

This is a remote role based in the US.

What you'll bring

  • Qualified and admitted to practice in at least one major common law jurisdiction (e.g. US (any state), Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia or New Zealand). Admission in a US state and/or an APAC jurisdiction is preferred. Experience working with local counsel in non-common-law markets in Asia is expected.
  • Working knowledge of competition law as it applies to distribution and retail arrangements across the US and APAC, including vertical agreements, selective distribution and resale price maintenance.
  • Deep working knowledge of US and APAC consumer protection, advertising and e-commerce frameworks, with the ability to apply them pragmatically to business objectives.
  • Exceptional drafting skills, with experience negotiating and preparing sophisticated sales, partnership, technology and data licensing, and distribution and retail agreements.
  • Familiarity with APAC and US privacy and data protection regimes as they apply to marketing, partnerships and data sharing, including structuring data use rights and restrictions in commercial agreements.
  • Proven ability to identify and mitigate legal and regulatory risk while enabling scalable, innovative go-to-market models across multiple markets.
  • Strong judgment and comfort operating as a trusted advisor to senior business stakeholders in a fast-moving environment.
  • Clear, practical communicator who can translate complex legal issues into actionable guidance.

Nice to have:

Benefits

ŌURA is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. jobs.title: Platform Engineer (FedD145)
jobs.description:
EMPLOYER IS A CONTRACTOR FOR THE U.S. GOVERNMENT.

Role Description

We are seeking a talented and experienced Platform Engineer to join our team. Possessing strong proficiency with Kubernetes, the ideal candidate will play a crucial role in the development and maintenance of our platform, demonstrating a strong understanding of system architecture, problem-solving skills, and the ability to guide junior engineers.

As a Platform Engineer within our organization, you will join a team of dedicated unicorns who are focused on advancing freedom and independence globally. Our teams work on various different technical baselines depending on specific engagements. We focus our Products on the Platform layer, but to deliver for our Heroes, we also work IaC automation, security, and implementation.

Responsibilities:

You will help us automate and build a runtime Production Environment and serve as a link between the Applications, either custom development, COTS, or OSS, and that environment, advocating best practices and facilitating communication between the application teams and platform teams.

In this position, you will be expected to:

  • Validate Solutions/Implementations: Ensure that solutions and implementations align with the outlined tasks and business requirements. Conduct thorough validations to maintain the integrity and efficiency of the platform.
  • Independently Problem Solve: Demonstrate the ability to identify and solve business problems independently. Develop small components to address specific challenges without relying on explicit architecture diagrams.
  • Understand Medium-Level Tasking: Comprehend how medium-level tasks contribute to the achievement of overall goals. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate various components into a cohesive and functional platform.
  • Estimate Time and Effort: Provide accurate time and effort estimates for medium-sized tasks. Assist in project planning and resource allocation based on estimated timelines.
  • Demonstrate Programming Language Proficiency: Possess familiarity with at least one programming language. Exhibit a basic understanding of when to use a programming language versus a shell for efficient task execution.
  • Own the bridge between the Application Development team(s) and the Production Environment

Travel Expectations: 10%-25%

The listed responsibilities are not exhaustive and additional responsibilities may be assigned based on the evolving needs of the organization. We are seeking a dynamic individual who is able to adapt and take on new responsibilities as they arise.

Preferred Experience and Qualifications:

  • Proven experience as a Platform Engineer or similar role, with a focus on system architecture and development.
  • Demonstrated experience with cloud-native technologies such as Kubernetes, Google Cloud, and Docker.
  • Familiarity with continuous delivery, distributed architectures, systems, everything-as-code, containerization, and cloud services.
  • Proficiency in at least one programming language (e.g., Python, Go, Ansible) and a basic understanding of shell scripting.
  • Proficient with YAML.
  • Experienced in working on a team following an Agile framework in a remote environment.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Experience with security automation and familiarity with API Security, Container Security, and Cloud Security.
  • Familiar with architecture security design, monitoring, and performance instrumentation in a complex enterprise environment.
  • Comfort with debugging systems and reading/writing code.
  • Secret Clearance required.
  • Possess a DoD 8570 IAT II certification.
  • Experienced in Department of Defense work, specifically working on a production Authority to Operate (ATO'd) system.
  • Knowledgeable about DevSecOps/DevOps and CI/CD theory.

Remote - USA

Salary range: $123,250 - $166,750

Who We Are

Defense Unicorns delivers mission value by streamlining software delivery so our customers can focus on the most important challenges. We share a vision of freedom and security for the advancement of progress and innovation. Our commitment to this vision, and to our mission-driven customers, means a commitment to speed, user experience and optionality, without compromising security. Our team is composed of innovators, software engineers, and veterans with decades of experience delivering technology programs across the federal market.

What We Do

We create and deliver secure solutions for continuous software integration and delivery. Defense Unicorns consolidates the best practices for security pipelines, testing, and deployment automation in order to meet the high security requirements valued by mission owners. Our solutions are agnostic by design and we believe that growing a robust ecosystem of secure, cloud-native software solutions can help enterprise customers inside and outside the federal market buy and integrate software more easily.

Who We Serve

Defense Unicorns’ customers are mission-focused leaders across public and private enterprises. We proudly support defense and civil agencies across the U.S. government and we work closely with the creators of leading-edge software solutions to deliver value to the mission-owner by improving the security and consumability of commercial software products.

What We Work On

  • Kubernetes
  • Cloud Environments (AWS/GCP and Azure)
  • Infrastructure-as-code (like Terraform/Pulumi)
  • Continuous Delivery and automation tooling
  • GitOps
  • Containers
  • CNCF projects and open source products and packages
  • Helm/Kustomize-Value Stream Mapping
  • Building and improving security delivery
  • Building Kubernetes and cloud native applications

Benefits Our Unicorns Enjoy

  • Medical/Dental/Vision
  • Premiums are 100% Company Paid
  • Health Savings Account
  • Life Insurance
  • Disability Insurance

Financial:

  • 401k Retirement Plan
  • Company Stock Options
  • Home Office Budget

Leave:

  • We offer all full-time Unicorns Flexible Time Off (FTO) plus all Federal Holidays, one week for Thanksgiving, and two weeks for Christmas and New Year’s
  • Paid Parental Leave

Learning:

At Defense Unicorns, we're committed to diversity. If you're enthusiastic about the role but don't match every criteria, we encourage you to apply. You could be the perfect fit for this or another role! Defense Unicorns is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Director Cloud Architecture & Delivery
jobs.description:
About Energy Exemplar

In an era where the world is rapidly advancing towards a cleaner future through decarbonization, Energy Exemplar’s mission lies in ‘Empowering Transformative Energy Decisions’. Founded in 1999 in Adelaide, Australia, our award-winning software portfolio encompassing the modeling and simulation platform PLEXOS®, Aurora, and Adapt2, is trusted by innovative organizations across the globe. Through our technology and people, we strive to enable stakeholders from across the entire energy value chain to revolutionize the energy ecosystem and to collaboratively plan and execute for a sustainable energy future with unprecedented clarity, speed, and innovation.

Our impact is global and is being recognized across the industry. Some of our recent accolades include:

  • SaaS Company of the Year (2025) – Global Business Tech Awards.
  • Environmental Impact Award (2025) – E+E Leaders Awards.
  • IPPAI (Independent Power Producers Association of India) Power Awards (2025) - Winners
  • Finalist: Platts Global Energy Awards (2024) – Grid Edge category
  • Finalist: Reuters Global Energy Transition Awards (2024) – Technologies of Change
  • Top 50 Marketing Team (2024) – Voted by the public at the ICON Awards.

How We Work

Energy Exemplar is growing fast and that growth is driven by how we work. We trust our team to deliver great results from wherever they work best, whether that’s at home, in the office, or on the move.

We’re a global team that values ownership, integrity, and innovation. You’ll be supported to balance work and life in a way that works for you, and empowered to take initiative, solve problems, and make an impact, regardless of your background, location, or role.

Our four core values, Customer Success, One Global Team, Integrity & Ownership, and Innovation Excellence aren’t just words. They show up in how we collaborate, how we solve, and how we grow together.

About the Position

The Director of Cloud Architecture & Delivery builds and leads the cloud architecture and forward-deployed engineering capability that enables Energy Exemplar's Solutions (pre-sales) organization to win and launch cloud-hosted and AI-enabled customers. This role builds and leads a team that works directly with customers to design, integrate, deploy, and validate cloud solutions and AI agents in customer environments. The position sits at the intersection of four disciplines: enterprise cloud architecture (Azure-first, multi-cloud fluent), energy-market software (PLEXOS, Aurora, Adapt2, and the PLEXOS Intelligence layer), applied AI and agentic systems, and consultative pre-sales. Utilities, ISOs/RTOs, developers, and regulators look to the Director for how Energy Exemplar's platform and AI agents run securely and at scale alongside their own cloud estates. The role owns the technical cloud and AI deployment in every pursuit: reference architectures, security and compliance responses, proof-of-concept environments, and the delivery plan that turns commitments made during the sales process into a practical, successful cloud and AI onboarding.

The Director reports to the Vice President, Solutions (Americas) and sits within the Presales Solutions team. Partnering with Sales, Solutions, and Services, the Director shapes solutions for complex opportunities, leads technical conversations with senior customer stakeholders, and builds confidence in proposed architectures. The role works day to day with Sales and Account Directors, Solutions Engineers, Product and Engineering (PLEXOS Cloud and PLEXOS Intelligence), Post Sales Services, Customer Success, Information Security, and cloud platform partners to establish repeatable approaches to technical discovery, solution design, and validation, guide cloud migration and deployment planning, ensure a clear, practical handover into post-sales delivery, and build internal architectural expertise through coaching, enablement, and technical standards. It is a remote, United States-based Director-level position, a people-leader role that still expects individual-contributor depth, with travel of up to 30% for onsite customer meetings, executive briefings, and industry events across North America and LATAM.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and lead a forward-deployed engineering capability that works closely with customer technical and business teams to translate priority use cases into deployed solutions.
  • Embed with customer teams, on site and in their cloud tenants, to design, integrate, and deploy AI agents and agentic workflows built on PLEXOS Intelligence, including integration with customer data, enterprise systems, APIs, and Energy Exemplar products.
  • Act as the senior cloud and AI technical advisor to customers and prospects (utilities, ISOs/RTOs, IPPs, and consultancies), engaging CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, enterprise architects, and IT leaders to build confidence and resolve technical objections.
  • Partner with Sales and Pre Sales on technical deal strategy, architecture workshops, and demonstrations; scope and guide proofs of concept and pilots with clear success criteria, from environment build and data onboarding through executive readout.
  • Define acceptance criteria with customers and validate deployed agents and solutions against the agreed success criteria (accuracy, performance, security, and human-in-the-loop controls), with evidence customers can take to their governance and risk teams.
  • Own the cloud reference architectures for PLEXOS Cloud, PLEXOS Intelligence, and adjacent AI agents and products as deployed for customers: landing zones, identity and access, networking, data residency, high-performance compute for large nodal and stochastic runs, and cost models.
  • Lead the pre-sales-to-Services handoff for cloud and AI deals: deployment plan, architecture decision record, risk register, and onboarding timeline agreed with Post Sales Services before contract signature. Develop migration roadmaps and delivery estimates with Services and Engineering, documenting assumptions, risks, and responsibilities before commitments are made, and provide architecture oversight for complex implementations so the proposed solution carries through to delivery.
  • Set guardrails for agentic deployments in regulated environments: agent identity and permissions, tool-use boundaries, evaluation harnesses, observability, and audit trails.
  • Lead cloud and AI architecture input into RFIs, RFPs, security reviews, vendor risk assessments, and proposals, coordinating specialist input and ensuring responses are accurate and achievable; lead customer discussions on SOC 2, ISO 27001, NERC CIP adjacency, FedRAMP-equivalent expectations, and CEII handling, and maintain a current response library with Information Security.
  • Establish reusable discovery frameworks, technical materials, agent templates, and deployment patterns (SaaS, customer-tenant, hybrid), including integration with customer data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, Fabric, on-prem SQL) and API/automation patterns for model orchestration, plus runbooks and environment-as-code templates that make repeatable launches the default.
  • Partner with Product Engineering to turn repeatable customer implementation patterns into supported product capabilities, reusable integrations, and deployment assets.

Skills and Experience

  • 12+ years in enterprise technology, including 7+ years designing and delivering production cloud architectures for enterprise or regulated customers in large or mid-sized organizations.
  • Experience leading engineers embedded in customer implementations (forward-deployed, field engineering, or customer-embedded delivery teams), taking AI and data solutions from use case to production while managing customer expectations, scope, and handover.
  • Strong customer-facing pre-sales experience supporting complex enterprise software opportunities, including technical discovery, solution validation and RFI or RFP responses.
  • Deep expertise in at least one hyperscaler (Azure preferred) and working fluency across AWS and GCP: compute (VMs, Kubernetes, batch/HPC), storage, networking, identity (Entra ID, SSO/SAML/OIDC, SCIM), and managed data services.
  • Experience designing AI agent engineering in production, including LLM application and agent orchestration frameworks, retrieval and tool integration, evaluation and monitoring, and model governance.
  • Ability to connect architecture decisions to customer business objectives, commercial value and delivery feasibility, including cost and risk considerations.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise integrations, REST/GraphQL, APIs and data flows, alongside cloud performance, scalability, governance and cost optimization.
  • Executive presence, communication and the ability to lead architecture and risk conversations with CIOs, CISOs, enterprise architects, and procurement at utilities, ISOs/RTOs, and developers.
  • A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer or Electrical Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field.

Desirable Experience

  • Master's degree in a technical or business discipline (MS, MEng, MBA) or equivalent demonstrated senior-level experience.
  • Current professional-level cloud architecture certification: Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional, or Google Professional Cloud Architect.
  • Working knowledge of the North American power sector: ISO/RTO market structures (PJM, MISO, ERCOT, CAISO, SPP, NYISO, ISO-NE), utility IRP and transmission planning cycles, and the data-governance expectations that come with CEII and market-sensitive data.
  • Direct experience with energy market simulation, production cost, capacity expansion, or resource adequacy tools (PLEXOS, Aurora, PROMOD, GridView, EnCompass, or similar), or with ETRM platforms such as Adapt2.
  • Experience migrating on-premises, compute-intensive analytical software to cloud or SaaS delivery, including customer change management and license-model transitions.
  • Experience building or scaling a pre-sales architecture capability and supporting cloud adoption across enterprise customers.

Measures of Success

  • Strong technical win rates and effective resolution of architecture and security objections in supported opportunities.
  • Proofs of concept meet agreed success criteria and help customers make informed decisions.
  • Proposed solutions are feasible, well documented and handed over clearly to delivery teams.
  • Reusable architectures and enablement improve pre-sales efficiency and technical capability.

Energy Exemplar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, identities, and abilities. Please let us know if you require accommodations at any stage of the recruitment process—we're here to support you in showcasing your full potential.

jobs.title: Account Director
jobs.description:
About TTC Global

Since 2004, TTC Global has helped high-profile organizations improve the quality of the software they depend on. We are an independent quality engineering and software testing consultancy operating across the US, Canada, the UK, India, Australia and New Zealand. Our work covers test automation, performance engineering, AI-First Quality Engineering and quality transformation for complex enterprise estates, with deep specialization in SAP, Oracle, Salesforce and Workday environments. TTC Global is a long-standing Tricentis partner and has been recognized by Tricentis on the global stage.

Perks of working for TTC

  • Competitive base salary and uncapped commission
  • Medical, dental and vision benefits
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Paid time off and paid holidays
  • Work-life balance and a relaxed, collaborative work environment
  • Growth and development opportunities

Position summary

The Account Director owns TTC Global's revenue in their region. You will grow a portfolio of existing enterprise clients, win new logos, and run the full sales cycle from first conversation through scoping, proposal, negotiation and signature. You will work alongside our delivery leaders to shape engagements that solve real quality problems, and you will be the senior relationship holder for each account after the contract is signed.

This is a quota-carrying role reporting to the Group Chief Revenue Officer. You will be supported by a Business Development Representative who books qualified meetings into your calendar, by marketing for events and campaigns, and by our partner teams at Tricentis and other platform vendors.

Responsibilities

  • Own a regional territory of named enterprise and upper mid-market accounts, with a target account list agreed each half-year.
  • Grow existing accounts by expanding from one program or platform to others (for example, from an SAP S/4HANA migration into Salesforce or Workday testing).
  • Win new logos through your own network, BDR-sourced meetings, partner referrals and events.
  • Build relationships with CIOs, VPs of IT, QA and test leaders, and program and transformation leaders.
  • Lead discovery and shape solutions with TTC delivery and practice leads, including Quality Maturity Assessments, test automation programs, Quality Engineering Managed Services and staff augmentation.
  • Write and present proposals, statements of work and RFP responses, and lead commercial negotiation.
  • Work with Tricentis and other partner account teams to co-sell and surface opportunities.

jobs.title: S&O Senior Associate
jobs.description:
About Clipboard

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.

Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

About this Role

The Strategy & Ops Senior Associate role is an experienced generalist role at Clipboard suited for the “all-around athlete” type who can do it all and wants exposure to a range of problems and opportunities.

You’re likely someone who’s interested in and capable of solving different problem types – you’re resourceful, adaptable, and confident you can figure it out if you can sink your teeth in deep enough.

Your first “tour of duty” will be on the Billing team (see more below). The specific projects you take on will depend on your strengths and what we learn during the recruiting process and your first days at Clipboard; that being said, here is a list of example initiatives to give you an idea:

  • Build an internal predictive analytics model and corresponding underwriting process to catch bad payers early with high accuracy to inform our contracting decisions and risk mitigation tactics

  • Research, vet, and onboard a new vendor that embeds AI agents into our customer-facing collections efforts

  • Redesign our process for converting workplaces to new methods of payment, such as getting customers who send checks to start paying us via eCheck to speed up the cash conversion process

  • Manage a team of Billing Account Managers

First Tour of Duty – Quick background on Billing

Our most immediate need right now is on the Billing team. The TLDR is that we want to maximize our profitability by collecting money as fast as possible and minimizing losses, while preserving the customer experience, all in service of reliably converting revenue into cash (the lifeline of a capital-intensive business like ours). This in a way is “ensuring high-quality growth” for the company.

Although Clipboard provides a service where workplaces can find qualified professionals to fill shifts, we are in many ways a lending company at our core since we pay professionals immediately after they work a shift. For illustrative purposes: a nurse works a shift → we pay the nurse $100 immediately with our cash → the workplace pays us $120 a month later. We extend debt to workplaces using cash we borrow, with interest, from an Asset-Backed Line (ABL) of credit – workplaces use that debt to pay their staffing costs, and we expect to be paid back by the workplaces at a later date based on agreed-upon net terms.

Billing is doing the critical work of converting our revenue into cash that we put in the bank. Otherwise, money we cannot collect is money we’ve already burned. With thousands of customers operating in different regulatory environments, under different conditions, with nuanced capital structures and corporate setups, and using varied complicated processes…this can be hard to do at scale. We consistently fight a multi-faceted battle: a battle wherein we must maximize the speed at which we recognize revenue, maximize the margin associated with each shift, and maximize the customer experience, all without letting one unduly impact the other.

Optimizing collections is critical to make sure Clipboard is generating sustainable, high-quality growth and turning top-line revenue into cash that we use to service or grow other parts of the business, and you will help us do that.

Who we’re looking for

We find those who are most successful in this type of role:

  • Are insatiably curious and notice non-obvious clues and patterns: Curiosity sits atop our company values. Understanding something from first principles and getting to the root cause of the problem will often reveal the best solution, and a natural and unwavering curiosity to keep asking questions and digging will take you most of the way.

  • Roll up their sleeves and go to the source: There are multiple ways to say this: touching reality, dogfooding, seeing for yourself, going to the front-lines, etc. Don’t just take someone’s word for it – go find out yourself by testing the feature, or listening to the agent call, or calling the customer, or executing the workflow. This is how you seek truth.

  • Bring a tenacity and persistence to problem-solving: You’ll hit walls and find yourself in uncertain and unfamiliar situations. If you can sit with the uncertainty, look at the problem from new angles, and keep applying pressure to a problem – you’ll position yourself for breakthroughs.

  • Bounce back from failure quickly: You’ll make mistakes, move in the wrong direction, and stumble from time-to-time. Just avoid big mistakes and don’t make the same mistakes twice, and learn from them quickly. Worry less about failing and more about losing momentum in your feedback loop. If you fail cheaply and quickly, that's worth the lesson/learning you get in return.

While performance on your case and interviews during the hiring process is the most important aspect of your candidacy, your years of relevant working experience will be taken into consideration for both (a) the work you’re placed into once hired and (b) compensation.

Why Join Clipboard?

  • 100% Remote – Always. Work from anywhere in the world.

  • Fast-Paced Startup Environment. Join a company that values curiosity, independence, and growth.

  • A Hiring Process That Rewards Skills, Not Just Experience. Every applicant gets a fair shot—our selection is based on real-world problem-solving ability, not just credentials.

  • Opportunity to make a significant impact with our workplace customers.

Hiring Process

  1. Application

  2. Case Study 1

  3. Interview 1

  4. Case Study 2 [OPTIONAL]

  5. Interview 2 [OPTIONAL]

  6. Interview with Head of Operations

  7. Interview with Head of People

System Requirements

To succeed in this role, you must have:

  • A reliable laptop/desktop (no Chromebooks or Linux OS).

  • Minimum 20 Mbps wired internet connection.

  • Wired headset for clear communication.

  • A quiet, distraction-free workspace.

  • Stable power and internet connectivity

*After submitting your application, please check your spam folder periodically over the next few days for updates.

#LI-DNI

Quick Note on Scammers:

Clipboard would never ask you for money or your bank details to participate in our hiring process. Report any scammers impersonating the Clipboard hiring team members here.

jobs.title: Senior GTM Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Apollo.io is the leading go-to-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1.6 billion. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.

As a Senior GTM Systems Engineer, you will partner closely with Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Revenue Operations to help Apollo's revenue teams move faster and smarter through aligned processes, scalable systems, and actionable data. You will own Salesforce architecture and process design across the GTM funnel, and act as the systems SME for the business functions you support.

This role sits within the GTM Business Systems team and is focused on turning business problems into elegant, durable system solutions. You will work across GTM, R&D, and IT to govern a multi-instance Salesforce environment, support the next-generation quote-to-cash build ahead of Apollo's pre-IPO scale, and contribute to a growing portfolio of AI-driven GTM builds.

This is a strong fit for an analyst who wants to own architecture decisions rather than execute against a spec, and who enjoys operating as the connective tissue between business stakeholders and technical delivery.

What You'll Do

Key Outcomes: Success in this role will be measured by your ability to:

  • Build a working command of Apollo's GTM business processes and tech stack, and review and update the full systems architecture map and process flow diagrams so the team has a reliable single source of truth.
  • Serve as the primary GTM Systems partner for one of the domains the team is organized around (TOFU: Marketing and Partnerships, MOFU: Sales, Success and Onboarding, or BOFU: Internal Tools and BI). Own keep-the-lights-on work and incremental improvements within sprints, become the systems SME for your domain, and lead bi-weekly alignment and backlog grooming sessions to establish a roadmap.
  • Partner with Sales leadership and Sales Operations to streamline the renewal process, including opportunity stages, pages, and page layouts.
  • Make and defend the architecture calls that do not get faster with AI: whether something should be a platform event or a custom object, and whether a routine field-mapping change will trigger a resync across millions of records.
  • Partner with GTM Systems engineers on AI-driven builds such as automated call coaching and deal scoring, demo instance automation, and AI-assisted CRM data capture. Help define the solution, not just configure it. Contribute across the full development lifecycle, from solution design through rollout and feedback.
  • Support the design, build, testing, rollout, and maintenance of next-generation quote-to-cash infrastructure in service of pre-IPO activities. This includes refining the opportunity model to reduce friction and increase accuracy for GTM teams processing new business, upsell, and renewal opportunities.
  • Own Salesforce initiatives and end-user support end to end. Build and maintain SFDC automation (flows, Apex, LWC), manage users, profiles, roles, and permission sets, administer page layouts, custom fields and objects, and record types, and handle data imports, exports, and upserts.
  • Implement and administer Salesforce-integrated tools as needed (for example Chili Piper, Ironclad, Gong), promote Salesforce best practices and end-user adoption, and keep functional and technical systems documentation thorough and current.

What We're Looking For

  • 4+ years of business analysis or consulting experience, plus 4+ years of hands-on experience with the Salesforce platform in an administration or development capacity.
  • A college degree in a technical field, or equivalent work experience.
  • Deep understanding of go-to-market business processes and how systems support them across Marketing, BDR, Sales, and CS/Onboarding.
  • Hands-on Salesforce depth: creating and maintaining custom fields and custom objects, managing roles, profiles, permission sets, and sharing settings, and building automation with Flow (preferred) and Process Builder. Well versed with Data Loader.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage and collaborate with multiple concurrent stakeholders, and to translate a vague business problem into a scoped, well-designed solution.
  • A track record of making and defending architecture decisions under ambiguity, not just executing against a spec.
  • Experience supporting end-to-end feature and system implementations: discovery and requirements gathering, vendor selection, solution design, build and configuration, QA/UAT, deployment, and training and communication.
  • Experience working within Agile methodology, and the ability to thrive in a high-growth, fast-paced environment while owning multiple projects with high attention to detail.
  • Strong logic, analytics, and problem-solving skills. Excellent verbal and written communication and time management. Microsoft Excel power user.
  • Nice to have: Salesforce Administrator certification, an active Trailhead account, experience across Sales Cloud, CPQ, and Service Cloud, experience in Salesforce environments with 100+ users, and experience at high-growth companies (Series C through IPO, SaaS or PLG preferred).

AI Fluency & Tooling

Apollo operates at the intersection of AI and go-to-market, and our systems team is expected to lead from the front. This role requires genuine fluency in leveraging AI tooling. That means:

  • Using AI-assisted development tools as part of your build workflow. Whether it is Salesforce configuration, writing and debugging Apex or Flow logic, or working down technical debt, you should be reaching for tools like Claude, Cursor, or Codex wherever they accelerate delivery, while owning the judgment behind each change.
  • Structuring systems and data for AI interpretation. Understanding how to make GTM data clean, well-labeled, and accessible so AI tools can reason over it reliably. This includes object and schema design, field definitions, and semantic documentation.
  • Helping build AI-native GTM capability. Partnering on the design and rollout of AI agents and AI-assisted workflows inside the GTM stack, and thinking about where automation should replace manual process entirely.
  • Staying current as the tooling evolves. The AI tooling landscape is moving fast. We want systems people who are curious, self-directed learners: people who experiment, share what works, and help raise the floor for the whole team.
  • Navigating AI's limitations and pitfalls. Understanding where AI-generated configuration or code can introduce errors, regressions, or false confidence in a production CRM, and implementing validation, testing, and review processes that protect data integrity. You know when to trust AI, when to verify its work, and when to rely on first-principles design instead.

The listed Pay Range reflects the total cash compensation inclusive of annual base salary and annual bonus as applicable. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonus target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Apollo and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity; company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; at least 10 paid holidays per year, flex PTO, and parental leave; employee assistance program and wellbeing benefits; global travel coverage; life/AD&D/STD/LTD insurance; FSA/HSA and medical, dental, and vision benefits.

Tier 1 Pay Range (San Francisco, New York City, Seattle)

$159,000—$198,000 USD

Tier 2 Pay Range (All other US Locations)

$138,000—$172,000 USD

We are AI Native

Apollo.io is an AI-native company built on a culture of continuous improvement. We’re on the front lines of driving productivity for our customers—and we expect the same mindset from our team. If you're energized by finding smarter, faster ways to get things done using AI and automation, you'll thrive here.

Why You’ll Love Working at Apollo

At Apollo, we’re driven by a shared mission: to help our customers unlock their full revenue potential. That’s why we take extreme ownership of our work, move with focus and urgency, and learn voraciously to stay ahead.

We invest deeply in your growth, ensuring you have the resources, support, and autonomy to own your role and make a real impact. Collaboration is at our core—we’re all for one, meaning you’ll have a team across departments ready to help you succeed. We encourage bold ideas and courageous action, giving you the freedom to experiment, take smart risks, and drive big wins.

If you’re looking for a place where your work matters, where you can push boundaries, and where your career can thrive—Apollo is the place for you.

jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager, Strategic
jobs.description:
About Customer.io

Over 9,000 companies, from scrappy startups to global brands, use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data.

Hi! I’m Lauren, Senior Manager of Customer Success at Customer.io. I’m looking for a Senior Customer Success Manager, Strategic to join our Americas team and own relationships with some of our largest customers. You’ll guide each account from onboarding through renewal, tie platform use to the business results your customers care about, and partner with Account Managers, Technical Support, Product, and Engineering along the way.

What we value

  • Customer outcomes first: you connect what a customer does in Customer.io to the goals their business is trying to reach
  • Ownership: you run your book of business, watch for risk early, and decide on next steps with confidence
  • Collaboration: you work with Account Managers, Technical Support, Product, and Engineering to get customers what they need
  • Curiosity about AI: you pick up new AI functionality quickly and bring it into your conversations with customers
  • Adaptability: you handle a varied, non-verticalized book and a fast pace of change with a steady head

What you’ll do

  • Manage a book of roughly 20 to 35 Strategic customers, each above $100k in ARR, guiding them through onboarding, adoption, and long-term success
  • Link platform use to measurable business outcomes, and track results such as renewal rate and growth dollars across your book
  • Partner with Account Managers to spot and qualify expansion opportunities, shape renewal strategy, and keep customer value aligned with revenue goals
  • Lead quarterly and executive business reviews, including onsite EBRs, and build mutual success plans with senior stakeholders
  • Build relationships with several stakeholders in each account, including leaders above the day-to-day decision maker
  • Read account risk closely, dig into the signals, and decide on the best next steps, including managing escalations
  • Talk through technical needs with users, then raise the conversation to strategic impact with executive sponsors and give recommendations that keep customers renewing year after year
  • Act as a bridge between Customer Success, Technical Support, Product, and Engineering, advocating for customers and bringing fresh perspectives to the CS org

What we’re looking for

  • Based in the U.S. or Canada, and open to travel
  • 5+ years of enterprise CSM experience in SaaS, managing complex, strategic accounts
  • Hands-on commercial involvement in renewals, upsell, or expansion, with a clear grasp of gross retention and expansion drivers
  • Strategic, consultative skills: you can tie platform usage to business value and present that impact to executives through EBRs and partnership reviews
  • Comfort with APIs, integrations, and data models, enough to problem-solve at a high level without handing off every technical question
  • Influence across teams, with a track record of getting colleagues to focus on customer needs
  • Enthusiasm for AI and the urgency to keep learning new functionality as it ships

Bonus points!

  • Background in martech, CDPs, or messaging platforms
  • Spanish language skills
  • Experience running client onsites

Compensation & Benefits

We believe in transparency. Starting salary for this role is $130,000 base + 10% variable (or equivalent in local currency) depending on experience and subject to market rate adjustment. In addition to base salary, this role includes an equity grant in the form of stock options, so you share in the success you help build.

We know our people are what make us great, and we’re committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family. We also offer 16 weeks paid parental leave, unlimited PTO, stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more.

See full benefits here →

Our Process

No gotchas, no trick questions - just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision.

Here's what you can expect from our hiring process:

  1. 30-minute video call with a Recruiter

  2. 45-minute video call with the Hiring Manager

  3. 60-minute Case Study Review with the Hiring Manager and potential team members

  4. Final 30-minute video call with Leadership

All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process.

We strive to build an inclusive team culture, implement bias-free hiring practices, and develop community partnerships to expand our global impact.

jobs.title: Principal + Staff Software Engineers
jobs.description:
Unstructured is defining the standard for enterprise data transformation in the age of LLMs and generative AI. In just two years, we've raised over $65M from world-class investors, including Menlo Ventures, Bain Capital, Databricks, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and IBM.

Our open-source toolkit has been downloaded 97M+ times and is used by 90% of the Fortune 1000. We power production AI workflows across commercial and federal sectors — transforming PDFs, HTML, Word docs, images, emails, and more into AI-ready data pipelines that scale.

We're not just building tools; we're building the backbone of generative AI and the infrastructure that unlocks intelligence across industries.

About the Role

Unstructured is looking for Staff and Principal Software Engineers to define the architectural foundation for how enterprises process and transform unstructured data for large-language-model (LLM) applications.

This is a high-impact, hands-on role for someone who thrives in deep systems work—someone who could write the book on Kubernetes, lives and breathes Python, and understands Postgres at the index and transaction-log level. You’ll own the technical direction for our core platform, guiding how data moves through every layer—from ingestion to transformation to retrieval.

You’ll partner closely with the Head of Engineering, Head of Infrastructure, and product leaders to ensure Unstructured’s systems are performant, resilient, and ready to support the next generation of AI-driven workloads.

Location(s) Preferred: San Francisco, Bay Area, San Jose, Seattle, Sacramento

What You’ll Own & Drive

  • Define and evolve the end-to-end architecture for Unstructured’s data transformation and retrieval platform.

  • Build and scale distributed systems that process massive volumes of unstructured data across diverse formats and sources.

  • Serve as the company-wide authority on Kubernetes orchestration, cluster design, performance tuning, and reliability.

  • Lead Python architecture and best practices—ensuring performance, modularity, and maintainability across services.

  • Design and optimize Postgres schemas, queries, and indexing strategies to support large-scale metadata and retrieval pipelines.

  • Mentor senior engineers through design reviews and code guidance, raising the bar for technical excellence across the org.

  • Partner with the infrastructure and product teams to translate research prototypes into production-grade systems.

  • Evaluate emerging technologies and open-source tools in LLM infrastructure, retrieval, and orchestration—deciding where and how to integrate them.

What We're Looking for

  • Have 10+ years of software engineering experience with a focus on distributed systems, infrastructure, or data architecture.

  • Are a Python expert—capable of building frameworks and performance-critical services from scratch.

  • Have deep Kubernetes expertise; you can design, deploy, and debug at scale and could teach others how to productionize it securely.

  • Are fluent in Postgres—you understand query planning, partitioning, and tuning for high-throughput environments.

  • Are obsessed with clean, scalable architecture and can lead design reviews that shape how entire systems evolve.

  • Have experience in high-performance data or AI/ML systems—especially those involving retrieval pipelines, embeddings, or hybrid workloads.

  • Thrive in fast-moving, ambiguous environments where technical depth and judgment matter more than process.

Bonus Points

  • Experience building or scaling LLM-powered or RAG systems in production.

  • Familiarity with open-source orchestration frameworks, vector databases, or hybrid cloud infrastructure.

  • Contributions to open-source projects in Python, Kubernetes, or distributed systems.

Why You’ll Love It Here

You’ll be surrounded by smart, kind, low-ego people who genuinely enjoy building together. We invest in our team with company offsites, best-in-tech swag, and the tools you need to do your best work, wherever you’re based.

We support you holistically, not just at work. For full-time, US-based employees, that includes:

  • Health: Medical, dental, and vision coverage through Justworks, effective the 1st of the month following your start date. All medical plans include fertility coverage, plus access to One Medical, Talkspace (12 free therapy sessions a year), Kindbody, and Teladoc. If you waive medical coverage, we pay a $250/month allowance.

  • Financial: 401(k) with company match (100% of the first 3% you contribute, 50% of the next 2%), company-paid life insurance, and optional supplemental life, short- and long-term disability, accident, critical illness, and hospital coverage. FSA and HSA options available.

  • Equity: Stock options, so you share in what we’re building.

  • Time off: Flexible paid time off (unlimited), up to 80 hours of paid sick leave a year, 12 company holidays, and a company-wide winter break between Christmas and New Year’s.

  • Family: 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all parents, available after 6 months, plus up to 6 additional unpaid weeks.

  • Remote setup: A $500 home office stipend and a $75/month cell and internet stipend.

  • Team: Team and company offsites throughout the year.

We want you focused on building, growing, and staying energized for the long haul. If you’re excited about what we’re building, we’d love to meet you.

Unstructured is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive culture where everyone can do their best work. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
