jobs.title: Territory Manager (Manawatu-Whanganui)
jobs.description:
About Halter

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund, Bessemer Venture Partners, BOND, DCVC, Blackbird, Promus Ventures, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram.

About the role

Farmers with Halter are writing the playbook for a world-first farming system, they are paving a new way of managing their land and animals, and in doing so, are unlocking more productive and sustainable uses of the world's agricultural land along with driving optimal profitability outcomes.

We've more recently launched into the Beef Market! This is an opportunity to build a new market from the bottom up. The Beef industry has not had a disruptive and influential product in years and this is your chance to make a huge impact.

As a Territory Manager at Halter, you will play a critical role in driving business growth and ensuring customer success within your designated territory. You will be responsible for executing sales strategies, building strong customer relationships, and meeting ambitious growth targets, all while acting as Halter’s on-the-ground representative. This role requires a proactive and hands-on approach, with a focus on both expansion and long-term customer satisfaction.

In this role, you will prioritise daily efforts that optimise growth performance and drive value for your customers. Working closely with cross-functional teams, including Product, Support, and other regional sales teams, you’ll share field insights to ensure Halter’s technology continues to meet the needs of farmers. Your contributions will directly support Halter’s mission to support 50% of the world's habitable landmass to be more productive and sustainable. This role is based in the Manawatu-Whanganui region. Applicants must live within the region. Travel is required to meet with farmers daily.


Who are we looking for

  • Attitude: You naturally play for the front of the jersey. Make those around you better. Thrive under pressure and own your results. You bring authentic energy and passion to every interaction.

  • Sales & Customer Success Expertise: You will be a high-performing value-based salesperson, with a strong history of creating opportunities, closing deals, and building lasting customer relationships. You understand post-sales value building and have experience upselling to grow partnerships.

  • Beef Industry Experience: You know the ropes of beef operations, understanding the unique challenges of the industry. If you don’t, you will be deeply passionate about it, and willing to dive deep into the operations of a farm to learn rapidly.

  • Territory Management: Able to use critical thinking to manage a large territory with a balanced focus on sales and customer success, making the appropriate trade-offs.

  • Problem Solving & Collaboration: Resourceful and quick-thinking, you work well with cross-functional teams to address challenges and drive solutions.

  • Willingness to Travel: Frequent travel within your territory to engage with customers and prospects.

What your day could look like

  • Prospecting & Expansion: Sourcing new leads and opportunities through proactive outreach, referrals, industry events, and other channels, as well as responding to inbound queries. You’ll manage the full sales pipeline from lead generation through to close.

  • Hitting Sales Targets: Manage your pipeline and meet high-growth sales targets by screening, qualifying, demonstrating the product, and successfully negotiating contracts with customers.

  • Customer Account Management: After the sale, maintain close relationships with customers to ensure their ongoing satisfaction, provide support, and address any challenges they face with Halter’s products. You’ll also ensure a smooth handoff from sales to customer onboarding and deployment of Halter, helping customers get the most value from Halter’s solutions.

  • Territory Ownership: A high level of ownership in your territory working with regional agricultural groups to foster deep relationships across the beef industry.

  • Customer Onboarding: Assist in owning the end-to-end customer experience during onboarding and deployment of Halter’s product, ensuring a smooth transition from sales to implementation.

  • Field Learnings & Feedback: Serve as the primary point of contact for gathering customer feedback in your territory. Work closely with Support, Product, and R&D teams to share insights from the field that can drive product improvements and innovations.

  • Collaborating with Support Teams: Partner with the Support Team to resolve any issues your customers encounter quickly. You’ll escalate problems as needed and ensure that customers in your territory feel fully supported.

Our Benefits

  • Healthy body, healthy mind. We’re partnered with Southern Cross Health Insurance to support your well-being.

  • We offer 6 months of fully paid parental leave for primary caregivers, 4 weeks of fully paid secondary caregiver leave and many other parental benefits that support you and your family.

  • Our personal growth is important. Halter offers an annual $1000 self-development budget to be used for anything that fuels personal growth.

  • Our time to recharge is valued, we’re offered wellness leave and unlimited paid annual leave.

  • Importantly, we offer an inclusive and attractive remuneration package made up of salary, benefits and an employee stock ownership plan.

Join our team

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram.

Why our team loves working at Halter:

  • Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

  • Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

  • You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our personal growth fund.

  • This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

jobs.title: Lead, Virtual Events & Launch Programs
jobs.description:
Who are we?

At UpGuard, we are replacing manual security bottlenecks with AI-driven precision. Fresh off a US$75M Series C, we are scaling our infrastructure to process 100 billion risk signals daily. This isn’t just growth; it’s a total reimagining of how the world manages cyber risk.

We build the Cyber Risk Posture Management (CRPM) platform that security teams actually love. By integrating security ratings, threat intel, and agentic AI, we empower organisations to stay ahead of an ever evolving attack surface.

We aren’t just building another tool; we’re defining a category. We provide the autonomy to ship world-class technology and the resources to do it at a global scale.

Why are we hiring for this role?

We're hiring a Lead, Virtual Events & Launch Programs to build and run UpGuard's global digital event and launch programs: Summit, our quarterly product launch broadcast, plus a year round series and on-demand content engine that keeps security and risk leaders engaged between launches.

You’ll set the strategy for how we use virtual events to reach security and risk leaders, and run the program that delivers it: webinars, virtual roundtables, and digital event series for audiences in North America, EMEA, and APAC, including our quarterly launch event (Summit), where we showcase what’s new across the UpGuard platform. Your job is to make sure every event reaches the right people, gives attendees something worth their time, and creates pipeline for our revenue teams..

You’ll work closely with product marketing, demand generation, partner marketing, regional marketing leads, and our executive team, and you’ll be the go-to expert on virtual events across the business. Because our audience is global, some events will run outside Australian business hours, and we’ll work with you on a schedule that makes that sustainable.

What will you do?

  • Set the strategy and annual plan for UpGuard’s virtual event program, aligned to marketing and pipeline goals, and decide which formats, topics, and audiences to invest in.

  • Act as executive producer for Summit, our quarterly launch broadcast: shape the launch narrative with Product and Product Marketing, build the run of show, and deliver a multi-speaker live production to broadcast standard

  • Own each event end to end: topic and format, agenda, speaker sourcing and preparation, run sheets, platform setup, rehearsals, live production, and on-demand publishing.

  • Work with product marketing and leadership to shape content around product launches, customer stories, and the topics security and risk leaders care about most.

  • Build and run UpGuard's speaker program: recruit, brief, coach and rehearse executives, customers, analysts and industry experts, and develop a bench of repeat speakers

  • Brief demand gen, content and design on each event's audience, positioning and assets so promotion lands with the right buyers.

  • Own the virtual event platform end to end, including administration, integration with CRM, data quality and attribution setup, so every registration and attendance is captured and routed correctly

  • Own the KPIs for Summit and our virtual program: registration-to-attendance rate, live and on-demand engagement, post-launch feature awareness and adoption, pipeline from the on-demand library, and attendee and speaker satisfaction. Report results to marketing leadership and use them to improve formats and decide what we run next.

  • Own UpGuard's on-demand event library: repurpose sessions into clips, series and follow-up assets, grow a returning audience, and report on content performance long after the live event.

  • Own the virtual events tech stack, vendor relationships, and program budget.

  • Guide and coordinate the contractors, agencies, and colleagues who support event delivery, and set the standard for production quality across the program.

What will you bring?

  • 7+ years in B2B event or content marketing, including ownership of a global virtual event program and a recurring flagship virtual launch event at scale.

  • A track record of virtual events that drove measurable registration, attendance, and pipeline, including large sessions with multiple speakers.

  • Experience setting event strategy and making investment decisions based on results.

  • Hands-on live production experience: building run-of-show, directing multi-speaker broadcasts, managing studio, AV, and streaming setups, and recovering a live event when something goes wrong.

  • Administrator-level experience running an enterprise virtual event platform (e.g. ON24, Goldcast, or BrightTALK) integrated with HubSpot or Salesforce, including data flows and attribution.

  • Experience managing event budgets, external vendors, and production agencies.

  • Excellent project management across many concurrent events and stakeholders in multiple regions.

  • Confidence working with executives, customers, and external speakers.

  • Flexibility to run some live events in North American and European time zones.

  • Experience in video editing and content repurposing.

What will give you an edge?

  • Experience marketing to security, IT, risk, or compliance audiences, or managing direct reports.

What's in it for you?

  • Monthly Lifestyle subsidy: Use this for financial, physical, and mental well-being

  • WFH set-up allowance: To ensure you have the right environment to work in, we will help you get set up within your first 3 months at UpGuard

  • $1500 USD annual Learning & Development allowance: To support your career development, all team members will be able to expense development opportunities against this allowance

  • Annual leave: PTO plus two additional UpGuardian leave days to give you time to recharge your batteries.

  • 18 weeks paid Parental Leave: Irrespective of parenting role

  • Personal Leave Allowance: This includes sick & carer’s leave

  • Fully remote working environment: While we have physical offices in Sydney & Hobart, we do not mandate compulsory attendance

  • Top-spec hardware: All team members will be provided with top-spec laptops for their role

  • Generative AI subsidy: UpGuard provides paid subscriptions for all team members to access generative AI tools to support their work

UpGuard is a Certified Great Place to Work® in the US, Australia, UK and India, establishing its position as a leading global technology employer. 99% of team members agree that UpGuard is a great place to work! Apply now to find out why!

As an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Please Note: Not all roles can be performed from the United States. Please check your specific job listing to confirm its advertised location. If the role you are applying for is listed as based in the US, we are currently only able to support hiring in the following locations: CA, CO, FL, IL, MA, MD, MO, OR, PA, TX, WA, and DC.

Before starting work with us, you will need to undertake a national police history check and reference checks.

jobs.description:
CrossCountry Consulting is the transformation partner for the Office of the CFO. As a trusted advisor to Fortune 500 companies, emerging growth market leaders, and private equity sponsors, we combine deep domain expertise with the power of data, AI, and technology to modernize workflows, drive human-centered change, and maximize transaction value. Qualifications

jobs.title: Junior Media Specialist
jobs.description:
Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Junior Media Specialist (JMS) owns the visual assets required for a client website—from market and brand research to cohesive imagery and production-ready logos. The JMS ensures assets are accurate, compliant, organized, and ready for the Website Builder and Data Specialist to use without additional handoffs.

WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

Website Image Curation

  • Research client and brokerage websites and social media profiles to identify relevant imagery and curate stock image folders aligned with LP best practices and design standards.

  • Maintain the internal image library, adding or updating labels as needed to ensure assets are properly organized and easy to find.

Logo Creation

  • Source the correct client and brokerage logos from the internal library.

  • Use the Logo Tool to efficiently create branded logo packages for website implementation including logo lockups when needed.

  • Verify brokerage compliance requirements are met.

Recurring Feedback and Reporting

  • Escalate unclear compliance requirements or complex logo reconstruction needs to the Team Leader.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

  • Fresh graduates with a background in graphic design, fine arts, web design are strongly encouraged to apply — full training is provided.

  • Impeccable eye for design + strong knowledge of imagery best practices.

  • Meticulous attention to detail.

  • Resourcefulness and updated on imagery best practices and SOPs.

  • Understanding of main US markets and interior/exterior design styles.

OTHER REQUIREMENTS

  • Must be a current resident of the Philippines

  • Willing to work graveyard hours, 5 days a week, 9 hours a day (with a one-hour meal break)

  • Own a laptop or desktop

  • Have a valid government ID

  • Have an existing bank account or willing to open one if hired

  • Have a stable internet connection that is at least 25 mbps and have a back-up connection too

  • Live in area where there is stable power supply that is not interrupted by constant power outages

Compensation

Additional Information

Join us in shaping the future of real estate

The real estate industry is in the midst of a seismic shift, and the future belongs to those who break new ground. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the proptech and marketing sectors, Luxury Presence challenges the status quo of what technology can do for real estate agents, leaders, and brokerages.

We're a team of agile and tenacious innovators working collaboratively to drive the industry forward. Together, we build game-changing products that empower modern real estate entrepreneurs to dominate their markets. From award-winning web design to agile SEO solutions to cutting-edge AI tools, we deliver tech that anticipates market shifts and keeps our clients ahead of their competition.

Founded in 2016 by Stanford Business School alum Malte Kramer, Luxury Presence has grown to a global team ranked on the Inc. 5000 fastest-growing companies list three years in a row. We're backed by world-class investors, including Bessemer Venture Partners, NextEquity Partners, Toba Capital, and Switch Ventures, and have raised $89 million to date.

More than 18,000 real estate businesses rely on our platform, including 30% of the Wall Street Journal RealTrends top agents and teams. Additionally, many of the industry's most powerful brokerages rely on Luxury Presence as a trusted business partner.

Every year since 2020, Luxury Presence has ranked on BuiltIn's Best Place to Work lists. HousingWire named our founder and CEO a 2024 Tech Trendsetter, we've received several Tech100 Awards, and we just scored an Inman Innovation Award for Best AI-Powered Platform.

Luxury Presence is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.

jobs.title: Helpdesk Technician Tier 1
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Staff Security Engineer (Product & Cloud)
jobs.description:
Who are we?

At UpGuard, we are replacing manual security bottlenecks with AI-driven precision. Fresh off a US$75M Series C, we are scaling our infrastructure to process 100 billion risk signals daily. This isn’t just growth; it’s a total reimagining of how the world manages cyber risk.

We build the Cyber Risk Posture Management (CRPM) platform that security teams actually love. By integrating security ratings, threat intel, and agentic AI, we empower organisations to stay ahead of an ever evolving attack surface.

We aren’t just building another tool; we’re defining a category. We provide the autonomy to ship world-class technology and the resources to do it at a global scale.

About the role

This is UpGuard's first dedicated product security hire. You'll have significant ownership over the direction of product security at UpGuard as we scale. You won't be inheriting someone else's decisions. You'll be defining the security standards, tooling, and practices that protect UpGuard's products and infrastructure for years to come.

In this role, you'll work across our product and production environments: performing security reviews, managing vulnerabilities, and running detection and response operations in our cloud-native infrastructure. You'll collaborate closely with our product engineering and platform teams to secure our products, CI/CD pipelines, and production systems, and to embed security into how we build from the ground up.

The full remit of product security is broad, so we've been deliberate about sequencing. In your first 6–12 months you'll:

  • Refresh threat modelling and security review as a standard part of how we ship.

  • Figure out where AI actually helps in AppSec (code review, triage, coverage) and build what works

  • Harden our GCP and Kubernetes baseline and get secure-by-default configs into infrastructure-as-code

The function sits at the heart of our engineering organisation, and you'll have genuine autonomy and influence: defining the security roadmap, driving best practices, and scaling our security posture as we grow.

This is a Staff-level individual contributor role.

What you'll do

  • Lead threat modelling and security reviews across UpGuard's product portfolio and cloud infrastructure, proactively surfacing attack vectors and designing mitigation strategies that scale with growth.

  • Build automation, policy-as-code, and AI-driven security tooling that lets product engineering teams "shift left" and embeds security across the SDLC, leveraging agentic workflows to triage, review, and scale the reach of a lean security function.

  • Design and implement secure-by-default configurations for cloud and Kubernetes infrastructure.

  • Own vulnerability management end-to-end, triaging and prioritizing by real risk, driving remediation with engineering teams, and building preventative controls across the software supply chain from development through production.

  • Build scalable detection and response systems that catch malicious activity, triage the noise, and run incidents end to end.

  • Build deep partnerships with our product engineering and platform teams, helping them deliver secure-by-design solutions.

You'll be building a function, not inheriting one; with real executive backing, at a company where product security is core to the business rather than a cost centre. Our engineering culture values iteration, collaboration, and speed, with a no-ego approach and pragmatic trade-offs. We're fully remote with optional offices in Sydney and Hobart, and no mandatory office attendance.

What you'll bring

  • 7+ years of experience in security engineering and/or software engineering/or security operations, work in cloud environments, with a focus on the below:

  • Cloud security experience (GCP preferred, but AWS or Azure is welcome)

  • Cloud native Kubernetes services (EKS/GKE/AKS) and strong container security principles

  • Strong understanding of securing IAM and cloud identities

  • Experience leading technical security reviews of products and architectures, running threat modelling exercises, and turning findings into security controls engineering teams can implement.

  • Strong knowledge of common web application vulnerabilities and how to prevent them (OWASP Top 10 and similar).

  • Hands-on experience with IAC and related tools (preferably Terraform/OpenTofu)

What will give you an edge?

  • Experience as the first security hire or founding member of a security function at a scaling company.

  • Familiarity with AI/LLM security risks (e.g. OWASP LLM Top 10) and securing AI-powered product features.

  • Strong backend engineering skills, particularly in Go

  • Experience supporting SOC 2 / ISO 27001 audits from an engineering perspective.

  • Public security research, CVEs, open-source security tooling, or conference talks.

  • Offensive security skills, with the ability to validate findings through hands-on exploitation.

What's in it for you?

  • WFH set-up allowance: To ensure you have the right environment to work in, we will help you get set up within your first 3 months at UpGuard

  • Monthly Lifestyle subsidy: Use this for financial, physical, and mental well-being

  • $1500 USD annual Learning & Development allowance: To support your career development, all team members will be able to expense development opportunities against this allowance

  • Annual leave: PTO plus two additional UpGuardian leave days to give you time to recharge your batteries.

  • 18 weeks paid Parental Leave: Irrespective of parenting role

  • Personal Leave Allowance: This includes sick & carer’s leave

  • Fully remote working environment: While we have physical offices in Sydney & Hobart, we do not mandate compulsory attendance

  • Top-spec hardware: All team members will be provided with top-spec laptops for their role

  • Generative AI subsidy: UpGuard provides paid subscriptions for all team members to access generative AI tools to support their work.

  • Stock options: Share in UpGuard's growth and long-term success

UpGuard is a Certified Great Place to Work® in the US, Australia, UK and India, establishing its position as a leading global technology employer. 99% of team members agree that UpGuard is a great place to work! Apply now to find out why!

As an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Please Note: Not all roles can be performed from the United States. Please check your specific job listing to confirm its advertised location. If the role you are applying for is listed as based in the US, we are currently only able to support hiring in the following locations: CA, CO, FL, IL, MA, MD, MO, OR, PA, TX, WA, and DC.

Before starting work with us, you will need to undertake a national police history check and reference checks.

jobs.title: Network Operations Manager, Contracting
jobs.description:
Maven Clinic is the world's largest virtual clinic for women and families on a mission to make healthcare work for all of us. Through Maven Enterprise, the company partners with more than 2,300 employers and health plans to provide end-to-end women's and family health programs spanning fertility and family building, maternity and newborn care, parenting and pediatrics, and menopause and midlife — improving clinical outcomes, reducing healthcare costs, and expanding equitable access to high-quality care at scale. Through its consumer platform, Maven provides direct access to virtual care across 30+ specialties, as well as dedicated hormone and GLP-1 care programs purpose-built for women. Founded in 2014 by CEO Kate Ryder, Maven Clinic has raised more than $425 million from leading healthcare and technology investors including General Catalyst, Sequoia, Dragoneer Investment Group, Oak HC/FT, StepStone Group, Icon Ventures, and Lux Capital. Recognized for innovation and industry leadership, Maven has been named to the TIME100 Most Influential Companies, CNBC Disruptor 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, and FORTUNE Best Places to Work. Learn more at mavenclinic.com

An award-winning culture working towards an important mission – Maven Clinic is a recipient of over 30 workplace and innovation awards, including:

  • TIME 100 Most Influential Companies (2023, 2026)
  • Fortune Change the World (2024)
  • CNBC Disruptor 50 List (2022, 2023, 2024)
  • Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials (2024)
  • Fortune Best Workplaces in Health Care (2024)
  • Fast Company Most Innovative Companies (2020, 2023)
  • Fortune Best Workplaces NY (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024)

About the Role:

Maven is looking for a Network Operations Manager who will support Maven’s network contracting function and network operations. This is an individual contributor role responsible for managing the full lifecycle of network partnerships—from identifying and vetting new partners to negotiating agreements and ensuring continued amendment management.

You will be the engine behind how Maven evaluates and contracts with network partners, bringing structure and consistency to a function that is critical to our growth. You are a natural relationship builder who is equally comfortable in a contract redline as you are in a partner call, and you know how to balance speed with rigor when building something new. Senior leadership will be available to guide unconventional negotiations, complex rate discussions, and non-standard contract structures, so you can focus on driving the work forward with confidence.

What You’ll Do:

Network Contracting

  • Manage the pipeline of prospective network partners across fertility and ancillary networks, tracking outreach, status, and next steps from initial contract through executed agreement. Maintain an executive dashboard to regularly report on network contracting status.
  • Maintain and enforce a structured framework for evaluating and qualifying new network partners, including criteria related to clinical quality, geographic coverage, capacity, and strategic fit.
  • Nurture relationships with prospective partners throughout the evaluation and contracting process, serving as a trusted point of contact and ambassador for Maven.
  • Lead the contracting process of new clinic contracts and amendments across the fertility clinic and ancillary partner networks, with additional support to global network contracting as needed.
  • Partner with clinical, operations, and finance stakeholders to ensure contract terms align with Maven’s operational and quality standards.
  • Maintain a clear audit trail of contract history, amendments, and communications for each network partner.

Network Operations

  • Build and maintain dashboards to monitor performance across all network verticals on an ongoing basis.
  • Develop standardized templates, evaluation rubrics, and workflows to support effective network operations with network partners.
  • Partner with network team to supply performance data and analysis that supports network quarterly business reviews (QBRs) and drives ongoing optimization.
  • Bring structure, data, and follow-through to projects that require cross-functional coordination and a bias toward action.
  • Support network product lifecycle—from requirements through implementation and post-launch monitoring—for network-facing tools and integrations.

What You’ll Bring:

  • 5+ years of experience in network development, provider contracting, partnerships, or a related function in healthcare or digital health
  • Hands-on contracting experience, including drafting, redlining, and negotiating agreements—a legal background is not required
  • Proven ability to build and manage a pipeline of partners or relationships, with strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Proven results in rate negotiations within guardrails and meeting high volume of contracting targets
  • Experience creating or improving processes in a fast-moving environment
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build trust with external partners and align internal stakeholders

The base salary range for this role is $119,000 - $140,000 per year. You will also be entitled to receive equity and benefits. Individual pay decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, and skillset.

This role requires active work authorization in the US.

Maven embraces a flexible hybrid work model. Our teams primarily operate from the New York Metropolitan area, NY, and remotely via San Francisco/Bay Area, CA, Seattle, WA. For those in our New York City office, we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to work onsite three days a week (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday). For those based in Boston, DC, Chicago, Seattle, and San Francisco, we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to attend monthly Work Together Days within these cities. This policy aims to balance remote work flexibility with the benefits of face-to-face interaction.

At Maven we believe that a diverse set of backgrounds and experiences enrich our teams and allow us to achieve above and beyond our goals. If you do not have experience in all of the areas detailed above, we hope that you will share your unique background with us in your application and how it can be additive to our teams.

Benefits That Work For You

Our benefits are designed to support your health, well-being and career development, helping you thrive both personally and professionally. We remain focused on providing a competitive benefits package for our employees. On top of standards such as employer-covered health, dental, and insurance plan options, we offer an inclusive approach to benefits:

  • Maven for Mavens: access to the full platform and specialists, including care for mental health, reproductive health, family planning and pediatrics.
  • Whole-self care through wellness partnerships
  • Hybrid work, in office meals, and work together days
  • 16 weeks 100% paid parental leave and new parent stipend (for Mavens who've been with us for 1 year+)
  • Annual professional development stipend and access to a personal career coach through Maven for Mavens
  • 401K matching for US-based employees, with immediate vesting

These benefits are applicable to Maven Clinic Co., US-based, full-time employees only. 1099/Contract Providers are ineligible for these benefits.

Maven is an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information. jobs.title: Senior Director, Market & Competitive Intelligence
jobs.description:
About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.

Position Summary

We compete in one of the most dynamic and consolidating markets in software, and we're looking for a leader to make sure we see it more clearly than anyone else.

As Director, Market & Competitive Intelligence, you'll report directly to the CMO and build a world-class intelligence function serving Product Marketing, Revenue Marketing, Product Management, Sales, Customer Success, and Executive Leadership. You'll create a unified understanding of our customers, markets, competitors, buyer behavior, growth opportunities, and turn that understanding into decisions that shape how Kaseya positions, prices, sells, and wins.

This is a high-visibility role with regular exposure to the executive team, real influence over strategy, and the opportunity to build a function — and a team — from a strong foundation.

You'll answer questions that matter: Which customer segments create the highest long-term value? Why do customers buy, expand, renew, or churn? Which competitors represent the biggest threat, and how do we beat them? Where should Kaseya invest next?

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and own Kaseya's competitive intelligence program; competitor profiles, battlecards, objection-handling guides, and early-warning systems for competitor product launches, pricing moves, and M&A activity
  • Lead market intelligence: TAM analysis, market landscape assessments, industry trend analysis, and emerging category evaluation across the MSP and SMB IT landscape
  • Build the enterprise Voice of Customer capability, including customer research, buyer journey analysis, and a best-in-class win/loss program
  • Design and maintain Kaseya's customer segmentation framework and ensure all go-to-market teams operate against a common methodology
  • Own the measurement framework for marketing effectiveness - pipeline influence, revenue contribution, campaign performance, and funnel conversion, moving marketing from descriptive reporting toward predictive intelligence
  • Partner with Data Science and Revenue Operations on AI-enabled models for churn prediction, expansion propensity, and customer lifetime value
  • Serve as a trusted intelligence advisor to executive leadership, producing regular Executive Intelligence Reviews on market movements, competitive threats, customer sentiment, and growth opportunities
  • Embed competitive and market insight into sales onboarding, training, and live deal support and measure its impact on win rates
  • Hire, develop, and lead a high-performing team of analysts and researchers, grounded in curiosity, rigor, and commercial impact

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in competitive intelligence, market intelligence, insights, analytics, product marketing, or corporate strategy
  • 3+ years leading intelligence, insights, analytics, research, or strategy teams or programs
  • B2B SaaS experience strongly preferred; experience in IT management, cybersecurity, MSP/channel, or infrastructure software is a plus
  • Demonstrated success building or significantly scaling an intelligence, insights, or analytics function
  • Hands-on experience with customer segmentation, Voice of Customer programs, competitive intelligence, and win/loss analysis
  • Exceptional analytical and synthesis skills; you move from fragmented data to a clear, defensible point of view, and translate analytics into executive decisions
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication; comfortable presenting to C-level executives and large sales audiences
  • Strong cross-functional leadership; able to influence without authority across product, sales, marketing, and corporate development

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in private equity-backed or high-growth, acquisitive software environments
  • Familiarity with the MSP ecosystem and its competitive landscape
  • Experience with CI platforms (e.g., Klue, Crayon), analyst research (Gartner, Forrester, Canalys), and AI/ML analytics initiatives
  • Experience in subscription and retention-based businesses
  • MBA or equivalent advanced degree

Additional information
Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

We've built the world's most advanced and largest video commerce platform, trusted by global brands and leading retailers. You will own the enrollment engine end to end, from awareness through activation, turning eligible lives into engaged members.

Enrollment is not a single-team problem. It sits at the intersection of nearly every function at Maven, and this role is built for someone who thrives there. You'll partner daily with Client Success (who own the client relationships that unlock eligible populations), Marketing (member acquisition and lifecycle), Product (enrollment experience and funnel), Finance (targets, forecasting, and unit economics), Data (measurement, segmentation, and attribution), and Clinical and Operations teams. Because so many teams touch enrollment, a core part of the job is holding those cross-functional partners accountable to their piece of the machine — the engine only works when every team delivers its part.

This is a player-coach role. You will lead a small, high-caliber team while remaining deeply hands-on yourself every day. Although it carries a Senior Director title, it is explicitly NOT a leaned-out management position for someone who wants to direct a team from a distance. This is a hard requirement: the person in this seat reads the data themselves, pressure-tests the funnel, drafts the plan, and does the work alongside the team. We are looking for a builder and operator who also develops people — not a manager who has stepped away from the work.

We're also looking for someone who can expand the definition of the job. A great deal of enrollment optimization work is already underway, but there is not enough strategic thinking about fundamentally new ways to drive enrollments — approaches that don't simply depend on securing permission to communicate with a client's employees. This role is expected to find and open those new avenues, not just optimize the existing ones.

What You'll Do:

  • Own member growth for the Core Business: Be directly accountable for enrollment targets across Maven's core business and for the revenue those enrollments drive. Set the strategy, build the plan, and act as a control tower across all cross-functional teams driving revenue to deliver the results quarter over quarter.
  • Build and run a scalable enrollment engine: Own the full journey from eligible population to enrolled, activated member — spanning client launches, member acquisition and messaging, the enrollment product experience, and re-engagement of eligible-but-not-enrolled members.
  • Expand the playbook and deliver new strategies to drive sustainable member growth: Think strategically and from first principles about new ways to grow enrollments beyond today's optimization work — including partnerships and approaches that don't rely solely on permission to communicate with a client's employees. Identify, size, and open avenues that expand the team's purview and unlock new growth.
  • Optimize relentlessly around data: Build and consistently iterate on the funnel, and create systems that enable quick diagnoses of opportunities. Build operational metrics that act as leading KPIs for each team contributing to enrollments and bring quantitative rigor into how teams execute against targets.
  • Hold the cross-functional machine accountable: Partner daily with Client Success, Marketing, Product, Finance, Data, Clinical, Payer, Sales, and Operations — and hold each team accountable to its operational KPIs in the enrollment process. Serve as the connective tissue that keeps every part of the engine delivering.
  • Operate as a player-coach: Lead and develop a small, high-performing team while staying in the execution and details. Set the bar for rigor and hands-on execution by doing the work, coaching through it, and multiplying the team's impact rather than stepping back from it. This is a role that comes with an expectation that you directly execute on the work.
  • Instrument and forecast: Partner with Data and Finance to build the measurement, segmentation, attribution, and forecasting needed to know exactly what is and isn't working, and to forecast enrollment and revenue with confidence.

What You'll Bring:

  • 10+ years of experience driving growth, enrollment, acquisition, or revenue outcomes, with a track record of personally owning and hitting a number — ideally in healthcare, benefits, marketplaces, consumer subscription, or another environment with a complex funnel and multiple stakeholders.
  • A hands-on player-coach. You are energized by being in the details daily — the data, the funnel, the plan, the execution — and you lead a small team as a way to multiply your own hands-on impact, not to step back from the work. This is a hard requirement for the role.
  • Elite quantitative ability as a core competency. You can build and interrogate a funnel model yourself, size opportunities, design experiments, and instinctively optimize around data rather than intuition. Strong quant is non-negotiable.
  • Strategic range. Beyond optimizing what exists, you can spot and pursue fundamentally new approaches to enrollment that expand the team's purview — not just incremental improvements to current channels.
  • Cross-functional leadership and accountability. Proven ability to align and mobilize many teams — Client Success, Marketing, Product, Finance, Data, Clinical, Operations — around a shared goal without direct authority over most of them, and to hold each accountable to its operational commitments.
  • Commercial instincts. You understand how enrollment translates into revenue and unit economics, and you can partner with Finance on targets and forecasting.
  • Comfort in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment with high visibility and direct accountability for a top-line company metric.

The base salary range for this role is $204,000.00 - $270,000.00 per year. You will also be entitled to receive bonus, equity, and benefits. Individual pay decisions are based on qualifications, experience, and skillset.

This role requires active work authorization in the US.

Maven embraces a flexible hybrid work model. Our teams primarily operate from the New York Metropolitan area, NY, and remotely via San Francisco/Bay Area, CA, Seattle, WA. For those in our New York City office, we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to work onsite three days a week (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday). For those based in Boston, DC, Chicago, Seattle, and San Francisco, we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to attend monthly Work Together Days within these cities. This policy aims to balance remote work flexibility with the benefits of face-to-face interaction.

At Maven we believe that a diverse set of backgrounds and experiences enrich our teams and allow us to achieve above and beyond our goals. If you do not have experience in all of the areas detailed above, we hope that you will share your unique background with us in your application and how it can be additive to our teams.

Benefits That Work For You

Our benefits are designed to support your health, well-being and career development, helping you thrive both personally and professionally. We remain focused on providing a competitive benefits package for our employees. On top of standards such as employer-covered health, dental, and insurance plan options, we offer an inclusive approach to benefits:

  • Whole-self care through wellness partnerships

These benefits are applicable to Maven Clinic Co., US-based, full-time employees only. 1099/Contract Providers are ineligible for these benefits.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information. Maven is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. jobs.title: Senior Accountant
jobs.description:
About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.

GREAT opportunity to grow with rapidly growing company, Kaseya. We are seeking a highly motivated, analytical, and results-driven Senior Accountant – Revenue Accounting to join our Finance organization. This role will be responsible for managing key revenue accounting activities, reviewing customer contracts, ensuring accurate revenue recognition in accordance with ASC 606, and supporting compliance with internal controls and financial reporting requirements. The ideal candidate will bring strong accounting expertise, advanced analytical capabilities, and a demonstrated ability to independently manage monthly close deliverables while maintaining accuracy and meeting critical deadlines. This position offers an exciting opportunity to leverage advanced Excel capabilities, artificial intelligence (AI), and automation to enhance accounting processes, strengthen financial reporting, and drive operational efficiencies within Kaseya's growing organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review and analyze customer contracts to ensure accurate revenue recognition in accordance with ASC 606, including the evaluation of non-standard contractual terms and conditions.
  • Manage key components of the monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close processes, ensuring timely and accurate completion of revenue-related accounting activities.
  • Prepare, review, and post manual journal entries, account reconciliations, and supporting financial documentation in accordance with established accounting policies.
  • Perform comprehensive balance sheet reconciliations and completeness analyses for revenue-related accounts, including contract liabilities (deferred revenue), contract assets (unbilled receivables), and accounts receivable.
  • Conduct detailed revenue analytics and flux analyses to identify trends, investigate material variances, and ensure the accuracy and completeness of financial reporting.
  • Evaluate complex customer contracts and accounting transactions to determine appropriate revenue recognition treatment and assess the financial impact of contractual terms.
  • Support compliance with Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) requirements by executing internal controls, maintaining supporting documentation, and ensuring audit readiness.
  • Utilize advanced Microsoft Excel capabilities and financial analysis tools to streamline reconciliations, enhance reporting accuracy, and improve accounting efficiency.
  • Identify, develop, and implement opportunities to leverage artificial intelligence (AI), automation, and emerging technologies to optimize revenue accounting workflows and reduce manual processes.
  • Take ownership of assigned monthly close deliverables, including journal entries, contract scoping analyses, account reconciliations, and process improvement initiatives.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams, including Finance, Sales, Legal, and Revenue Operations, to resolve contract-related accounting matters and ensure alignment with revenue recognition policies.
  • Support internal and external audits by preparing detailed schedules, reconciliations, technical accounting documentation, and responses to audit inquiries.
  • Proactively identify accounting risks, process inefficiencies, and opportunities to strengthen financial controls and reporting procedures.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance the accuracy, scalability, and efficiency of revenue accounting operations.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field required.
  • Advanced coursework or professional development in financial accounting, revenue recognition, or financial reporting is preferred.
  • CPA certification or progress toward obtaining CPA licensure is a plus.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 3–5 years of progressive professional experience in accounting, finance, revenue accounting, or a related financial reporting function.
  • Strong understanding of generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP), financial reporting requirements, and fundamental revenue accounting concepts.
  • Proficient/Foundational experience is preferred in applying ASC 606 revenue recognition guidance, including accounting for customer contracts with non-standard terms and conditions.
  • Demonstrated experience managing accounting deliverables within monthly or quarterly financial close cycles.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including advanced formulas, pivot tables, lookups, financial reconciliations, and analysis of large datasets.
  • Proven ability to prepare accurate journal entries, perform account reconciliations, investigate variances, and maintain complete financial documentation.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex financial information and identify accounting discrepancies.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage competing priorities, take ownership of deliverables, and consistently meet critical financial close deadlines.
  • Excellent attention to detail, with a commitment to accuracy, completeness, and compliance with established accounting standards.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain financial findings and collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented mindset with the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-growth business environment.
  • Interest in leveraging AI, automation, and emerging technologies to improve accounting processes, reporting accuracy, and operational efficiency.
  • Ability to identify opportunities for process improvement, recommend practical solutions, and contribute to scalable accounting operations.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with SOX compliance, internal controls, audit documentation, and financial reporting requirements.
  • Experience performing balance sheet completeness analyses, reconciliations, and flux analyses involving deferred revenue, contract assets, unbilled receivables, and accounts receivable.
  • Prior experience managing revenue-related monthly close activities, including contract scoping analyses, journal entries, and account reconciliations.
  • Experience working within a SaaS, technology, or subscription-based business environment, including familiarity with recurring revenue models and complex customer contracts.
  • Advanced Excel capabilities, including Power Query, XLOOKUP, complex financial models, and data transformation techniques.
  • Experience implementing or utilizing AI-powered tools, robotic process automation (RPA), or other technologies to streamline accounting processes.
  • Familiarity with enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems and revenue management or financial reporting platforms.
  • Experience collaborating with Legal, Sales, Finance, and Revenue Operations teams to evaluate contractual terms and resolve revenue accounting matters.
  • Demonstrated success identifying accounting process inefficiencies, implementing improvements, and enhancing financial reporting accuracy.
  • CPA certification or relevant professional accounting credentials.

Additional information
Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), RFA
jobs.description:
About RFA and Titan

RFA is a leading IT and cybersecurity partner to financial services firms: hedge funds, private equity, asset managers, and the firms that serve them. RFA is part of Titan, which is building the AI workforce for IT.

Titan has raised over $100M from General Catalyst, 8VC, and CalPERS, acquired market-leading IT firms like RFA, and put AI agents into production in large enterprises. We've automated 100K+ tickets across 800+ customers and are leading the industry in service quality. Our tech team has talent from Scale AI, CoreWeave, Vanta, Dropbox, Meta, FiveRings, TwoSigma, Amazon, Harvard, Stanford, and MIT.

Why this role, why now

AI is changing security faster than anything we've seen, and we want RFA to be the one leading it for its clients. RFA's clients answer to regulators, investors, and DDQs, and they expect their IT partner to be the most security-minded team in the room. With Titan's AI agents now working alongside RFA's engineers, we can deliver security that is faster, more thorough, and more proactive than a traditional MSP or MSSP.

We're looking for a CISO for RFA: a security leader who wants to build security for financial firms from the ground up, with AI at the center of how it's delivered.

About the role

As RFA's CISO, you own security for RFA and its clients. You lead RFA's GRC, SOC, and vCISO teams, act as the senior security advisor to client leadership, and make sure RFA itself holds up to the scrutiny of the most demanding funds. You'll report to RFA's COO and work closely with RFA's service delivery and engineering teams, and with Titan's product and engineering teams.

You own and measure success by client outcomes (incidents prevented and contained, audits and DDQs passed), growth and retention of RFA's security revenue, and an RFA that passes every client security review.

This role is remote (US).

In this role you will

  • Set RFA's security strategy and lead RFA's GRC, SOC, and vCISO teams, who report to you

  • Build and run RFA's client security offering: vCISO, managed detection and response, SOC, vulnerability management, email security, and incident response, with AI agents doing the volume and people doing the judgment

  • Be the trusted security advisor to client CFOs, COOs, and CCOs: board and investment committee updates, regulatory readiness (SEC, FINRA, Reg S-P, state privacy rules), and investor DDQs

  • Lead incident response for RFA clients, from first alert to client communication and lessons learned

  • Own RFA's own security and compliance program, including SOC 2 and the security questionnaires clients send us

  • Work with Titan's engineers to make sure the AI agents working in client environments are safe: least-privilege access, guardrails, logging, and audit trails

  • Guide RFA clients adopting Claude, ChatGPT, and Copilot on AI governance: data boundaries, connector and permission review, shadow AI discovery

  • Join sales cycles as RFA's security voice: win the client's CISO or CCO, and turn what we learn into packaged services and pricing

You might thrive in this role if you

  • Bring 10+ years in security, including leading a security function or practice as CISO, VP, or Head of Security

  • Have built or run security services at an MSP, MSSP, or security consultancy, ideally serving financial services firms

  • Know what hedge funds, PE firms, and asset managers need from security: SEC cybersecurity rules, Reg S-P, investor DDQs, and frameworks like NIST CSF, SOC 2, and ISO 27001

  • Are hands-on with Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, Defender, and modern EDR, SIEM, and email security stacks

  • Are excited, not threatened, by AI agents doing security work, and have opinions on how to make them safe

  • Can explain risk to a fund COO in plain language and to an engineer in technical detail

  • Take extreme ownership and would rather build the program than inherit one

Bonus

  • CISSP, CISM, CISA, or CRISC

  • vCISO experience across multiple financial services clients

  • Experience securing LLM applications or AI governance work (e.g., ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF)

Logistics

Location: Remote (US)

Travel: Under 5%, for occasional client meetings and time with the team in NYC

We've built the world's most advanced and largest video commerce platform, trusted by global brands and leading retailers. But we're more than software — our compounding network effect grows stronger with every partner we add, bringing the energy of in-store experiences online and transforming how businesses engage, convert, and build lasting customer relationships at scale.

Having raised over $235M to date, led by investors such as SoftBank Vision Fund 2, and operating at global scale, we offer unparalleled opportunities to solve complex challenges and drive meaningful impact in the future of connected commerce.

If you're curious, ambitious, and energized by big ideas — Firework is the place to grow, lead, and shape what comes next. Together.

To determine a successful candidate’s starting pay, we carefully consider a variety of factors, including primary work location, an evaluation of the candidate’s skills and experience, market demands, and internal parity. We understand some candidates may see the above and not apply because they don’t meet all the qualifications. Maven Clinic is the world's largest virtual clinic for women and families on a mission to make healthcare work for all of us.   • 3+ years experience managing and mentoring PMs
  • A track record of scaling an operational product to reliability: you have taken something manual and error-prone and made it run quietly at volume

On top of standards such as employer-covered health, dental, and insurance plan options, we offer an inclusive approach to benefits:

jobs.title: Onboarding Manager
jobs.description:
About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.

About the Role

As an Onboarding Manager, you will play a pivotal role in encouraging partners to engage with and participate in MSP Enablement programs as soon as possible after the point of sale. You will set milestones for new program participants, encourage users to move through the process in a quick and efficient manner, and run meetings to integrate members into their assigned groups. Additionally, you will update systems, train partners on using our platforms, track members post-onboarding, provide feedback for process improvements, and assist with event production as needed.

Key Responsibilities

  • Encourage partners to engage with and participate in MSP Enablement programs as soon as possible after the point of sale.
  • Set milestones for new program participants as they navigate the onboarding process and begin interacting with the MSP enablement community and TruMethods Peer groups. Influence Peer group placement by communicating known information to program management and operations functions.
  • Run one-to-one and one-to-many meetings, following a process to integrate peer members into their assigned groups.
  • Update systems as designed and documented, appropriately leveraging systems for communication and relationship management.
  • Train partners on how to use the MSP Enablement platforms to access the software and content needed to successfully participate in MSP Enablement programs.
  • Track members post-onboarding to ensure that the onboarding program equips members to be successful.
  • Provide feedback on how to improve processes, assisting with implementation and improvements that promote a positive program experience for partners.
  • Assist with event production by attending in-person and virtual peer quarterly events as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proven experience in onboarding, customer service, or a related field.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong organizational and time-management abilities.
  • Proficiency in using CRM systems and other relevant software.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Flexibility to attend in-person and virtual events as required.

Additional information
Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Enterprise Sales Director, Retail
jobs.description:
About us

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Sierra was co-founded by Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor who first met while working together at Google over 20 years ago. Bret currently serves as Chairman of the Board of Open AI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce and CTO of Facebook. Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs.

About the Retail team

  • Sierra is partnering with a large and growing number of retailers - spanning apparel and beauty, grocery and big-box, home and auto, consumer services, marketplaces, and consumer technology. Our agents help millions of shoppers and members every day: tracking and returning orders, finding the right product, booking services, and resolving issues in each brand’s own voice.

  • Retail is also where AI agents go beyond support to generate revenue. From product discovery and personalized recommendations to cart recovery, win-back campaigns, and in-store support that turns unanswered store calls into visits and sales, our team is redefining what an agent can do for a brand’s top line - not just its cost line.

  • Join us to transform how the world’s most-loved consumer brands engage their customers - and help build technology that makes shopping more personal, effortless, and delightful for everyone.

What you'll do

  • Prospecting & lead generation: Identify and target potential customers through research, networking, and cold calling. Build new relationships with our enterprise customers and prospects to drive revenue, pipeline, and deployment capacity.

  • Manage relationships: Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers and stakeholders with our largest customers. Serve as their primary point of contact and exceed their expectations.

  • Negotiating & closing complex deal cycles: Lead negotiations with existing and prospective customers, addressing objections and closing deals. Navigate contracts and agreements quickly and effectively, working closely with legal and finance stakeholders.

  • Sales strategy & planning: Develop and execute sales strategies to meet or exceed sales targets. Craft tailored sales presentations and proposals that meet our enterprise customers needs. Collaborate with our marketing team to implement effective sales campaigns and presentations.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with our broader GTM team, as well as our product, technical and operations orgs to deliver our industry-leading product.

  • Operate as an AI-native seller: Leverage AI tools across the full sales cycle- account research, personalized outreach, call summarization, pipeline forecasting, and deal execution- to automate low-value tasks and reinvest that time into high-value customer relationships, while continuously adopting and experimenting with new tools to work faster and smarter than traditional methods allow.

What you'll bring

  • 6-8 years of experience in an enterprise customer-facing sales role, identifying and closing large accounts.

  • Enterprise experience: Experience managing a $1M+ quota and running end-to-end complex 6- and 7-figure ACV deals.

  • Strong communication skills: Exceptional verbal and written communication abilities.

  • Analytical mindset: Ability to analyze market trends, identify opportunities, and make data-driven decisions.

  • Prospecting & lead generation: Proven track record of identifying and targeting potential enterprise clients through research, networking, and cold calling.

Even better...

  • Industry knowledge: Familiarity with the AI landscape, key players, and emerging trends.

Our values

  • Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

  • Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

  • Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

  • Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

  • Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.

What we offer

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

  • Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

  • Life insurance and disability benefits

  • Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

  • Parental leave

  • Fertility and family building benefits

  • Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized when working onsite

  • Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

  • Free alphorn lessons

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region and employment type, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.

Be you, with us

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. To do so, it is important to us that the diversity of our employees represents the diversity of our customers. We believe that our work and culture are better when we encourage, support, and respect different skills and experiences represented within our team. We encourage you to apply through the link on this page even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description.

Sierra is a proud equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws, including veteran status and disability status. Hiring decisions are made by people, based on merit. If you need a reasonable accommodation for a disability, a religious practice, pregnancy or any related condition at any point in the application or interview process, contact us at accommodations@sierra.ai. Requests are handled confidentially and do not affect your candidacy.

We will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with applicable fair chance laws.
