jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Meet Yubico

Yubico is a global leader in identity security and creator of the YubiKey, the original hardware-backed passkey. We are publicly traded on Nasdaq Stockholm; our global footprint includes headquarters in Stockholm, Sweden, Silicon Valley, California; and Singapore.

Why Join Our Mission?

At Yubico, we are guided by a shared belief that your work matters. We operate under a cultural philosophy of Speed with Integrity, pushing the boundaries of technology to secure the AI frontier—protecting both human and agentic AI interactions—and leading the transition to post-quantum cryptography. In everything we do, we live by our core values:

  • Battle Friction: We constantly look for new ways to simplify our products, our work, and the user experience.
  • Inspire Higher: We think big, champion the open internet, and strive to do the right thing even when it is difficult.
  • One Team: We are open, responsive, and collaborative, overcoming challenges and celebrating our successes together.

Aligned with our commitment to open standards, we foster a thriving builder ecosystem through the Yubico Developer Program, offering free open-source repositories, libraries, and SDKs to help developers rapidly integrate strong hardware authentication into any application. Through close collaborations with technical partners like Google, Microsoft, and Amazon, as well as newer frontiers like OpenAI, we continue to shape a safer digital world while donating security keys to protect vulnerable communities, journalists, and humanitarian groups worldwide through our Secure it Forward program.

At Yubico, we offer:

Yubico Values: We work to ensure that our employees have an open space to have their voices amplified to create a workplace where everyone feels like they belong. In support of this, our employees have created some pretty cool Employee Resource Groups that foster inclusion, help build community and connection across Yubico. Additionally, Yubico donates YubiKeys to organizations in need all over the world (you can read more about our work here).

Social Connection: Relationships and connectedness matter, and we love spending time with our team! Our virtual workspace keeps us connected day-to-day whether it's through Yubico celebrating wins or our buzzing Slack communities. Check out our Life at Yubico Page on LinkedIn and our awards here.

The Role

Yubico is looking for an experienced and highly collaborative Senior Product Manager to define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Tools, Libraries, and Applications (TLA) that underlie many of Yubico products and services. In this role, you will be a technical leader in our product management team and work closely with builders across a variety of our products from open source libraries and SDKs which empower other developers to create amazing things with our products, command line tools for managing and using YubiKeys and YubiHSMs, as well as graphical apps for mobile and desktop platforms.

Our team works with authentication protocols like FIDO2/WebAuthn and uses cryptography to implement open standards. You'll have the opportunity to help us showcase our libraries in sample apps, making complex topics easier to use. You will help define and deliver the success of Yubico’s foundational product areas and expand the use of our technology to new and innovative areas that capture the market demand. You will serve as the strategic counterpart to our Senior Director of Engineering for Tools, Libraries & Apps.

This role will own the "what" and "why" behind the enterprise-grade, secured, and reliable software used to build new applications and services that expand the value of Yubico hardware and services. To succeed, you will work closely with other product managers, engineers, solutions engineers, and operations teams to translate complex business and technical requirements into a robust definition for the foundational tools, libraries and applications in our expanding product portfolio

Tasks & Responsibilities

  • Product Strategy & Roadmap Ownership: Define and execute the long-term product vision and roadmap for our foundational tools, libraries, and applications, ensuring tight alignment with overarching business goals and customer needs.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner deeply across Engineering, Product, Operations, and Security teams to design high-impact capabilities that enhance product foundations that underlie efficiency and scalability of our solutions.
  • Customer focus: Meet with customers to understand market demand and outcomes for new products
  • Requirements Definition: Translate complex workflows and software requirements into clear, high-quality product requirement documents (PRDs) and user stories.
  • Technical Partnership & Conflict Resolution: Serve as the strategic unifier in cross-functional technical decisions. Actively synthesize competing priorities between product vision and architectural necessity, ensuring trade-offs are documented, data-backed, and optimized for long-term reliability.
  • Data-driven Insights: Provide data-driven insights on the specific products being managed, including sales and financial performance, year-over-year trends, pipeline, etc.
  • Full life cycle management: Manage the full life-cycle of a product from inception to end of life including: conception, market and requirements gathering, customer validation, creation of high-quality requirements document, management of engineering, marketing preparation, release and end-of-life processes
  • Security & Compliance Management: Collaborate with security and engineering teams to ensure software systems seamlessly integrate with critical cryptographic infrastructure (such as PKI and HSMs) while maintaining Yubico's gold standard of security.

Basic Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Experience: 10+ years of progressively broadening product management experience, with a strong track record of shipping complex, enterprise-class hardware & manufacturing solutions.
  • Domain Expertise: Proven experience in technical product management including development of large-scale internal tools.
  • Leadership & Acumen: Proven ability to act as a constructive challenger to highly technical engineering partners. Strong business and technical acumen with the confidence to debate architectural tradeoffs and act as a constructive challenger in deeply technical environments and manage competing priorities across geographically distributed teams.
  • Communication: Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills to align multi-disciplinary teams toward a unified vision.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Cryptographic Systems: Understanding of cryptographic systems, Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), or Key Management Systems utilizing Hardware Security Modules (HSMs).
  • Analytical Mindset: Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a hands-on approach to diving deep into technical workflows alongside engineering teams.

U.S. benefits designed for your overall well-being:

Health coverage. We’ve got you covered with top of the line health plans, including dental and vision. We pay 100% of your premium and 85% for your family.

Retirement plan. Our retirement plan includes a 401K dollar per dollar match up to 6% with a cap of $6K/year. Immediate vesting.

Wellness reimbursement. We offer $1,200.00 in wellness earnings (prorated based on start date) that you can use on your gym membership, a massage, or your favorite online fitness classes. This is a taxable benefit if you choose to participate.

Learning and development. We encourage your professional growth and offer a yearly development stipend of $3,000 and mentorship program.

Time off. We offer a total of 15 vacation days plus 10 holidays, and 7 sick days a year.

Paid parental leave. We love welcoming new family members to our YubiTeam! All parents receive 8 weeks of paid leave. Birthing parents receive an additional 8 weeks of paid leave (16 weeks total).

Commuter Benefits. If you need to commute to the office, we offer commuter benefits.

Strong mission & company values. We’re a global team on a global mission to make the internet more secure for everyone. We believe that every person’s work matters. That you should always be nice, stay humble, and have fun, and never take yourself too seriously.

jobs.description:
Hi there! We're Testlio, a global software testing company that has been helping businesses improve their digital products since 2012.
We work with companies around the world to test websites, mobile apps, and online payment systems. Our freelance community helps identify issues and make sure these products work as expected for real customers.
Learn more about us at www.testlio.com.

About This Opportunity

We're looking for people in Italy, Belgium, and Germany to help us test how local payment methods work when paying for advertising on Facebook and Instagram through Meta Ads Manager.

Requirements:

  • Location & Payment Method:
    • Italy: Satispay account.
    • Belgium: Wero activated with a Belgian bank account.
    • Germany: Wero activated with a German bank account.
  • Have access to Meta Ads Manager, or be willing to create an account.
  • Have an iOS/Android device or a computer with an updated browser, plus a smartphone with the required payment app.
  • Comfortable following instructions and submitting feedback in English.
  • Available to start ASAP and complete testing by November 16, 2026.
  • Duration: Approximately 1.5 hours.
  • Compensation: Paid hourly testing assignment.

Don't have Satispay or Wero yet? You can still apply if you're willing and eligible to set it up before testing.

  • Follow step-by-step instructions from our testing team.
  • Add a local payment method to Meta Ads Manager.
  • Complete a small advertising payment of approximately €5.

Why do we need local testers?
Online payment methods can work differently depending on the country, bank, and device. That's why companies need local people to help check that payments are processed correctly.
Your role is to follow simple instructions, complete a small authorized transaction, and tell us whether everything worked as expected.
No previous software testing experience is required!

You'll receive instructions for the assigned testing activities. Never share passwords, full card numbers, or sensitive banking information in your reports.

If your profile matches the project requirements, our team will reach out with the next steps.

jobs.title: Senior Analytics Engineer (Data Modeling & BI)
jobs.description:
Hey there!
We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

Ready to be part of the experience?

About the Role

At Fever, we are building a federated data organization that combines centralization where it’s essential and autonomy where it creates value. Our teams leverage modern data platforms (Snowflake, DBT, Airflow, DataHub, Metabase, etc.). At the same time, we are developing our own technology to deliver high-quality data products across multiple business domains.

As a Senior Analytics Engineer, you’ll be the bridge between data engineering and business analytics, ensuring that our stakeholders can make decisions on reliable, well-modeled, and discoverable datasets.

  • Design, build, and maintain data models (DBT, SQL) that transform raw data into clean, trusted datasets for self-service and reporting.

  • Work with business squads (B2B, Marketing, CRM, Product) to understand their needs and turn them into reusable data assets.

  • Support self-service analytics by enabling stakeholders to explore data confidently by leveraging existing viz and BI tools or driving custom developments to let the data tell a complete story.
  • Contribute to Airflow pipelines in Python, supporting automation and orchestration needs.
  • Contribute to our data mesh vision, creating domain-owned datasets while following platform and engineering guidelines.
  • Leverage Agentic AI, Claude Code, and other advanced AI tools in your day-to-day workflow to accelerate development cycles, boost efficiency, and maximize your overall impact.

What You Bring

  • Fluent in Spanish and English; you’ll communicate in Spanish with local teams and in English with global teams
  • A Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Computer Engineering, Data Engineering, Data Science, or a related field.
  • A collaborative mindset: comfortable working with both engineers and business stakeholders.
  • Strong communication skills, adaptable to a multidisciplinary, international, and fast-paced environment.
  • A keen interest in understanding a complex business landscape and to drive the company forward by providing the data to answer the most valuable questions
  • Strong experience with SQL and data modeling (star/snowflake schemas, data vault, or similar).
  • Hands-on experience with DBT (or similar transformation frameworks).
  • Hands-on experience with Python and orchestration frameworks (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect).
  • Familiarity with modern cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, etc.).
  • Experience with BI tools (Metabase, Superset, Tableau, etc.).
  • Understanding of data quality, governance, and observability practices.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in a federated or data mesh environment.
  • Familiarity with data catalog tools (DataHub, Collibra, Amundsen).
  • Exposure to analytics in domains like marketing, CRM, or B2B reporting.
  • Hands-on experience or strong interest in leveraging Agentic AI and coding assistants (like Claude Code or Copilot) to accelerate data workflows and development.

Benefits & Perks

  • Attractive compensation package consisting of base salary and the potential to earn a significant bonus for top performance
  • Stock options
  • Responsibility from day one and professional and personal growth
  • Opportunity to have a real impact in a high-growth global category leader

Hello! I am Sebastian, Marketing Lead at Kayzen, and I am looking for a Marketing Manager, Community & Events to join our team.

But wait, you have not heard of Kayzen before?

Kayzen is the Apps DSP: an AI-native platform built on its own bidding engine, for buying app inventory across mobile and connected TV screens. App developers, agencies, media buyers and ad platforms use Kayzen to drive full-funnel outcomes across both screens, from awareness and consideration to installs, purchases and calls. 🤝 The Team

Join me as part of Kayzen’s growing marketing team, where we collaborate closely with stakeholders across the business to drive our strategy forward.You'll collaborate alongside a high-performing, international group spanning customer success, sales, product, engineering, data, operations, design, and marketing. We are seeking a relationship-driven, hands-on marketer to make Kayzen more visible and connected across key communities and events in our industry.   • Agency or high-growth SaaS experience preferred.

  • Proven ability to deliver in a customer-facing role with professionalism and confidence.

  • Strong organizational and project management skills with attention to detail.

  • Excellent relationship-building and communication skills with internal and external stakeholders.

  • A passion for the creator economy, influencer innovation, and emerging social trends.

  • Fluency in French Highly Preferred

How You Work

Learn more at later.com.

About this position:

As an Enterprise Account Director at Later, you will own a portfolio of our most strategic enterprise client relationships, typically representing $5M-$15M in annual business depending on account size and complexity.

You will operate as the CEO of the account, with significant autonomy and accountability for setting the account strategy, building executive relationships, driving expansion, and determining how Later should invest to deepen and grow each partnership.

This is a senior commercial and strategic leadership role within the evolving creator and influencer marketing ecosystem. You will advise some of the world’s leading brands on how influencer and creator marketing can support broader brand, commerce, customer acquisition, and growth objectives, while helping them navigate a rapidly changing social landscape.

You will bring a strong point of view on creator strategy, social trends, measurement, and the influencer ecosystem, while translating client business priorities into meaningful opportunities for Later. Success in this role requires strong commercial instincts, executive presence, strategic thinking, and the ability to navigate complex enterprise organizations with a high degree of independence.

What you'll be doing:

Enterprise Account Strategy & Growth

  • Own the long-term strategy and growth plan for a portfolio of strategic enterprise clients representing approximately $5M-$15M in annual business.
  • Develop a clear growth thesis for each account, including expansion opportunities, stakeholder strategy, competitive dynamics, risks, and areas where Later can create additional value.
  • Drive expansion by identifying whitespace, developing opportunities, and building the executive alignment required to increase Later’s strategic and commercial footprint.
  • Connect client business priorities to opportunities across influencer marketing, creator strategy, social, commerce, and Later’s broader capabilities.
  • Maintain a forward-looking view of each partnership, anticipating changes in client priorities, organizational structure, competitive dynamics, and the broader creator and social landscape.

  • Own the roadmap for a consolidated creator engagement and tracking system, and decide what gets built and in what order.

  • Use AI and automation to take manual work out of outreach, routing, and follow-up, and measure what it saves.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Systems Architecture
jobs.description:
Valinor is a new type of defense and government tech company focused on solving the problems others don't. Our unique model of centralized go-to-market and decentralized engineering allows us to move with unparalleled efficiency to identify unmet needs, build right-sized solutions, and get products where they matter most - in the hands of users. Unlike others in the space, who focus on the flashy problems, Valinor exists to solve the quiet, unaddressed problems-the small but significant ones that lead to cracks in the country's strength, stability, and security.

Backed by General Catalyst, Founders Fund, and Friends & Family Capital, Valinor was founded in 2024 and has established strategic partnerships with Palantir, Anduril, and Helsing. We are building the dream team, and we want you on it.

About The Role

We're looking for a software engineer to own the architecture, data handling, and product layer of the software stack at one of Valinor’s product companies, currently in stealth. The system turns raw sensor data into a usable, trusted picture for the end user. You'll work directly with the General Manager and alongside a small team of engineers to rapidly develop a new product. You’ll also partner with product enablement at the Valinor Hub to stand up infrastructure and management.

We see this as a step-up role: someone who has already been part of building a system like this, whether embedded/edge software, sensor or data pipelines, or detection and classification work, as a strong contributor, and is ready to own that kind of architecture for the first time, with direct partnership from the GM on the highest-stakes tradeoffs.

What You'll Do

1. Overall Software Architecture

  • Design the software architecture that ties the products data flow, processing, and user-facing product together end to end.

  • Define clean interfaces with the sensor integration and API work, so the pieces fit into a coherent whole rather than a collection of one-offs.

  • Make and document the core architecture decisions early, since the system needs to flex as we learn what the product needs to become.

2. Data Handling & Pipeline

  • Architect the edge vs. cloud processing split — what runs on-system under power/compute constraints versus what gets backhauled.

  • Stand up time-series and object storage systems for sensor and telemetry data, and the ingestion pipeline that gets data from the system to backend reliable.

  • Design for bandwidth-constrained, compression-aware data transport, and build in the data versioning and observability needed to trust what's flowing in as sensor types multiply.

3. Detection, Classification & Pattern-of-life

  • Work with various sensor modalities, including acoustic, EO/IR, radar, RF/AIS, and others, to build detection and classification capability — starting with classical signal-processing methods where appropriate, and applied ML where it earns its complexity.

  • Contribute to pattern-of-life anomaly detection work.

  • Fuse multi-modal signals into a single detection/classification output.

4. User Interface — Configuration & Visualization

  • Build the product configuration interface and the geospatial data visualization layer (the common operating picture) the end customer will actually use.

What We're Looking For

Required

  • Architecture contribution, ready to lead: you've been part of a small team that designed and built a system with real architectural stakes — edge/embedded software, sensor or data pipelines, or similar — and you're ready to own that kind of system yourself for the first time.

  • Data pipeline and storage experience: comfortable designing and operating time-series data systems and message-based ingestion pipelines (MQTT, Kafka, or equivalent), including handling for intermittent/unreliable connectivity.

  • Full-stack range: comfortable moving between backend/data pipeline work (Python, Go, or similar) and frontend (React/TypeScript) without needing a specialist for each; enough familiarity with embedded/edge constraints to architect around them, even if you're not writing firmware yourself.

  • At least one sensing/signal domain: hands-on experience with at least one of acoustic, EO/IR, or radar signal processing or detection — and genuine excitement to pick up the others as the product grows into them.

  • Cloud infrastructure ownership: able to stand up and maintain CI/CD and cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred; GovCloud experience a plus) without a dedicated DevOps function yet in place.

  • Step-up temperament: proven ability to build and rebuild quickly with loose specs, and comfort taking ownership of a decision you'd previously have brought to someone else.

Strongly Preferred

  • TAK (or similar government system) integration experience: hands-on work integrating with TAK (ATAK/WinTAK/TAK Server) or a comparable government C2/situational-awareness system is a significant plus.

  • Applied ML experience, particularly anomaly detection or pattern-of-life modeling.

  • Prior experience in defense or dual-use tech, including familiarity with the general shape of DoD software requirements (security, data handling, eventual ATO/RMF processes).

  • Geospatial visualization experience (Mapbox, Cesium, deck.gl, or similar).

  • Prior experience on an autonomous systems, robotics, or maritime/subsea platform.

What Valinor Offers

  • Competitive salary, equity packages, and benefits, including health, dental, and vision insurance - fully covered for employees, 401K, development stipends, among others.

  • Unlimited PTO and two-week company holiday at the end of every calendar year.

  • We are a pro-mental health and pro-family company - we actually encourage employees to spend time with themselves and their families. Valinor also provides fertility benefits to those just beginning that journey.

  • Fun work environment - we like to laugh and take care of each other, but we also deeply respect the mission in front of us.

This role requires the candidate be eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance. Active clearance preferred, but not required.

Valinor is an equal-opportunity employer committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. The Valinor team is made up of incredibly talented and unique individuals, who together are disrupting industry norms by creating new paths towards the future of defense and government technology. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, Veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law, including those with a criminal history, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the CA Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance. We actively encourage members of recognized minorities, women, Veterans, and those with disabilities to apply, and we work to create a welcoming and supportive environment for all applicants throughout the interview process. If you are someone passionate about working on problems that have a real-world impact, we'd love to hear from you!

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

OKX is hiring a Senior Compliance Officer to build and run our global derivatives trade and transaction reporting function. The function covers CFTC swap data reporting under Part 45, EU transaction reporting under MiFIR, EU derivatives reporting under EMIR, UK MiFIR and UK EMIR, and ASIC derivative transaction reporting across multiple OKX entities and a growing derivatives product set. These regimes have different scopes, reporting parties, data requirements and destinations. You will determine how they apply to OKX’s activities and help build a reliable process for meeting each obligation.

Most of the work is data and judgment: deciding what is reportable, by which entity, and to whom, then making sure the right trade and lifecycle data reaches the right swap data repository, trade repository, or regulator on time and reconciles to our trading records. You will own reporting scoping/eligibility, submission monitoring, and the controls that show our reports are complete, accurate, and timely.

This is a hands-on Compliance leadership role. You will work with Trading, Product, Engineering, Data, Legal, local Compliance teams and reporting providers, and you will lead regulatory change in this space. Responsibilities for source data, systems, submissions and remediation will be agreed across those teams; you will lead the compliance framework and stay close enough to the process to identify and proactively resolve problems. You will report to the Head of Markets and Product Compliance and support a central function that owns reporting interpretation, scoping, oversight, and remediation for every entity in scope.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Interpret and apply derivatives and transaction reporting rules across global regimes, including CFTC Part 45, MiFIR Article 26, EMIR Article 9, UK MiFIR, UK EMIR, and the ASIC Derivative Transaction Rules (Reporting) 2024, exercising independent technical judgment, supported by Legal and outside counsel.

  • Own and maintain entity, product, and transaction-level reporting scoping and eligibility: which entity reports, which products and lifecycle events are in scope, which counterparty role triggers the obligation, and which repository or authority receives the report.

  • Oversee, support, and help maintain the daily reporting process. Monitor submissions against deadlines, including T+1 for MiFIR transaction reports, investigate rejections and breaks, and track each one to resolution.

  • Reconcile reported activity to trading records and repository data, and coordinate corrections and back-reporting with the teams that own the relevant systems and data.

  • Define and maintain the reporting data specification with Engineering and Data, including field-level mapping, reference data such as LEIs, UTIs, UPIs, and ISINs, and the validation rules applied before submission.

  • Build and run the control framework: completeness, accuracy, and timeliness checks, exception management, management information, and records that hold up to regulator and audit review.

  • Drive reporting readiness and remediation. Assess new derivatives products, new entities, and regulatory changes, identify control gaps, agree on owners and deadlines across Compliance, Operations, Product, and Engineering, and track delivery.

  • Escalate material issues. Assess the impact of reporting errors, escalate to senior management, and support notifications to regulators where required.

  • Manage relationships with swap data repositories, trade repositories, approved reporting mechanisms, and reporting vendors, including onboarding, testing, and service issues.

  • Hands-on leader. Build a small team, and coordinate with and train local compliance leads.

  • Support independent testing by Compliance Monitoring, Risk, and Internal Audit, and support regulator inquiries with complete, reproducible records.

What We Look For In You

  • A degree in finance, economics, law, data science, or computer science, or an equivalent professional qualification

  • 7+ years in trade reporting, transaction reporting, or regulatory reporting at an exchange, broker, bank, trading firm, fintech, or digital asset platform

  • Deep working knowledge of at least two of the following regimes: CFTC swap data reporting, MiFIR transaction reporting, EMIR, UK MiFIR, UK EMIR, and ASIC derivative transaction reporting. Hands-on experience with both a US and a European regime is strongly preferred.

  • A sound understanding of derivatives trade lifecycles and the data needed to report executions, changes, terminations and, where applicable, valuations and collateral.

  • The ability to interrogate large datasets, investigate reporting breaks and explain clear requirements to engineers and other business partners. SQL or comparable data analysis skills are highly desirable.

  • Experience building or improving a reporting framework, including procedures, reconciliations, exception management and evidence that can withstand regulatory or audit scrutiny; this may include remediating historical reporting errors, including back-reporting.

  • The judgment to make proportionate risk decisions, escalate material issues and lead delivery across teams without relying on a single team to own every part of the reporting process.

  • Experience with digital asset derivatives, such as perpetual futures and options, and how they map to reporting product classifications

Nice to Haves

  • Experience leading a regulatory reporting change program, such as EMIR Refit, UK EMIR Refit, the CFTC reporting rewrite, or the ASIC 2024 rules.

  • Familiarity with ISO 20022 XML reporting formats.

  • Python or similar scripting for data validation, and experience with data warehouse tools such as Databricks.

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive total compensation package

  • L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development

  • Various team building programs and company events

  • More that we love to tell you along the process!

About the Role

Updater is seeking a commercially minded, highly strategic, and technically fluent Enterprise Accounts Director to own and grow a focused portfolio of our most important enterprise customers.

You’ll become deeply embedded in your customers’ businesses, building trusted relationships with senior decision-makers, understanding their technical environments and strategic priorities, and developing account strategies that drive long-term partnership health, performance, and growth.

You’ll work closely with Sales on strategic accounts, help create continuity from late-stage sales through implementation and launch, and serve as the ongoing business owner for the relationship. We’re looking for someone who can navigate complex technical partnerships, challenge customers when needed, build compelling business cases, and turn strong relationships into meaningful commercial growth.

Key Responsibilities

Own Strategic Accounts

  • Serve as the senior relationship owner for a focused portfolio of large, complex enterprise accounts, developing strategies that drive long-term health, performance, retention, and growth.
  • Develop a deep understanding of each customer’s business model, technical environment, strategic priorities, organizational dynamics, and success metrics.

Manage Relationships Across the Customer Lifecycle

  • Lead strategic commercial conversations around expansion, pricing, and other changes to the relationship.
  • Anticipate underperformance or relationship risk and develop clear strategies to improve outcomes.

Navigate Complex Enterprise Relationships

  • Develop a strong working understanding of Updater’s products, APIs, integrations, data flows, and customer workflows.
  • Translate technical capabilities and constraints into clear business implications for customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Drive complex partnership initiatives across Product, Engineering, Professional Services, Sales, and other internal teams.
  • Bring customer insights into internal decision-making while balancing customer needs with Updater’s product and commercial priorities.

Requirements

  • 8–10+ years of experience across enterprise account management, strategic partnerships, enterprise sales, customer success, consulting, or a related commercially focused role.
  • Meaningful experience owning large, complex enterprise relationships involving software, APIs, integrations, embedded products, or other technically complex partnerships.
  • Demonstrated ability to move beyond day-to-day relationship management and develop strategic account plans that improve customer outcomes and create commercial growth.

  • Strong commercial instincts, including experience identifying expansion opportunities, developing business cases, navigating objections, and advancing complex commercial conversations.
  • Demonstrated ability to take initiative, operate autonomously, and drive cross-functional work across Product, Engineering, Professional Services, Sales, and other teams.

  • Experience in telecommunications, utilities, real estate, financial services, marketplaces, or other complex enterprise ecosystems is a plus.
  • Familiarity with AI tools for analysis, workflow automation, or account management is a plus.

In your first 90 days, you’ll develop a deep understanding of your account portfolio, including each customer’s business, stakeholders, technical environment, economics, performance, risks, and growth opportunities. You’ll build strong internal and external relationships and establish clear account strategies and priorities.

Over time, you’ll become the trusted strategic partner and internal business owner for your accounts. You’ll understand where relationships are performing well, where risk exists, and where meaningful opportunities exist to deepen and grow the partnership.

Ultimately, success means building enterprise relationships that perform better, grow over time, and create meaningful long-term value for both our customers and Updater.

Updater is a leading technology platform helping major brands acquire and retain customers at scale. We are on a mission to power millions of complex transactions through intelligent, autonomous systems. By combining deep integrations, real-world data, and purpose-built AI agents, we’re transforming fragmented purchasing workflows into seamless, automated experiences – freeing businesses and consumers from operational friction and enabling a new standard of speed, accuracy, and scale.

Updater has raised over $450 million from leading investors, including SoftBank Capital, Vista Credit Partners, IA Ventures, Commerce Ventures, Second Century Ventures (the strategic investment arm of the National Association of Realtors®), and more. For more information, please visit www.updater.com.

jobs.title: Research Scientist - Generative Audio
jobs.description:
We are seeking Research Scientists (across all levels of seniority) to join our Artist-First AI Music Lab. Our team pioneers and advances state-of-the-art generative technologies for music that create breakthrough experiences for fans and artists. We invent entirely new listening experiences that center and celebrate artists and creatives. All of our products will put artists and songwriters first, through these four principles:

  • Partnerships with record labels, distributors, and music publishers: We’ll develop new products for artists and fans through upfront agreements, not by asking for forgiveness later.
  • Choice in participation: We recognize there’s a wide range of views on the use of generative music tools within the artistic community. Therefore, artists and rightsholders will choose if and how to participate to ensure the use of AI tools aligns with the values of the people behind the music.
  • Fair compensation and new revenue: We will build products that create wholly new revenue streams for rightsholders, artists, and songwriters, ensuring they are properly compensated for the use of their work and transparently credited for their contributions.
  • Artist-fan connection: AI tools we develop will not replace human artistry. They will give artists new ways to be creative and connect with fans. We will leverage our role as the place where more than 700 million people already come to listen to music every month to ensure that generative AI deepens artist-fan connections.

Learn more in our press release: https://newsroom.spotify.com/2025-10-16/artist-first-ai-music-spotify-collaboration/

What You'll Do

Conduct groundbreaking research in generative audio using diffusion or flow matching models, with a focus on one or more of the following areas:

Vocal Synthesis — Research in vocal and speech synthesis, along with related areas such as ML-based audio processing and signal processing.

Post-Training — Research in post-training techniques for music generation, including preference alignment methods (such as DPO, RLHF, or KTO), reward model design and training, and reinforcement learning to improve output quality, controllability, and human preference adherence.

Editing — Research in iterative music generation and audio editing, including capabilities such as stem replacement, instrumentation change, mood changes (while preserving content), tempo changes, and structure changes.

You will also:

  • Run large-scale experiments with access to Spotify's extensive infrastructure and an audience of more than 700 million monthly active users.

You'll create the smart connections that blend someone's medical past with their live health data, crafting an AI experience that actually keeps patients coming back. Turn raw data into advice people can use, making Docplanner the one health app they can't live without.

jobs.title: Cashmere Lab Testing & Quality Leader
jobs.description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

  • We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
  • Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
  • Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE

Cashmere Lab Testing & Quality Leader

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the testing and quality assurance of cashmere raw materials and finished products.
  • Establish and maintain testing standards for composition, fiber length, fineness, and color consistency.
  • Supervise laboratory operations and ensure compliance with international testing standards (GB, ISO, ASTM).
  • Collaborate with suppliers, brands, and third-party testing institutions (e.g., SGS, BV, TUV, UL, Shanghai Garment Research Institute).
  • Build and manage QA/QC teams, train staff, and implement standardized testing procedures.
  • Provide technical reports and data analysis to support procurement, production, and R&D decisions.
  • Drive continuous improvement in testing methods, including micro-analysis and advanced fiber testing technologies.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or above in Textile Engineering, Material Science, or related fields.
  • Proven experience in cashmere or wool fiber testing, with strong knowledge of raw material analysis.
  • Background in either brand-side QA/QC or third-party testing institutions is highly welcomed.
  • Familiarity with international and domestic testing methods (composition, length, color, oil content for down/feather).
  • Strong leadership and team management skills, able to supervise multi-functional teams.
  • Excellent communication and coordination abilities across suppliers, factories, and internal stakeholders.
  • Analytical mindset, detail-oriented, and proactive in problem-solving.

Compensation & Benefits:

  • Competitive salary package with performance bonus.
  • International working environment with exposure to global cashmere supply chain.
  • Career development opportunities in textile testing and quality leadership.

All posted ranges are reflective of base salary and may vary depending upon experience level and location. Bonus and equity may also be provided for eligible roles.

Pay Range

$1—$2 USD

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

You will build strong relationships with key stakeholders, uncover new opportunities, and ensure customers realize measurable value from Algolia’s platform. This role requires a strategic approach to account management, aligning Algolia’s solutions to customer goals to deepen adoption and drive revenue growth.

You will partner closely with Customer Success Managers, Renewal Account Executives, and Customer Success Engineers to deliver a seamless customer experience and proactively address risk and opportunity.

We’re looking for someone who thrives in a high-ownership environment, operates with autonomy, and brings a consultative approach to growing customer relationships. You will be expected to navigate ambiguity, define your own approach, and collaborate cross-functionally to improve our go-to-market motion.

YOUR ROLE WILL CONSIST OF:

  • Own and manage a large portfolio of existing Commercial customers, with accountability for retaining and growing recurring revenue across your install base
  • Develop a deep understanding of each customer’s business objectives, use cases, and success criteria to proactively identify expansion (upsell and cross-sell) opportunities
  • Act as the primary commercial point of contact for your accounts, building strong, trust-based relationships with key stakeholders and decision-makers
  • Drive account planning and execution strategies that align Algolia’s solutions to customer goals, ensuring customers extract maximum value from their existing feature set
  • Lead commercial conversations including renewals, pricing discussions, and expansion opportunities within your install base
  • Partner closely with Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, Support, and other cross-functional teams to proactively address customer needs, remove blockers, and deliver a seamless customer experience
  • Monitor account health and usage signals to identify risks early, taking action to prevent churn and mitigate contraction
  • Maintain accurate forecasting and pipeline management for your book of business, with a focus on predictable revenue retention and growth
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to customers by bringing insights, best practices, and a consultative approach aligned with Algolia’s position as a leader in search and discovery

YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF YOU HAVE:

  • Fluent in Dutch and English
  • 4+ years in a B2B SaaS sales or account management role, with ownership of renewals and expansion revenue, ideally with a background working with eCommerce or digital experience platforms
  • A strong customer-first mindset with a genuine interest in building long-term relationships and helping customers succeed
  • Experience managing and growing a book of business (e.g., Account Management, Customer Growth, Renewals, or Account Executive roles with install base focus)
  • Proven ability to identify and close expansion opportunities within existing accounts
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to effectively engage cross-functional partners to solve customer challenges
  • Comfort operating in a high-growth, dynamic environment, with the ability to manage a high volume of accounts while maintaining attention to detail and prioritization

NICE TO HAVE:

  • Experience with SaaS, APIs, or developer-focused products
  • Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based business models
  • Have familiarity with the Dutch and/or Nordic markets

#LI-Hybrid

Algolia does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, military status, veteran status, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.

The annual total cash compensation range (base salary and commission) for this role reflects market pay data within this location. The exact compensation offered for this role may vary depending on specific location and job-related knowledge, technical skills, and experience; and is only one part of our Total Rewards philosophy to compensate and recognize employees for their work.

On-Target Earnings Pay Range

€139.000—€170.000 EUR

FLEXIBLE WORKPLACE STRATEGY:

Algolia’s flexible workplace model is designed to empower all Algolians to fulfill our mission to power search and discovery with ease. We place an emphasis on an individual’s impact, contribution, and output, over their physical location. Algolia is a high-trust environment and many of our team members have the autonomy to choose where they want to work and when.

We have a global presence with offices in Paris, NYC, London, Sydney and Bucharest, however we also offer many of our team members the option to work remotely either as fully remote or hybrid-remote employees. Positions listed as "Remote" are only available for remote work within the specified country. Positions listed within a specific city are only available in that location - depending on the role it may be available with either a hybrid-remote or in-office schedule.

WE’RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO CAN LIVE OUR VALUES:

  • GRIT - Problem-solving and perseverance capability in an ever-changing and growing environment.
  • TRUST - Willingness to trust our co-workers and to take ownership.
  • CANDOR - Ability to receive and give constructive feedback.
  • CARE - Genuine care about other team members, our clients and the decisions we make in the company.
  • HUMILITY - Aptitude for learning from others, putting ego aside.

We’re looking for talented, passionate people to help build the world’s best search and discovery technology. We value autonomy, diversity, and collaboration. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone is respected and supported—regardless of race, age, ancestry, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, color, veteran status, disability, or socioeconomic background.

IMPORTANT NOTICE FOR CANDIDATES - Recruitment Fraud Notice

We’ve recently seen an increase in recruitment scams targeting job seekers. To help protect yourself, please keep the following in mind:

  • Our open positions may appear on third-party job boards, but the best way to apply safely is directly through our careers page.
  • All genuine communication from Algolia will come from an @algolia.com email address. If you receive an email from someone claiming to work at Algolia who does not have an @algolia.com email address, please do not respond or share any personal information.

READY TO APPLY?

If you share our values and our enthusiasm for building the world’s best search & discovery technology, we’d love to review your application!

jobs.title: Sr. Analyst, Revenue Operations and Analytics
jobs.description:
About Zuora

At Zuora, we help businesses grow smarter and adapt faster. Our platform powers modern business models — from subscriptions and usage-based pricing to AI-driven and outcome-based offerings — helping companies launch new products, automate complex billing, and unlock predictable, recurring revenue.

We’ve led the Subscription Economy for more than a decade. Now we’re evolving again by building the definitive platform for quote to cash and helping companies monetize their products and services with an adaptable, AI-ready foundation.

The Opportunity

Drive transparency, predictability, and insights to the organization through actionable GTM reporting and business intelligence at scale across all levels of the organization.

What You'll Achieve:

  • Support our GTM strategy through a portfolio of dashboards and reports that surface actionable insights
  • Build out a standardized and effective forecasting framework and review process with cross-functional teams
  • Maintain reusable definitions in markdown-based documentation and other shared knowledge assets to support team enablement and skill-building

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Who are we?

At UpGuard, we are replacing manual security bottlenecks with AI-driven precision. Fresh off a US$75M Series C, we are scaling our infrastructure to process 100 billion risk signals daily. This isn’t just growth; it’s a total reimagining of how the world manages cyber risk.

We build the Cyber Risk Posture Management (CRPM) platform that security teams actually love. By integrating security ratings, threat intel, and agentic AI, we empower organisations to stay ahead of an ever evolving attack surface.

We aren’t just building another tool; we’re defining a category. We provide the autonomy to ship world-class technology and the resources to do it at a global scale.

Why are we hiring this role?

Due to continued growth, the Customer Success team is expanding and we require a Customer Success Manager to join our high performing team to onboard and enable our customers. The ideal candidate will be experienced in leading customer interactions, detail oriented, articulate and credible with the ability to listen effectively and provide clear advice.

As a Customer Success Manager, you'll report to the Lead CSM and analyze the causes of your customer’s greatest pain points and work closely to mitigate them using UpGuard technology. You will solicit constant feedback from both customers and colleagues, helping improve UpGuard over time, and you’ll work with customers around the world, from early contact to successful deployment, gaining constant, and unique, insight into the world's most important industries and institutions.

What will you do?

  • You will onboard and manage UpGuard customers to ensure they understand how best to use UpGuard effectively to meet their goals.

  • You will provide resources to your customers, including success plans, customer-specific training sessions and organize regular check in calls.

  • You will engage your customers early and frequently, to help them get the most out of UpGuard from day one and continue to drive engagement.

  • You will translate your customer’s requirements by understanding their risk management frameworks to offer a tailored solution on how best they can utilize UpGuard.

  • You will monitor the health of your customers and intervene with proactive education when customers are not effectively using UpGuard to achieve the value they expected.

  • Advocate for the customer; Provide updates to internal cross-functional partners (Product, Sales & Marketing) on customer perspectives, risks, strategic insights, issue resolution activities, expansion & cross-sell opportunities.

What will you bring?

  • 2+ years' experience in customer success, project management or account management.

  • An understanding of cyber risk management or risk management frameworks.

  • Experience with supporting and building customer relationships in a scalable manner.

  • Highly organized with the ability to update existing documentation and document new processes.

  • High-level of proficiency in the English language, both written and spoken.

  • The ability to work cross functionally with many internal groups and be a team player.

  • Curious and willing to learn.

What would give you an edge?

  • Experience in Customer Success tools, such as ChurnZero or GainSight.

  • Experience with a CRM, such as HubSpot or Salesforce.

  • Experience in cyber risk management or risk management.

  • Understanding of Cyber Security best practices.

  • Basic/working knowledge of APIs.

  • Experience conducting training sessions.

What’s in it for you?

  • Monthly Lifestyle subsidy: Use this for financial, physical, and mental well-being

  • WFH set-up allowance: To ensure you have the right environment to work in, we will help you get set up within your first 3 months at UpGuard

  • $1500 USD annual Learning & Development allowance: To support your career development, all team members will be able to expense development opportunities against this allowance

  • Annual leave: PTO plus two additional UpGuardian leave days to give you time to recharge your batteries.

  • 18 weeks paid Parental Leave: Irrespective of parenting role

  • Personal Leave Allowance: This includes sick & carer’s leave

  • Fully remote working environment: While we have physical offices in Sydney & Hobart, we do not mandate compulsory attendance

  • Top-spec hardware: All team members will be provided with top-spec laptops for their role

  • Generative AI subsidy: UpGuard provides paid subscriptions for all team members to access generative AI tools to support their work.

UpGuard is a Certified Great Place to Work® in the US, Australia, UK and India, establishing its position as a leading global technology employer. 99% of team members agree that UpGuard is a great place to work! Apply now to find out why!

As an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Please Note: Not all roles can be performed from the United States. Please check your specific job listing to confirm its advertised location. If the role you are applying for is listed as based in the US, we are currently only able to support hiring in the following locations: CA, CO, FL, IL, MA, MD, MO, OR, PA, TX, WA, and DC.

Before starting work with us, you will need to undertake a national police history check and reference checks.

jobs.title: Video Editor
jobs.description:
Kalshi is defining a new category

Kalshi has defined a new category: prediction markets. Kalshi allows people to trade on the outcome of any events and turn any question about the future into a financial asset. Kalshi fought for years and legalized prediction markets in the US for the first time in history. Kalshi is currently the fastest growing financial market in America, and has thousands of markets across politics, economics, financials, weather, tech, AI, culture and more.

We believe prediction markets have the potential to be the largest financial market because they turn anything into a financial position.

  • Our vision: well… build the largest financial market on the planet.
  • Our mission: bring more truth to the world through the power of markets.

Building a new category is hard… like really hard. But it’s beautiful and deeply fulfilling. Our culture is simple: we hire really talented people, work really hard, and enjoy the climb. We are looking for ambitious and exceptional people to join our (relatively small) team to help us build the next generation of financial markets.

Role Roadmap

We are looking for a Video Editor who is passionate about creating viral social media content, including TikTok and other user-generated content. We have a massive nationwide campaign coming up that will involve hundreds of videos being created. This role will be crucial to the success of the campaign.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Edit and produce high-quality, engaging social media videos, including UGC TikTok videos, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.
  • Collaborate with our creative and social teams to ideate, plan, and execute video content that will go viral.
  • Transform raw footage into polished, short-form video content that’s optimized for social media.
  • Stay up-to-date with social media video trends, techniques, and best practices to ensure content resonates with our audience.
  • Ability to film or capture content is a plus—helping guide shoots or even capturing footage on occasion.

Who You Are:

You love making super high quality engaging videos and have made many viral videos yourself. You thrive in fast-paced environments and are obsessed with crafting content that engages and excites audiences.

Some basic requirements:

  • Experience making videos that have gone viral.
  • 2+ years of experience in video editing, specifically for social media platforms like TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.
  • Proven ability to create highly engaging and viral content.
  • A creative mindset with a keen understanding of storytelling, pacing, and the latest video trends.
  • Experience in editing short-form, fast-paced videos for social media audiences.
  • Experience with sound editing, color correction, and motion graphics is a plus.
  • Bonus: Experience in filming content or directing video shoots.

NYC Pay Transparency Disclosure:

Salary Range: $70,000 to $150,000 annually plus equity and benefits.

This salary range is based on the current available market data and represents the expected salary range for this role. Kalshi has minimal hierarchy and few titles, but a broad range of experience is represented within roles. Should you have compensation expectations that exceed these bands, we'd love to hear from you and would welcome you to reach out to discuss further.

Our Culture

Meritocracy is at our core, and we value people who take ownership and figure (usually hard) things out. We dream big. We love our craft deeply and are proud of what we put out in the world. We are committed to our vision of building something big… but also useful: a product that brings more truth through the power of markets.

Kalshians are Kalshi’s most important asset: we pick Kalshians carefully, so we trust them fully on day 1.

Commitment to Equal Opportunity

Kalshi is committed to creating a culture of inclusion and belonging, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe it is our collective responsibility to uphold these values and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to join us in our mission. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law. If you are passionate about what you do and want to use your talents to support our mission and values, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior GTM Systems & AI Specialist
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Cobalt was founded on the belief of a fundamental human aspiration: the desire to live better and safer. It all started in 2013, when our founders realized that pentesting can be better. Today our diverse, fully remote team is committed to helping organizations of all sizes with seamless, effective and collaborative Offensive Security Testing that empower organizations to OPERATE FEARLESSLY and INNOVATE SECURELY.

Our customers can start a pentest in as little as 24 hours and integrate with advanced development cycles thanks to the powerful combination of our SaaS platform coupled with an exclusive community of testers known as the Cobalt Core. Accepting just 5% of applicants, the Cobalt Core boasts over 500 closely vetted and highly skilled testers who jointly conduct thousands of tests each year and are at the forefront of identifying and helping remediate risk across a dynamically changing attack surface.

Cobalt is an Equal Opportunity Employer and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive workforce at our company. At Cobalt we aspire to engage with diverse individuals, communities, and organizations in order to continue to nurture our unique rich diverse culture. Join our team, and be your true self to do your best work.

Description

We are looking for a Senior GTM Systems & AI Specialist to own and scale the technology infrastructure that powers Cobalt’s go-to-market organization.

Reporting to the Sr. Director of Revenue Operations, this role will serve as the technical owner of our GTM technology ecosystem, with deep hands-on responsibility for Salesforce, HubSpot, integrations, enrichment, automation, and the systems supporting our customer lifecycle.

This is a highly cross-functional individual contributor role for someone who combines deep GTM systems expertise with a strong understanding of how modern B2B SaaS revenue organizations operate. You won’t just administer tools — you’ll partner with Revenue Operations, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Analytics to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions and identify opportunities to leverage automation and AI to improve how our GTM teams operate.

Success in this role means our GTM teams have reliable systems, connected and trustworthy data, scalable automation, and an increasingly AI-enabled technology ecosystem that helps the business operate more efficiently.

What You'll Own

GTM Systems & Architecture

  • Serve as the primary technical owner and administrator of Salesforce, including architecture, objects, Flows, automation, permissions, integrations, data model, release management, reporting infrastructure, and system governance.
  • Own the broader GTM technology ecosystem, including integrations and data flows between Salesforce, HubSpot, Customer Success platforms, enrichment providers, prospecting and sequencing tools, and other GTM applications.
  • Partner closely with Revenue Operations to translate GTM strategy and business requirements into scalable technical solutions across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success.
  • Evaluate, implement, and optimize GTM technologies with a focus on business impact, scalability, usability, and reducing operational complexity.

HubSpot & Marketing Technology

  • Serve as the primary technical owner and administrator of HubSpot, including workflows, lifecycle stages, lead scoring and routing, forms, campaign infrastructure, attribution configuration, integrations, automation, and data synchronization with Salesforce.
  • Partner with Marketing and Revenue Operations to ensure our marketing technology infrastructure supports lead management, campaign execution, attribution, intent signals, funnel measurement, and Marketing-to-Sales handoffs.
  • Maintain alignment between Salesforce and HubSpot data models, lifecycle definitions, routing logic, campaign data, and reporting requirements.

Data, Enrichment & GTM Signals

  • Own the technical infrastructure supporting GTM data quality and enrichment, including enrichment providers, field mapping, matching logic, deduplication, normalization, data governance, and ongoing monitoring.
  • Design and maintain reliable enrichment and data orchestration workflows that ensure GTM teams have accurate, complete, and actionable account and contact data.
  • Build scalable processes for activating intent signals, engagement data, enrichment signals, and buying triggers across GTM systems.
  • Proactively monitor data and integration health, identify gaps or failures, and implement solutions that improve data accuracy, coverage, reliability, and usability.

Customer Success Technology

  • Support the administration and integration of Customer Success platforms and the data infrastructure supporting the post-sale customer lifecycle.
  • Partner with Revenue Operations and Customer Success to enable processes such as customer health scoring, segmentation, account planning, renewals, expansion, churn risk, and lifecycle management.
  • Ensure customer and commercial data flows reliably across Salesforce, Customer Success platforms, and the broader GTM ecosystem.

Automation, AI & Innovation

  • Identify, design, and implement opportunities to automate repetitive GTM workflows across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Revenue Operations.
  • Build scalable workflow automation using native platform capabilities, APIs, webhooks, and tools such as n8n, Zapier, or similar technologies.
  • Evaluate and implement practical AI-powered solutions that improve GTM productivity, research, data quality, prioritization, customer insights, or operational efficiency.
  • Build and experiment with AI-enabled workflows and agents where they can deliver measurable business value.
  • Stay current on emerging GTM and AI technologies and proactively recommend opportunities to improve how our revenue organization operates.

Systems Governance & Operational Excellence

  • Own system health, integrations, permissions, release management, documentation, and technical governance across the GTM technology ecosystem.
  • Establish monitoring and controls to proactively identify integration failures, data issues, workflow errors, and system risks.
  • Maintain clear documentation of architecture, integrations, workflows, business rules, and system dependencies to support scalability and business continuity.
  • Own technical initiatives end-to-end, from discovery and solution design through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing optimization.

You Must Have

  • 7+ years of experience in GTM Systems, Revenue Operations, Marketing Operations, Salesforce Administration, GTM Engineering, or a related field within B2B SaaS.
  • Advanced hands-on Salesforce administration expertise, including Flows, automation, permissions, integrations, data architecture, reporting, dashboards, and governance.
  • Advanced hands-on HubSpot administration expertise, including workflows, lifecycle management, lead scoring and routing, forms, campaigns, attribution, automation, integrations, and reporting.
  • Experience serving as a primary technical owner of Salesforce and HubSpot, including managing the integration and data flow between the two platforms.
  • Strong understanding of the end-to-end B2B SaaS GTM lifecycle across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success, with the ability to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions.
  • Strong experience with GTM data enrichment and governance, including enrichment providers, matching and mapping logic, deduplication, normalization, data quality monitoring, and CRM data management.
  • Experience designing and maintaining cross-platform integrations using APIs, webhooks, middleware, or workflow automation platforms.
  • Experience building scalable workflow automation using native GTM platforms and tools such as n8n, Zapier, Make, or similar technologies.
  • Experience administering or integrating Customer Success platforms and supporting post-sale customer data and workflows.
  • Experience applying AI and automation to GTM workflows, with an understanding of where AI can create meaningful business value and where traditional automation is the better solution.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently own business-critical GTM systems, troubleshoot complex issues, and drive technical initiatives from requirements through deployment.
  • Strong communication and partnership skills, with the ability to work effectively with Revenue Operations, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Analytics, and technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with GTM technologies such as Apollo, Clay, LeanData, ZoomInfo, 6sense, Gong, Outreach, Qualified, Clari, UserGems, Planhat, or similar platforms.
  • Experience designing signal-based GTM workflows using intent, engagement, enrichment, product, or customer data.
  • Experience building or deploying AI-powered workflows or agents within GTM systems.
  • Working knowledge of SQL, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, or similar technologies used to extend and automate GTM systems.
  • Experience supporting a scaling SaaS organization through systems transformation, technology consolidation, or process redesign.

Why You Should Join Us

  • Grow in a passionate, rapidly expanding industry operating at the forefront of the Pentesting industry
  • Work directly with experienced senior leaders with ongoing mentorship opportunities
  • Earn competitive compensation and an attractive equity plan
  • Save for the future with a 401(k) program (US) or pension (EU)
  • Benefit from medical, dental, vision and life insurance (US) or statutory healthcare (EU)
  • Leverage stipends for:
    • Wellness
    • Work-from-home equipment & wifi
    • Learning & development
  • Make the most of our flexible, generous paid time off and paid parental leave

Pay Range Disclosure (For US openings only)

Cobalt is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The salary range for this role is ($135,000 - $160,000) + equity + benefits. A candidate’s salary is determined by various factors including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, skills, and certifications. The salary range may differ in other states and may be impacted by proximity to major metropolitan cities.

Cobalt (the "Company") is an equal opportunity employer, and we want the best available persons for every job. The Company makes employment decisions only based on merit. It is the Company's policy to prohibit discrimination in any employment opportunity (including but not limited to recruitment, employment, promotion, salary increases, benefits, termination and all other terms and conditions of employment) based on race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, pregnancy, religious creed, national origin, ancestry, age, physical/mental disability, medical condition, marital/domestic partner status, military and veteran status, height, weight or any other such characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. The Company is committed to complying with all applicable laws and providing equal employment opportunities. This commitment applies to all persons involved in the operations of the Company regardless of where the employee is located and prohibits unlawful discrimination by any employee of the Company.

Cobalt is an E-Verify employer. E-Verify is an Internet-based system operated by the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) in partnership with the Social Security Administration (SSA). It allows participating employers to electronically verify the employment eligibility of their newly hired employees in the United States.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Back in 2012, we were a group of engineers and designers who decided we wanted to build things, so we did. Able started as an engineering and product hub building for a portfolio of early-stage startups. We built many relationships while developing products that were thoughtful, effective, and genuinely useful. But, since then, we’ve grown… and so has our ambition.

Now, we’re entering our next chapter, defined by applied AI. AI is a powerful force in the end-to-end software development cycle, and we’re creating practices that allow us to deliver software fast and more effectively than traditional approaches, creating meaningful value for our partners. Today, our builder mindset is driving us to become an AI-native organization across every function. We’re still evolving, and that’s part of the opportunity. If you want to build, learn, and tackle challenges alongside an ambitious team, let’s build together.

This position is 100% remote within LatAm.

About the Role

As a Technical Program Manager at Able, you'll drive the execution of AI and software programs across engineering, product, and partner teams. You'll keep work moving — owning timelines, dependencies, and communication for one or more programs — while working closely with senior TPMs and the hiring manager on the harder tradeoff calls. This is a technical role: you should be comfortable following a system design discussion, understanding the dependencies between services and teams, and asking the right questions when an estimate or integration doesn't line up. You don't need to architect the system yourself, but you do need to understand enough of how it's built to keep delivery on track and spot risk early.

You'll thrive here if you're organized, proactive, comfortable with ambiguity, and eager to grow your technical depth in a fast-moving, AI-native delivery environment.

What We’re Looking For

Day-to-Day Responsibilities

Program Execution

  • Drive one or more AI and software delivery programs through planning, execution, and launch.
  • Own program schedules, execution plans, and cross-functional alignment to ensure delivery commitments are met.
  • Maintain roadmaps, milestones, dependencies, and status; keep plans current as priorities shift.
  • Contribute to design and planning discussions — understand the technical scope well enough to track it accurately.

Engineering Coordination & Delivery

  • Coordinate work across backend, frontend, ML/AI, and data workstreams, keeping handoffs and interfaces clear.
  • Identify and escalate technical blockers, dependencies, and integration gaps before they slip the schedule.
  • Track and report program health using sprint progress, milestones, delivery metrics, risks, dependencies, and launch readiness indicators and keep them visible to the team.

Risk & Communication

  • Track risks and dependencies; flag issues early and help drive them to resolution with engineering leads.
  • Communicate clear, accurate program status to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Keep documentation, action items, and decisions organized and accessible.

Stakeholder Support

Acceleration Partners is accepting applications for an exciting new role that will sit in our Strategic Territory Growth department. Client Revenue:

Manages day-to-day communication with top publishers in program (when owning paid placements and optimization). Communication is managed independently 95% of the time.

  • Relationship management: Is able to optimize opportunities with top publishers on behalf of the client. They must view themselves as an extension of the clients business and develop long lasting relationships with these partners
  • Budget management: Can identify opportunities that will drive client growth all while maintaining a healhy return on investment

  • Growth mindset and passion to drive client’s business forward
