jobs.title: Field Intelligence Analyst (Remote, UAE)
jobs.description:
About Sayari:

Sayari is the judgment infrastructure for trustworthy AI in economic security and commercial risk. The Sayari Commercial World Model resolves 11.7B+ primary-source records from 250+ jurisdictions forming the ground truth of global commerce. A Judgment Ontology, encoding over a decade of investigative tradecraft, and Superconductor, an agentic orchestration platform, deliver AI that reasons like an expert analyst, shows its work, and traces every finding to its source. Trusted by U.S. Customs and Border Protection, HM Revenue & Customs, and Fortune 500 enterprises, Sayari is used by thousands of professionals across 35+ countries to secure supply chains and dismantle illicit networks. Headquartered in Washington, D.C., with offices in London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Tel Aviv.

About the Role

Sayari’s customers buy answers to hard problems: who really owns a supplier, where a sanctioned network is moving goods, which alerts deserve an analyst’s time. Sayari’s AI platform Superconductor delivers those answers at machine scale. It is built in the field, with analysts and engineers working alongside customers to define what it needs to do.

The Field Intelligence Analyst brings Sayari’s tradecraft to that work. You scope the problem, design the solution, prove its value, and deliver mission impact. You own the analytical relationship for a portfolio of accounts, from first conversation through sustained delivery. What you learn on live engagements flows back into Superconductor and into Sayari’s tradecraft standard.

You work in our Field Intelligence Department, a global team of analysts deployed to support government agencies and Fortune 500 companies. You sit in the same org as Forward Deployed Engineers and the Product team. The field shapes the roadmap, and Product sets it.

Why This Role Exists

  • Customers buy answers. Superconductor reasons like an expert analyst at machine scale. The analyst’s job shifts from producing every answer by hand to directing, validating, and extending what Superconductor produces, and teaching customer analysts to do the same.
  • Context should survive the contract. The analyst who designed the proof-of-value knows why the success criteria are what they are. Keeping that analyst on the account protects delivery quality and surfaces the next problem before the customer names it.
  • Tradecraft is built in the field. Field Intelligence Analysts see what was promised, what was delivered, and what the customer did with it. That full view produces better methodology, better evals, and a better Superconductor than any single-phase role can.

What You Will Do

Own the analytical relationship, end to end

  • Run discovery and proof-of-value engagements anchored on work the customer already pays people to do, such as alert adjudication, due diligence, investigations, and case prioritization. Define success criteria you will personally be accountable for delivering.
  • Stay on the account after close and deliver the work you scoped. This includes multi-hop investigations across ownership, trade, and corporate records, plus analytical briefings and training.
  • Serve as the customer’s single analytical point of contact from first conversation through renewal.

Build with Field Engineering and Product

  • Pair with FDEs on discovery and delivery. You define the analytical requirement, they build it, and you validate it against the mission.
  • When something built for one customer should be rebuilt for many, make the case to Product with evidence: the problem, the workaround, and the customers who share it.
  • Document where the platform falls short of the mission, with raw examples attached.

Deliver analyst-plus-AI, and teach it

  • Direct Superconductor against live mission problems. Validate its reasoning against expert standards, and extend it into new customer workflows.
  • Train and certify customer analysts on Sayari methods and on working with Superconductor. Identify the customer experts who should go further.

Build the tradecraft

  • Capture the judgment calls, non-obvious pivots, and creative approaches from live engagements. Contribute them to the Tradecraft team as expert-annotated reference cases, eval scenarios, and training material.
  • Hold your work to the Field Intelligence standard, and help raise it.

Support Go-To-Market Teams

  • Work with Sales to diagnose customer problems, scope solutions, and deliver mission impact.

Who You Are

Required

  • A builder’s temperament and comfort with ambiguity. You do well on small teams with end-to-end ownership and no defined lane, working next to engineers on things that don’t exist yet.
  • Experience conducting complex, multi-source investigations in one or more of these areas: financial crime, sanctions and export controls, supply chain and forced labor risk, transnational criminal organizations, or law enforcement and intelligence investigations. This should include work with corporate records, trade data, and OSINT.
  • Customer-facing range. You have scoped engagements, demonstrated capability to skeptical experts, and delivered under a statement of work. Candidates often come from solutions consulting, services delivery, embedded analytics, or mission-support roles.
  • Hands-on fluency directing and evaluating AI and agentic analytical tools. You can define what “right” looks like precisely enough to test against.
  • Clear communication with analysts, program managers, engineers, and executives.

Desired

  • Python or SQL for data manipulation, and familiarity with REST APIs.
  • Experience designing training curricula or certifying analysts.
  • For government portfolios: an active Government security clearance and same citizenship as your country of residence.

Sayari is an equal opportunity employer and strongly encourages diverse candidates to apply. We believe diversity and inclusion mean our team members should reflect the diversity of the United States. No employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on race, color, ethnicity, religion, age, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability status, veteran status, genetics, or political affiliation. We strongly encourage applicants of all backgrounds to apply.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive, Belgium
jobs.description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organisations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organisations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs.

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

What You’ll Do

The Enterprise Account Executive, Benelux is a key role responsible for driving sales growth and expanding the customer base in the cybersecurity technology sector. The focus is on acquiring new accounts, building strong customer relationships, and ensuring customer satisfaction and retention. The successful candidate will have a proven track record in selling cybersecurity technologies, introducing disruptive cyber software solutions, and exceeding sales quotas consistently. They will also be adept at establishing and nurturing Channel Partner relationships, with pre-existing connections with key resellers in the region being a crucial requirement.

  • Sales Experience: Minimum of 5 years of successful sales experience in the cybersecurity technology industry, with a strong track record of achieving sales growth

  • Introduction of New Solutions: Demonstrated success in introducing and selling new disruptive cyber software solutions

  • Quota Achievement: Proven ability to exceed sales quotas consistently quarter over quarter.

  • Channel Partner Management: Experience in establishing and monetizing strong Channel Partner relationships, with existing relationships in the region being essential.

  • Sales Process Management: Proficiency in managing all aspects of the sales process, including qualification, proof of value, forecasting, negotiation, and deal closure.

  • Post-Sales Management: Ability to manage and drive the post-proof of value ROI process.

  • CRM and Pipeline Management: Experience in accurately tracking and managing customer information in company-provided CRM, and maintaining an accurate pipeline and forecasting in Salesforce (SFDC).

  • Product Presentation and Demo: Capability to present and demonstrate Horizon3AI solutions effectively in both virtual and in-person meetings.

  • Independent and Team Player: Demonstrated ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively with distributed sales, support, and success teams.

What You’ll Bring

  • Industry Experience: Minimum of 3 years of experience working in the INFOSEC or SaaS space

  • Education: A college degree or equivalent work experience required

  • Native level fluency in Dutch and/or French with excellent English communication skills

Travel Required

We are a fully remote company, and this job may require up to 60% of travel within the Benelux region. Job-related travel expenses are reviewed and must be approved by your manager.

Perks of Horizon3

  • Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

  • Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

  • Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.

Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

  • Additional compensation: This role is also eligible for an equity package (in the form of stock options). If any other compensation benefits apply, they will be discussed during the interview process.

You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3.ai, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3.ai, where your unique contributions are recognised, and your potential is limitless.

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

jobs.title: Senior Revenue Forecasting & Operations Business Partner
jobs.description:
Caylent is an AI-first cloud services company that helps organizations turn ambitious ideas into meaningful business impact. As an AWS Premier Tier Services Partner and a charter member of Anthropic’s Claude Partner Network, we combine deep expertise in AWS, artificial intelligence, and Anthropic’s Claude platform to help customers modernize their technology, build intelligent products, and move AI from experimentation into production.

Our capabilities span generative and agentic AI, cloud migration and modernization, cloud-native application development, data and analytics, DevOps, managed services, security and compliance, and customer experience transformation. At Caylent, our people always come first.

We are a fully remote global company with employees in Canada, the United States and Latin America. We celebrate the culture of each of our team members and foster a community of technological curiosity. Come talk to us to learn more about what it means to be a Caylien!

The Mission

We are seeking a Senior Revenue Forecasting & Operations Business Partner to own Caylent’s revenue forecast and the operational data that feeds it, and to act as the finance partner to our Sales and Delivery leadership. Reporting to the Director of Finance, you will turn signed SOWs, staffing plans, and billing schedules into a forecast leadership can rely on, and explain the variance when actuals land.

This is a hands-on role with high visibility to the CFO and the executive team. You will work daily with senior leaders across Sales, Delivery, Resource Management, and Accounting, challenging assumptions, influencing decisions, and translating financial trade-offs into clear recommendations they can act on. As we grow, you will also help integrate acquired entities into our forecasting, reporting, and systems.

Your Assignment

Revenue Forecasting and Finance Business Partner

  • Own the monthly and quarterly revenue forecast across all entities (US, Canada, Brazil, Argentina, Mexico) and subsidiaries, and maintain a rolling 12-month forecast that supports the annual budget and reforecast cycles.
  • Build the forecast bottom-up from signed SOWs, change orders, staffing plans, and billing schedules, and reconcile it top-down to the Salesforce pipeline and bookings.
  • Forecast by revenue type: time and materials, fixed fee, managed services, and AWS-funded engagements.
  • Model backlog burn, utilization, and bench impact on revenue, and flag engagements at risk of under-delivery or overrun.
  • Deliver a monthly forecast vs. actuals package with variance explained by engagement, practice, and entity.

Business Partnering

  • Act as the trusted finance partner to Sales, Delivery, and Resource Management leaders, joining their forecast, pipeline, and staffing reviews on a recurring basis.
  • Partner on deal and SOW structuring (pricing, fee model, AWS funding) before signature, not only after.
  • Challenge assumptions (pipeline conversion, utilization, staffing, deal structure) with data, and influence decisions.
  • Translate financial trade-offs (margin, cash, risk) into clear recommendations for senior, non-finance stakeholders.

Systems, Data & Reporting

  • Be the Finance owner of revenue data across Salesforce, the PSA or time tracking system, and the ERP; define the fields and controls that keep them in sync.
  • Build and maintain forecast models and dashboards with full traceability from reported numbers back to source records.
  • Automate recurring reporting where practical (Google Sheets, Apps Script, SQL, BI tooling, or AI tools).
  • Document revenue operations processes and controls to support audit and month-end close.

What Success Looks Like

  • First 30 days: Understand the forecast end to end and map every active engagement to its fee structure, billing schedule, funding terms, and staffing plan.
  • First 90 days: Own the monthly forecast and deliver the first forecast vs. actuals package with variance explained by engagement; establish regular cadences with Sales and Delivery leadership and become their go-to finance partner for forecast and deal questions.
  • First 6 months: Forecast accuracy within 5% of actuals at the company level and within 10% by offering; forecast reviews with Sales and Delivery leaders run on a regular cadence.
  • First year: Forecast model and dashboards are the single source of truth for revenue; recurring reporting is automated; Sales and Delivery leaders rely on Finance’s view in their own planning decisions.

Your Qualifications

  • 5+ years in FP&A, revenue operations, or revenue accounting, with at least 2 years in professional services or consulting.
  • Proven track record as a finance business partner to senior commercial and operational leaders.
  • Hands-on experience forecasting project-based revenue: time and materials, fixed fee, and milestone engagements
  • Experience in Salesforce and at least one PSA or time tracking system
  • Advanced Google Sheets or Excel modeling; comfortable building models others will audit
  • Clear written and verbal communication; executive presence with senior stakeholders; able to explain a variance in a few sentences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience at an AWS or cloud consulting partner, including AWS funding programs
  • Exposure to M&A, including integration of acquired entities into forecasting, reporting, and systems.
  • Working knowledge of ASC 606 for services revenue, including percentage-of-completion and deferred and unbilled revenue.
  • SQL, Apps Script, or Python for reporting automation
  • Experience with multi-entity and multi-currency reporting

jobs.title: Lead DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
Lead DevOps Engineer

As a Lead DevOps Engineer at Particle41, you will own the DevOps strategy and the design, automation, and operation of the cloud infrastructure that powers our clients’ most complex digital projects. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will champion DevOps culture and practices, set the standards other teams build on, and ensure the delivery of innovative and high-quality projects. Your role will also involve mentoring and coaching team members, fostering a culture of collaboration, automation, and continuous learning.

In This Role, You Will:

Strategy & Practice Ownership

  • Own the DevOps technical roadmap and vision, in collaboration with architects and stakeholders, and align it with business goals.
  • Define the "golden path": reference architectures, reusable IaC modules, pipeline templates, and standards that teams across projects adopt.
  • Be accountable for platform reliability, security posture, and delivery velocity outcomes across the engagements you lead; measured through SLOs, not just activities performed.
  • Represent the DevOps practice with clients: participate in discovery and pre-sales conversations, estimate and scope infrastructure workstreams, and advise client leadership on cloud and platform decisions.
  • Contribute to growing the practice interview and assess DevOps candidates, and help shape team structure and capability development.

Infrastructure & Platform Engineering

  • Lead the design and implementation of cloud infrastructure across AWS, Azure, and GCP using infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or Pulumi.
  • Architect and operate container platforms, including Kubernetes (EKS, AKS, GKE) and managed container services, to support scalable, resilient workloads.
  • Define landing zones, account/subscription structures, and network topologies that balance security, cost, and developer velocity.
  • Evaluate and recommend platform tooling and managed services to support business requirements.

CI/CD & Automation

  • Own the CI/CD strategy and pipeline architecture (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, Jenkins) that makes releases fast, repeatable, and safe across teams.
  • Drive an automation-first culture across build, test, deployment, and environment provisioning — setting the standard for eliminating manual toil, and staying hands-on where it matters most.
  • Establish GitOps workflows (e.g., ArgoCD, Flux) for declarative, auditable deployments.

Reliability & Observability

  • Define the observability strategy - monitoring, logging, and tracing (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, CloudWatch, OpenTelemetry) and drive its adoption across teams.

Strong SQL on Oracle, SQL Server, or DB2 / IBM i (AS400).
Data engineering experience: ETL/ELT development, pipeline design, and data modeling.
At least one full-cycle ERP implementation, upgrade, or migration where you owned data conversion or data migration work.
Working knowledge of core JDE modules: Financials, Distribution / Logistics, and Manufacturing.

Clear, confident written and spoken English. Comfortable working directly with client stakeholders.
Able to work as an independent contractor.

Nice to Have
JDE technical tools: Orchestrator, Business Services (BSSV), UBEs / Report Design Aid, Table Conversion, and Form Design Aid.
Cloud data platforms: Snowflake, Azure Data Factory, Databricks, AWS (Glue, Redshift), or dbt.
BI tools: Power BI, Tableau, or OBIEE.
Python for data processing and automation.
Industry background in manufacturing, distribution, or automotive aftermarket.
Oracle JD Edwards certification.
Prior consulting or staff augmentation experience.

As a Finance & Strategy Manager at Hopper, you will be a finance partner to business leaders across the company, helping them understand performance, evaluate opportunities and make better decisions. You will build the models behind our forecasts, partnerships and strategic plans, lead business reviews, and turn analysis into clear recommendations for senior leadership and the CFO.

This role is a great fit for someone who has built rigorous models under pressure in investment banking or private equity and now wants to apply those skills in-house, closer to the decisions. We are a lean team that moves fast, and we use SQL and AI tools like Claude to automate the manual work so we can spend our time on analysis and strategy.

What would your day-to-day look like

  • Build and maintain integrated financial models, scenario and sensitivity analyses, and business cases for new products, partnerships and investments

  • Evaluate the economics of new commercial agreements (pricing, revenue share, unit economics, ROI) and help shape deal terms with business leaders

  • Support fundraising, M&A and capital allocation decisions, including the models and analysis behind them

  • Own the monthly and quarterly forecast for the areas you support, and contribute to the annual budget and long-range plan by building the driver-based models and inputs that connect operational metrics to P&L outcomes

  • Lead monthly and quarterly reviews of actuals vs. plan and forecast, explain variances, and flag risks and opportunities to business leaders

  • Partner with leadership on high-impact questions such as market sizing, investment prioritization and cost optimization

  • Prepare clear, executive-, board- and investor-ready materials that tell the story behind the numbers

jobs.title: Applications Engineering Manager (West Coast)
jobs.description:
About Standard Bots

Standard Bots is building the next generation of industrial robots -- hardware that's powerful, affordable, and designed to scale. We're the largest U.S. industrial robotics company by robots shipped, and our robots are showing up on factory floors everywhere from independent machine shops to NASA and Lockheed Martin. Someone has to make sure those robots actually work -- and someone has to build the team that makes that happen at scale. That's this role.

Note: This position is technically remote, but is territory based and requires you to live on the West Coast. This role also requires up to 25% domestic travel. You're still in the field -- just not living out of a suitcase 2-3 days a week.

Also note: Like every Applications Engineer at Standard Bots, this is not a software engineering role. You are a hands-on industrial automation engineer who also happens to lead people. If you've never commissioned a robotic cell, this isn't the right seat.

The Role

The Applications Engineering Manager is a player-coach. You still know your way around a factory floor -- fixtures, I/O, ladder logic, robot programming, all the things -- and you use that expertise every day, both to stay sharp and to earn the respect of the team you're leading.

You'll manage a team of Applications Engineers across your territory, owning their development, their workload, and the quality of every customer engagement they touch. You'll be the escalation point when installs get complicated, the person who jumps on a plane when a customer situation needs senior eyes, and the one who sets the standard for what great applications engineering looks like at Standard Bots.

This is still a hands-on role. You're not managing from a desk. You're leading from the front.

You'll report directly to the VP of Applications Engineering.

What You'll Do

Team Leadership & Development

- Manage and develop a team of Applications Engineers across your territory -- setting expectations, coaching on technical and customer-facing skills, and building a team that executes at a high level

- Own capacity planning and workload distribution across your team -- making sure the right engineer is on the right job and nobody is drowning

- Be the technical and cultural standard-setter for your team; the bar you hold yourself to is the bar your team rises to

- Conduct regular 1:1s, performance conversations, and development planning -- you invest in your people's growth, not just their output

Territory & Customer Ownership

- Own the applications engineering function for your territory -- from pre-sales POC support through post-install customer success

- Serve as the senior technical escalation point for complex integrations, difficult customer situations, or installs that aren't going as planned

- Partner closely with your Regional Sales Manager on territory priorities, pipeline, and customer strategy -- you're the technical counterpart to their commercial leadership

- Maintain strong relationships with key customer accounts in your territory; they should know you by name and trust your judgment

Hands-On Technical Work

- Stay sharp and stay in it -- you're still designing solutions, reviewing integrations, commissioning cells, and supporting installs when the situation calls for it

- Lead or co-lead technically complex or strategically important customer engagements yourself

- Review and sign off on solution designs, POCs, and integration plans produced by your team

- Travel to customer sites as needed -- up to 25% domestically -- for escalations, key installs, and customer relationship moments

Standards & Continuous Improvement

- Define and enforce the standard for how applications engineering work gets done in your territory -- documentation, handoffs, commissioning checklists, customer training quality

- Feed territory-level learnings back to the broader applications engineering organization and to product and engineering teams

- Help build the playbooks, templates, and training materials that make every AE on your team better and every deployment more repeatable

What We're Looking For

- The same trifecta as our Applications Engineers -- you're genuinely fluent across mechanical, electrical, and software: PLC programming and ladder logic, pneumatics, DC power systems, robot programming, Python scripting, CAD

- 5+ years of hands-on applications engineering, systems integration, or automation engineering experience -- you've done the field work and done it well

- 2+ years of people management or team lead experience -- you've led engineers, given hard feedback, and helped someone grow

- Strong customer-facing presence -- you can manage a difficult customer conversation, set expectations clearly, and represent Standard Bots credibly at a senior level

- Experience managing a distributed team or territory; you know how to lead people you don't see every day

- Comfort with up to 25% domestic travel for escalations, key customer engagements, and team support

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics, or a related engineering discipline -- or equivalent hands-on experience that tells the same story

Nice to Have

- Prior experience with collaborative robots (UR, Fanuc, KUKA, ABB, or similar)

- Background scaling an applications engineering or field engineering function -- you've helped build something, not just inherited it

- Experience with vision systems, force/torque sensing, or custom end-of-arm tooling

- Familiarity with machine tending, palletizing, welding, or assembly automation applications

Compensation and Benefits

The salary range for this role is $140,000 to $200,000, depending on experience. We are open to a variety of seniority levels for this role and will build compensation packages that are commensurate with seniority and skill level. Base salary is just one part of the overall compensation at Standard Bots. All Full-Time Employees are eligible for Employee Stock Options. We also offer a package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance, life insurance, disability insurance, and 401(k) to regular full-time employees.

jobs.title: Senior Applications Engineer (West Coast)
jobs.description:
About Standard Bots

Standard Bots is building the next generation of industrial robots -- hardware that's powerful, affordable, and designed to scale. We're the largest U.S. industrial robotics company by robots shipped, and our robots are showing up on factory floors everywhere from independent machine shops to NASA and Lockheed Martin.

Note: This role is technically remote, but you must live on the west coast (preference for California). This job is customer-facing and requires up to 50% domestic travel, Monday through Friday. If that makes you nervous, this probably isn't the right fit. If that sounds like a perk, read on.

Also note: This is not a software engineering role. If you're looking for a job where you sit at a desk and write application code, this is the wrong job description. If you want to actually build things, wire things up, and watch them run -- keep reading.

The Role

The Senior Applications Engineer is one of the rarest profiles in industrial automation -- and one of the most important roles at Standard Bots.

You're not a mechanical engineer. You're not an electrical engineer. You're not a software engineer. You're all three, and you know how to make them talk to each other. You can look at a customer's production line, understand what's broken or slow or manual, and figure out how to fix it with a robot. Then you build the proof of concept, get on a plane, and go install it.

From pre to post sale, you're the one working closely with the sales team to make the solution real. You'll build the proof of concept, design the integration, write the python scripts, build the fixture, run the wiring, and commission the cell -- then train the customer's team on how to use it. You'll also help run demos at trade shows, support trainings at customer sites and in our shop, and be the technical backbone for every customer engagement that requires hands-on expertise.

This is a builder's role. Tinkerers welcome. People who get bored at a desk are strongly encouraged to apply.

What You'll Do

Solution Design & Proof of Concept

- Work with the sales team and customers to understand automation goals, production constraints, and integration requirements

- Design practical, buildable solutions around Standard Bots' hardware -- and build the proof of concept yourself to validate it works before anyone signs anything

- Develop application notes, sample code, and supporting documentation that help customers and internal teams understand how to replicate and scale solutions

Field Installation & Integration

- Travel to customer sites to install, program, wire, and commission robotic cells

- Own the integration from mechanical setup through software configuration -- fixtures, I/O, PLC handshakes, safety, test, sign-off

- Troubleshoot on-site when things don't go as planned (and sometimes they don't) -- you stay until it works

Customer Training & Support

- Train customer operators and technicians on Standard Bots hardware and software -- both on-site and at our facility

- Support customers post-install as they find new applications and push the limits of what the robot can do

- Be a trusted technical resource for the accounts you've worked with -- they'll call you when something comes up

Trade Shows & Demos

- Represent Standard Bots at industry events and trade shows -- build the demo, run it live, talk shop with engineers and plant managers on the floor

- Help develop and maintain demo systems that show the breadth of what Standard Bots hardware can do

Internal Collaboration

- Feed real-world integration learnings back to our hardware and software engineering teams -- you're on the front lines and your input shapes the product

- Assist in-house engineering with testing new features, peripherals, and integrations as we expand the platform

What We're Looking For

- A genuine trifecta: you're comfortable with mechanical systems, electrical systems, and software -- not just one of the three

- 6+ years of hands-on experience with industrial automation fundamentals: PLC programming and ladder logic, pneumatics, DC power systems (you know the difference between NPN and PNP), robot programming (any platform), and Python scripting

- Proficiency with CAD -- SolidWorks preferred, but we care more that you can design and think in 3D than which tool you use

- Customer-facing experience -- you can explain a technical integration to an engineer, a plant manager, and an ops director in the same conversation and land differently with each one

- A genuine bias for getting things done in the field, not just in theory -- you'd rather build it than write about it

- Comfort with up to 50% domestic travel; this role is hands-on and on-site by nature

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics, or a related engineering discipline -- or equivalent hands-on experience that tells the same story

Nice to Have

- Prior experience with collaborative robots (UR, Fanuc, KUKA, ABB, or similar)

- Familiarity with machine tending, palletizing, welding, or assembly automation applications

- Experience with vision systems, force/torque sensing, or custom end-of-arm tooling

- Background in a manufacturing or production environment -- you've worked on or near a factory floor before

Compensation and Benefits

The salary range for this role is $150,000 to $200,000, depending on experience. We are open to a variety of seniority levels for this role and will build compensation packages that are commensurate with seniority and skill level. Base salary is just one part of the overall compensation at Standard Bots. All Full-Time Employees are eligible for Employee Stock Options. We also offer a package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance, life insurance, disability insurance, and 401(k) to regular full-time employees.

The AutoFi platform enables a more transactional buying experience with $4B in funded loans processed through AutoFi annually. AutoFi’s dynamic selling platform empowers dealers to sell vehicles more efficiently and profitably, both online and in the showroom. If changing a trillion-dollar industry sounds exciting, we’d love to hear from you.

For more information, visit www.autofi.com.

About the Role
Reporting to the Manager, Partner Support Services, the Dealer Partner Support Specialist is responsible for supporting the ongoing operational health, configuration, and functionality of AutoFi's products and services for our Dealership and Dealer Group partners. Acting as a key point of contact and subject matter expert following implementation, this role responds to partner inquiries, manages program adjustments, troubleshoots issues, and works collaboratively with internal teams and external vendors to ensure programs function as intended and continue to meet evolving business needs.

Partner Support Services plays a key role in operating as the first line of support for all of AutoFi’s clientele. They monitor expected program functionality, proactively taking steps to resolve potential gaps and capitalize on enhancement opportunities.

An ideal candidate will be a detail-oriented, resourceful problem solver who combines strong customer service skills with technical aptitude and a commitment to accuracy. They will be comfortable managing competing priorities, investigating issues independently, and communicating effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders in a fast paced environment. Success in this role requires accountability, sound judgement, adaptability and a proactive approach to maintaining program health and delivering an exceptional partner experience. This position includes occasional scheduled evening and weekend support coverage to accommodate Dealerships operating hours. Whether you’re balancing location needs, family priorities, or a new phase of life, Centria’s virtual model gives you the support and tools to stay connected, effective, and fulfilled in your role.

What Centria Offers:

Your Role & Impact as a BCBA

At Centria, you’re not just a BCBA - you’re a clinical leader, a mentor, and a changemaker. If you’re ready to grow your career without sacrificing your values, apply today and join a team that invests in your clinical excellence!

jobs.title: Applications Engineering Manager (Boston)
jobs.description:
About Standard Bots

Standard Bots is building the next generation of industrial robots -- hardware that's powerful, affordable, and designed to scale. We're the largest U.S. industrial robotics company by robots shipped, and our robots are showing up on factory floors everywhere from independent machine shops to NASA and Lockheed Martin. Someone has to make sure those robots actually work -- and someone has to build the team that makes that happen at scale. That's this role.

Note: This role requires up to 25% domestic travel. You're still in the field -- just not living out of a suitcase 2-3 days a week.

Also note: Like every Applications Engineer at Standard Bots, this is not a software engineering role. You are a hands-on industrial automation engineer who also happens to lead people. If you've never commissioned a robotic cell, this isn't the right seat.

The Role

The Applications Engineering Manager is a player-coach. You still know your way around a factory floor -- fixtures, I/O, ladder logic, robot programming, all the things -- and you use that expertise every day, both to stay sharp and to earn the respect of the team you're leading.

You'll manage a team of Applications Engineers across your territory, owning their development, their workload, and the quality of every customer engagement they touch. You'll be the escalation point when installs get complicated, the person who jumps on a plane when a customer situation needs senior eyes, and the one who sets the standard for what great applications engineering looks like at Standard Bots.

This is still a hands-on role. You're not managing from a desk. You're leading from the front.

You'll report directly to the VP of Applications Engineering.

What You'll Do

Team Leadership & Development

- Manage and develop a team of Applications Engineers across your territory -- setting expectations, coaching on technical and customer-facing skills, and building a team that executes at a high level

- Own capacity planning and workload distribution across your team -- making sure the right engineer is on the right job and nobody is drowning

- Be the technical and cultural standard-setter for your team; the bar you hold yourself to is the bar your team rises to

- Conduct regular 1:1s, performance conversations, and development planning -- you invest in your people's growth, not just their output

Territory & Customer Ownership

- Own the applications engineering function for your territory -- from pre-sales POC support through post-install customer success

- Serve as the senior technical escalation point for complex integrations, difficult customer situations, or installs that aren't going as planned

- Partner closely with your Regional Sales Manager on territory priorities, pipeline, and customer strategy -- you're the technical counterpart to their commercial leadership

- Maintain strong relationships with key customer accounts in your territory; they should know you by name and trust your judgment

Hands-On Technical Work

- Stay sharp and stay in it -- you're still designing solutions, reviewing integrations, commissioning cells, and supporting installs when the situation calls for it

- Lead or co-lead technically complex or strategically important customer engagements yourself

- Review and sign off on solution designs, POCs, and integration plans produced by your team

- Travel to customer sites as needed -- up to 25% domestically -- for escalations, key installs, and customer relationship moments

Standards & Continuous Improvement

- Define and enforce the standard for how applications engineering work gets done in your territory -- documentation, handoffs, commissioning checklists, customer training quality

- Feed territory-level learnings back to the broader applications engineering organization and to product and engineering teams

- Help build the playbooks, templates, and training materials that make every AE on your team better and every deployment more repeatable

What We're Looking For

- The same trifecta as our Applications Engineers -- you're genuinely fluent across mechanical, electrical, and software: PLC programming and ladder logic, pneumatics, DC power systems, robot programming, Python scripting, CAD

- 5+ years of hands-on applications engineering, systems integration, or automation engineering experience -- you've done the field work and done it well

- 2+ years of people management or team lead experience -- you've led engineers, given hard feedback, and helped someone grow

- Strong customer-facing presence -- you can manage a difficult customer conversation, set expectations clearly, and represent Standard Bots credibly at a senior level

- Experience managing a distributed team or territory; you know how to lead people you don't see every day

- Comfort with up to 25% domestic travel for escalations, key customer engagements, and team support

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics, or a related engineering discipline -- or equivalent hands-on experience that tells the same story

Nice to Have

- Prior experience with collaborative robots (UR, Fanuc, KUKA, ABB, or similar)

- Background scaling an applications engineering or field engineering function -- you've helped build something, not just inherited it

- Experience with vision systems, force/torque sensing, or custom end-of-arm tooling

- Familiarity with machine tending, palletizing, welding, or assembly automation applications

Compensation and Benefits

The salary range for this role is $140,000 to $180,000, depending on experience. We are open to a variety of seniority levels for this role and will build compensation packages that are commensurate with seniority and skill level. Base salary is just one part of the overall compensation at Standard Bots. All Full-Time Employees are eligible for Employee Stock Options. We also offer a package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance, life insurance, disability insurance, and 401(k) to regular full-time employees.

jobs.title: Senior Consultant
jobs.description:
Managing pricing and rebates shouldn’t be a hassle. Enable’s intelligent platform is built for the speed of today’s market, eliminating disconnects between pricing strategy and rebate execution. We help companies to increase profitability and simplify the complex with accurate, AI-powered insights, real-time performance monitoring, agreement optimization, and simplified rebate management.

After securing $291M in Series A-D funding and acquiring Flintfox in 2025, Enable is positioned for continued, significant growth. Since the launch of our flagship product in 2016, we have been rapidly scaling our client base, product offerings, and built a team of top-tier professionals committed to reshaping the industry.

Want a glimpse into life at Enable? Visit our Life at Enable page to learn how you can be part of our journey.

Job Summary

The position is responsible for the Implementation of Enable’s products within a chosen domain of expertise, both at the individual product and solution level across multiple customer’s environments. This requires continuously refreshed, advanced level technical knowledge within chosen technical domains, working effectively as part of multi-functional project teams. You will lead the implementation, onboarding and adoption of customers, including discovery, design, configuration, testing, validation and go live phases.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Meets or exceeds customer expectations by implementing products that address the client’s business requirements within the ‘Scope of Work’ (SOW) agreed by Enable and the customer.
  • Able to effectively troubleshoot technical implementation issues interacting with Enable support teams to manage product issues where necessary.
  • Actively serves as member of the Enable project team, often as a technical lead, contributing product and solution expertise to deliver customer value
  • Contributes to building the knowledge base within Enable technical practices and communities including lessons learned, best practices, tools, methods and learning events.
  • Serve as a coach to associate level consultants who are actively engaged as part of the project team on assigned client engagements.
  • Identifies customer training gaps and opportunities for Enable product or service expansion and enhancement.
  • Proactively manages issues, escalations and anticpates project risks
  • Acts as a go-to expert for challengine questions across various subject areas
  • Build strong, positive working relationships with both internal and external stakeholders.
  • Mentoring and supporting team members within the Success & Services department.
  • Lead productive customer meetings and workshops, resolving complex support tasks, and triaging incoming customer requests independently.
  • Adheres to all company policies, including but not limited to time and expenses, code of conduct, ethics, security and any required training available.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities (KSAs)

  • Demonstrates ability to implement Enable software technology within customer environments at a complex level for the individual products of chosen domain expertise.
  • Proven and advanced level comprehension of product capabilities and how solution design can be integrated into the customer environment.
  • Proven ability to build strong relationships with customers, communicating effectively and ensure technical project delivery
  • Possess advanced technology troubleshooting skills for products of chosen expertise and basic technology troubleshooting capabilities, escalating where necessary.
  • Consistently achieves role KPI’s balancing billable time with self-development plans to ensure skills are constantly updated and in demand.
  • Ability to effectively time manage and manage multiple customer engagements concurrently
  • Acts as a role model for co-workers and customers by clearly communicating project status udates, risks, successes and next stages of projects
  • Experienced in change management, to facilitate smooth customer transitions from legacy systems to Enable.
  • Continually strives to build advanced skills.
  • Fulfils ethics, security and compliance training and test requirements to always protect Enable’s interests and assets.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Preferred 2+ years experience working in customer facing role in Customer Success or an enterprise software organization
  • Related Product and Industry Certifications as required (e.g. Oracle, SAP, SQL)
  • Annually maintained all granted internal and external technical and professional certifications to latest level as appropriate.
  • Experience with international cross cultural teams preferred
  • Experience handling large data sets and familiarity with tools like Python or SQL.
  • English language written and verbally fluency required, other languages preferred

Travel

  • Our roles may require some travel, with a typical average being in the region of up to 20%. Very infrequently, however, some customers at some specific stages of their projects may request a higher percentage of travel, sometimes up to 50% or more.

Compensation

Additional Information

Total Rewards:

At Enable, we’re committed to your professional development and growth. Starting pay is determined by factors like location, skills, experience, market conditions, and internal parity.

Salary/TCC is just one component of Enable’s total rewards package. Enable is committed to investing in the holistic health and wellbeing of all Enablees and their families. Our benefits and perks include, but are not limited to:

Paid Time Off: Take the time you need to relax and recharge

Comprehensive Insurance: Health and life coverage for you and your family

Retirement Plan: Build your future with our retirement savings plan

Lucrative Bonus Plan: Enjoy a rewarding bonus structure subject to company or individual performance

Equity Program: Benefit from our equity program with additional options tied to tenure and performance

Career Growth: Explore new opportunities with our internal mobility program

Additional Perks:  

Training: Access a range of workshops and courses designed to boost your professional growth and take your career to new heights 

Pets: Bring your pets to our welcoming, pet-friendly offices

According to LinkedIn's Gender Insights Report, women apply for 20% fewer jobs than men, despite similar job search behaviors. At Enable, we’re committed to closing this gap by encouraging women and underrepresented groups to apply, even if they don’t meet all qualifications.

Enable is an equal opportunity employer, fostering an inclusive, accessible workplace that values diversity. We provide fair, discrimination-free employment, ensuring a harassment-free environment with equitable treatment.

We welcome applications from all backgrounds. If you need reasonable adjustments during recruitment or in the role, please let us know.

This job posting is for a current, existing vacancy.

jobs.title: Dealer Partner Support Specialist - Level 1 (Canada)
jobs.description:
About AutoFi

AutoFi is the leading provider of digital commerce technology that powers the sales and finance experiences for the most innovative brands and dealers in automotive. The AutoFi platform enables a more transactional buying experience with $4B in funded loans processed through AutoFi annually. AutoFi’s dynamic selling platform empowers dealers to sell vehicles more efficiently and profitably, both online and in the showroom. We are funded for years of future growth and backed by investors including Crosslink Capital, Santander Holdings USA, SVB Financial Group, Ford, BMW iVentures and JP Morgan Chase.

Our team is diverse - spread out across the U.S. and Canada, we have backgrounds from finance and technology as well as deep experience in all areas of the auto space. We’re empathetic, gritty, curious, and humble owners of this business and are supported by some of the biggest names in the auto and financial industries as commercial partners. We’ve never been more excited about the opportunity in front of us to help transition the auto industry from offline to online. If changing a trillion-dollar industry sounds exciting, we’d love to hear from you.

For more information, visit www.autofi.com.

About the Role
Reporting to the Manager, Partner Support Services, the Dealer Partner Support Specialist is responsible for supporting the ongoing operational health, configuration, and functionality of AutoFi's products and services for our Dealership and Dealer Group partners. Acting as a key point of contact and subject matter expert following implementation, this role responds to partner inquiries, manages program adjustments, troubleshoots issues, and works collaboratively with internal teams and external vendors to ensure programs function as intended and continue to meet evolving business needs.

Partner Support Services plays a key role in operating as the first line of support for all of AutoFi’s clientele. They triage and prioritize all incoming requests, resolve general inquiries, make program settings adjustments, work with vendors to align on integrated functionality, and ensure Clients/Partners are able to connect with the appropriate resources. They monitor expected program functionality, proactively taking steps to resolve potential gaps and capitalize on enhancement opportunities.

An ideal candidate will be a detail-oriented, resourceful problem solver who combines strong customer service skills with technical aptitude and a commitment to accuracy. They will be comfortable managing competing priorities, investigating issues independently, and communicating effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders in a fast paced environment. Success in this role requires accountability, sound judgement, adaptability and a proactive approach to maintaining program health and delivering an exceptional partner experience. This position includes occasional scheduled evening and weekend support coverage to accommodate Dealerships operating hours. Each member of our team is challenged to contribute in a variety of capacities across the entire organization and show their individual strengths, from product to customer experience.

Responsibilities

  • Participate in and contribute to a collaborative, accountable team environment with a culture of open communication through knowledge sharing, constructive feedback, and a willingness to support shared priorities.
  • Develop and maintain proficiency in AutoFi's product suite, integration capabilities, and Dealer Partner use cases, providing informed recommendations to optimize program configurations and functionality.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for Dealer Partners, responding to inquiries, resolving issues, and managing requests professionally and efficiently in accordance with expected service levels.
  • Maintain and optimize Dealer Partner program settings, configurations, features, and integrations, including working with JSON, XML, CSS, and Regex as needed.
  • Independently validate completed work to ensure configuration changes are accurate, complete, and functioning as intended before considering requests resolved.
  • Perform initial troubleshooting of configuration, integration, and functional issues as needed to identify root causes, resolve common problems, and escalate more complex issues with appropriate supporting details.
  • Collaborate with Account Management, Product, Engineering, and other internal teams, as well as external vendors, to coordinate solutions and support evolving Dealer Partner needs.
  • Proactively monitor Dealer Partner programs to identify functional anomalies, configuration gaps, and opportunities to improve program performance and reliability.
  • Manage a concurrent workload of approximately 20-30 assigned requests through to resolution against expected SLAs, effectively balancing competing priorities, maintaining accurate case documentation, clear stakeholder communication, and timely follow-up through phone, email and text, leveraging specific internal and vendor communications platforms where applicable.
  • Identify recurring issues and opportunities to improve support processes, contributing to the development of standardized procedures, documentation, and best practices, inclusive of the nuances, pros and cons of various approaches.
  • Support first-line inquiries across AutoFi's broader Partner ecosystem as needed through phone, chat and email, leveraging available tools, including AI-assisted solutions, to improve efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Participate in scheduled after-hours support coverage, including a minimum of one Saturday per month.

Qualifications

  • 2-3 years experience working in customer support, technical support, account management or a related customer-facing role, preferably within the SaaS environment.
  • Strong attention to detail, with a demonstrated ability to accurately execute, validate and document work
    Analytical and critical thinking skills, including the ability to independently investigate issues, troubleshoot basic technical problems, and determine when escalation is appropriate.
  • Excellent written/verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and navigate challenging customer interactions
  • Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize competing requests and meet established service expectations
  • Technical aptitude and comfort working with software configurations, system settings, integrated applications and AI Agents
  • A proactive, accountable approach to problem-solving, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively across teams
  • Flexibility to participate in scheduled evening and weekend coverage including a minimum of one Saturday per month
  • Familiarity with automotive dealership operations, business models, and personnel responsibilities strongly preferred.
  • Working knowledge of APIs, JSON, XML, HTML, CSS, and Regex strongly preferred
  • Experience using Salesforce, Jira, Postman, or similar CRM, case management, and API troubleshooting tools preferred.
  • Experience using AI-assisted tools to improve productivity, troubleshooting, or customer support workflows preferred.

Compensation

+ 2,000 CAD performance bonus annually

Additional Information

What's in it for you:

- We offer full training and a competitive total rewards package along with great benefits

- Medical, Dental & Vision coverage - 100% premium coverage for employee / 50+% for dependents

- Flexible work hours

- Remote environment

- Competitive pay

- Visionary leadership team

- Growth opportunities within a dynamic culture

- Wellness & cultural initiatives (fitness challenges, wellness webinars, virtual games, regional activities, etc.)

- Up to $1K per year for employee professional development

- Stock options - we are all owners!

Individual compensation decisions are based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience and qualifications and local market conditions. Please note, the foregoing salary range does not reflect an employee’s total compensation package, which may include bonus, company equity, and health benefits.

AutoFi is an equal opportunity employer. Individuals seeking employment are considered without regards to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or other protected status under all applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.

Personal Information submitted as part of your application is subject to our website privacy policy, located at https://www.autofi.com/privacy-policy/

jobs.title: Medical Director, Clinical Development(Nephrology)
jobs.description:
About Jade Biosciences

Jade Biosciences is a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on developing best-in-class therapies that address critical unmet needs in autoimmune diseases. Jade’s lead candidate, JADE101, targets the cytokine APRIL, and is currently being evaluated for the treatment of immunoglobulin A nephropathy. Jade’s pipeline also includes JADE201, an afucosylated anti-BAFF-R monoclonal antibody, as well as JADE301, an anti-IFN-β monoclonal antibody. Jade was launched based on assets licensed from Paragon Therapeutics, an antibody discovery engine founded by Fairmount. For more information, visit JadeBiosciences.com and follow the Company on LinkedIn.

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced and mission-driven Medical Director in Clinical Development to lead and support clinical programs in nephrology, with a focus on rare or immune-mediated kidney diseases. This role is ideal for a physician-scientist who thrives in a small biotech environment where agility, cross-functional collaboration, and scientific leadership are essential. The Medical Director will play a key role in advancing Jade’s pipeline through clinical development. This newly created position will report to the Executive Medical Director of Clinical Development. This is a fully remote role and will require some travel.

Key Responsibilities

Clinical Development

  • Lead the design, execution, and oversight of clinical trials in nephrology, including protocol development, study monitoring, and data interpretation.
  • Serve as Medical Monitor for ongoing trials, ensuring patient safety and scientific integrity.
  • Collaborate with clinical operations, regulatory, and biometrics teams to ensure trial success and compliance.
  • Educate and advise clinical sites/investigators to support enrollment and optimal study conduct, including presenting at investigator meetings and/or site initiation visits, and serving as the medical point of contact for site staff questions about patient eligibility, and providing input into patient safety assessment and management
  • Provide medical expertise and support to external partners, vendors, and contractors as required to ensure smooth program execution
  • Communicate effectively, orally and in writing, with internal and external stakeholders regarding the assigned clinical program, including the CMO, CEO, external medical experts and others.

Regulatory and Scientific Contributions

  • Contribute to the preparation of regulatory documents (INDs, NDAs, briefing documents, etc.).
  • Support interactions with regulatory authorities and ethics committees.
  • Stay current with scientific literature and competitive landscape in nephrology and related fields.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with translational science, biomarker, and commercial teams to align clinical strategy with broader company goals.
  • Provide medical input into lifecycle planning and early market preparation.

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Begin building relationships with key opinion leaders (KOLs), investigators, and advocacy groups in nephrology.
  • Represent the company at scientific meetings, advisory boards, and industry events.

Qualifications

  • MD (or equivalent medical degree); board certification in nephrology strongly preferred.
  • 3+ years of experience as a nephrologist in academia or industry, and/or experience in nephrology clinical trials or rare disease programs.
  • Experience in clinical trial design, execution, and medical monitoring.
  • Strong clinical judgment, scientific rigor, and regulatory knowledge.
  • Ability to work independently and thrive in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence and motivate cross-functional teams, manage a diverse set of stakeholders, and work closely with team leaders
  • High ethical standards and impeccable integrity
  • Exercise sound judgment in managing complex, confidential, and regulated information.

Position Location

This is a remote role; periodic travel to team and company events is required.

The anticipated salary range for candidates for this role is $270,000 - $300,000. The final salary offered will depend on several factors, which may include, but not limited to, relevant years of experience, educational background, and geography.

As part of the I-9 verification of authorization to work in the United States, Jade Bioscience participates in E-Verify. To learn more about E-Verify please review this poster.

Jade Biosciences is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Security Engineer
jobs.description:
About Latent

Latent is the enterprise pharmacy intelligence platform, powered by a clinical agentic engine, that enables health systems to grow their pharmacy operations and serve more patients. One engine works across the pharmacy journey to identify patients who qualify for care, improve medication access, capture eligible prescriptions and support patients throughout treatment. Latent’s platform enables more than 60 leading health systems that collectively serve an estimated 70 million people. Founded by Sriram “Sri” Somasundaram and Rishabh Jain, Latent has raised $80 million from Transformation Capital, Spark Capital, Conviction, General Catalyst, Y Combinator, and others.

The Role

We’re building the intelligence layer of American healthcare. Our systems sit directly in critical workflows and power how clinical AI is delivered and used in practice. You’ll be working on securing all aspects of Latent’s code, cloud, AI, and IT systems. You will be partnering with all Latent employees across engineering, product, legal, and GTM to safely enable Latent employees to move quickly without sacrificing security and compliance.

What You'll Do

You’ll be a Security generalist, helping define, lead, and execute the roadmap in all aspects of Security. Here are some of the areas you will work in:

  • Cloud Security
    Mature and harden Latent’s cloud environment from a security and compliance standpoint into a secure-by-default stance so developers can ship code with confidence and the Infrastructure team doesn’t have to worry that their next Terraform apply will put everything on the open internet.

  • AI Security
    Employees at Latent use a lot of AI. Help us give all of our employees access to the latest and greatest AI-powered tools in a secure and compliant way so our agents don’t run amok and do the wrong thing.

  • Data Security
    Latent’s business thrives on giving our users deep insights into their patient data, their pharmacy performance, and how our AI is performing. Help us secure our data warehouse so that our internal employees and customers get the insight they need without sacrificing our commitment to patient security and privacy.

  • Application and Product Security
    Latent’s developers ship a lot of code. Help us come up with ways to automate all aspects of the SDLC from a security perspective to ensure security is built in instead of being a bolt-on afterwards. In addition, as Latent plans the next iteration of its application and agentic platform, help us come up with the right security requirements for new product features and enhancements.

  • IT Security
    Help our hard-working IT folks secure Latent employee devices and applications. Automate security around IT and business applications including user lifecycle provisioning, just-in-time access, elevated access provisioning, and device hardening to ensure employees can do their job securely without thinking about security.

  • Incident Detection and Response
    Help the Security team investigate potential incidents, build detections that are specific to Latent’s environment, and work with our AI-native MDR service to improve accuracy around escalated incidents.

What We're Looking For

You’re a builder who holds yourself and others to high standards. You can design, develop, and create security automations and workflows using AI that can scale Latent’s security team.

  • Ownership: You don’t hand off problems or wait for someone to tell you what to do. Find our gaps, risks, and vulnerabilities and implement the solution.

  • Bias for Action: You won’t wait for someone else to solve a problem you’re in a position to solve.

  • A Yes Mindset: Latent’s Security team is not a no factory. While we put our foot down when the risk is high, our goal is to find creative solutions that 1) Understand what an employee actually needs and 2) That balances speed and security.

  • Automation Mindset: You’re always looking for ways to move faster by automating repetitive or manual work.

  • Complexity Management: You’re good at planning and building the simplest solution that gets the job done, with an eye towards the future as Latent scales quickly. You can take a complex and large product and break it down into focused, iterative steps that incrementally make our security and compliance posture better.

  • Product Focus: You’re comfortable working closely with the customers that use Latent’s security program: Latent’s employees! You love sitting alongside folks from all areas of the company, understanding their day to day, and crafting the perfect solution for them both now and in the future.

Technical Qualifications

We really are looking for a little bit of a unicorn and someone who has done it all when it comes to security. If you’ve worked in multiple of these areas, this is the place for you!

  • You aren’t afraid to use coding agents to contribute solutions directly to the code base! (You don’t have to be a coding wizard Harry, but you do need to understand basic engineering principles to give your coding agent positive feedback if it spits out the wrong solution)

  • You’ve built out IAM workflows (Okta, SSO, SAML, JIT provisioning) to give employees just the right amount of access to get their job done

  • You’ve designed and rolled out managed settings for AI tools and coding agents to make sure employees have a good sandbox to work in to get their jobs done with AI

  • You have collaborated with developers to help them write secure code and secure features.

  • You’ve helped harden AWS cloud and CI/CD environments (Think well-scoped IAM roles, hardening cloud environments to CIS standards, picking the right CSPM and driving down a findings backlog ect..)

  • You’ve helped build and maintain a vulnerability management program all the way up the stack (Server/Container/3rd Party OSS/Custom Code)

  • You’ve automated security and compliance requirements for MacOS and BYOD endpoints using an MDM

  • You understand your way around a security alert, security investigation, and can write and tune detections that are relevant to Latent’s environment

Nice to Have

  • You have experience working at an early stage startup doing security

  • You’ve worked with healthcare data before and can speak a little HIPAA

  • You’ve participated in or built controls for SOC2 audits

Why Join Latent

  • Backed by top-tier investors including General Catalyst, Conviction, and Y Combinator

  • Work alongside a high-caliber team building products our healthcare partners love

  • Work on mission-critical problems at the intersection of AI and healthcare

  • Real ownership and visibility

  • High-impact role on a small, fast-growing team

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents

  • Flexible PTO policy

  • Paid parental leave

  • Fertility and family-building stipend through Carrot

jobs.title: Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW)
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Staff Security Operations Specialist, LeapSec
jobs.description:
Company Description

Workleap is a Montreal-based tech company, founded in 2006. We're builders at heart, we make simple products that actually matter to the people who use them. We have two product lines: Workleap Agent, our newest solution built to make every manager more effective, and ShareGate, the world's leading solution for Microsoft 365 migration and governance. More than 15,000 companies worldwide trust us to do exactly that. We're intentional about who joins us. If you're the kind of person who gets excited by a hard problem and wants to help shape what comes next, there's a place for you here.

Your role

You will own how Workleap detects, investigates and responds to threats across Workleap and ShareGate, and you will build the AI layer that runs it. Our security tooling generates more noise than a small team can work, and too many findings are ambiguous or wrong. This role exists now to turn detection and response into a system where agents triage, enrich and investigate, and people make the calls that genuinely need judgment. It is a hands on Staff individual contributor role with no direct reports.

Your impact:

  • Build the pipeline that runs security operations end to end: integrations that pull alerts and findings out of every source tool, an agentic system that triages, enriches, correlates and drafts the investigation, and a connection into Jira that routes each result to the owning team with evidence and a fix path, so no finding is ever copied by hand.
  • Define the trust model for those agents, deciding what they close alone, what they recommend and what always goes to a human, backed by evals and secured against prompt injection and permission abuse.
  • Drive false positives and misrated findings out of our security tooling, so every finding that reaches a person is real and correctly prioritized.
  • Own detection engineering end to end, written as code and mapped to MITRE ATT&CK, so coverage survives any change of platform.
  • Lead security incident response from triage to postmortem, with agents gathering the evidence, and hold our managed detection partner to a measurable standard.
  • Make security a partner developers want to work with, delivering findings in their workflow with clear evidence and a fix path.

Your team

Over the next 12 months, LeapSec is delivering two strategic bets: putting security inside product squads, with agents carrying vulnerability and detection work, and automating SOC 2 evidence so nobody gathers it by hand. You will own the detection and response side of that work: cleaning up the tooling, building the agents, and proving how much they can be trusted to do alone.

LeapSec covers Security Operations and Compliance across Workleap and ShareGate. You will report to the Director of Infrastructure and Security and work daily with our Staff Application Security Specialist and security tooling team, and as needed with Infrastructure, ITX and product engineering. We are a small team with a wide mandate: we track work honestly in Jira, deliver on fixed dates, and expect people to own outcomes end to end.

Our environment is Azure first, with a cloud native SIEM and XDR stack, Zscaler, Cloudflare and a managed detection partner today. We choose tools on merit and expect to keep choosing.

What you'll bring

  • 7+ years in security operations, incident response or detection engineering, with recent hands on time in a cloud SaaS environment;
  • Deep experience working findings that are not clean: validating what tooling flags, tuning false positives out at the source, and deciding with incomplete evidence whether something is real;
  • Years of working directly with developers, getting fixes shipped without authority and keeping the relationship intact when the answer is no;
  • Built and shipped agent systems for security work that others depend on, such as MCP servers, Claude skills, subagents or custom tools, with evals that decide when the output is trusted;
  • A working model of how agentic systems fail and get attacked, including prompt injection, tool permission scoping and credential handling;
  • Detection engineering as a discipline: detections as code, a SIEM query language you write fluently, and false positive rates you actually measure;
  • Strong grasp of identity and cloud attack paths, ideally in Azure and Entra ID;
  • Bonus: experience directing a managed detection partner, threat hunting or forensics, and working proficiency in French.

Most of this sounds like you? Apply.

What the job comes with

  • Base salary: $140 000 - $190 000. This range reflects our Canada-wide compensation scale. Final offers may be adjusted based on the candidate's region to align with local market conditions.
  • Annual bonus program.
  • LTIP program, share in Workleap's long-term growth.
  • RRSP + Family health insurance + telemedicine + annual wellness budget.
  • Flexible vacation policy.
  • Remote work, with access to our Montreal office.
  • In-person gatherings twice a year.
  • Claude access, for everyone.

What drives us

At Workleap, we build software that sits at the center of how people experience work, every day, at every level.

We move fast. Priorities shift, decisions get made with the information we have, and we iterate. If you thrive on intensity and ambiguity doesn't slow you down, you'll feel right at home.
We're builders. We do what it takes to move forward. AI is part of our toolkit. We use it to go faster and decide smarter, not to replace judgment.

If you want real impact and a place where your decisions matter, this is it.

How we hire

Transparency is how we hire — for you as much as for us.

Here's how it works: a first call with a recruiter, then a virtual interview with the hiring manager. You'll then complete a take-home case study, followed by a meet with future colleagues to discuss it together. Depending on the role, the process may vary slightly — your recruiter will walk you through it on your first call.

We use AI to support certain steps of the process, but every hiring decision remains human.

We can't wait to meet you.

By applying, you confirm that you have read and agree to our privacy policy.
