jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist - Personalization & Predictions
jobs.description:
Bloomreach is building the world’s premier agentic platform for personalization.We’re revolutionizing how businesses connect with their customers, building and deploying AI agents to personalize the entire customer journey.

  • We're taking autonomous search mainstream, making product discovery more intuitive and conversational for customers, and more profitable for businesses.
  • We’re making conversational shopping a reality, connecting every shopper with tailored guidance and product expertise — available on demand, at every touchpoint in their journey.
  • We're designing the future of autonomous marketing, taking the work out of workflows, and reclaiming the creative, strategic, and customer-first work marketers were always meant to do.

And we're building all of that on the intelligence of a single AI engine — Loomi — so that personalization isn't only autonomous…it's also consistent.From retail to financial services, hospitality to gaming, businesses use Bloomreach to drive higher growth and lasting loyalty. We power personalization for more than 1,400 global brands, including American Eagle, Sonepar, and Pandora.

You'd be joining the Artificial Intelligence team. We own the algorithmic core of the platform: Predictions, Contextual Personalization, contextual bandits, autosegmentation, and the agentic workflows behind Loomi. We work with behavioural data at terabyte scale, across 1,400+ customers, in production, every day. We are currently allowing flexibility for our employees to work from anywhere for the respective region (Central & Eastern Europe) or we are happy to meet you in our offices in Bratislava (Slovakia) or Brno, Prague (Czechia) on a full-time basis.

The mission

You find the signal in how 1,400 brands' customers actually behave — and you prove it moved a business metric. Your models decide which customers are predicted to churn, which segments form themselves, which offer a shopper sees, and whether the discount changed anything or was going to convert anyway.

What you'll actually do

  • Frame the problem before modelling it. Most of our highest-impact work arrives as a vague business question, and turning it into something measurable is the first job.
  • Work the data at scale. Behavioural data, product catalogues and event streams across BigQuery and Databricks — finding features that carry real predictive signal, not the ones that are easy to compute.
  • Build and evaluate models across Predictions and Contextual Personalization: propensity and churn, contextual bandits, autosegmentation, uplift and incrementality.
  • Design the evaluation, not just the model. Offline metrics, backtests, and the A/B design that decides whether this ships. You own the question "how would we know if this is worse?"
  • Bring methods in from outside and judge them honestly — read the literature, run the quick PoC, and tell a real result from a well-marketed one.
  • Hand off cleanly to ML Engineering. You own the model and the evidence; they own making it survive production. That handoff is a document and a conversation, not a notebook over a wall.
  • Explain your results to people who aren't data scientists — Product, Engineering leadership, and sometimes customers.

What success looks like after 12 months

  • Two models you built are in production and you can name the business metric each one moved.
  • A question the team was arguing about is settled, with evidence, and your writeup is what people link to.
  • ML Engineering describes your handoffs as easy.

This role bends in three directions

We'd rather shape it around you than the other way round.

  • Modelling & data science — features, experiments, and whether the number means anything.
  • ML product engineering — you own an ML-powered feature end to end and the ML part is what makes it interesting.
  • Platform & MLOps — pipelines, serving, deployment, observability, inference cost.

Most people lean one way and dip into the others. This opening is centered on the first. If you'd rather own the serving path, latency and reliability, our Senior AI/ML Engineer opening (in Czechia or Slovakia) is the better fit, and applying to both is fine.

What you'll need

  • 5+ years building ML models that shipped and were used by someone other than you — in industry, not only in research or coursework.
  • Strong Python and genuinely strong SQL. You should be comfortable being handed a warehouse and finding your own way around it.
  • Solid grounding in classical ML — tree-based models, regression, classification, clustering — and the judgement to know when the simpler model is the right answer.
  • Real rigour on experiment design and evaluation. You know why a metric moved, and when it didn't move for the reason everyone assumes.
  • Comfort on a cloud data platform — we work in GCP (BigQuery) and Databricks, but the principles transfer.
  • A quantitative degree, or equivalent practical depth.
  • Working English, written and spoken.

Plus real depth in at least one of:

  • Causal inference and uplift modelling — separating who converts because of an intervention from who would have converted anyway.
  • Contextual bandits, sequential decision-making, or off-policy evaluation.
  • Ranking, recommendation or information retrieval.
  • LLM evaluation, or applied work with the GenAI stack.

Also good: you use agentic coding tools daily and have a view on where they help and where they quietly don't. We build agents for a living, and people who use them tend to have better instincts about them.

#LI-KP1

The pay range actually offered will take into account a variety of potential factors considered in compensation, including but not limited to skills, qualifications, geographic location, accomplishments, experience, credentials, internal equity and business needs, and may vary from the range listed above.

Base Salary Range

1 470 000 Kč—1 830 000 Kč CZK

More things you'll like about Bloomreach:

Culture:

  • A great deal of freedom and trust. At Bloomreach we don’t clock in and out, and we have neither corporate rules nor long approval processes. This freedom goes hand in hand with responsibility. We are interested in results from day one.

  • We have defined our 5 values and the 10 underlying key behaviors that we strongly believe in. We can only succeed if everyone lives these behaviors day to day. We've embedded them in our processes like recruitment, onboarding, feedback, personal development, performance review and internal communication.

  • We believe in flexible working hours to accommodate your working style.

  • We work virtual-first with several Bloomreach Hubs available across three continents.

  • We organize company events to experience the global spirit of the company and get excited about what's ahead.

  • We encourage and support our employees to engage in volunteering activities - every Bloomreacher can take 5 paid days off to volunteer*.

  • The Bloomreach Glassdoor page elaborates on our stellar 4.7/5 rating. The Bloomreach Comparably page Culture score is even higher at 4.9/5

Personal Development:

  • We have a People Development Program - participating in personal development workshops on various topics run by experts from inside the company. We are continuously developing & updating competency maps for select functions.

  • Our resident communication coach Ivo Večeřa is available to help navigate work-related communications & decision-making challenges.*

  • Our managers are strongly encouraged to participate in the Leader Development Program to develop in the areas we consider essential for any leader. The program includes regular comprehensive feedback, consultations with a coach and follow-up check-ins.

  • Bloomreachers utilize the $1,500 professional education budget on an annual basis to purchase education products (books, courses, certifications, etc.)*

Well-being:

  • The Employee Assistance Program -- with counselors -- is available for non-work-related challenges.*

  • Subscription to Calm - sleep and meditation app.*

  • We organize ‘DisConnect’ days where Bloomreachers globally enjoy one additional day off each quarter, allowing us to unwind together and focus on activities away from the screen with our loved ones.

  • We facilitate sports, yoga, and meditation opportunities for each other.

  • Extended parental leave up to 26 calendar weeks for Primary Caregivers.*

Compensation:

  • Restricted Stock Units or Stock Options are granted depending on a team member’s role, seniority, and location.*

  • Everyone gets to participate in the company's success through the company performance bonus.*

  • We offer an employee referral bonus of up to $3,000!

  • We reward & celebrate work anniversaries -- Bloomversaries!*

(*Subject to employment type. Interns are exempt from marked benefits, usually for the first 6 months.)

Excited? Join us and transform the future of commerce experiences!

If this position doesn't suit you, but you know someone who might be a great fit, share it - we will be very grateful!

Any unsolicited resumes/candidate profiles submitted through our website or to personal email accounts of employees of Bloomreach are considered property of Bloomreach and are not subject to payment of agency fees.

jobs.title: Growth Account Executive
jobs.description:
About Neuroscale

Neuroscale is on a mission to transform hiring into a science. Our vision is to build the most intelligent recruiting platform in the world, where sourcing, screening, outreach, vetting, and hiring for the most ambitious companies on earth happen in one unified system, powered by AI that actually understands hiring. We built Arbi, the first end-to-end AI recruiting platform that connects companies with thousands of specialized recruiters and autonomous AI sourcing agents that work together to fill roles faster and more accurately. Pipeline is compounding. Customers range from startups to enterprises to the federal government. The category is being redrawn in real time, and we intend to own the pen.

About You

You are a person who craves impact. You want to leave a (big) dent on the world. You are generally disappointed in the bar held by most people every day. You feel smarter than everyone around you, yet that doesn't make you happy, it makes you sad that you aren't being pushed to think hard enough. You've sold before, and you've sold well, but you're tired of being a cog in someone else's revenue machine. You want to build the machine. You want your name attached to the deals, the content, the category.

The Role

We are hiring a Growth Account Executive to be a foundational voice of Neuroscale in the market. This is a hybrid role that fuses revenue ownership with content-driven distribution. You will close deals AND build the brand that makes those deals inbound by default.

This is not a traditional AE role. It is not a traditional growth role either. You will own deals through the full motion: converting customers through high-signal content and outbound, running deals end-to-end, and architecting the systems that future hires will run on. You will be a public face of Neuroscale on LinkedIn and across the recruiting community, the person on demos closing deals against legacy ATS and recruiting tech, and the operator who turns chaos into a repeatable engine.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role. If you need a playbook handed to you, this is not the job for you.

What You'll Own

  • Sales Execution. Carry a quota and beat it. Run the full cycle: qualification, demo, pilot, close. Convert inbound from free trials, demo requests, and content-driven traffic. Run targeted outbound to in-house TA teams, recruiting agencies, and RPOs that fit our ICP. Manage fast deal cycles across multiple customer types. Out-sell legacy ATS and recruiting tech in competitive evaluations against Greenhouse, Lever, Bullhorn, and the new wave of AI sourcing point solutions.

  • Awareness and Growth Strategy. Strategize and iterate with the founders on the best ways to build awareness of Neuroscale and Arbi. Bring sharp opinions on positioning, narrative, and which channels deserve real investment. Translate strategy into shipped experiments instead of slide decks.

  • Growth Experimentation. Design and run experiments to test new products, messages, and ICPs. Build lead magnets, content, and landing pages to validate hypotheses fast. Measure what works, kill what doesn't, and double down on the winners.

  • Customer Storytelling and Distribution. Surface the amazing hires happening on our platform and turn them into stories the market actually wants to consume. Build a personal and company presence on LinkedIn that Heads of TA, recruiting leaders, and HR operators want to follow. Spread customer wins through video, partner channels, influencers, and the broader recruiting community. Cover the industry's hot debates with a strong, opinionated point of view, and make Neuroscale the default voice in the AI recruiting conversation.

If this isn't you, don't bother applying.

Some Interesting Problems You Will Work On

  • Define how the AI recruiting category gets sold, in a market that didn't exist 24 months ago

  • Build a content engine that makes Neuroscale the most-followed voice in modern recruiting

  • Crack the GTM motion for a hybrid product that serves in-house TA, agencies, and RPOs simultaneously

  • Design the activation and conversion loops for a PLG motion in a space that has historically been sales-led

  • Help build the playbook that the next ten AEs run on

Compensation and Benefits

  1. $350K OTE (base + variable + bonus). Real compensation for people who do real work.

  2. Uncapped commission with aggressive accelerators. You get extra-rewarded as we grow.

  3. Health, Vision, and Dental. 50% reimbursed. We take care of the people who take care of the company.

  4. Generous PTO. We measure output, not hours. Take the trip.

  5. Remote or in-person. We have two modern campuses in Reston and Sterling, Virginia. Northern Virginia is what happens when defense money meets startup ambition. It's the SF of the east coast and we've planted our flag here.

  6. Generous relocation assistance if applicable, available after 90 days of employment.

  7. Direct access to the best. You will work alongside founders, operators, and advisors who have built and scaled real things. The learning curve here is not a perk line item but it might be the most valuable thing on this list.

The Team

  1. We are not a recruiting agency or consulting firm. We are not a "process first" company. We don't have a lot of BS meetings and we don't have a lot of managers. What we do have is a small, hungry, unreasonably talented group of people who move fast, think hard, and genuinely care about building something that matters.

  2. You will not be handed a lead list and a script. You will not be "onboarded" for three weeks. You will be thrown into the fire on day one, working directly with the founding team on positioning, pricing, narrative, and the deals that shape what Neuroscale becomes. You will be the primary commercial voice in customer conversations, one of the public faces on LinkedIn, and the person who makes sure our story actually lands.

  3. We move with urgency. And we hold ourselves to a standard that most people would find uncomfortable. This is not a job. It's a chance to do some of the most important work of your career, earlier than you thought possible, with people who will push you harder than anyone has before.

If that sounds like home, you already know what to do.

Equal Opportunity

Neuroscale is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, identities, and walks of life, including but not limited to race, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, and disability status.

jobs.title: Manager, Business Analytics
jobs.description:
At Veracyte, we offer exciting career opportunities for those interested in joining a pioneering team that is committed to transforming cancer care for patients across the globe. Working at Veracyte enables our employees to not only make a meaningful impact on the lives of patients, but to also learn and grow within a purpose driven environment. This is what we call the Veracyte way – it’s about how we work together, guided by our values, to give clinicians the insights they need to help patients make life-changing decisions.

Our Values:

  • We Seek A Better Way: We pursue bold ideas, embrace complexity, and keep pushing forward.
  • We Make It Happen: We act with urgency, deliver with excellence, and always find a way.
  • We Are Stronger Together: We engage with empathy, align around what's best for Veracyte, and celebrate as one team.
  • We Care Deeply: We show up with integrity, kindness, and respect for one another.

The Position:

The Manager, Business Analytics is a highly technical individual contributor within the Sales Operations & Business Analytics (SOBA) Center of Excellence. You will serve as a strategic analytics partner across Commercial, Operations, Finance, and other business functions, leveraging advanced analytics, statistical modeling, data science, and automation to improve operational performance, revenue realization, and business decision-making. The successful candidate combines deep technical expertise with strong business acumen, translating complex data into actionable insights that influence leadership decisions and drive measurable business outcomes. Working at the intersection of analytics, business intelligence, data engineering, and operational strategy, this individual partners closely with stakeholders across the enterprise to build scalable analytical solutions that enable data-driven decision-making.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the analytics lead supporting Commercial, Finance, Operations, and related organizational functions.
  • Act as a thought partner to operational and commercial leadership, helping prioritize analytical investments, define success metrics, and measure business outcomes.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure analytical solutions are aligned with strategic priorities and deliver measurable value to the business.
  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable analytical solutions using SQL, Python, Snowflake, Tableau, Power BI, and modern cloud-based data platforms.
  • Perform statistical analysis, forecasting, segmentation, hypothesis testing, predictive modeling, and exploratory data analysis to support business planning and operational decision-making.
  • Partner with Data Engineering, IT, and Master Data Management teams to define data requirements, improve data quality, optimize data pipelines, and enhance enterprise data architecture.
  • Build and maintain semantic data models, reusable datasets, KPI frameworks, and standardized metrics aligned with SOBA governance standards.
  • Support enterprise data governance initiatives by validating source system integrity, documenting metric definitions, monitoring data quality, and promoting reporting consistency.
  • Leverage AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics techniques where appropriate to improve forecasting accuracy, automate decision support, and uncover new business insights.

Who You Are:

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Information Systems, Analytics, or a related quantitative field.
  • 6-8+ years of experience in advanced analytics, business intelligence, data science, revenue analytics, or a similar technical analytical role.
  • Expert-level SQL skills, including complex joins, window functions, common table expressions (CTEs), query optimization, and dimensional data modeling.
  • Strong Python programming experience, including the use of libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, SciPy, StatsModels, Scikit-Learn, and data visualization frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts, ETL/ELT processes, data governance, and data quality management practices, including cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Redshift, Databricks, BigQuery, Azure Synapse, or similar technologies
  • Experience with Tableau, Power BI, or similar business intelligence platforms, including dashboard development and performance optimization.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze large, complex datasets and communicate findings through compelling narratives, insights, and recommendations.
  • Ability to independently manage ambiguous problems and deliver high-impact solutions in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience within diagnostics, laboratory services, healthcare technology, life sciences, or payer analytics environments.
  • Exposure to AI-enabled analytics, generative AI applications, workflow automation platforms, and emerging analytics technologies.
  • Experience partnering with executive stakeholders to influence strategic business decisions through data-driven insights.

Pay range

$130,000—$145,000 USD

What We Can Offer You

Veracyte is a growing company that offers significant career opportunities if you are curious, driven, patient-oriented and aspire to help us build a great company. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, and are committed to fostering an inclusive workforce, where diverse backgrounds are represented, engaged, and empowered to drive innovative ideas and decisions. We are thrilled to be recognized as a 2024 Certified™ Great Place to Work® in both the US and Israel - a testament to our dynamic, inclusive, and inspiring workplace where passion meets purpose.

About Veracyte

Veracyte (Nasdaq: VCYT) is a global diagnostics company whose vision is to transform cancer care for patients all over the world. We empower clinicians with the high-value insights they need to guide and assure patients at pivotal moments in the race to diagnose and treat cancer. Our Veracyte Diagnostics Platform delivers high-performing cancer tests that are fueled by broad genomic and clinical data, deep bioinformatic and AI capabilities, and a powerful evidence-generation engine, which ultimately drives durable reimbursement and guideline inclusion for our tests, along with new insights to support continued innovation and pipeline development. For more information, please visit www.veracyte.com or follow us on LinkedIn or X (Twitter).

jobs.title: Founding Member of Technical Staff
jobs.description:
About Neuroscale

Neuroscale is on a mission to fill the world’s most important roles.

Recruiting is a zero-sum game. The best people get hired once, and the teams that move fastest win. We build Arbi, an AI recruiting platform that combines autonomous agents with elite recruiters so world-class companies and federal agencies can hire well and grow fast.

Arbi searches 800M+ profiles, runs outreach, and interviews candidates at scale. Through every search, placement, and interaction on our platform, we capture proprietary hiring data that no one else has at scale, and that data powers the agentic systems we are building to make hiring faster, smarter, and more precise.

We believe AI will create more jobs, not less. As companies move faster with fewer constraints, they will hire more ambitiously and for roles that did not exist before, making the hiring layer more critical than ever.

We hold a USAF SBIR Direct-to-Phase-II contract, sell into federal through Carahsoft, and work with enterprise, federal, and regulated organizations that most AI startups cannot touch. Our second product, Athena, extends the same agent infrastructure into federal agency workflows.

We are a small, founder-led team and this is one of the first engineering seats.

About the Role

You will work directly with the founders on the hardest technical questions in the product:

  • How do we understand the nuance in a hiring requirement well enough to find the person a filter & criteria search never would?

  • How do we interview candidates at scale and turn those conversations into a data edge no public profile can give you?

  • How do agents decide who to reach out to, what to say, and when to hand off to a human?

  • How do we make a recruiter say “wow” in the first five minutes?

You will design, build, and ship features end to end, most of them built on LLMs. Recent work includes agent execution infrastructure, feedback loops that improve search quality from recruiter behavior, and multi-tenant deployment for regulated customers.

Our stack: Next.js + React, Node.js, Python FastAPI, OpenSearch (Elasticsearch), Temporal, and a range of inference providers and models.

About You

  • You have built something from scratch. A startup, a product, a system people depend on.

  • You ship. We care more about what you have built than where you have worked.

  • You are high agency. You find the highest-leverage problem, decide it is yours, and attack it.

  • You have shown excellence somewhere: work, school, open source, a side project that took off.

  • You take asymmetric bets. Joining a founding team is one of them.

  • You have real experience with the core of our stack: Next.js, Node.js, AWS, and search or data infrastructure.

  • Experience with LLM products, voice or conversational AI, or search at scale is a plus, not a filter.

  • Based in or willing to relocate to Northern Virginia. We build in person.

Why Founding

  • Direct ownership of core systems from day one. Your decisions become the architecture.

  • Meaningful founding equity. You should share in what you build.

  • Work on problems with real stakes: federal hiring, regulated industries, roles that matter.

  • A front-row seat to going from early traction to category leader.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Competitve salary plus meaningful founding equity.

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage.

  • Meals provided in office.

  • Relocation support for the right candidate.

jobs.title: Expansion Account Executive, Mid-Market

jobs.title: IP Counsel
jobs.description:
At Veracyte, we offer exciting career opportunities for those interested in joining a pioneering team that is committed to transforming cancer care for patients across the globe. Working at Veracyte enables our employees to not only make a meaningful impact on the lives of patients, but to also learn and grow within a purpose driven environment. This is what we call the Veracyte way – it’s about how we work together, guided by our values, to give clinicians the insights they need to help patients make life-changing decisions.

Our Values:

  • We Seek A Better Way: We pursue bold ideas, embrace complexity, and keep pushing forward.
  • We Make It Happen: We act with urgency, deliver with excellence, and always find a way.
  • We Are Stronger Together: We engage with empathy, align around what's best for Veracyte, and celebrate as one team.
  • We Care Deeply: We show up with integrity, kindness, and respect for one another.

The Position:

Veracyte is seeking an IP Counsel to drive IP risk management, with a focus on freedom-to-operate and invalidity analyses, and support technical transactions with significant IP components. This role partners across the business to translate complex IP considerations into practical guidance that supports innovation and strategic growth.

Key Responsibilities

  • IP Risk Identification and Mitigation
    • Drive freedom-to-operate and invalidity analyses to identify and mitigate IP risks throughout Veracyte products lifecycle and for strategic business initiatives.
    • Provide practical, business-oriented legal advice balancing legal risks with organizational objectives, including design-around opportunities, licensing strategies, and other risk mitigation approaches.
    • Contribute to the implementation of processes for proactive IP risk identification and mitigation.
    • Partner to manage pre-litigation issues, intellectual property disputes, oppositions, and other litigation matters.
  • Technology Transactions Support
    • Facilitate review, negotiations, and drafting of research collaboration, material transfer, technology evaluation, data use, licensing, and other agreements with substantial IP components.
    • Provide IP support for strategic collaborations, partnerships, and business development transactions.
    • Advise on IP ownership, licensing, data rights, publication rights, and other issues in research and development agreements.
  • Growth of Veracyte IP Program
    • Collaborate with other legal team members on development and continued enhancement of the company's IP program—including support for patent prosecution.
    • Serve as a trusted advisor to scientific, clinical, regulatory, commercial, and executive stakeholders.
    • Develop and deliver IP education and training programs to increase IP awareness across the organization.
    • Manage outside IP counsel and related legal budgets.

Who You Are:

You’re a strategic thinker business-oriented thinker with a collaborative mindset and infinite curiosity. You thrive in a fast-paced environment and are energized by complex challenges and meaningful work.

Required

  • J.D. or equivalent law degree with active bar membership.
  • Minimum of 5 years of relevant legal experience, including substantive work in life sciences IP (diagnostics, biotechnology, medical devices, pharmaceuticals, genomics, or related life sciences fields).
  • Demonstrated experience conducting and advising on freedom-to-operate and invalidity analyses—and ability to assess complex legal risks and develop practical, solution-oriented business recommendations.
  • Experience and interest in growing skills in transactional practice involving complex agreements with IP components. Interest in patent prosecution support is welcomed.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills.

Preferred

  • Scientific degree (including advanced degree) in a life sciences discipline.
  • Experience managing matters for diagnostics, molecular biology, genomics, or related industries.
  • Law firm training in FTO analysis, opinion work, and patent or technology transactions practice.
  • Patent bar membership.
  • Experience managing outside counsel.

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

SOCi is the leader in AI-powered marketing solutions for multi-location businesses. With its proprietary Genius AI™ and suite of Genius Agents™, SOCi provides a first-of-its-kind, AI-powered digital workforce capable of handling the workload of 1,000 local marketers™, empowering brands to achieve unmatched digital visibility, strengthen customer engagement, and scale faster than ever before.

SOCi is recognized by Fast Company as one of the World's Most Innovative Companies, and is trusted by nearly 1,000 top brands—including Ford, Ace Hardware, Kumon, Liberty Tax, and more—to automate and optimize local marketing tasks across all locations. Founded in 2012 and backed by leading strategic investors, SOCi is transforming how multi-location brands manage and scale their marketing efforts. You can view our Awards and Accolades here!

About the Role

We are seeking a highly organized, analytical, and process-oriented Revenue Operations Analyst to support our Customer Success, Sales, and Marketing organizations. This role will serve as a key operational partner across the customer lifecycle, helping teams operate efficiently through strong queue management, Salesforce administration and reporting, Customer Success operations, and cross-functional process management. The ideal candidate is comfortable working across multiple teams, can translate business needs into operational solutions, and has advanced Salesforce reporting skills. This person should be equally comfortable investigating an operational issue, building an executive-ready dashboard, coordinating a cancellation across multiple departments, and identifying opportunities to improve the underlying process.

Key Responsibilities

Revenue Operations Queue Management

  • Own the day-to-day management of the Revenue Operations request queue.
  • Review and triage incoming cases, determine priority and appropriate ownership, and route requests to the correct Revenue Operations team member or functional owner.
  • Manage assigned cases from intake through resolution, ensuring timely communication and appropriate follow-up with stakeholders.
  • Monitor queue health, aging, volume, and resolution times to ensure requests are addressed within established service-level expectations.
  • Identify recurring requests and issues that may indicate opportunities for process improvement, automation, documentation, or enablement.
  • Maintain clear documentation of case resolutions and operational changes.

Customer Success Operations

  • Serve as a primary Revenue Operations point of contact and operational partner for the Customer Success organization.
  • Partner with Customer Success leaders and team members to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable processes, reporting, and system improvements.
  • Support changes and enhancements to Salesforce and other Revenue Operations tools used by Customer Success.
  • Partner closely with Customer Success Enablement to ensure alignment and understanding of processes, tools, documentation, and enablement assets impacted by operational changes.
  • Help document and standardize Customer Success operational processes and identify opportunities to improve efficiency and scalability.
  • Support testing and quality assurance for system, workflow, and process changes before deployment.

Cancellation & Offboarding Operations

  • Manage and oversee the end-to-end customer cancellation process.
  • Coordinate across Customer Success, Implementation/Offboarding, Billing, Finance, and other stakeholders to ensure cancellations are processed accurately and on time.
  • Perform quality assurance throughout the cancellation process to ensure required information is complete, systems are updated appropriately, and downstream teams receive the information they need.
  • Identify and resolve discrepancies or process gaps that could impact customer offboarding, billing, reporting, or revenue data.
  • Maintain documentation and controls to ensure a consistent and auditable cancellation process.
  • Analyze cancellation trends and surface insights or recurring operational issues to Revenue Operations and Customer Success leadership.

Reporting & Analytics

  • Develop and maintain Salesforce reports and dashboards supporting Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Revenue Operations.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to understand reporting requirements and translate them into accurate, actionable reporting.
  • Provide Clari and CAP reporting to Customer Success leadership as needed.
  • Build recurring and ad hoc reporting to support leadership decision-making and operational reviews.
  • Perform quality assurance and validation of reporting to ensure data accuracy and consistency.
  • Investigate discrepancies across Salesforce and other revenue systems and partner with appropriate teams to resolve data issues.
  • Help establish consistent definitions and reporting methodologies for key revenue and customer metrics.

Salesforce & Data Management

  • Serve as a Salesforce reporting subject matter expert within Revenue Operations.
  • Build and maintain advanced Salesforce reports, dashboards, report types, filters, formulas, and related reporting solutions.
  • Support data quality initiatives by identifying incomplete, inconsistent, or inaccurate CRM data.
  • Partner with Revenue Operations and system administrators to recommend improvements to Salesforce fields, workflows, processes, and reporting structures.
  • Assist with user acceptance testing and quality assurance for Salesforce enhancements.
  • Help maintain documentation related to Salesforce processes, reporting definitions, and operational workflows.

Process Improvement & Operational Excellence

  • Identify opportunities to streamline manual processes and improve operational efficiency.
  • Document current-state and future-state processes, requirements, and standard operating procedures.
  • Partner cross-functionally to implement process improvements and measure their effectiveness.
  • Look for opportunities to reduce repetitive requests through automation, self-service reporting, documentation, and enablement.
  • Maintain strong attention to detail while balancing multiple requests, projects, and priorities.

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Customer Success Operations, Business Operations, or a related analytical/operational role.
  • Strong Salesforce experience with an advanced understanding of reports and dashboards.
  • Experience working with CRM data and translating business requirements into reporting or operational solutions.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to investigate data, identify trends, and communicate findings clearly.
  • Strong project and process management skills with the ability to manage work from intake through completion.
  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy and quality assurance.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively with stakeholders across multiple departments.
  • Ability to prioritize competing requests and operate effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Comfortable identifying problems, recommending solutions, and taking ownership through resolution.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting a SaaS or recurring-revenue business.
  • Experience supporting Customer Success operations and customer lifecycle processes.
  • Experience with Clari or similar revenue intelligence/forecasting platforms.
  • Experience with ticketing or case-management workflows.
  • Experience working with customer cancellation, offboarding, billing, or renewal processes.
  • Experience with data visualization or business intelligence tools.
  • Familiarity with revenue metrics including ARR, churn, retention, renewals, pipeline, and forecast reporting.
  • Experience identifying opportunities for workflow automation and operational scale.

SOCi expects to pay a base salary in the range of $60,000 to 80,000 CAD base salary. Within the range, individual pay is determined by factors such as job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

What SOCi Provides to You

  • Comprehensive Benefits Package (full-time permanent, non-contract roles only)
    • Health insurance plans, dental, and vision
    • Wellness incentives
    • 401(k) plan with employer match
  • Flexible Work Environment (full-time, non-contract roles only)
    • Flexible paid time off
    • Quarterly wellness days
    • Paid holidays
    • Unique employee engagement programs
  • Empowering Career Growth and Success

What’s Important at SOCi

Led by a team of industry experts, SOCi is leading the pack in agentic marketing for multi-location brands. Our passionate team of SOCialites work from home around the globe!
Our collaborative, dynamic culture allows our teams to work cross-functionally and optimize productivity. We are a fast-paced, agile environment where thought leadership and input are encouraged. If you are looking for a place where you can come and make a difference in the way enterprise organizations utilize social technology, then SOCi is for you. Visit soci.ai for more information.

  • Sales cycles move faster due to strong technical confidence and execution

  • 3-8+ years in Solutions Consulting, Sales Engineering, Technical Customer Success, Implementation or Onboarding, or a similar customer facing role in B2B SaaS

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with executive presence and strong storytelling ability

  • Thrive in a high-ownership, fast-paced startup environment with evolving priorities

  • Experience with ATS platforms such as Greenhouse, Lever, iCIMS, Workday, Taleo, SmartRecruiters, or BambooHR

  • Experience supporting enterprise customers, security reviews, and implementation constraints

  • Prior exposure to AI enabled products, automation platforms, or data heavy workflows

What’s in It for You

  • Be a foundational hire shaping how customers experience Neuroscale from day one

  • Work directly with Sales, Product, and Engineering to influence roadmap and growth

  • Zero bureaucracy, high trust, and a strong culture of ownership and execution

  • Base Salary: $100K–$150K

  • Performance bonus: Quarterly bonuses tied to clear milestones (demos, onboarding, etc)

  • Flexibility: Remote-first, flexible hours, and work-from-anywhere (digital nomad)

  • Growth path: Clear, fast-track path to a Head of Customer Success as we scale the team

Equal Opportunity

Neuroscale is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, identities, and walks of life — including but not limited to race, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, and disability status.

The Director, Customer & Partner Marketing will own the strategy and execution of marketing programs that drive customer expansion (cross-sell, upsell, and account growth), generate partner-sourced pipeline, and support retention. Programs span SOCi’s customers (multi-location brands, franchise organizations, and property businesses) and its partners (agencies, technology providers, and resellers).

Working closely with Account Management, Customer Success, Partnerships, Sales, and Product Marketing, this leader will develop targeted, data-driven campaigns that engage customer buying groups, create demand for additional SOCi solutions, and reinforce customer value. This leader will align with Sales, Account Management, and Customer Success leaders on where to focus limited marketing resources to hit expansion and partner pipeline targets.

This role requires a balance of strategic thinking, hands-on execution, and revenue accountability for expansion and partner-sourced pipeline goals, with a strong emphasis on using AI, automation, and data to drive performance and operational efficiency. The role directly manages two Demand Generation Managers and a Marketing Coordinator.

Responsibilities

Customer Growth, Expansion & Retention

  • Develop and execute customer marketing strategies that generate expansion pipeline, accelerate cross-sell and upsell opportunities, and support customer retention.
  • Partner with Account Management and Customer Success to align marketing programs with revenue targets, renewal priorities, and strategic account opportunities.
  • Work with Sales, Account Management, and Customer Success leaders to prioritize programs and allocate limited marketing resources against expansion and partner pipeline targets.
  • Build targeted, account-based campaigns that engage customer buying groups across multi-location brands, franchise organizations, and property businesses, identify new stakeholders, and create demand for additional SOCi solutions.
  • Lead customer lifecycle marketing, including targeted campaigns, nurture programs, webinars, events, and customer communications.
  • Use customer segmentation, account intelligence, and behavioral signals to deliver personalized marketing experiences and improve engagement.
  • Partner with Product Marketing to turn product launches and new-module releases into cross-sell and upsell campaigns, and help support customer advocacy programs (references, case studies, reviews) that provide proof points for expansion and partner campaigns.

Partner Marketing

  • Develop and execute co-marketing strategies with technology, integration, strategic, agency, and reseller partners to generate partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline.
  • Collaborate with Partnerships, Sales, and Product Marketing to build integrated campaigns, joint events, webinars, and content that expand SOCi's market reach.
  • Establish scalable partner marketing programs, processes, and measurement frameworks to maximize pipeline contribution and ROI.
  • Build partner enablement and channel programs (campaign-in-a-box assets, co-sell support, partner training, and funds management where applicable) that make it easy for agencies and resellers to promote and sell SOCi.

AI, Automation & Performance

  • Champion the use of AI and automation (including signal-based triggers, personalization, and content scaling) to improve campaign execution, personalization, targeting, and marketing efficiency.
  • Identify opportunities to automate workflows, accelerate campaign development, and scale high-performing programs.
  • Partner with Marketing Operations to establish KPIs and reporting for expansion pipeline, partner contribution, customer engagement, retention marketing, and revenue impact.
  • Analyze performance data to optimize campaigns, prioritize investments, and communicate actionable insights to leadership.

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Lead and develop a high-performing customer and partner marketing team (two Demand Generation Managers and a Marketing Coordinator), fostering accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  • Serve as a strategic partner to Account Management, Customer Success, Partnerships, Sales, and Product Marketing.
  • Own the customer and partner marketing budget and make transparent prioritization tradeoffs across competing requests from Sales, Account Management, and Customer Success.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of B2B SaaS marketing experience, with a strong background in customer growth, demand generation, or account-based marketing.
  • 5+ years in customer, expansion, or channel/partner marketing, including experience working with agency, technology, or reseller partners.
  • 3+ years of people management experience, with demonstrated success developing high-performing teams.
  • Proven track record of developing marketing programs that generate measurable pipeline and revenue, particularly through customer cross-sell and upsell initiatives.
  • Experience executing integrated, account-based, and retention-focused marketing programs targeting complex B2B buying groups.
  • Strong proficiency in marketing automation, CRM platforms (e.g., Marketo, Salesforce), and data-driven performance optimization, with hands-on experience building AI-enabled marketing workflows.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and cross-functional leadership skills, with the ability to translate strategy into measurable results.
  • Proven ability to align with Sales and Customer Success leadership and prioritize limited resources against competing demands.
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Preferred: experience marketing to multi-location, franchise, or local-business customers, or within a martech/agency ecosystem.

.

What SOCi Provides to You

  • Comprehensive Benefits Package (full-time permanent, non-contract roles only)
    • Health insurance plans, dental, and vision
    • Wellness incentives
    • 401(k) plan with employer match
  • Flexible Work Environment (full-time, non-contract roles only)
    • Flexible paid time off
    • Quarterly wellness days
    • Paid holidays
    • Unique employee engagement programs
  • Empowering Career Growth and Success

What’s Important at SOCi

Led by a team of industry experts, SOCi is leading the pack in agentic marketing for multi-location brands. Our passionate team of SOCialites work from home around the globe!
Our collaborative, dynamic culture allows our teams to work cross-functionally and optimize productivity. We are a fast-paced, agile environment where thought leadership and input are encouraged. If you are looking for a place where you can come and make a difference in the way enterprise organizations utilize social technology, then SOCi is for you. Visit soci.ai for more information.

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer, Search
jobs.description:
MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform for industrial and frontline teams. More than 15,000 customers, including McDonalds, Michaels, Cintas, Redimix, and U.S. LBM, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 16 million managed assets and 92 million completed work orders.

In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining Autodesk Operations Solutions, the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations. Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours.

About the Role
We’re starting a new Search team to make it easier for users find exactly what they need across MaintainX. You’ll play a critical role in designing, building, and scaling search infrastructure that reflects the unique shape of the MaintainX domain. This is a zero-to-one role. You’ll be scoping ambiguity, shipping usable search early, and evolving it with fast feedback loops. If you enjoy building systems from scratch, obsess over performance and relevance, and want your work to power daily decisions across industries, we’d love to talk.

What You'll Do:

  • Design and build MaintainX’s end-to-end search and retrieval platform — from indexing pipelines and ranking systems to AI-facing query layers.

  • Partner with product and domain experts to model search across core entities like work orders, assets, and procedures, ensuring high-relevance results.

  • Ship fast, iterate fast, launch early versions, gather feedback, and improve rapidly.

  • Operate and optimize distributed systems, ensuring reliability, performance, and scalability under real-world load.

  • Drive architectural decisions, balancing correctness, performance, and long-term maintainability.

  • Own integrations between search systems and upstream data sources.

  • Explore semantic search, vector retrieval, and AI-enhanced relevance using modern ML tooling.

  • On-call duties (currently business hours)

About You:

  • Hands-on experience designing, building, and operating production-grade search systems end-to-end — including indexing, query execution, relevance tuning, and infrastructure — using technologies such as Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Lucene, Solr, or similar.

  • Understanding of embeddings, chunking, and retrieval strategies.

  • Familiarity with search-specific tuning: analyzers, BM25, shard sizing, cluster health, and relevance optimization.

  • Comfort taking systems from implementation to deployment and production operation, working across backend services, data pipelines, and integration points as needed.

  • An expert level of English, both spoken and written, is required, as the individual will need to lead platform engineering managers across multiple teams, present technical priorities to executive stakeholders, and align with engineering leaders outside Québec on a daily basis.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience evaluating and improving search relevance using both qualitative analysis and quantitative metrics.

  • Experience shipping AI-powered or LLM-integrated backend systems

  • Comfortable using modern AI tools like GPT, Copilot, or Cursor to boost productivity and streamline development.

  • Understanding of multi-tenancy and data security, including ACLs, field-level access controls, and secure index partitioning.

  • Experience building observability and success metrics into systems to monitor performance, usage, and impact.

Our mission is to keep the physical world running. Factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses stay up because the people who maintain them have tools worth using. That is what we build.

Compensation and benefits. Base pay is one part of the package. Depending on the role, compensation may also include commission, an annual bonus and equity. Benefits differ by country. For roles in the United States, Autodesk’s benefits are described at benefits.autodesk.com. For roles in Canada and other countries, the plan differs on health coverage, retirement and leave, and your recruiter will walk you through it.

Belonging. We take pride in a culture where everyone can thrive. More at autodesk.com/company/global-belonging. More on where this is going: Autodesk CEO Andrew Anagnost on building the future of connected operations, and AOS SVP Stephen Hooper on welcoming MaintainX to Autodesk.

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer / Cloud Infrastructure Engineer - Cybersecurity
jobs.description:
About Truelogic

Qualifications and Job Requirements

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Containers & Orchestration: Strong knowledge of Docker and Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE).

  • Security Standards: Deep understanding of zero-trust security, IAM governance, and cloud compliance auditing.

What We Offer

  • Highly Competitive USD Pay: Earn an excellent, market-leading compensation in USD, that goes beyond typical market offerings.

  • Paid Time Off: We value your well-being. Our paid time off policies ensure you have the chance to unwind and recharge when needed.

  • Work with Autonomy: Enjoy the freedom to manage your time as long as the work gets done. Focus on results, not the clock.

  • Work with Top American Companies: Grow your expertise working on innovative, high-impact projects with Industry-Leading U.S. Companies.

Why You’ll Like Working Here

  • A Culture That Values You: We prioritize well-being and work-life balance, offering engagement activities and fostering dynamic teams to ensure you thrive both personally and professionally.

  • Diverse, Global Network: Connect with over 600 professionals in 25+ countries, expand your network, and collaborate with a multicultural team from Latin America.

  • Team Up with Skilled Professionals: Join forces with senior talent. All of our team members are seasoned experts, ensuring you're working with the best in your field.

Apply now!

jobs.title: Security Engineer, IAM
jobs.description:
Role Description

Security Engineers at Dropbox safeguard our digital ecosystem alongside a diverse team of professionals dedicated to protecting our products and users. Trusted by millions, our mission is to integrate security seamlessly into Dropbox, empowering confident collaboration.

In this role, you’ll build and operate the identity and access controls that help Dropbox employees, services, and AI agents access what they need securely. You’ll combine security engineering and automation to strengthen authentication and authorization, enforce least privilege, and simplify identity lifecycle management across our infrastructure. Working closely with Infrastructure, Corp Engineering, Developer Platform, and Incident Response, you’ll make secure access easier to use and maintain reliable IAM services as Dropbox adopts new AI tools and agentic workflows.

Our Engineering Career Framework is viewable by anyone outside the company and describes what’s expected for our engineers at each of our career levels. Check out our blog post on this topic and more here.

Responsibilities

  • Design, deploy, and operate IAM controls across Dropbox’s cloud and on-premises infrastructure
  • Design and implement secure identity, authentication, and authorization controls for AI agents and other non-human actors
  • Implement least-privilege access using RBAC, ABAC, permission boundaries, service control policies, and just-in-time access
  • Design secure integrations using SAML, OAuth 2.1, OpenID Connect, SCIM, and SPIFFE/SPIRE
  • Automate identity lifecycle processes to ensure access is granted, modified, and revoked promptly
  • Develop identity guardrails using infrastructure-as-code and policy-as-code
  • Build monitoring and alerting for anomalous authentication, privilege escalation, credential misuse, and unauthorized access
  • Partner with Incident Response to investigate identity-related incidents and rapidly revoke compromised access
  • Conduct security reviews and threat modeling for new identity architectures and integrations
  • Maintain IAM services with strong reliability, documentation, operational ownership, and on-call support

Many teams at Dropbox run Services with on-call rotations, which entails being available for calls during both core and non-core business hours. If a team has an on-call rotation, all engineers on the team are expected to participate in the rotation as part of their employment. Applicants are encouraged to ask for more details of the rotations to which the applicant is applying.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of security engineering experience, including substantial IAM or identity-security experience
  • Hands-on experience with Okta, Okta for AI Agents and Sailpoint, or comparable technologies
  • Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, least privilege, zero trust, and identity lifecycle management
  • Experience with SAML, OAuth 2.0/2.1, OpenID Connect, SCIM, and MFA
  • Experience designing RBAC or ABAC authorization models
  • Experience securing human and non-human identities, including services, workloads, automation, and CI/CD systems
  • Experience with agentic frameworks and MCP tool integration
  • Experience implementing access reviews, privileged-access controls, and joiner/mover/leaver workflows
  • Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language, such as Python, Go, Java, Ruby, or Bash
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code, policy-as-code, APIs, and security automation
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with workload identity technologies such as SPIFFE/SPIRE, Kubernetes service accounts, or cloud workload identity.
  • Experience securing identities and authorization for AI agents and other autonomous systems.
  • Experience with just-in-time access, zero-standing-privilege, or privileged-access management platforms.
  • Familiarity with identity threat detection and response.
  • Experience building IAM controls for multi-account cloud environments.
  • Familiarity with NIST SP 800-63, NIST SP 800-207, CIS benchmarks, and relevant identity-security guidance.
  • Experience supporting compliance programs such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or FedRAMP.
  • Security certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, or equivalent.
  • Contributions to the identity or security community through open-source projects, publications, or conferences.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

  • Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

Compensation

US Zone 1

This role is not available in Zone 1

US Zone 2

$193,500—$261,900 USD

US Zone 3

$172,000—$232,800 USD

jobs.title: General Manager, Communication, Media, Entertainment and Technology - US-Based
jobs.description:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

As the General Manager for Communication, Media, Entertainment, & Technology (CMET) at Toptal, you will be the visionary architect of our growth strategy in this dynamic industry. We’re seeking a hands-on leader with an entrepreneurial spirit who can inspire and scale a world-class team to drive exponential growth in our enterprise customer base.

In this high-impact role, you will collaborate with Senior Leadership to unlock transformative market opportunities and identify the highest-potential avenues for value creation. Your strategic insight and foresight will be pivotal in shaping the future of Toptal’s presence in the CMET landscape.

You will lead from the front, rolling up your sleeves to work directly with your sales team in forging and nurturing relationships with Fortune 500 companies. Your ability to strategically target and close deals will be integral to our success, positioning Toptal as a leader in the industry.

If you are a strategic thinker with a passion for driving growth, a knack for crafting compelling strategies, and the ability to execute at the highest level, we want to hear from you.

This is a remote position. Applicants must be authorized to work in the US at the time of hire. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Define strategy & execute tactics to acquire key target prospects while deepening strategic relationships with CMET portfolio clients.
  • Cultivate relationships with Senior leaders at accounts in your team’s portfolio.
  • Leverage your professional network connections to expand reach within your industry.
  • Develop hypotheses to drive the team’s Go-to-Market Strategy and expand Toptal’s presence within Communication, Media, Entertainment, & Technology.
  • Develop & prioritize industry-specific offerings in alignment with Category Service Leaders
  • Evaluate and evolve the team’s short-, medium-, and long-term plan to establish Toptal as the leading provider of professional services in the enterprise space.
  • Develop account prioritization criteria and work with members of the team to optimize account portfolios and engagement strategies.
  • Develop account plans and relationship maps by leveraging industry insights.
  • Lead a team of experienced Sales & Client Services professionals to expand Toptal’s professional services market share within the Communication, Media, Entertainment, and Technology industries.
  • Regularly meet with Sales Director & CMET team members to review KPIs, provide guidance to increase deal velocity, evaluate performance, and develop coaching plans.
  • Lead with both inspiration and accountability, establishing clear performance standards, providing direct feedback in real time, and driving execution through focused, consistent coaching.
  • Actively recruit new members to join our rapidly growing team

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard and integrate into Toptal.
  • Learn Toptal’s model, our value proposition, and our story.
  • Learn our sales method and our selling process.
  • Meet the team and understand targets and goals.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Build your initial GTM strategy for CMET in partnership with Services GMs, iterating based on feedback from clients while exercising discretion and independent judgment.
  • Get up to speed on your industry territory and understand priority focus areas at the portfolio level
  • Develop a performance cadence with the team to review key metrics (e.g., activity, conversion, etc.) and identify specific areas for improvement.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Roll out a focused industry strategy to align the team around clear goals, tactics, and go-to-market priorities across the CMET.
  • Scale growth with existing clients and have a defined strategy to procure high-potential net-new clients.
  • Engage with services stakeholders to develop coordinated strategies designed to accelerate and diversify growth while strengthening client relationships.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Secure initial traction within the CMET sector by closing new enterprise logos and expanding opportunities with existing clients, laying the groundwork for accelerated growth.
  • Assess current team structure and capabilities, making necessary changes to ensure the right team is in place to support near-term opportunity and long-term growth goals.
  • Establish clear team and individual performance objectives, aligning efforts around pipeline generation, sales velocity, and account development to drive early momentum.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Achieve quarterly and annual growth objectives by setting clear performance expectations across the team, leading business reviews, and coaching through deal cycles.
  • Demonstrate your ability to coach and develop the team to achieve ambitious goals while continuously improving pipeline health, close rates, and exceptional client outcomes.
  • Expand the team’s portfolio by securing five or more new Fortune 500 clients, deepen relationships with existing clients, and promote growth through Toptal’s suite of offerings.
  • Partner with Toptal Leadership to design and operationalize a 12-month growth plan for CMET through focused industry segmentation, strategic account targeting, and effective resource alignment.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree is required. Master’s degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field preferred.
  • 15+ years of experience in Professional Services, including 5+ years leading sales teams in Communication, Media, Entertainment, & Technology.
  • 5+ years of in-market experience running and managing an industry business unit. Must have current, deep industry relationships at the leadership level within CMET.
  • Experience establishing high-impact, revenue-generating commercial relationships, with a proven track record of success in building credibility across all levels of an organization. You can develop positive relationships across the business to partner on key initiatives and gain consensus on processes and strategies.
  • Minimum of 10 years experience building client portfolios of $20M+ with a blended team of hunters and farmers
  • A well-rounded understanding of emerging technologies and the ability to have an informed discussion about software delivery and development concepts with prospective clients.
  • Recent experience selling large, complex, multi-phase, managed technology projects to enterprise clients with $2B+ in annual revenue.
  • P&L experience with a strong understanding of business operations and management principles.
  • Skilled at fostering positive internal relationships to align stakeholders, build consensus, and drive forward key strategic initiatives.
  • Experience at a technology or hyper-growth company is strongly preferred.
  • Experience in an operationally rigorous environment with competing deadlines and fast-paced work product turnaround.
  • Ability to thrive and excel in a dynamic, fast-paced organization.
  • Professional maturity, solid EQ skills, and executive presence – you’re an adept storyteller with experience building long-term client relationships and influencing senior-level buyers.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to travel and engage with Toptal clients both inside and outside of your geographic location.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Essential Job Functions

  • Regularly and reliably attend scheduled virtual team meetings on camera.
  • Work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Use all required digital collaboration tools.
  • Prioritize and self-manage workflows and deadlines.

US FLSA Classification: Full-Time/Exempt

For candidates who meet the qualifications and job requirements listed above, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. In the US, Toptal’s benefit offerings include participation in a 401(k) retirement plan; medical, dental, and vision health insurance plans; basic life insurance coverage and short-term and long-term disability coverage; access to flexible spending, dependent care, and health savings accounts; access to telehealth virtual doctors; an employee assistance program; and flexible paid time off.

jobs.title: Technical Oversight - Processing
jobs.description:
About Pylon

America’s $13T mortgage market is one of the most important financial systems in the world. It underwrites the middle class and is the mechanism through which millions of families build wealth. But while every other financial instrument has been simplified to an API call, mortgages are still assembled by hand.

We started from zero and created the first vertically integrated mortgage platform that turns origination into a single API.

Publicly traded companies and the country’s largest originators are already building on Pylon. Revenue is compounding monthly. We’re backed by Peter Thiel, Conversion Capital, QED, Citi, Fifth Wall, and the founders of Ramp, Blend, and Mercury.

Working at Pylon isn’t for those seeking comfort. The people who thrive here have high agency, strong opinions, and a track record of delivering outcomes without direction. Many of us are former founders. We move quickly, challenge each other directly, and take full ownership of results. It’s hard work, but it will be worth it.

Join us in building America’s mortgage rails.

About the Role

We’re seeking a Technical Oversight - Processing with deep mortgage operations experience and strong independent judgment. This is not a traditional customer support or relationship-only role. You will act as a senior operational partner to our originating customers, owning issue resolution end-to-end and ensuring loans move cleanly, compliantly, and predictably through the lifecycle.

You will work directly with customers while collaborating closely with underwriting, processing, product, and engineering to reduce errors, prevent rework, and improve system-driven workflows. This role is ideal for someone who has worked inside the loan file, understands where mortgages break, and is motivated to help build scalable, automated systems that eliminate those failures over time.

We are not a traditional mortgage lender. If you’re excited about operating with rigor today while helping design the future of automated mortgage infrastructure, this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities

Client & Origination Ownership

  • Act as a operational point of contact for originating customers, owning issue resolution from identification through closure

  • Guide customers through the full loan lifecycle, providing clear, accurate direction on requirements, timelines, disclosures and next steps

  • Own the operational health of assigned loans end-to-end, ensuring files progress on schedule and close on time by proactively identifying blockers, driving resolution, and coordinating across internal teams and customers.

  • Proactively manage customer expectations to reduce inbound escalations and uncertainty

Operational Judgment & Risk Prevention

  • Independently evaluate loan scenarios to identify potential structural, disclosure, or compliance risks before they escalate

  • Catch missing, inconsistent, or incorrect inputs that could lead to redisclosures, delays, or downstream rework

  • Provide firm, professional guidance to customers when corrections or process adherence are required

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with underwriting, processing, and closing teams to ensure clean handoffs and aligned execution

  • Serve as a trusted escalation point, reducing leadership involvement by resolving complex or high-stakes issues directly

  • Coordinate with third-party vendors to ensure issues are addressed efficiently, quickly and accurately

Systems & Product Feedback

  • Identify recurring patterns, edge cases, and workflow gaps that impact loan quality or customer experience

  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering to help define requirements, guardrails, and operational acceptance criteria

  • Contribute real-world mortgage insight to improve automation, tooling, and system-driven decisioning

Documentation & Quality

  • Maintain clear, accurate documentation of customer interactions, decisions, and follow-ups

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer - Travel & Hospitality
jobs.description:
About Truelogic

At Truelogic we are a leading provider of nearshore staff augmentation services headquartered in New York. For over two decades, we’ve been delivering top-tier technology solutions to companies of all sizes, from innovative startups to industry leaders, helping them achieve their digital transformation goals.

Our team of 600+ highly skilled tech professionals, based in Latin America, drives digital disruption by partnering with U.S. companies on their most impactful projects. Whether collaborating with Fortune 500 giants or scaling startups, we deliver results that make a difference.

By applying for this position, you’re taking the first step in joining a dynamic team that values your expertise and aspirations. We aim to align your skills with opportunities that foster exceptional career growth and success while contributing to transformative projects that shape the future.

Our Client

The client is building a socially connected travel platform that enables users to discover, rent, and exchange homes through trusted personal networks.

The product combines elements of home sharing, social networking, payments, trust and safety, and home exchange. An initial mobile product has already been developed, and the company is preparing for a broader public launch, starting with approximately 200 homes in the United States.

The company is now entering its next phase, focused on strengthening the existing product, improving the user experience, expanding the web experience, and building a scalable foundation for future growth.

Job Summary

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Product Designer to help evolve an existing MVP into a polished, intuitive, and launch-ready product.

The designer will work closely with the Founders, technical leadership, and engineering team to review and improve the existing mobile experience, identify usability gaps, refine key user journeys, and translate product requirements into high-quality mobile and web designs.

The mobile product already has an MVP/beta application and existing Figma assets, while the web experience is less mature and will require more new design work.

This role requires strong product thinking and the ability to work with an imperfect existing product, challenge assumptions, and help distinguish launch-critical functionality from future enhancements. Business priorities and technical direction will be provided by the leadership team.

Responsibilities

  • Review and evolve the existing product and its Figma assets.

  • Collaborate with product and technical leadership to refine the existing MVP experience, identify UX gaps, and prioritize improvements for the initial US launch.

  • Translate business and product requirements into intuitive user flows and interfaces.

  • Improve and evolve the existing React Native mobile experience while designing new responsive web experiences aligned with the core mobile product.

  • Improve key product journeys, including:

    • Onboarding and account creation.

    • Home discovery.

    • Social and trusted-network interactions.

    • Home listing.

    • Booking and rental flows.

    • Home exchange.

    • Payments.

    • Messaging and communication.

    • Trust and safety workflows.

  • Identify usability inconsistencies and opportunities to simplify the current product.

  • Create wireframes, prototypes, high-fidelity designs, and reusable design components.

  • Maintain and evolve the product's design system.

  • Collaborate closely with engineers to ensure designs are feasible and accurately implemented.

  • Provide product design recommendations, challenge assumptions, and help leadership distinguish launch-critical UX improvements from future enhancements.

  • Help create a consistent experience across mobile and web.

  • Contribute to product documentation so future team members can understand key UX decisions and flows.

Qualifications and Job Requirements

  • Proven experience improving and evolving existing consumer products, ideally taking an MVP or beta product toward production or public launch.

  • Strong experience designing consumer digital products.

  • Excellent product thinking and UX fundamentals.

  • Strong proficiency in Figma.

  • Experience designing both mobile and responsive web applications.

  • Ability to work within an existing product rather than exclusively on greenfield projects.

  • Experience working directly with engineers and technical stakeholders.

  • Strong understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and design systems.

  • Comfortable operating in an early-stage environment where requirements continue to evolve.

  • Ability to balance product quality with the need to ship quickly.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience with travel, marketplaces, social platforms, booking products, or consumer marketplaces.

  • Experience designing payment or checkout flows.

  • Experience with social graphs, messaging, or community-driven products.

  • Experience working with React Native products.

  • Front-end development knowledge or the ability to collaborate closely with front-end engineers.

  • Experience with design-to-code or AI-assisted product development workflows.

  • Experience helping companies transition an early MVP into a scalable production product.

What We Offer

  • 100% Remote Work: Enjoy the freedom to work from the location that helps you thrive. All it takes is a laptop and a reliable internet connection.

  • Highly Competitive USD Pay: Earn an excellent, market-leading compensation in USD, that goes beyond typical market offerings.

  • Paid Time Off: We value your well-being. Our paid time off policies ensure you have the chance to unwind and recharge when needed.

  • Work with Autonomy: Enjoy the freedom to manage your time as long as the work gets done. Focus on results, not the clock.

  • Work with Top American Companies: Grow your expertise working on innovative, high-impact projects with Industry-Leading U.S. Companies.

Why You’ll Like Working Here

  • A Culture That Values You: We prioritize well-being and work-life balance, offering engagement activities and fostering dynamic teams to ensure you thrive both personally and professionally.

  • Diverse, Global Network: Connect with over 600 professionals in 25+ countries, expand your network, and collaborate with a multicultural team from Latin America.

Apply now!
